 $A5B2 CALL $7D98    ; Decode 9 graphic blocks, then substitute every other
                     ; byte via table $9A00
 $A5B5 CALL $7D00    ; Initialize IM 2 interrupt vector table and set light ISR
*$A5B8 LD HL,$A0B0   ; point to per-frame handler #R$A0B0 (light ISR)
 $A5BB LD ($FDFE),HL ; set ISR handler address
 $A5BE EI            ;
 $A5BF RET           ;

; Initialize both players' game state (lives, bombs, HUD)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8C0.
;
; .
;
; Sets up both players' game state (lives, bombs, HUD pointers) at the start of
; a new game.
@label=init_players
c$A5C0 LD A,$00      ;
 $A5C2 CALL $6498    ; Init menu screen
 $A5C5 LD HL,$9C79   ; {Zero player 1's 11-byte state block ($9C79)
 $A5C8 LD DE,$9C7A   ;
 $A5CB LD BC,$000B   ;
 $A5CE LD (HL),$00   ;
 $A5D0 LDIR          ; }
 $A5D2 LD HL,$9C85   ; {Zero player 2's 11-byte state block ($9C85)
 $A5D5 LD DE,$9C86   ;
 $A5D8 LD BC,$000B   ;
 $A5DB LD (HL),$00   ;
 $A5DD LDIR          ; }
 $A5DF LD A,$03      ; POKE 42464,N sets starting lives count
 $A5E1 LD ($9C88),A  ;
 $A5E4 DEC A         ;
 $A5E5 LD ($9C7C),A  ;
 $A5E8 LD A,$01      ;
 $A5EA LD ($9C76),A  ; set Active player
 $A5ED LD HL,$9C79   ; {HUD pointer for the active player ($9C77)
 $A5F0 LD ($9C77),HL ; }
 $A5F3 LD ($9C81),A  ;
 $A5F6 LD ($9C8D),A  ;
 $A5F9 LD A,$03      ; POKE 42490,N sets starting bomb count
 $A5FB LD ($9C82),A  ;
 $A5FE LD ($9C8E),A  ;
 $A601 LD A,$02      ; {Reset explosion-data index ($9C84/$9C90)
 $A603 LD ($9C84),A  ;
 $A606 LD ($9C90),A  ; }
 $A609 LD A,$00      ;
 $A60B LD ($9C7F),A  ;
 $A60E LD ($9C8B),A  ;
 $A611 RET           ;

; Initialize wave-group counters and load group data tables
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8C0.
;
; .
;
; Sets up everything a new wave needs: scatters the level's config row into the
; working pointers that the background, scenery and colour subsystems read each
; frame, and derives the enemy fire-rate and reload values from the player's
; difficulty fields. Finishes by initialising the wave, selecting the colour
; scheme and showing the credits screen.
@label=load_wave_config
c$A612 LD IX,($9C77)  ; {IX = the current player's record ($9C77); A = its
 $A616 LD A,(IX+$08)  ; wave-group id}
 $A619 LD ($9C68),A   ; Save wave-group id ($9C68)
 $A61C LD ($9C72),A   ; set Wave type / group id
 $A61F LD HL,$9C84    ; {Point at the explosion-data table ($9C84), stride 13
 $A622 LD DE,$000D    ;
 $A625 LD B,A         ; }
*$A626 ADD HL,DE      ; {Index 13-byte table at $9C84 for explosion data
 $A627 DJNZ $A626     ; }
 $A629 LD ($9C73),HL  ; set Explosion-data pointer
 $A62C LD A,$06       ; {Reset the wave's spawn budget ($9C6F = 6)
 $A62E LD ($9C6F),A   ; }
 $A631 LD A,(IX+$06)  ; {Index the per-level config table ($61D4) by the
 $A634 LD HL,$61D4    ; player's level index, stride 20
 $A637 LD DE,$0014    ;
 $A63A LD B,A         ;
 $A63B INC B          ; }
*$A63C ADD HL,DE      ; {Index 20-byte per-level table at $61D4
 $A63D DJNZ $A63C     ; }
 $A63F XOR A          ; {Clear the wave progress and bonus counters
 $A640 LD ($9C69),A   ;
 $A643 LD ($9C3F),A   ;
 $A646 LD ($9C6A),A   ; }
 $A649 DI             ; {Point SP at the config row so its fields can be popped
 $A64A LD ($A69B),SP  ; off in order}
 $A64E LD SP,HL       ; {SP-trick: pop level-config pointers (colour
 $A64F POP HL         ; scheme/level index/scenery script)
 $A650 LD ($9C57),HL  ;
 $A653 POP HL         ;
 $A654 LD ($9BA5),HL  ;
 $A657 POP HL         ;
 $A658 LD ($9BFD),HL  ;
 $A65B POP HL         ; }
 $A65C LD A,($9C72)   ; get Wave type / group id
 $A65F CP $03         ; {Adjust cursor if wave-type is 3
 $A661 JR NZ,$A667    ; }
 $A663 LD A,L         ; {Wave type 3 reads its colour scheme 4 bytes further
 $A664 ADD A,$04      ; into the row
 $A666 LD L,A         ; }
*$A667 LD A,(IX+$0A)  ; {Fire-rate baseline = difficulty (IX+$0A) * 8 + the
 $A66A ADD A,A        ; row's low byte
 $A66B ADD A,A        ;
 $A66C ADD A,A        ;
 $A66D ADD A,L        ; }
 $A66E JR NC,$A672    ; Clamp fire-timer high byte on overflow
 $A670 LD A,$FF       ;
*$A672 LD ($9C41),A   ; {Store the fire-rate baseline ($9C41/$9C40)
 $A675 LD A,H         ;
 $A676 ADD A,(IX+$0A) ;
 $A679 LD ($9C40),A   ; }
 $A67C POP HL         ; {Fire-timer reload value ($9C42/$9C43) and its high
 $A67D LD A,L         ; byte ($9C71)
 $A67E LD ($9C43),A   ;
 $A681 LD ($9C42),A   ;
 $A684 LD A,H         ;
 $A685 LD ($9C71),A   ; }
 $A688 POP HL         ; {Screen/timing pokes ($5B56, $C2E1 and $5B7A)
 $A689 LD A,L         ;
 $A68A LD ($5B56),A   ;
 $A68D SRL A          ;
 $A68F LD ($C2E1),A   ;
 $A692 LD A,H         ;
 $A693 LD ($5B7A),A   ; }
 $A696 LD ($9BA7),SP  ; SP now points at the row's wave-tag threshold table;
                      ; keep it ($9BA7)
 $A69A LD SP,$0000    ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP (patched by $A64A)
 $A69D EI             ; {An easier difficulty (4+ bombs) earns an extra bonus
 $A69E LD HL,$9C40    ; step
 $A6A1 LD A,(IX+$09)  ;
 $A6A4 CP $04         ; }
 $A6A6 JR C,$A6A9     ; Bump bonus counter past difficulty threshold
 $A6A8 INC (HL)       ;
*$A6A9 LD A,(IX+$03)  ; {So does still holding 3+ lives
 $A6AC CP $03         ; }
 $A6AE JR C,$A6B1     ; Bump bonus counter past second threshold
 $A6B0 INC (HL)       ;
*$A6B1 CALL $B730     ; Initialize wave
 $A6B4 CALL $A4E7     ; Find level index from formation tag, reset state,
                      ; select colour scheme
 $A6B7 CALL $6A88     ; Show credits screen
 $A6BA RET            ;

; Show title screen and credits (attract sequence)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8C0.

; .
;

@label=show_title_attract

                     ; 1987"

 $A6C5 CALL $A5A0    ; Start music track 0

                     ; ROBINSON, GRAPHICS BY JOHN CUMMING, MUSIC BY STEVE
                     ; TURNER"

 $A6E2 DJNZ $A6DD    ;
 $A6E4 RET           ;

 $A702 LD A,$FE      ;

 $A708 LD A,($9CC7)  ;

 $A70D ADD A,$07     ;
 $A70F LD ($9CC7),A  ;
 $A712 LD A,$20      ;
 $A714 POP HL        ;
 $A715 CALL $6663    ; Print packed-BCD number with leading-zero suppression
 $A718 POP BC        ;
 $A719 DJNZ $A6F5    ;
 $A71B LD A,$00      ;
 $A71D LD ($9C59),A  ; set Active colour scheme
 $A720 CALL $C6A6    ; Screen wipe transition effect
 $A723 LD B,$06      ;
 $A725 LD E,$02      ;
 $A727 LD C,$87      ;

; Handle player death (respawn, or Game Over if out of lives)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8C0.
;
; .
;
; Redraws the HUD, waits for the controls to be released, then dispatches the
; player's next state through the #R$A02E sub-table.
@label=handle_player_death
c$A773 CALL $6771    ; Update player's HUD panel
 $A776 CALL $6971    ; Wait for input
 $A779 LD A,($9C3E)  ; {wait for frame-done flag $9C3E, run state table at
 $A77C LD HL,$A02E   ; $A02E
 $A77F CALL $B7F6    ;
 $A782 RET           ; }

; Player death-check entry (mid-point of $A773, skips input/frame update)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $1B of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
c$A783 LD IX,($9C77)   ; load player object pointer into IX
 $A787 INC (IX+$05)    ; increment death/state counter at IX+5
 $A78A LD (IX+$08),$01 ; {init respawn state fields IX+8=1, IX+9=3
 $A78E LD (IX+$09),$03 ; }
 $A792 LD A,(IX+$03)   ; {check lives-remaining field at IX+3; skip Game Over
 $A795 AND A           ; if lives left
 $A796 JR NZ,$A7C9     ; }
; Out of lives, Game Over.
 $A798 PUSH IX         ; save IX
 $A79A LD A,$11        ; "GAME OVER"
 $A79C CALL $6648      ; Print message N from table $627A
 $A79F LD A,$0A        ; {position first Game Over text line (row $0A, col
 $A7A1 LD C,$90        ; $90/8)
 $A7A3 LD E,$08        ; }
 $A7A5 CALL $6778      ; Paint attribute colour-wipe column
 $A7A8 LD A,$0A        ; {position second Game Over text line (row $0A, col
 $A7AA LD C,$40        ; $40/8)
 $A7AC LD E,$08        ; }
 $A7AE CALL $6778      ; Paint attribute colour-wipe column
 $A7B1 CALL $6989      ; Check for new high score, congratulate and reset
                       ; defaults if so
 $A7B4 POP IX          ; {restore IX, re-init player state
 $A7B6 CALL $A7D7      ; }
 $A7B9 LD A,$09        ; {set active-object type $9C59=9
 $A7BB LD ($9C59),A    ; }
 $A7BE CALL $C6A6      ; Screen wipe transition effect
 $A7C1 LD A,(IX+$03)   ; {check IX+3 sign, branch if negative
 $A7C4 AND A           ;
 $A7C5 JP M,$A7D5      ; }
 $A7C8 RET             ; return
*$A7C9 XOR A           ;
 $A7CA LD ($9C59),A    ; set Active colour scheme
 $A7CD CALL $C6A6      ; Screen wipe transition effect
 $A7D0 CALL $A7D7      ; Decrement current player's lives
 $A7D3 AND A           ;
 $A7D4 RET             ;
*$A7D5 SCF             ;
 $A7D6 RET             ;

; Decrement current player's lives; switch turn to other player if any remain
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A783.
;
; IX current player's state block base (lives at IX+$03)
;
; Handles a player's death: in 2-player mode, hands control to the other player
; if they still have lives, then decrements the (now-current) player's life
; count.
@label=player_lose_life
c$A7D7 LD A,($9C75)  ;
 $A7DA DEC A         ;
 $A7DB JR Z,$A7FE    ; Single-player: skip switch, just decrement lives
 $A7DD LD HL,$9C76   ;
 $A7E0 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A7E1 LD IY,$9C79   ; Default: select the other player's state block
 $A7E5 DEC A         ;
 $A7E6 JR NZ,$A7EC   ; Active player was 2: keep player-1 block selected
                     ; instead
 $A7E8 LD IY,$9C85   ;
*$A7EC LD A,(IY+$03) ;
 $A7EF AND A         ;
 $A7F0 JR Z,$A7FE    ; Other player is out of lives: don't switch turns
 $A7F2 PUSH IY       ;
 $A7F4 POP IX        ;
 $A7F6 LD ($9C77),IX ; Switch current-player pointer to the other player
 $A7FA LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A7FB XOR $03       ; Toggle active-player flag
 $A7FD LD (HL),A     ;
*$A7FE DEC (IX+$03)  ; Decrement the (now-current) player's lives
 $A801 RET           ;

; Start game: switch ISR to $A0B0, enter main loop
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for indices $17, $18, $19, $1D of the #R$A000 jump table (see
; #R$B7F6).
@label=start_game

 $A897 LD ($FDFE),HL ; set ISR handler address
 $A89A LD SP,$0000   ;
 $A89D EI            ;
 $A89E LD A,$09      ;
 $A8A0 CALL $6498    ; Init menu screen
 $A8A3 AND A         ;
 $A8A4 JP $A909      ;

; Post-death prompt: alert, then wait for Q or fire to pick the next player
; state
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $1E of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
; .
; Reached as player state 2 from #R$A561 once the death/recovery timer expires:
; it sounds a maximum-priority alert and then blocks until Q or fire is
; pressed, Q handing on to #R$A894 (state 1, restart) and fire leaving state 0
; for the no-op #R$A588.
@label=post_death_prompt
c$A8A7 CALL $A1CE    ; Request sound effect at maximum priority
 $A8AA LD HL,$9C3D   ; HL = the player state #R$A561 dispatches on ($9C3D)
*$A8AD LD A,$FB      ; {Poll keyboard half-row $FB and test bit 0 (Q)
 $A8AF IN A,($FE)    ;
 $A8B1 BIT 0,A       ; }
 $A8B3 JR Z,$A8BD    ; Q is down: take the restart path
 $A8B5 CALL $6943    ; Read fire button (Kempston/keyboard) with debounce
 $A8B8 LD (HL),$00   ; {Hold the state at 0 while waiting; loop until fire is
 $A8BA JR NC,$A8AD   ; pressed}
 $A8BC RET           ;
*$A8BD LD (HL),$01   ; {Q chosen: state 1, so the next dispatch starts play
 $A8BF RET           ; }

; Start new game: reset game state
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Resets core per-game state at the start of a new game, then waits for the
; first deferred event (player death/continue) before returning.
@label=new_game_reset
c$A8C0 CALL $6971    ; Wait for input
 $A8C3 CALL $A1C8    ; Clear pending sound-effect priority
 $A8C6 LD HL,$FF00   ; {Clear the deferred-event mask ($9C27), mark event bit 2
 $A8C9 LD ($9C27),HL ; pending
 $A8CC LD HL,$9C27   ;
 $A8CF SET 2,(HL)    ; }
 $A8D1 LD A,$00      ; {Player state $9C3D=0
 $A8D3 LD ($9C3D),A  ; }
 $A8D6 LD ($9C3E),A  ; Player state $9C3E=0
 $A8D9 XOR A         ; {Immobilise flag $9C3B=0
 $A8DA LD ($9C3B),A  ; }
 $A8DD LD ($9CDC),A  ; set Input state / action code
 $A8E0 DEC A         ; {Disable the death/recovery timer (#R$A561 sentinel,
 $A8E1 LD ($9C3C),A  ; $9C3C=$FF)}
 $A8E4 DI            ;
 $A8E5 CALL $BBC2    ; Clear buffers at $7F00-$7FFF and $8000-$80FF
 $A8E8 CALL $BCE9    ; Draw active objects' collision masks into attribute
                     ; buffer
 $A8EB EI            ;
 $A8EC CALL $A3A0    ; Scenery/event script interpreter
 $A8EF LD HL,$A0C4   ; point to per-frame handler #R$A0C4 (heavy ISR)
 $A8F2 LD ($FDFE),HL ; set ISR handler address
*$A8F5 CALL $A13A    ; Dispatch highest-priority pending deferred event
 $A8F8 LD A,($9C3E)  ; {Poll deferred events until player state $9C3E is set
 $A8FB AND A         ;
 $A8FC JR Z,$A8F5    ; }
 $A8FE LD A,($9C3D)  ;
 $A901 RET           ;
 $A902 LD SP,$0000   ;
 $A905 CALL $A5A5    ; Show title screen once, then (re)initialize interrupts
 $A908 AND A         ;
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$A894.
*$A909 CALL NC,$A6BB ; Show title screen and credits
*$A90C CALL NC,$A6E5 ; Print high-score table
 $A90F CALL NC,$A772 ;
 $A912 JR NC,$A909   ;
 $A914 CALL $A5C0    ; Initialize both players' game state
*$A917 CALL $A612    ; Initialize wave-group counters and load group data
                     ; tables
 $A91A CALL $A8C0    ; Start new game
 $A91D CALL $A773    ; Handle player death
 $A920 JR NC,$A917   ;
 $A922 CALL $A6C9    ;
 $A925 JR $A90C      ;

; Start playing music track A
;
; Used by the routines at #R$6989, #R$A5A0 and #R$A802.
;
; A music track number
;
; Starts playing a music track: marks the menu system busy, then points the
; music engine's note reader at the requested track's score data.
@label=music_start
c$A927 LD ($9C29),A  ; Mark menu/music busy ($9C29 guard used by #R$6A4A)
 $A92A DI            ;
 $A92B ADD A,A       ; {Track number * 2 -> byte offset into #R$AB03
 $A92C LD E,A        ;
 $A92D LD D,$00      ; }
 $A92F LD HL,$AB03   ; {Look up the track's score pointer
 $A932 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A933 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A934 INC HL        ;
 $A935 LD H,(HL)     ;
 $A936 LD L,A        ; }

; Point score reader at next event, check for end
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A94C.
;
; .
;
; Advances the music score reader to the next event, stopping the track on the
; $FF end marker, otherwise loading that event's pattern pointer.
c$A937 LD ($AA8E),HL ; Save score pointer ($AA8E)
 $A93A LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A93B CP $FF        ; {End marker $FF: stop the track (#R$AA32)
 $A93D JP Z,$AA32    ; }
 $A940 LD E,A        ;
 $A941 LD D,$00      ;
 $A943 LD HL,$AACB   ; {Index pattern-pointer table #R$AACB (2 bytes/entry)
 $A946 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A947 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $A948 LD E,(HL)     ; {Load the pattern pointer into HL
 $A949 INC HL        ;
 $A94A LD D,(HL)     ;
 $A94B EX DE,HL      ; }

; Parse next music score byte (note/duration/rest)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Reads score bytes and classifies by value range: >=$D0 sets an
; instrument/octave value ($AA98), $60-$6F indexes a note-pitch table at
; #R$AA9B (3 bytes/entry) to play a note, other ranges set duration ($AA92) or
; rest. Also polls the menu dispatcher (#R$6A4A) and fire button each event, so
; music playback and menu input share this loop while on the title screen.
@label=music_parse_note
c$A94C LD ($AA90),HL ;
 $A94F CALL $6A4A    ; Main menu key dispatcher
 $A952 CALL $6943    ; Read fire button (Kempston/keyboard) with debounce
 $A955 JP C,$AA32    ; Abort playback if fire/menu action pressed
 $A958 LD HL,($AA90) ;
 $A95B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A95C CP $FF        ; {End-of-score marker $FF: fetch next event (#R$AA2B)
 $A95E JP Z,$AA2B    ; }
 $A961 CP $60        ; {Below $60: play a note (#R$A98A)
 $A963 JP C,$A98A    ; }
 $A966 JP Z,$A97A    ; Exactly $60: reset instrument (#R$A97A)
 $A969 CP $70        ;
 $A96B JP C,$A972    ; $61-$6F: set instrument/octave value (#R$A972)
 $A96E CP $D0        ;
 $A970 JR C,$A981    ; $70-$CF: set note duration (#R$A981)
*$A972 AND $0F       ; {Store instrument/octave low nibble ($AA98)
 $A974 LD ($AA98),A  ; }
 $A977 INC HL        ;
 $A978 JR $A94C      ; => Parse next music score byte
*$A97A XOR A         ;
 $A97B LD ($AA98),A  ;
 $A97E INC HL        ;
 $A97F JR $A94C      ; => Parse next music score byte
*$A981 AND $0F       ;
 $A983 INC A         ;
 $A984 LD ($AA92),A  ; Store note duration ($AA92)
 $A987 INC HL        ;
 $A988 JR $A94C      ; => Parse next music score byte
*$A98A AND $0F       ;
 $A98C EX DE,HL      ;
 $A98D LD B,$00      ;
 $A98F LD C,A        ;
 $A990 LD HL,$AA9B   ; {Index note-pitch table #R$AA9B (3 bytes/entry)
 $A993 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $A994 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $A995 ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $A996 LD A,(HL)     ; {Store the entry's tone byte to #R$AA8D
 $A997 LD ($AA8D),A  ; }
 $A99A INC HL        ; {Read the 16-bit base period from the table into HL
 $A99B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A99C INC HL        ;
 $A99D LD H,(HL)     ;
 $A99E LD L,A        ; }
 $A99F LD A,(DE)     ; {Octave = high nibble of score byte -> $AA93
 $A9A0 RRA           ;
 $A9A1 RRA           ;
 $A9A2 RRA           ;
 $A9A3 RRA           ;
 $A9A4 AND $0F       ;
 $A9A6 LD ($AA93),A  ; }
 $A9A9 LD B,A        ;
 $A9AA JR Z,$A9B2    ;
*$A9AC SRA H         ; {Halve the period once per octave
 $A9AE RR L          ;
 $A9B0 DJNZ $A9AC    ; }
*$A9B2 LD BC,$FFF4   ; {Adjust period (-12) and store as $AA96
 $A9B5 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $A9B6 LD ($AA96),HL ; }
 $A9B9 LD A,($AA93)  ;
 $A9BC NEG           ;
 $A9BE ADD A,$05     ;
 $A9C0 LD L,A        ;
 $A9C1 LD A,($AA8D)  ; {Reload the tone byte (#R$AA8D)
 $A9C4 LD C,A        ; }
 $A9C5 LD A,($AA92)  ;
*$A9C8 RRA           ;
 $A9C9 DEC L         ;
 $A9CA JR C,$A9CE    ;
 $A9CC JR NZ,$A9C8   ;
*$A9CE RLA           ;
 $A9CF AND $0F       ;
 $A9D1 LD H,A        ;
 $A9D2 LD A,L        ;
 $A9D3 AND A         ;
 $A9D4 LD B,A        ;
 $A9D5 JR Z,$A9DB    ;
*$A9D7 SRL C         ;
 $A9D9 DJNZ $A9D7    ;
*$A9DB LD A,H        ;
 $A9DC LD HL,$0000   ;
*$A9DF ADD HL,BC     ; {Scale by duration via repeated addition
 $A9E0 DEC A         ;
 $A9E1 JR NZ,$A9DF   ; }
 $A9E3 LD A,H        ; {Add half of the result (x1.5)
 $A9E4 SRL A         ;
 $A9E6 LD B,A        ;
 $A9E7 LD A,L        ;
 $A9E8 RRA           ;
 $A9E9 LD C,A        ;
 $A9EA ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $A9EB LD ($AA99),HL ; Store the second period parameter ($AA99)
 $A9EE LD A,($AA98)  ;
; Look up note pitch period and apply octave shift
; .
; Called from #R$A94C for a $60-$6F score byte. Low nibble of the byte indexes
; the pitch-period table at #R$AA9B (3 bytes/entry, note within octave); high
; nibble is the octave number - if nonzero, #R$AA0F halves the pitch period
; that many times (one halving per octave) before the note is played via
; #R$AA34.
 $A9F1 AND A         ;
 $A9F2 JR NZ,$A9F6   ;
 $A9F4 INC DE        ;
 $A9F5 LD A,(DE)     ;
*$A9F6 AND $0F       ; Note index (low nibble)
 $A9F8 LD B,$00      ;
 $A9FA LD C,A        ;
 $A9FB LD HL,$AA9B   ;
 $A9FE ADD HL,BC     ;
 $A9FF ADD HL,BC     ;
 $AA00 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $AA01 INC HL        ;
 $AA02 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA03 INC HL        ;
 $AA04 LD H,(HL)     ;
 $AA05 LD L,A        ;
 $AA06 LD A,(DE)     ; {Octave number (high nibble); skip halving if zero
 $AA07 RRA           ;
 $AA08 RRA           ;
 $AA09 RRA           ;
 $AA0A RRA           ; }
 $AA0B AND $0F       ;
 $AA0D JR Z,$AA16    ;
; Halve note period HL by octave count in A
*$AA0F SRA H         ;
 $AA11 RR L          ;
 $AA13 DEC A         ;
 $AA14 JR NZ,$AA0F   ;
*$AA16 EX DE,HL      ;
 $AA17 INC HL        ;
 $AA18 LD ($AA90),HL ;
 $AA1B LD HL,($AA96) ;
 $AA1E LD BC,($AA99) ;
 $AA22 CALL $AA34    ; Play beeper music note
 $AA25 LD HL,($AA90) ;
 $AA28 JP $A94C      ; => Parse next music score byte
*$AA2B LD HL,($AA8E) ;
 $AA2E INC HL        ;
 $AA2F JP $A937      ; => Point score reader at next event, check for end
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$A937.
*$AA32 EI            ;
 $AA33 RET           ;

; Play beeper music note (square-wave tone generator)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A94C.
;
; .
;
; Plays one note for its duration as a square wave, with a short attack click
; at the start. Timing is derived directly from the note's pitch period, the
; same technique used by the sound-effect player at #R$A222.
@label=beep_play_note
c$AA34 DI            ;
 $AA35 LD ($AA94),DE ; Save note period parameters ($AA94)
 $AA39 LD DE,$0020   ; Initial 32-step attack/click burst
*$AA3C LD A,(DE)     ;
 $AA3D AND $10       ;
 $AA3F OUT ($FE),A   ; Toggle border/speaker bit during attack
 $AA41 LD A,$20      ;
*$AA43 DEC A         ;
 $AA44 JR NZ,$AA43   ;
 $AA46 DEC E         ;
 $AA47 JR NZ,$AA3C   ;
 $AA49 XOR A         ;
 $AA4A EX AF,AF'     ;
 $AA4B LD D,H        ;
 $AA4C LD E,L        ;
 $AA4D SRL D         ;
 $AA4F RR E          ;
*$AA51 XOR A         ;
 $AA52 SBC HL,DE     ; Phase accumulator step (HL -= period)
 $AA54 DEC BC        ; {Decrement duration (BC); finish when zero
 $AA55 LD A,C        ;
 $AA56 OR B          ;
 $AA57 JP Z,$AA88    ; }
*$AA5A LD A,L        ; {delay loop: hold current tone half-cycle for HL ticks
 $AA5B OR H          ;
 $AA5C DEC HL        ;
 $AA5D JP NZ,$AA5A   ; }
 $AA60 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $AA61 XOR $10       ; {Toggle speaker bit, output to port $FE
 $AA63 OUT ($FE),A   ; }
 $AA65 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $AA66 LD H,D        ;
 $AA67 LD L,E        ;
*$AA68 LD A,E        ; {Hold second half-cycle for DE ticks
 $AA69 OR D          ;
 $AA6A DEC DE        ;
 $AA6B JP NZ,$AA68   ; }
 $AA6E EX AF,AF'     ;
 $AA6F XOR $10       ; {Toggle speaker bit again (full square-wave period)
 $AA71 OUT ($FE),A   ; }
 $AA73 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $AA74 XOR A         ; {Recompute period via Bresenham blend ($AA94/$AA96)
 $AA75 LD DE,($AA94) ;
 $AA79 SBC HL,DE     ;
 $AA7B LD DE,($AA96) ; }
 $AA7F JR NC,$AA84   ;
*$AA81 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AA82 JR NC,$AA81   ;
*$AA84 EX DE,HL      ;
 $AA85 JP $AA51      ; Loop back for next cycle
*$AA88 LD B,$00      ; {Silence pad and return
*$AA8A DJNZ $AA8A    ;
 $AA8C RET           ; }

; Music engine work variables and note-pitch table
b$AA8D DEFB $00      ; Current note's first pitch-table byte (second-tone
                     ; parameter)
 $AA8E DEFW $0000    ; Track/score note pointer (set by $A927/$A937)

; Object render pass: clip each object's sprite and emit a drawing program
;
; Used by the routines at #R$6A88 and #R$A0C4.
;
; IY object struct base
;
; Draws one object per call: works out its screen address from its position,
; tests how much scenery its footprint covers, then looks up and clips its
; sprite frame via #R$AF2A and hands the result to the blitters. The blit is
; not called directly - the routine patches a blit-variant opcode into a two-
; or three-byte formation-script program held inline (at $AE3B, $AEB3, $AEDC,
; $AEEF, $AF18 and $AF25, which disassemble as nonsense because they are script
; data, not code) and runs it through #R$AFB8. Objects wider than one sprite
; are drawn as two halves, the second taken from the table at $6B55, and a
; mirrored object (IY+$04 bit 6) takes a separate path. Interleaved throughout
; is a border/speaker toggle loop (#R$AC95) the routine keeps returning to
; between phases; see docs/Actors.md.
@label=render_objects
c$AC8D LD ($ACB5),SP  ; Save SP (restored at $ACB4)
 $AC91 LD IY,$9D1E    ; Point IY at fixed-object list head $9D1E
*$AC95 LD HL,$9C37    ; Loop head: point at the toggle state byte ($9C37)
 $AC98 LD A,(HL)      ; {Toggle border/speaker bit of state byte at $9C37 and
 $AC99 XOR $18        ; output it
 $AC9B LD (HL),A      ;
 $AC9C INC HL         ;
 $AC9D AND (HL)       ; }
 $AC9E OUT ($FE),A    ; Write the toggled value to port $FE
 $ACA0 LD SP,IY       ; {Pop next loop/duration word via SP-trick into IY
 $ACA2 POP IY         ;
 $ACA4 LD SP,IY       ; }
 $ACA6 BIT 2,(IY+$04) ; Loop while duration bit (IY+$04 bit 2) is clear
 $ACAA JR Z,$AC95     ;
 $ACAC RES 0,(IY+$04) ; Clear "busy" flag ($9D1E+$04 bit 0) once duration
                      ; elapses
 $ACB0 POP HL         ; {Unwind the SP-trick stack and return
 $ACB1 POP HL         ;
 $ACB2 LD SP,HL       ;
 $ACB3 RET            ; }
@label=render_objects_restore_sp
 $ACB4 LD SP,$0000    ; {!!MUT-ARG!! Restore the SP saved by #R$AC8D's prologue
 $ACB7 RET            ; (operand at $ACB5 is patched there) and return (patched
                      ; by $AC8D)}
 $ACB8 SET 5,(IY+$04) ; Entry: request toggle loop (sets IY+$04 bit 5)
 $ACBC BIT 4,(IY+$04) ; Only continue toggling while bit 4 flag is set
 $ACC0 JP NZ,$AC95    ; Keep toggling while bit 4 is still set
 $ACC3 LD A,(IY+$06)  ; Start of object-column draw phase (separate from the
                      ; border-toggle head)
 $ACC6 POP HL         ; {Offset the address by the animation frame
 $ACC7 ADD A,H        ;
 $ACC8 LD H,A         ; }
 $ACC9 LD DE,$0008    ; {DE = 8 (cell stride)
 $ACCC EXX            ; }
 $ACCD LD A,(IY+$0C)  ; {X offset = (column - 6) * 2
 $ACD0 SUB $06        ;
 $ACD2 ADD A,A        ;
 $ACD3 LD E,A         ;
 $ACD4 LD D,$00       ; }
 $ACD6 LD L,(IY+$0E)  ; {Index the row-address table at $9B00 by (row+1)*2
 $ACD9 INC L          ;
 $ACDA SLA L          ;
 $ACDC LD H,$9B       ; }
 $ACDE LD SP,HL       ; {Fetch the row's screen base, add the X offset
 $ACDF POP HL         ;
 $ACE0 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ACE1 LD SP,HL       ; }
 $ACE2 EXX            ;
 $ACE3 PUSH HL        ; {Stack 3 cell addresses across the row (stride 8)
 $ACE4 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ACE5 PUSH HL        ;
 $ACE6 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ACE7 EXX            ; }
 $ACE8 LD SP,$0024    ; {Step down one screen row ($24)
 $ACEB ADD HL,SP      ;
 $ACEC LD SP,HL       ; }
 $ACED EXX            ;
 $ACEE PUSH HL        ; {Stack 2 more cell addresses on that row
 $ACEF ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ACF0 PUSH HL        ; }
 $ACF1 JP $AC95       ; Back to the toggle loop
 $ACF4 SET 5,(IY+$04) ; Alternate entry: request toggle loop (mirrors $ACB8)
 $ACF8 LD A,($9C01)   ; {Vertical sub-cell offset from the scroll position
 $ACFB NEG            ; ($9C01) and Y fraction
 $ACFD ADD A,(IY+$0D) ;
 $AD00 AND $E0        ;
 $AD02 RLCA           ;
 $AD03 RLCA           ;
 $AD04 RLCA           ;
 $AD05 LD E,A         ;
 $AD06 LD D,$00       ; }
 $AD08 POP HL         ; {Back the source pointer off by that offset
 $AD09 AND A          ;
 $AD0A SBC HL,DE      ; }
 $AD0C LD ($AD86),HL  ; {Self-modify the scan phase's source operand ($AD86)
 $AD0F LD ($AD65),A   ; and row adjust ($AD65)}
 $AD12 LD A,$07       ; {Self-modify the first LDI chain's entry point ($AD4A)
 $AD14 SUB E          ; - clips the copy
 $AD15 ADD A,A        ;
 $AD16 LD ($AD4A),A   ; }
 $AD19 NEG            ; {Self-modify the second LDI chain's entry point ($AD68)
 $AD1B ADD A,$0E      ;
 $AD1D LD ($AD68),A   ; }
 $AD20 EX DE,HL       ;
 $AD21 EXX            ;
 $AD22 LD A,(IY+$0C)  ; {X offset = (column - 8) * 2
 $AD25 SUB $08        ;
 $AD27 ADD A,A        ;
 $AD28 LD E,A         ;
 $AD29 LD D,$00       ; }
 $AD2B LD HL,$9C01    ; {Row index, rounded up when the Y fraction has crossed
 $AD2E LD A,(IY+$0D)  ; the scroll position
 $AD31 CP (HL)        ;
 $AD32 CCF            ;
 $AD33 LD A,(IY+$0E)  ;
 $AD36 ADC A,D        ;
 $AD37 ADD A,A        ;
 $AD38 LD L,A         ;
 $AD39 LD H,$9B       ; }
 $AD3B LD SP,HL       ; {Row base + X offset -> the scan phase's start operand
 $AD3C POP HL         ; ($AD82)
 $AD3D ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AD3E LD ($AD82),HL  ; }
 $AD41 LD DE,$00B4    ; {DE = $B4 source stride; 4 passes
 $AD44 LD B,$04       ; }
*$AD46 LD SP,HL       ; {Point SP at this pass's source, fetch the destination
 $AD47 EXX            ;
 $AD48 POP HL         ; }
*$AD49 JR $AD49       ; !!MUT-ARG!! Self-modified jump: skip N of the LDIs
                      ; below to clip the row (patched by $AD16)
 $AD4B LDI            ; {Copy up to 7 cells
 $AD4D LDI            ;
 $AD4F LDI            ;
 $AD51 LDI            ;
 $AD53 LDI            ;
 $AD55 LDI            ;
 $AD57 LDI            ; }
 $AD59 LD HL,$0028    ; {Advance the destination by $28 to the next row
 $AD5C ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AD5D EX DE,HL       ; }
 $AD5E EXX            ; {Advance the source pointer to match
 $AD5F ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AD60 LD SP,HL       ;
 $AD61 EXX            ; }
 $AD62 POP HL         ; {Fetch the next destination, apply the self-modified
 $AD63 LD A,L         ; row adjust}
 $AD64 ADD A,$00      ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $AD0F
 $AD66 LD L,A         ;
*$AD67 JR $AD67       ; !!MUT-ARG!! Self-modified jump: skip N of the LDIs
                      ; below to clip the row (patched by $AD1D)
 $AD69 LDI            ; {Copy up to 8 cells
 $AD6B LDI            ;
 $AD6D LDI            ;
 $AD6F LDI            ;
 $AD71 LDI            ;
 $AD73 LDI            ;
 $AD75 LDI            ;
 $AD77 LDI            ; }
 $AD79 EXX            ; {Rewind the source pointer for the next pass
 $AD7A AND A          ;
 $AD7B SBC HL,DE      ;
 $AD7D INC HL         ;
 $AD7E INC HL         ; }
 $AD7F DJNZ $AD46     ; Loop 4 passes
 $AD81 LD HL,$0000    ; {!!MUT-ARG!! HL = scan start on screen (operand patched
 $AD84 EXX            ; at $AD3E) (patched by $AD3E)}
 $AD85 LD HL,$0000    ; {!!MUT-ARG!! Shadow HL = scan start in the source
 $AD88 LD C,$18       ; (patched at $AD0C); C = 24 cells (patched by $AD0C)
 $AD8A EXX            ; }
 $AD8B LD DE,$0024    ; {DE = $24 row stride; 6 rows
 $AD8E LD B,$06       ; }
*$AD90 LD SP,HL       ; {Point SP at this row
 $AD91 EXX            ; }
 $AD92 LD DE,$0030    ; DE = $30 cell stride
 $AD95 POP AF         ; {Cell 1: count it if non-blank (PUSH/POP pads both
 $AD96 AND $7E        ; paths to equal timing)
 $AD98 JR Z,$AD9D     ;
 $AD9A PUSH HL        ;
 $AD9B POP HL         ;
 $AD9C DEC C          ; }
*$AD9D ADD HL,DE      ; {Cell 2
 $AD9E POP AF         ;
 $AD9F AND $7E        ;
 $ADA1 JR Z,$ADA6     ;
 $ADA3 PUSH HL        ;
 $ADA4 POP HL         ;
 $ADA5 DEC C          ; }
*$ADA6 ADD HL,DE      ; {Cell 3
 $ADA7 POP AF         ;
 $ADA8 AND $7E        ;
 $ADAA JR Z,$ADAF     ;
 $ADAC PUSH HL        ;
 $ADAD POP HL         ;
 $ADAE DEC C          ; }
*$ADAF ADD HL,DE      ; {Cell 4
 $ADB0 POP AF         ;
 $ADB1 AND $7E        ;
 $ADB3 JR Z,$ADB8     ;
 $ADB5 PUSH HL        ;
 $ADB6 POP HL         ;
 $ADB7 DEC C          ; }
*$ADB8 LD DE,$FF78    ; {Step both pointers back a row ($FF78)
 $ADBB ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ADBC EXX            ;
 $ADBD ADD HL,DE      ;
 $ADBE LD SP,HL       ; }
 $ADBF DJNZ $AD90     ; Loop 6 rows
 $ADC1 EXX            ; {Fewer than 8 cells left blank: leave the flag alone
 $ADC2 LD A,C         ;
 $ADC3 CP $08         ;
 $ADC5 JP C,$AC95     ; }
 $ADC8 SET 0,(IY+$04) ; {Otherwise mark the object ready to draw (IY+$04 bit 0)
 $ADCC JP $AC95       ; }
 $ADCF RES 5,(IY+$04) ; Assume off-screen: clear the drawable flag
 $ADD3 LD A,(IY+$06)  ; {A = animation frame
 $ADD6 EXX            ; }
 $ADD7 LD HL,$ADE0    ; {Look up and clip the sprite; #R$AF2A returns to $ADE0
 $ADDA LD DE,$AE3E    ; if any of it is visible, else to $AE3E
 $ADDD JP $AF2A       ; }
 $ADE0 EXX            ; {Visible: mark the object drawable again
 $ADE1 SET 5,(IY+$04) ; }
 $ADE5 LD ($9C15),HL  ; set Blit source data pointer (the clipped sprite)
 $ADE8 LD HL,$9C1A    ; {Blit width from C, height from E/2
 $ADEB LD (HL),C      ;
 $ADEC INC HL         ;
 $ADED SRL E          ;
 $ADEF LD (HL),E      ; }
 $ADF0 ADD A,$88      ; {Destination page derived from the frame
 $ADF2 LD ($9C14),A   ;
 $ADF5 LD ($9C10),A   ; }
 $ADF8 SUB $88        ; {E = column byte offset
 $ADFA ADD A,A        ;
 $ADFB LD E,A         ; }
 $ADFC LD A,(IY+$0D)  ; {Screen row from the object's Y (IY+$0D/$0E)
 $ADFF AND $E0        ;
 $AE01 OR (IY+$0E)    ;
 $AE04 RLCA           ;
 $AE05 RLCA           ;
 $AE06 RLCA           ; }
 $AE07 LD ($9C13),A   ;
 $AE0A LD C,A         ; {Compare the row against the scroll offset ($9C00);
 $AE0B AND $07        ; back up a row group if behind
 $AE0D LD HL,$9C00    ;
 $AE10 CP (HL)        ;
 $AE11 LD A,C         ;
 $AE12 JR NC,$AE16    ;
 $AE14 SUB $08        ; }
*$AE16 AND $F8        ; {Fold the scroll offset back into the row ($9C0F)
 $AE18 OR (HL)        ;
 $AE19 LD ($9C0F),A   ; }
 $AE1C ADD A,$08      ; {Index the row-address table at $9B00
 $AE1E AND $F8        ;
 $AE20 RRCA           ;
 $AE21 RRCA           ;
 $AE22 LD D,$00       ;
 $AE24 LD L,A         ;
 $AE25 LD H,$9B       ; }
 $AE27 LD SP,HL       ; {Row base + column offset -> $9C11
 $AE28 POP HL         ;
 $AE29 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AE2A LD ($9C11),HL  ; }
 $AE2D EXX            ;
 $AE2E LD A,C         ; {Patch the blit opcode into the drawing program at
 $AE2F OR $10         ; $AE3C
 $AE31 LD ($AE3C),A   ; }
 $AE34 LD IX,$AE3B    ; Run the drawing program at $AE3B through #R$AFB8
 $AE38 JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AE3B LD ($2812),HL  ; !!MUT-ARG!! Drawing program (formation-script bytes,
                      ; not code): blit opcode patched at $AE3C (patched by
                      ; $AE31)
 $AE3E JP $AC95       ; Back to the toggle loop
 $AE41 RES 5,(IY+$04) ; Second draw variant: assume off-screen
 $AE45 LD A,(IY+$06)  ; {A = animation frame
 $AE48 EXX            ; }
 $AE49 LD HL,$AE52    ; {Look up and clip the sprite; returns to $AE52 if
 $AE4C LD DE,$AEDE    ; visible, else $AEDE
 $AE4F JP $AF2A       ; }
 $AE52 EXX            ; {Visible: mark the object drawable again
 $AE53 SET 5,(IY+$04) ; }
 $AE57 LD ($9C15),HL  ; set Blit source data pointer (the clipped sprite)
 $AE5A LD HL,$9C1A    ; {Blit width from C, height from E/2
 $AE5D LD (HL),C      ;
 $AE5E INC HL         ;
 $AE5F SRL E          ;
 $AE61 LD (HL),E      ; }
 $AE62 ADD A,$88      ; {Destination page derived from the frame
 $AE64 LD ($9C14),A   ;
 $AE67 LD ($9C10),A   ; }
 $AE6A SUB $88        ; {E = column byte offset
 $AE6C ADD A,A        ;
 $AE6D LD E,A         ; }
 $AE6E LD A,(IY+$0D)  ; {Screen row from the object's Y (IY+$0D/$0E)
 $AE71 AND $E0        ;
 $AE73 OR (IY+$0E)    ;
 $AE76 RLCA           ;
 $AE77 RLCA           ;
 $AE78 RLCA           ; }
 $AE79 LD ($9C13),A   ;
 $AE7C LD C,A         ; {Compare the row against the scroll offset ($9C00);
 $AE7D AND $07        ; back up a row group if behind
 $AE7F LD HL,$9C00    ;
 $AE82 CP (HL)        ;
 $AE83 LD A,C         ;
 $AE84 JR NC,$AE88    ;
 $AE86 SUB $08        ; }
*$AE88 AND $F8        ; {Fold the scroll offset back into the row ($9C0F)
 $AE8A OR (HL)        ;
 $AE8B LD ($9C0F),A   ; }
 $AE8E ADD A,$08      ; {Index the row-address table at $9B00
 $AE90 AND $F8        ;
 $AE92 RRCA           ;
 $AE93 RRCA           ;
 $AE94 LD D,$00       ;
 $AE96 LD L,A         ;
 $AE97 LD H,$9B       ; }
 $AE99 LD SP,HL       ; {Row base + column offset -> $9C11
 $AE9A POP HL         ;
 $AE9B ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AE9C LD ($9C11),HL  ; }
 $AE9F EXX            ;
 $AEA0 LD A,C         ; {Mirror flag (IY+$04 bit 6) clear: take the plain path
 $AEA1 BIT 6,(IY+$04) ; at $AEE1
 $AEA5 JR Z,$AEE1     ; }
 $AEA7 OR $10         ; {Mirrored: patch the blit opcode into the drawing
 $AEA9 LD ($AEB4),A   ; program at $AEB4}
 $AEAC LD IX,$AEB3    ; Run the drawing program at $AEB3 through #R$AFB8
 $AEB0 JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AEB3 INC H          ; Drawing program (formation-script bytes, not code):
                      ; blit opcode patched at $AEB4
*$AEB4 LD (DE),A      ; !!MUT-CMD!! Blit-variant selector of the drawing
                      ; program above - script data, not an opcode; $AEA9
                      ; writes (C OR $10)
 $AEB5 JR Z,$AEB4     ;
 $AEB7 LD A,(HL)      ; {Second sprite half needed? skip if the frame index is
 $AEB8 LD A,(DE)      ; $08 or above
 $AEB9 CP $08         ;
 $AEBB JR NC,$AEDE    ; }
 $AEBD LD SP,$6B55    ; {Point SP at the second-half sprite table ($6B55)
 $AEC0 EXX            ; }
 $AEC1 LD HL,$AECA    ; {Look up and clip that half; returns to $AECA if
 $AEC4 LD DE,$AEDE    ; visible, else $AEDE
 $AEC7 JP $AF2A       ; }
 $AECA EXX            ; {set Blit source data pointer (the clipped second half)
 $AECB LD ($9C15),HL  ;
 $AECE EXX            ; }
 $AECF LD A,C         ; {Patch the blit opcode into the drawing program at
 $AED0 OR $10         ; $AEDC
 $AED2 LD ($AEDC),A   ; }
 $AED5 LD IX,$AEDC    ; Run the drawing program at $AEDC through #R$AFB8
 $AED9 JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AEDC LD (DE),A      ; {!!MUT-CMD!! Drawing program - script data, not code;
 $AEDD JR Z,$AEA2     ; $AED2 writes (C OR $10) into the selector byte at $AEDC
 $AEDF SUB L          ;
 $AEE0 XOR H          ; }
*$AEE1 AND $FC        ; {Unmirrored path: patch the blit opcode into the
 $AEE3 OR $00         ; drawing program at $AEF0
 $AEE5 LD ($AEF0),A   ; }
 $AEE8 LD IX,$AEEF    ; Run the drawing program at $AEEF through #R$AFB8
 $AEEC JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AEEF INC H          ; Drawing program (formation-script bytes, not code):
                      ; blit opcode patched at $AEF0
*$AEF0 NOP            ; !!MUT-CMD!! Blit-variant selector of the drawing
                      ; program above - script data, not an opcode; $AEE5
                      ; writes (A AND $FC)
 $AEF1 JR Z,$AEF0     ;
 $AEF3 LD A,(HL)      ; {Second sprite half needed? skip if the frame index is
 $AEF4 LD A,(DE)      ; $08 or above
 $AEF5 CP $08         ;
 $AEF7 JR NC,$AF1E    ; }
 $AEF9 LD SP,$6B55    ; {Point SP at the second-half sprite table ($6B55)
 $AEFC EXX            ; }
 $AEFD LD HL,$AF06    ; {Look up and clip that half; returns to $AF06 if
 $AF00 LD DE,$AF1E    ; visible, else $AF1E
 $AF03 JP $AF2A       ; }
 $AF06 EXX            ; {set Blit source data pointer (the clipped second half)
 $AF07 LD ($9C15),HL  ;
 $AF0A EXX            ; }
 $AF0B LD A,C         ; {Patch the blit opcode into the drawing program at
 $AF0C OR $02         ; $AF18
 $AF0E LD ($AF18),A   ; }
 $AF11 LD IX,$AF18    ; Run the drawing program at $AF18 through #R$AFB8
 $AF15 JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AF18 LD (BC),A      ; {!!MUT-CMD!! Drawing program - script data, not code;
 $AF19 JR NZ,$AF43    ; $AF0E writes (C OR $02) into the selector byte at $AF18
                      ; }
 $AF1B JP $AC95       ; Back to the toggle loop
*$AF1E LD IX,$AF25    ; Fully clipped: run the bare drawing program at $AF25
 $AF22 JP $AFB8       ; => Formation script
 $AF25 JR NZ,$AF4F    ; Drawing program (formation-script bytes, not code)
 $AF27 JP $AC95       ; Back to the toggle loop
*$AF2A EXX            ; {Read this frame's sprite descriptor byte from the
 $AF2B ADD A,$3C      ; table at $9B3C
 $AF2D LD L,A         ;
 $AF2E LD H,$9B       ;
 $AF30 LD C,(HL)      ; }
 $AF31 POP HL         ; {Pop the caller's "visible" and "clipped out" return
 $AF32 POP DE         ; addresses}
 $AF33 LD A,C         ; {Advance the sprite pointer by (descriptor AND 7)
 $AF34 AND $07        ; strides
 $AF36 JR Z,$AF3C     ;
 $AF38 LD B,A         ;
*$AF39 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AF3A DJNZ $AF39     ; }
*$AF3C POP DE         ; {Fold the descriptor into the blit-variant selector
 $AF3D XOR C          ;
 $AF3E RRCA           ;
 $AF3F OR D           ;
 $AF40 AND $FE        ;
 $AF42 EXX            ; }
*$AF43 LD C,A         ; {C = blit variant; store the row count ($9C19)
 $AF44 EXX            ;
 $AF45 LD A,D         ;
 $AF46 LD ($9C19),A   ; }
 $AF49 LD A,(IY+$0B)  ; {Sub-cell X shift from the object's X fraction (IY+$0B)
 $AF4C RLCA           ;
 $AF4D RLCA           ;
 $AF4E RLCA           ;
*$AF4F AND E          ; }
 $AF50 BIT 3,C        ; {Descriptor bit 3: on a shift wrap, back the pointer up
 $AF52 JR Z,$AF60     ; one row ($FFE0)
 $AF54 NEG            ;
 $AF56 ADD A,$08      ;
 $AF58 AND $07        ;
 $AF5A JR NZ,$AF60    ;
 $AF5C LD DE,$FFE0    ;
 $AF5F ADD HL,DE      ; }
*$AF60 POP DE         ; {Advance the sprite pointer by the remaining shift
 $AF61 AND A          ; steps
 $AF62 JR Z,$AF68     ;
 $AF64 LD B,A         ;
*$AF65 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AF66 DJNZ $AF65     ; }
*$AF68 LD B,C         ; {Clip out entirely if the object's row (IY+$0E) is 0
 $AF69 LD A,(IY+$0E)  ;
 $AF6C AND A          ; }
 $AF6D JP Z,$AFB5     ; {Clip out entirely if the row is $1A or beyond
 $AF70 CP $1A         ;
 $AF72 JP NC,$AFB5    ; }
 $AF75 LD A,(IY+$0C)  ; {Column relative to the left edge (IY+$0C - 8); branch
 $AF78 SUB $08        ; if positive
 $AF7A POP DE         ;
 $AF7B LD C,D         ; }
 $AF7C JP P,$AF96     ; {Off the left edge: clip out entirely if the whole
 $AF7F NEG            ; sprite is past it
 $AF81 CP C           ;
 $AF82 JP NC,$AFB5    ; }
 $AF85 BIT 3,B        ; {Skip the source advance for a mask-reversed variant
 $AF87 JR NZ,$AF8F    ; (descriptor bit 3)
 $AF89 LD B,A         ;
 $AF8A LD D,$00       ;
*$AF8C ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AF8D DJNZ $AF8C     ; }
*$AF8F NEG            ; {Trim the visible width by the clipped amount, return
 $AF91 ADD A,C        ; via the visible path
 $AF92 LD C,A         ;
 $AF93 XOR A          ;
 $AF94 JR $AFB3       ; }
*$AF96 LD D,A         ; {Off the right edge: clip out entirely if the whole
 $AF97 EX AF,AF'      ; sprite is past it
 $AF98 LD A,D         ;
 $AF99 ADD A,C        ;
 $AF9A SUB $12        ;
 $AF9C JR C,$AFB2     ;
 $AF9E JR Z,$AFB2     ;
 $AFA0 CP C           ;
 $AFA1 JP NC,$AFB5    ; }
 $AFA4 BIT 3,B        ; {Skip the source advance for a mask-reversed variant
 $AFA6 JR Z,$AFAE     ; (descriptor bit 3)
 $AFA8 LD B,A         ;
 $AFA9 LD D,$00       ;
*$AFAB ADD HL,DE      ;
 $AFAC DJNZ $AFAB     ; }
*$AFAE NEG            ; {Trim the visible width by the clipped amount
 $AFB0 ADD A,C        ;
 $AFB1 LD C,A         ; }
*$AFB2 EX AF,AF'      ; {Return to the caller's "visible" continuation
*$AFB3 EXX            ;
 $AFB4 JP (HL)        ; }
*$AFB5 EXX            ; {Return to the caller's "clipped out" continuation
 $AFB6 EX DE,HL       ;
 $AFB7 JP (HL)        ; }

; Formation script: read next byte, dispatch via $A000 table (SP=addr/RET
; trick)
;
; Used by the routines at #R$AC8D, #R$AFC3, #R$B005, #R$B072, #R$B0B4, #R$B15B,
; #R$B1BE, #R$B24A, #R$B2DA, #R$B36A, #R$B3FE, #R$B452, #R$B4AA, #R$B502,
; #R$B55E, #R$B61A and #R$B72D.
;
; IX formation-script pointer
;
; The shared bytecode-dispatch core of the enemy formation/wave scripting
; system: reads the next script byte and jumps to its handler in the #R$A000
; table.
@label=formation_dispatch
c$AFB8 LD L,(IX+$00) ; {read next script byte from (IX), advance script pointer
 $AFBB INC IX        ; }
 $AFBD LD H,$A0      ; {form address $A0xx from script byte, jump there via
 $AFBF LD SP,HL      ; faked RET
 $AFC0 RET           ; }

; Formation opcode $14: jump to (IX)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $14 of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6). A single JP
; (IX) - an indirect dispatch that continues execution at whatever address IX
; currently holds.
@label=jp_ix
c$AFC1 JP (IX)       ;

; Update tile-block tables ($7900+) from SP-fed data (index $00, INC L)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $00 of the #R$A000 jump table. Fills a page of the 2x2
; tile-block tables from popped stack data, ascending; twin of #R$B072 which
; fills descending. Continues into the formation script (#R$AFB8).
c$AFC3 LD SP,($9C15) ; Source data via SP (POP-fed)
 $AFC7 LD A,($9C1A)  ; B = column/pass count ($9C1A)
 $AFCA LD B,A        ;
 $AFCB LD H,$79      ; H=$79: destination tile-block table page
 $AFCD LD A,$F0      ; A=$F0: row index start (writes ascending)
*$AFCF LD L,A        ; Set row index for this pass
 $AFD0 POP DE        ; {Store low byte of popped word, ascending (iteration
 $AFD1 LD (HL),E     ; 1/16)
 $AFD2 INC L         ; }
 $AFD3 POP DE        ; {iteration 2/16
 $AFD4 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFD5 INC L         ; }
 $AFD6 POP DE        ; {iteration 3/16
 $AFD7 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFD8 INC L         ; }
 $AFD9 POP DE        ; {iteration 4/16
 $AFDA LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFDB INC L         ; }
 $AFDC POP DE        ; {iteration 5/16
 $AFDD LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFDE INC L         ; }
 $AFDF POP DE        ; {iteration 6/16
 $AFE0 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFE1 INC L         ; }
 $AFE2 POP DE        ; {iteration 7/16
 $AFE3 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFE4 INC L         ; }
 $AFE5 POP DE        ; {iteration 8/16
 $AFE6 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFE7 INC L         ; }
 $AFE8 POP DE        ; {iteration 9/16
 $AFE9 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFEA INC L         ; }
 $AFEB POP DE        ; {iteration 10/16
 $AFEC LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFED INC L         ; }
 $AFEE POP DE        ; {iteration 11/16
 $AFEF LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFF0 INC L         ; }
 $AFF1 POP DE        ; {iteration 12/16
 $AFF2 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFF3 INC L         ; }
 $AFF4 POP DE        ; {iteration 13/16
 $AFF5 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFF6 INC L         ; }
 $AFF7 POP DE        ; {iteration 14/16
 $AFF8 LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFF9 INC L         ; }
 $AFFA POP DE        ; {iteration 15/16
 $AFFB LD (HL),E     ;
 $AFFC INC L         ; }
 $AFFD POP DE        ; {iteration 16/16 (no INC L, next page picks up at $F0)
 $AFFE LD (HL),E     ; }
 $AFFF INC H         ; Next page ($7A/$7B/$7C)
 $B000 DJNZ $AFCF    ; Loop B passes
 $B002 JP $AFB8      ; => Formation script

 $B020 INC E         ; }
 $B021 POP BC        ; {iteration 2/16
 $B022 LD L,C        ;
 $B023 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B024 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B025 INC E         ; }
 $B026 POP BC        ; {iteration 3/16
 $B027 LD L,C        ;
 $B028 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B029 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B02A INC E         ; }
 $B02B POP BC        ; {iteration 4/16
 $B02C LD L,C        ;
 $B02D LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B02E LD (DE),A     ;
 $B02F INC E         ; }
 $B030 POP BC        ; {iteration 5/16
 $B031 LD L,C        ;
 $B032 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B033 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B034 INC E         ; }
 $B035 POP BC        ; {iteration 6/16
 $B036 LD L,C        ;

 $B043 INC E         ; }
 $B044 POP BC        ; {iteration 9/16
 $B045 LD L,C        ;
 $B046 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B047 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B048 INC E         ; }
 $B049 POP BC        ; {iteration 10/16
 $B04A LD L,C        ;
 $B04B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B04C LD (DE),A     ;
 $B04D INC E         ; }
 $B04E POP BC        ; {iteration 11/16
 $B04F LD L,C        ;
 $B050 LD A,(HL)     ;

 $B05E LD L,C        ;

 $B060 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B061 INC E         ; }
 $B062 POP BC        ; {iteration 15/16
 $B063 LD L,C        ;
 $B064 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B065 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B066 INC E         ; }

 $B068 LD L,C        ;

 $B06A LD (DE),A     ; }
 $B06B DEC D         ; Next row column-base
 $B06C EXX           ;
 $B06D DJNZ $B019    ; Loop $9C1A rows
 $B06F JP $AFB8      ; => Formation script

; Masked tile blit setup (index $01): to tile-block table, run $B1BE body
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Sets up a masked blit with destination $79F0 (into the 2x2 tile-block tables,
; not the screen) and jumps into the shared body at #R$B1C6 inside #R$B1BE.

 $B125 LD DE,$79F0   ; Destination = tile-block buffer $79F0
 $B128 JP $B1C6      ; Run the shared masked-blit body (#R$B1BE)

; Masked tile blit setup (index $03): configure, then run $B24A body
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $03 of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6). Sets up a
; masked tile blit (source via SP, dest high = width+$78, self-modified
; row-start operand = $F0) and jumps into the shared blit body at #R$B25E

c$B12B LD A,($9C1A)  ;
 $B12E LD B,A        ;

 $B134 ADD A,$78     ; {Destination high byte = width + $78
 $B136 LD D,A        ; }
 $B137 LD A,$F0      ;
 $B139 LD ($B263),A  ; Self-modify #R$B24A's row-start operand ($F0)
 $B13C JP $B25E      ; Run the shared masked-blit body (#R$B25E)

; Masked tile blit setup (index $05): to tile-block table, run $B2DA body

 $B145 LD A,$FF      ;

; Masked tile blit setup (index $07): run $B36A body
;
; .
;
; .

; jumps into the shared body at #R$B37F inside #R$B36A.
c$B14A LD A,($9C1A)  ; B = column/pass count ($9C1A)
 $B14D LD B,A        ;
 $B14E EXX           ;
 $B14F LD SP,($9C15) ; Source tile data via SP (POP-fed)
 $B153 ADD A,$78     ; {Destination high byte = width + $78

; Copy 8-wide screen strips (SP-trick, screen-third aware)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $11 of the #R$A000 jump table. Copies vertical 8-byte-wide
; screen strips, picking one of three copy loops so the blit steps correctly
; across the ZX screen's non-linear thirds. Continues into the formation script
; (#R$AFB8).
c$B55E LD HL,($9C11) ;
 $B561 LD BC,($9C19) ; {Row count from $9C19 (+1)
 $B565 INC C         ; }
 $B566 EXX           ;
 $B567 LD HL,($9C0F) ;
 $B56A LD A,L        ;
 $B56B EXX           ;
 $B56C CP $C8        ; {Pick copy variant by column vs $C8 (screen-third
 $B56E JR C,$B571    ; boundary)}
 $B570 DEC C         ;
*$B571 LD DE,$0024   ;
 $B574 DJNZ $B596    ;
 $B576 LD B,C        ;
*$B577 LD SP,HL      ; Point SP at strip for the pointer-swap trick
 $B578 EXX           ;
 $B579 LD L,A        ;
 $B57A EX (SP),HL    ; {Swap source/dest pointers via EX (SP),HL
 $B57B POP DE        ; }
 $B57C LDI           ; {Copy 8 bytes of this strip row
 $B57E LDI           ;
 $B580 LDI           ;
 $B582 LDI           ;
 $B584 LDI           ;
 $B586 LDI           ;
 $B588 LDI           ;
 $B58A LDI           ; }
 $B58C EX DE,HL      ;
 $B58D EXX           ;
 $B58E ADD A,$08     ; {Advance column (+8) and dest row (+$24)
 $B590 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $B591 DJNZ $B577    ; Loop rows
 $B593 JP $AFB8      ; => Formation script
*$B596 DJNZ $B5CE    ;
 $B598 LD B,C        ;
*$B599 LD SP,HL      ; {Point SP at this strip, swap source/dest pointers via
 $B59A EXX           ; EX (SP),HL
 $B59B LD L,A        ;
 $B59C EX (SP),HL    ;
 $B59D POP DE        ; }
 $B59E LDI           ; {Copy 8 bytes of this strip row
 $B5A0 LDI           ;
 $B5A2 LDI           ;
 $B5A4 LDI           ;
 $B5A6 LDI           ;
 $B5A8 LDI           ;
 $B5AA LDI           ;
 $B5AC LDI           ; }

 $B5B2 POP DE        ; }

 $B5B5 LDI           ;
 $B5B7 LDI           ;
 $B5B9 LDI           ;
 $B5BB LDI           ;
 $B5BD LDI           ;
 $B5BF LDI           ;
 $B5C1 LDI           ; }
 $B5C3 EX DE,HL      ; {Mirror back (DEC H) after crossing the third
 $B5C4 DEC H         ; }
 $B5C5 EXX           ;
 $B5C6 ADD A,$08     ;
 $B5C8 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $B5C9 DJNZ $B599    ;
 $B5CB JP $AFB8      ; => Formation script
*$B5CE LD B,C        ; B = row count
*$B5CF LD SP,HL      ; {Point SP at this strip, swap source/dest pointers via
 $B5D0 EXX           ; EX (SP),HL
 $B5D1 LD L,A        ;
 $B5D2 EX (SP),HL    ;
 $B5D3 POP DE        ; }
 $B5D4 LDI           ; {Copy 8 bytes of this strip row
 $B5D6 LDI           ;
 $B5D8 LDI           ;
 $B5DA LDI           ;
 $B5DC LDI           ;
 $B5DE LDI           ;
 $B5E0 LDI           ;
 $B5E2 LDI           ; }
 $B5E4 EX DE,HL      ; {Advance to the next screen third (INC H), point at the
 $B5E5 INC H         ; next strip
 $B5E6 LD L,A        ;
 $B5E7 EX (SP),HL    ;
 $B5E8 POP DE        ; }
 $B5E9 LDI           ; {Copy 8 bytes of this strip row
 $B5EB LDI           ;
 $B5ED LDI           ;
 $B5EF LDI           ;
 $B5F1 LDI           ;
 $B5F3 LDI           ;
 $B5F5 LDI           ;
 $B5F7 LDI           ; }
 $B5F9 EX DE,HL      ; {Advance to the next screen third (INC H), point at the

 $B5FC EX (SP),HL    ;

 $B5FE LDI           ; {Copy 8 bytes of this strip row
 $B600 LDI           ;
 $B602 LDI           ;
 $B604 LDI           ;
 $B606 LDI           ;
 $B608 LDI           ;

 $B745 LD (IY+$01),H   ;

 $B74F DJNZ $B742      ; Loop 19 pool slots

; Mark formation slot done, trigger completion effect when group empties
;
; Used by the routines at #R$BFEB, #R$C015, #R$C075, #R$C11C, #R$C199, #R$C298,
; #R$C31A, #R$C359, #R$C388 and #R$C3C7.
;
; IY object struct base
;
; Marks an object's formation slot done. Once its whole group has emptied,
; triggers the group's completion effect (explosion or score-award) and
; decrements the group counter. The tail from #R$B7DC onward (an SP=IY stack
; trick) is not yet analyzed.
c$B79F LD C,$00        ; {entry: normal call, C=0
 $B7A1 JR $B7A6        ; }
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$C051.
*$B7A3 LD C,$FF        ; {entry: alternate call, C=$FF
 $B7A5 NOP             ; }
*$B7A6 LD (IY+$14),$00 ; {clear flag at IY+14; read formation-slot index from
 $B7AA LD A,(IY+$13)   ; IY+13}
 $B7AD CP $FF          ; {skip if slot unused ($FF)
 $B7AF JR Z,$B7DC      ; }
 $B7B1 ADD A,A         ; {index this slot's mask byte ($9B50 + 2*slot), clear
 $B7B2 ADD A,$50       ; the object's bit via C
 $B7B4 LD L,A          ;
 $B7B5 LD H,$9B        ;
 $B7B7 LD A,(HL)       ;
 $B7B8 AND C           ; }
 $B7B9 LD (HL),A       ; write back masked bitmap byte
 $B7BA DEC L           ; {step back to the slot's count byte and decrement it;
 $B7BB DEC (HL)        ; skip if still nonzero
 $B7BC JR NZ,$B7DC     ; }
 $B7BE AND A           ; {skip if counter was already zero
 $B7BF JR Z,$B7DC      ; }
 $B7C1 LD (IY+$13),$FF ; {mark slot done; check completion mode
 $B7C5 CP $01          ; }
 $B7C7 JR Z,$B7CE      ; branch to alternate completion path
 $B7C9 CALL $C648      ; {Decrement wave-group counter
 $B7CC JR $B7D7        ; }
*$B7CE LD A,($9C3F)    ; {check game mode flag at $9C3F
 $B7D1 AND A           ;
 $B7D2 JR NZ,$B7DC     ; }
 $B7D4 CALL $C5D2      ; Convert object to explosion
*$B7D7 LD HL,$9D18     ; {decrement group counter at $9D18, return
 $B7DA DEC (HL)        ;
 $B7DB RET             ; }
*$B7DC LD ($B7EF),SP   ;
 $B7E0 LD SP,IY        ;
 $B7E2 POP HL          ;
 $B7E3 LD ($0000),HL   ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BDBF
 $B7E6 LD HL,($9D1C)   ;
 $B7E9 PUSH HL         ;
 $B7EA LD ($9D1C),SP   ;
 $B7EE LD SP,$0000     ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $B7DC
 $B7F1 LD IY,($B7E4)   ;
 $B7F5 RET             ;

; Jump-table dispatcher: JP to word-sized table entry A
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A13A, #R$A3A0, #R$A561, #R$A773, #R$B8F9, #R$B941
; and #R$BD99.
;
; A word index into the jump table
; HL jump table base address
;
; Jumps to the routine whose address sits at entry A of the word table pointed
; to by HL.
@label=jump_table_dispatch
c$B7F6 ADD A,A       ;
 $B7F7 ADD A,L       ;
 $B7F8 LD L,A        ;
 $B7F9 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B7FA INC HL        ;
 $B7FB LD H,(HL)     ;
 $B7FC LD L,A        ;
 $B7FD JP (HL)       ;

; Pseudo-random number generator (advances LFSR state at $9C2B-$9C32)
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B920, #R$BA43, #R$BA4F, #R$BD99, #R$C075, #R$C43C
; and #R$C5D2.
;
; O:A pseudo-random byte
;   BC,DE,HL preserved (saved into self-modified operands at entry, restored
; .          before RET)
;
; Advances an 8-byte shift-register state and returns a new pseudo-random byte,
; without disturbing the caller's registers.
@label=random
c$B7FE LD ($B842),HL ; Self-modify: save caller's HL (restored at $B841)
 $B801 LD ($B83F),DE ; Self-modify: save caller's DE (restored at $B83E)
 $B805 LD ($B83C),BC ; Self-modify: save caller's BC (restored at $B83B)
 $B809 LD HL,$9C32   ; Point HL at LFSR state top byte
 $B80C RR (HL)       ; Rotate top byte through carry
 $B80E DEC HL        ;
 $B80F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B810 LD E,A        ;
 $B811 RRA           ;
 $B812 LD D,A        ;
 $B813 DEC HL        ;
 $B814 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B815 LD C,A        ;
 $B816 ADD A,A       ;
 $B817 ADD A,A       ;
 $B818 ADD A,A       ;
 $B819 ADD A,A       ;
 $B81A LD B,A        ;
 $B81B DEC HL        ;
 $B81C LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B81D INC HL        ;
 $B81E LD (HL),A     ;
 $B81F SRL A         ;
 $B821 SRL A         ;
 $B823 SRL A         ;
 $B825 SRL A         ;
 $B827 OR B          ; {Mix rotated nibbles into new state byte
 $B828 XOR D         ; }
 $B829 LD B,A        ;
 $B82A LD A,C        ;
 $B82B INC HL        ;
 $B82C LD (HL),A     ;
 $B82D LD A,($9C2E)  ;
 $B830 LD ($9C2F),A  ;
 $B833 LD A,B        ;
 $B834 LD ($9C2E),A  ;
 $B837 LD A,E        ;
 $B838 INC HL        ;
 $B839 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B83A LD A,B        ;
 $B83B LD BC,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore caller's BC (patched by $B805)
 $B83E LD DE,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore caller's DE (patched by $B801)
 $B841 LD HL,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore caller's HL (patched by $B7FE)
 $B844 RET           ;

; Compute angle from object IX to target IY
;
; Used by the routines at #R$BA2B, #R$BE4A and #R$C43C.
;
; IX object position (shooter)
; IY target position (e.g. player)
;
; Computes the coarse angle (0-63) from the shooter to its target, for use by
; aiming/movement code such as #R$C43C. A rough atan2 built from position
; deltas and a linear-search division, not a lookup table.
@label=calc_angle
c$B845 LD A,(IX+$0B) ;
 $B848 RLA           ;
 $B849 LD A,(IX+$0C) ;
 $B84C ADC A,$00     ;
 $B84E SUB (IY+$0C)  ; Delta X = rounded IX position minus IY column
 $B851 LD C,A        ;
 $B852 LD A,(IX+$0D) ;
 $B855 RLA           ;
 $B856 LD A,(IX+$0E) ;
 $B859 ADC A,$00     ;
 $B85B SUB (IY+$0E)  ; Delta Y = rounded IX position minus IY row
 $B85E LD B,A        ;
 $B85F LD D,$00      ;
 $B861 LD A,B        ;
 $B862 AND A         ;
 $B863 JP P,$B86B    ; Skip abs-negate if delta Y already positive
 $B866 NEG           ;
 $B868 LD B,A        ;
 $B869 LD D,$3F      ;
*$B86B LD A,C        ;
 $B86C AND A         ;
 $B86D JP P,$B878    ; Skip abs-negate if delta X already positive
 $B870 NEG           ;
 $B872 LD C,A        ;
 $B873 LD A,D        ;
 $B874 XOR $1F       ;
 $B876 LD D,A        ;
 $B877 LD A,C        ;
*$B878 CP B          ;
 $B879 JR NC,$B881   ; Swap X/Y (octant refinement) if X >= Y
 $B87B LD C,B        ;
 $B87C LD B,A        ;
 $B87D LD A,D        ;
 $B87E XOR $0F       ;
 $B880 LD D,A        ;
*$B881 LD A,$03      ;
 $B883 CP C          ;
 $B884 JR C,$B887    ; Clamp check against threshold $03
 $B886 CP B          ;
*$B887 CCF           ;
 $B888 PUSH AF       ;
 $B889 LD E,$08      ;
 $B88B SLA B         ;
 $B88D SLA B         ;
 $B88F SLA B         ;
 $B891 LD A,C        ;
 $B892 ADD A,A       ;
 $B893 ADD A,A       ;
 $B894 ADD A,A       ;
*$B895 DEC E         ;
 $B896 JR Z,$B89C    ; Division-loop exit when remainder hits zero
 $B898 SUB C         ;
 $B899 CP B          ;
 $B89A JR NC,$B895   ; Division loop: continue while remainder >= Y
*$B89C LD A,E        ;
 $B89D XOR D         ;
 $B89E LD D,A        ;
 $B89F POP AF        ;
 $B8A0 LD A,D        ;
 $B8A1 RET           ;

; Compute velocity vector (dx,dy) from angle and speed
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B974, #R$B992, #R$BE4A, #R$C015 and #R$C3C7.
;
; A angle (0-63, index into sine table $9B5F)
; B speed/magnitude
; IY object struct base
;
; Looks up sin(A) in the table at $9B5F, sign-extends it, then multiplies by
; speed B via repeated addition to get dx (stored at IY+7/+8). Then computes
; angle-16 (mod 64, a quarter-turn) for cos(A) the same way, to get dy (stored
; at IY+9/+10). Classic 8-bit "aim/fire toward angle" trajectory calculation.
@label=angle_to_velocity
c$B8A2 LD C,B        ; {save speed (B->C), point HL at sine table $9B5F
 $B8A3 PUSH AF       ;
 $B8A4 LD HL,$9B5F   ; }
 $B8A7 LD E,A        ; {index table by angle A
 $B8A8 LD D,$00      ;
 $B8AA ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $B8AB LD A,(HL)     ; {sign-extend table value into DE
 $B8AC LD E,A        ;
 $B8AD RLA           ;
 $B8AE SBC A,A       ;
 $B8AF LD D,A        ; }
 $B8B0 LD HL,$0000   ; HL=0 (accumulator)
*$B8B3 ADD HL,DE     ; {multiply table value by speed B (repeated add)
 $B8B4 DJNZ $B8B3    ; }
 $B8B6 LD (IY+$07),L ; {store dx at IY+7/+8
 $B8B9 LD (IY+$08),H ; }
 $B8BC LD B,C        ; {restore speed and angle
 $B8BD POP AF        ; }
 $B8BE SUB $10       ; {angle-16 mod 64: quarter-turn offset for cosine
 $B8C0 AND $3F       ; }
 $B8C2 LD HL,$9B5F   ; point HL at sine table again
 $B8C5 LD E,A        ; {index table by cosine angle
 $B8C6 LD D,$00      ;
 $B8C8 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $B8C9 LD A,(HL)     ; {sign-extend table value into DE
 $B8CA LD E,A        ;
 $B8CB RLA           ;
 $B8CC SBC A,A       ;
 $B8CD LD D,A        ; }
 $B8CE LD HL,$0000   ; HL=0 (accumulator)
*$B8D1 ADD HL,DE     ; {multiply table value by speed B (repeated add)
 $B8D2 DJNZ $B8D1    ; }
 $B8D4 LD (IY+$09),L ; {store dy at IY+9/+10
 $B8D7 LD (IY+$0A),H ; }
 $B8DA RET           ; return

; Set object position from $9C01, clamp column (IY+$0C) to 8-24
;
; Used by the routine at #R$C5D2.
;
; IY object struct base (writes position fields IY+$0B/$0C/$0D)
;
; Sets an object's on-screen position, keeping its column within the playable
; screen area.
@label=set_object_position
c$B8DB LD A,($9C01)    ; {Snap Y to the top ($9C01), reset X to the left edge
 $B8DE LD (IY+$0D),A   ;
 $B8E1 LD (IY+$0B),$00 ; }
 $B8E5 LD A,(IY+$0C)   ; {Read the object's column
 $B8E8 CP $08          ; }
 $B8EA JR NC,$B8F1     ; Skip left-edge clamp if column is already in range
 $B8EC LD (IY+$0C),$08 ; {Clamp column at the left edge (8)
 $B8F0 RET             ; }
*$B8F1 CP $19          ; {Skip right-edge clamp if column is already in range
 $B8F3 RET C           ; }
 $B8F4 LD (IY+$0C),$18 ; {Clamp column at the right edge ($18)
 $B8F8 RET             ; }

; Movement-pattern script interpreter
;
; Used by the routines at #R$C075, #R$C11C, #R$C199 and #R$C217.
;
; IY object struct base
;
; Runs an object's movement-pattern script one step at a time, waiting out a
; per-object timer between steps before continuing into #R$B920 to decode the
; next script byte.
@label=movement_script_run
c$B8F9 DEC (IY+$18)    ; {Count down the frame-delay timer (IY+$18); branch
 $B8FC JR Z,$B914      ; when it expires
 $B8FE JP P,$B904      ;
 $B901 INC (IY+$18)    ; }
*$B904 LD A,(IY+$17)   ; Dispatched step's script byte (IY+$17)
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$B920.
*$B907 LD C,A          ; {Mask to 0-7, dispatch via the #R$A076 sub-table
 $B908 AND $07         ;
 $B90A LD HL,$A076     ; }
 $B90D CALL $B7F6      ; Jump-table dispatcher
 $B910 RET NC          ;
 $B911 JP $B8F9        ; => Movement-pattern script interpreter
*$B914 LD (IY+$18),$01 ; {Timer expired: default to 1 frame, load the script
 $B918 LD L,(IY+$15)   ; pointer
 $B91B LD H,(IY+$16)   ; }
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$B920.
*$B91E LD A,(HL)       ;
 $B91F INC HL          ;

; Decode movement-script "wait" byte (bit 7 set = wait N or random frames)
;
; .
;
; A script byte to decode
;
; Decodes the next movement-script byte: a wait command reloads the frame-delay
; timer, otherwise it's a step index handled by the fallthrough at #R$B935.
c$B920 AND A         ; {High bit clear: not a wait, fall through to step
 $B921 JP P,$B935    ; dispatch}
 $B924 AND $7F       ; {Low 7 bits = wait frame count
 $B926 CP $01        ; }
 $B928 JR NZ,$B930   ; Value 1 means random wait
 $B92A CALL $B7FE    ; Pseudo-random number generator
 $B92D AND $1F       ; {Random wait = 1-32 frames
 $B92F INC A         ; }
*$B930 LD (IY+$18),A ;
 $B933 JR $B91E      ;
*$B935 LD (IY+$17),A ;
 $B938 LD (IY+$15),L ;
 $B93B LD (IY+$16),H ;
 $B93E JP $B907      ;

; Movement opcode $3B: dispatch sub-command (C bits 3-6) via $A082
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $3B of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
@label=mvop_dispatch_sub
c$B941 LD A,C        ;
 $B942 AND $78       ;
 $B944 RRCA          ;
 $B945 RRCA          ;
 $B946 RRCA          ;
 $B947 LD HL,$A082   ;
 $B94A CALL $B7F6    ; Jump-table dispatcher
 $B94D RET           ;

; Read next movement-script byte into E
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B95F, #R$B9CA and #R$B9F1.
;
;   IY object struct base (script pointer at IY+$15/$16)
; O:E the fetched script byte
;   HL preserved; advances the object's script pointer (IY+$15/$16)
;
; Fetches the next byte of an object's movement script and advances its script
; pointer.
@label=movement_next_byte
c$B94E PUSH HL       ;
 $B94F LD L,(IY+$15) ;
 $B952 LD H,(IY+$16) ;
 $B955 LD E,(HL)     ;
 $B956 INC HL        ;
 $B957 LD (IY+$15),L ;
 $B95A LD (IY+$16),H ;
 $B95D POP HL        ;
 $B95E RET           ;

; Movement opcode $3C: set field IY+$19 (from C or next script byte)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $3C of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
; .
; Sets a per-object field, its value either packed into the opcode byte itself
; or, if that's zero, read as a following script byte.
@label=mvop_set_iy19
c$B95F LD A,C        ; {C's high nibble as the value; skip if zero
 $B960 AND $78       ; }
 $B962 JR Z,$B96C    ;
 $B964 RRCA          ; {Extract the value, store, signal continue
 $B965 RRCA          ;
 $B966 RRCA          ;
 $B967 LD (IY+$19),A ;
 $B96A SCF           ; }
 $B96B RET           ;
*$B96C CALL $B94E    ; Read next movement-script byte into E
 $B96F LD (IY+$19),E ; Otherwise: store the value read by #R$B94E, signal
                     ; continue
 $B972 SCF           ;
 $B973 RET           ;

; Movement opcode $3D: set absolute heading, apply velocity
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $3D of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
; .
; Sets the object's heading to a value packed into the opcode byte, mirroring
; it if the object faces left, then moves it.
@label=mvop_set_heading
c$B974 LD A,C         ; {Extract heading value from C
 $B975 AND $78        ;
 $B977 RRCA           ; }
 $B978 BIT 7,(IY+$04) ; {Mirror the heading if the object faces left (IY+$04
 $B97C JR Z,$B984     ; bit 7)}
 $B97E NEG            ;
 $B980 ADD A,$20      ;
 $B982 AND $3F        ;
*$B984 LD (IY+$10),A  ; Store the new heading
 $B987 LD B,(IY+$11)  ; B = speed (IY+$11)
 $B98A CALL $B8A2     ; Compute velocity vector (dx,dy) from angle and speed
 $B98D CALL $BA0A     ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $B990 AND A          ;
 $B991 RET            ;

; Movement opcode $3E: turn heading relative, apply velocity
;
; Used by the routine at #R$BA2B.
;
; .
;
; Turns the object's heading by an amount and sign packed into the opcode byte,
; then moves it.
@label=mvop_turn_heading
c$B992 BIT 7,(IY+$04) ; {Mirror the turn direction if the object faces left
 $B996 JR Z,$B99C     ; (IY+$04 bit 7)}
 $B998 LD A,C         ;
 $B999 XOR $40        ;
 $B99B LD C,A         ;
*$B99C LD A,C         ; {Extract turn amount from C
 $B99D AND $38        ;
 $B99F RRCA           ;
 $B9A0 RRCA           ;
 $B9A1 RRCA           ;
 $B9A2 INC A          ; }
 $B9A3 BIT 6,C        ; {Negate the turn if C bit 6 is set
 $B9A5 JR Z,$B9A9     ;
 $B9A7 NEG            ; }
*$B9A9 ADD A,(IY+$10) ; {Apply the turn to the current heading (IY+$10)
 $B9AC AND $3F        ;
 $B9AE LD (IY+$10),A  ; }
 $B9B1 LD B,(IY+$11)  ; B = speed (IY+$11)
 $B9B4 CALL $B8A2     ; Compute velocity vector (dx,dy) from angle and speed
 $B9B7 CALL $BA0A     ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $B9BA AND A          ;
 $B9BB RET            ;

; Movement opcode $3F: set/clear mirror flag (IY+$04 bit 6)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $3F of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
@label=mvop_set_mirror
c$B9BC SET 6,(IY+$04) ;

; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B974, #R$B992, #R$BE4A, #R$BFEB, #R$C015 and
; #R$C3C7.
;
; IY object struct base
;
; SP=IY stack trick: adds the velocity fields (set by #R$B8A2, IY+7/+8 and
; IY+9/+10) onto the position fields (IY+11/+12 and IY+13/+14). The generic
; "move by velocity" step; also index $43 of the #R$A000 jump table.
@label=apply_velocity
c$BA0A LD ($BA1F),SP ; Save caller's SP (restored at $BA1E)
 $BA0E LD SP,IY      ; {Point SP at the object's velocity fields (IY+7)
 $BA10 LD HL,$0007   ;
 $BA13 ADD HL,SP     ;
 $BA14 LD SP,HL      ; }
 $BA15 POP HL        ; {Pop dx, dy, X into HL/DE/BC
 $BA16 POP DE        ;
 $BA17 POP BC        ; }
 $BA18 ADD HL,BC     ; {X += dx
 $BA19 EX DE,HL      ; }
 $BA1A POP BC        ; {Y += dy
 $BA1B ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $BA1C PUSH HL       ; {Write both updated coordinates back
 $BA1D PUSH DE       ; }
 $BA1E LD SP,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP (patched by $BA0A)
 $BA21 AND A         ;
 $BA22 RET           ;

; Spawn a group of formation objects from the free-list pool
;
; Used by the routines at #R$C981 and #R$C9AF.
;
; O:Cy set if a group was spawned
;
; Called from #R$C981 (column spawn markers) and #R$C9AF (enemy timeline).
; Finds the first free formation slot at $9B4F, works out how many objects to
; spawn from the remaining wave counter ($9D18) against a per-group budget
; table at $5CF4, then pops that many objects off the free list ($9D1C) via an
; SP-trick and initializes each from a spawn-template table at $5B55 (index*9 +
; $5B55), applying a difficulty offset ($9C41). Returns carry set on success.
c$BA5F EX AF,AF'       ;
 $BA60 LD A,($9D18)    ;
 $BA63 AND A           ; {Exit if wave counter is zero
 $BA64 RET Z           ; }
 $BA65 LD HL,$9B4F     ; Scan the 8 formation slots ($9B4F, stride 2) for the
                       ; first free one
 $BA68 LD B,$08        ;
 $BA6A XOR A           ;
*$BA6B CP (HL)         ;
 $BA6C JR Z,$BA74      ;
 $BA6E INC L           ;
 $BA6F INC L           ;
 $BA70 DJNZ $BA6B      ;
 $BA72 AND A           ;
 $BA73 RET             ;
*$BA74 LD A,$08        ; Compute slot index (8-B)
 $BA76 SUB B           ;
 $BA77 LD ($BB55),A    ; Store slot index at $BB55
 $BA7A PUSH HL         ;
 $BA7B LD A,D          ; {E = (D high nibble) + $30
 $BA7C AND $F0         ;
 $BA7E ADD A,$30       ;
 $BA80 LD E,A          ; }
 $BA81 LD A,D          ; {D = (D low nibble * 16) + 8
 $BA82 AND $0F         ;
 $BA84 ADD A,A         ;
 $BA85 ADD A,A         ;
 $BA86 ADD A,A         ;
 $BA87 ADD A,A         ;
 $BA88 ADD A,$08       ;
 $BA8A LD D,A          ; }
 $BA8B LD A,C          ; {Save C's top 2 bits to self-modified operand $BB41
 $BA8C AND $C0         ;
 $BA8E LD ($BB41),A    ; }
 $BA91 XOR C           ; Clear those bits from C (mask to 0-$3F)
 $BA92 LD H,$5B        ; {HL = $5B29 + masked C: index tag-to-group table
 $BA94 ADD A,$29       ;
 $BA96 LD L,A          ; }
 $BA97 LD C,(HL)       ; {C = looked-up group index (BC for word math)
 $BA98 LD B,$00        ; }
 $BA9A LD HL,$5CF4     ; {Index group-budget table at $5CF4 (2 bytes/entry)
 $BA9D ADD HL,BC       ;
 $BA9E ADD HL,BC       ; }
 $BA9F LD A,($9D18)    ;
 $BAA2 LD B,A          ;
 $BAA3 CP (HL)         ; {Clamp spawn count to remaining wave counter ($9D18)
 $BAA4 JR C,$BAA7      ; }
 $BAA6 LD B,(HL)       ;
*$BAA7 SUB B           ; {Deduct spawned count from wave counter
 $BAA8 LD ($9D18),A    ; }
 $BAAB INC HL          ;
 $BAAC LD A,B          ;
 $BAAD EXX             ;
 $BAAE LD B,A          ;
 $BAAF LD HL,($9D1C)   ; Pop head of free-object list ($9D1C)
 $BAB2 PUSH HL         ;
 $BAB3 POP IX          ;
 $BAB5 LD ($BAC7),SP   ; Save SP (self-modified operand, restored below)
*$BAB9 LD SP,HL        ; {SP-trick: pop B objects off the free list
 $BABA POP HL          ;
 $BABB DJNZ $BAB9      ; }
 $BABD LD ($9D1C),HL   ; Update free-list head ($9D1C)
 $BAC0 PUSH IX         ;
 $BAC2 LD ($BBB4),IX   ; Store allocated object pointer at $BBB4
 $BAC6 LD SP,$0000     ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP (patched by $BAB5)
 $BAC9 EXX             ;
 $BACA LD B,A          ;
 $BACB EXX             ;
 $BACC POP BC          ;
 $BACD LD (BC),A       ; {Write object-index byte
 $BACE INC C           ; }
 $BACF EXX             ;
 $BAD0 LD A,(HL)       ;
 $BAD1 INC HL          ;
 $BAD2 EXX             ;
 $BAD3 CP $01          ; {Type 1: consume a $9C69 credit
 $BAD5 JR NZ,$BAE1     ; }
 $BAD7 LD HL,$9C69     ;
 $BADA LD A,(HL)       ;
 $BADB AND A           ;
 $BADC JR Z,$BAE1      ;
 $BADE LD A,$01        ;
 $BAE0 DEC (HL)        ;
*$BAE1 LD (BC),A       ;
 $BAE2 AND A           ;
 $BAE3 JR Z,$BAEA      ;
 $BAE5 LD A,$06        ;
 $BAE7 LD ($9C44),A    ;
*$BAEA EXX             ; {Read spawn-template index byte
 $BAEB LD A,(HL)       ;
 $BAEC INC HL          ; }
 $BAED EXX             ;
 $BAEE LD L,A          ;
 $BAEF ADD A,A         ; {Index template table at $5B55 (index*9 + $5B55)
 $BAF0 ADD A,A         ;
 $BAF1 ADD A,A         ;
 $BAF2 ADD A,L         ;
 $BAF3 ADD A,$55       ; }
 $BAF5 LD L,A          ;
 $BAF6 LD H,$5B        ;
 $BAF8 LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 0 -> IX+$05
 $BAF9 INC HL          ;
 $BAFA LD ($BB51),A    ; }
 $BAFD LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 1 -> IX+$12
 $BAFE INC HL          ;
 $BAFF LD ($BB4D),A    ; }
 $BB02 LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 2 -> IX+$1A
 $BB03 INC HL          ;
 $BB04 LD ($BB59),A    ; }
 $BB07 LD A,($9C41)    ; {Add difficulty offset ($9C41), clamp to $FF; template
 $BB0A ADD A,(HL)      ; byte 3 -> IX+$1B
 $BB0B JR NC,$BB0F     ;
 $BB0D LD A,$FF        ; }
*$BB0F INC HL          ;
 $BB10 LD ($BB5D),A    ;
 $BB13 LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 4 -> IX+$11
 $BB14 INC HL          ;
 $BB15 LD ($BB61),A    ; }
 $BB18 LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 5 -> IX+$02 (not a code pointer - see
 $BB19 INC HL          ; #R$5B55)
 $BB1A LD ($BB45),A    ; }
 $BB1D LD A,(HL)       ; {Template byte 6 -> IX+$03
 $BB1E INC HL          ;
 $BB1F LD ($BB49),A    ; }
 $BB22 LD A,(HL)       ; {Template bytes 7,8 (little-endian) = a fixed-slot
 $BB23 INC HL          ; address ($9D1E/$9D24/$9D2A)
 $BB24 LD H,(HL)       ;
 $BB25 LD L,A          ; }
 $BB26 LD ($BBB7),HL   ; {Save that address into the read-modify-write tail's
 $BB29 LD ($BBBB),HL   ; operands ($BBB6/$BBBA)}
 $BB2C EXX             ;
 $BB2D LD A,(HL)       ;
 $BB2E INC HL          ;
 $BB2F EXX             ;
 $BB30 LD B,A          ;
 $BB31 AND $7F         ;
 $BB33 LD C,A          ;
 $BB34 XOR B           ;
 $BB35 LD B,A          ;
 $BB36 EX AF,AF'       ;
 $BB37 OR B            ;
 $BB38 LD B,A          ;
 $BB39 EXX             ;
 $BB3A LD ($BBBE),SP   ;
*$BB3E LD (IX+$04),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! Init object fields from the self-modified
                       ; operands just patched above (patched by $BA8E)
 $BB42 LD (IX+$02),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB1A
 $BB46 LD (IX+$03),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB1F
 $BB4A LD (IX+$12),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BAFF
 $BB4E LD (IX+$05),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BAFA
 $BB52 LD (IX+$13),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BA77
 $BB56 LD (IX+$1A),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB04
 $BB5A LD (IX+$1B),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB10
 $BB5E LD (IX+$11),$00 ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB15
 $BB62 SET 0,(IX+$04)  ;
 $BB66 LD (IX+$1C),$10 ;
 $BB6A LD (IX+$06),$06 ;
 $BB6E LD (IX+$18),$01 ;
 $BB72 LD A,(HL)       ; {Read the byte at the fixed-slot address
 $BB73 INC HL          ; (movement-script selector)
 $BB74 EXX             ; }
 $BB75 LD L,A          ; {Index $5B00 table by that byte
 $BB76 LD H,$5B        ; }
 $BB78 LD E,(HL)       ; {E = looked-up offset, D = 0
 $BB79 LD D,$00        ; }
 $BB7B LD HL,$5BAF     ; {HL = $5BAF + 2*offset: entry point into the shared
 $BB7E ADD HL,DE       ; script bytecode
 $BB7F ADD HL,DE       ; }
 $BB80 LD (IX+$15),L   ; {Store script entry point at object's IX+$15/$16
 $BB83 LD (IX+$16),H   ; }
 $BB86 LD A,B          ;
 $BB87 LD (IX+$0F),A   ;
 $BB8A ADD A,C         ;
 $BB8B LD B,A          ;
 $BB8C EXX             ;
 $BB8D LD A,E          ;
 $BB8E ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $BB8F INC HL          ;
 $BB90 RRCA            ;
 $BB91 RRCA            ;
 $BB92 RRCA            ;
 $BB93 LD C,A          ;
 $BB94 AND $E0         ;
 $BB96 LD (IX+$0B),A   ;
 $BB99 XOR C           ;
 $BB9A LD (IX+$0C),A   ;
 $BB9D LD A,D          ;
 $BB9E ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $BB9F INC HL          ;
 $BBA0 RRCA            ;
 $BBA1 RRCA            ;
 $BBA2 RRCA            ;
 $BBA3 LD C,A          ;
 $BBA4 AND $E0         ;
 $BBA6 LD (IX+$0D),A   ;
 $BBA9 XOR C           ;
 $BBAA LD (IX+$0E),A   ;
 $BBAD LD SP,IX        ;
 $BBAF POP IX          ;
 $BBB1 DJNZ $BB3E      ;
 $BBB3 LD SP,$0000     ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP (patched by $BAC2)

                       ; address (patched by $BB26)
 $BBB9 EX (SP),HL      ; Swap it with the stack top
 $BBBA LD ($0000),HL   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Write the swapped value back to the
                       ; fixed-slot address (patched by $BB29)
 $BBBD LD SP,$0000     ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $BB3A
 $BBC0 SCF             ;
 $BBC1 RET             ;

; Clear buffers at $7F00-$7FFF and $8000-$80FF (fast PUSH fill)
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A0C4 and #R$A8C0.
;
; .
;
; Zeroes two 256-byte buffers each frame using a fast PUSH-unroll fill, the
; same technique shared by other fast-fill routines in this game.
@label=clear_buffers
c$BBC2 LD DE,$0000   ; DE=$0000 (fill value)
 $BBC5 LD HL,$7F00   ; {Point HL/B at first buffer ($7F00, 16 groups of 8)
 $BBC8 LD B,$10      ; }
 $BBCA CALL $BBD2    ; Fill first buffer, then set up second buffer ($8000)
 $BBCD LD HL,$8000   ;
 $BBD0 LD B,$10      ;
*$BBD2 LD ($BBE2),SP ; SP-trick: save caller's SP, point SP at fill destination
 $BBD6 LD SP,HL      ;
*$BBD7 PUSH DE       ; {Unrolled PUSH DE x8, looped B times
 $BBD8 PUSH DE       ;
 $BBD9 PUSH DE       ;
 $BBDA PUSH DE       ;
 $BBDB PUSH DE       ;
 $BBDC PUSH DE       ;
 $BBDD PUSH DE       ;
 $BBDE PUSH DE       ; }
 $BBDF DJNZ $BBD7    ;
 $BBE1 LD SP,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP and return (patched by $BBD2)
 $BBE4 RET           ;

; Mark active objects into the attribute-buffer collision mask
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Marks each active object's position into the collision attribute buffers, one
; distinct bit per object, for damage/collision checks to test against later.
@label=mark_collision_masks
c$BBE5 LD ($BCDA),SP ; Save SP (restored via the $7E-page LD SP tail)
 $BBE9 LD IY,($9D30) ; IY = object list head ($9D30)
 $BBED LD HL,$9D19   ; {B = 6 - active object count ($9D19)
 $BBF0 LD A,$06      ;
 $BBF2 SUB (HL)      ; }

                     ; damage/collision branch (Immunity)

 $BBF7 LD C,$01      ; }
*$BBF9 LD A,(IY+$05) ; {E = object's mask bit only when type (IY+$05) is 3
 $BBFC CP $03        ;
 $BBFE LD E,C        ;
 $BBFF JR Z,$BC03    ;
 $BC01 LD E,$00      ; }

 $BC05 LD A,(IY+$0D) ; {Compute $7Exx attribute-row address from object Y
 $BC08 AND $E0       ; (IY+$0D/$0E)
 $BC0A OR (IY+$0E)   ;
 $BC0D RLCA          ;
 $BC0E RLCA          ;
 $BC0F RLCA          ;
 $BC10 INC A         ;
 $BC11 LD L,A        ; }
 $BC12 LD A,(HL)     ; {OR mask bit into this attribute row
 $BC13 OR E          ;
 $BC14 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC15 INC L         ; {row 2/12
 $BC16 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC17 OR E          ;
 $BC18 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC19 INC L         ; {row 3/12
 $BC1A LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC1B OR E          ;
 $BC1C LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC1D INC L         ; {row 4/12
 $BC1E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC1F OR E          ;
 $BC20 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC21 INC L         ; {row 5/12
 $BC22 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC23 OR E          ;
 $BC24 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC25 INC L         ; {row 6/12
 $BC26 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC27 OR E          ;
 $BC28 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC29 INC L         ; {row 7/12
 $BC2A LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC2B OR E          ;
 $BC2C LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC2D INC L         ; {row 8/12
 $BC2E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC2F OR E          ;
 $BC30 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC31 INC L         ; {row 9/12
 $BC32 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC33 OR E          ;
 $BC34 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC35 INC L         ; {row 10/12
 $BC36 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC37 OR E          ;
 $BC38 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC39 INC L         ; {row 11/12
 $BC3A LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC3B OR E          ;
 $BC3C LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC3D INC L         ; {row 12/12
 $BC3E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC3F OR E          ;
 $BC40 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC41 LD H,$7F      ; H=$7F: point at the high-page attribute buffer
 $BC43 LD A,(IY+$0B) ; {Compute $7Fxx attribute-row address from object Y
 $BC46 AND $E0       ; (IY+$0B/$0C)
 $BC48 OR (IY+$0C)   ;
 $BC4B RLCA          ;
 $BC4C RLCA          ;
 $BC4D RLCA          ;
 $BC4E LD L,A        ; }
 $BC4F LD A,(HL)     ; {OR mask bit into this attribute row (row 1/8)
 $BC50 OR E          ;
 $BC51 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC52 INC L         ; {row 2/8
 $BC53 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC54 OR E          ;
 $BC55 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC56 INC L         ; {row 3/8
 $BC57 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC58 OR E          ;
 $BC59 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC5A INC L         ; {row 4/8
 $BC5B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC5C OR E          ;
 $BC5D LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC5E INC L         ; {row 5/8
 $BC5F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC60 OR E          ;
 $BC61 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC62 INC L         ; {row 6/8
 $BC63 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC64 OR E          ;
 $BC65 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC66 INC L         ; {row 7/8
 $BC67 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC68 OR E          ;
 $BC69 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC6A INC L         ; {row 8/8
 $BC6B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BC6C OR E          ;
 $BC6D LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BC6E LD (IY+$14),C ; {Store the object's mask bit (IY+$14), rotate C for the
 $BC71 RLC C         ; next object}
 $BC73 LD SP,IY      ; {Advance to the next object in the list
 $BC75 POP IY        ; }

; Entry point reached from #R$BBE5's mask-draw loop; also entered directly when
; POKE 48115,58 (Immunity) forces the mask byte to $80, skipping the normal
; per-object bit rotation (RLC C) at $BC71 and disabling the damage/collision
; branch.
*$BC79 LD C,$80      ;
 $BC7B LD H,$7E      ;

; Draw fixed 8-row collision mask into both attribute buffers
;
; .
