; Update randomized countdown, then enter player update ($BDAE)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Randomly ticks down a shared timer used elsewhere for homing/steering, then
; falls through into the per-frame player update loop.
c$BD99 CALL $B7FE     ; Pseudo-random number generator
 $BD9C AND $01        ;
 $BD9E JR NZ,$BDAA    ;
 $BDA0 LD HL,$9C42    ;
 $BDA3 DEC (HL)       ;
 $BDA4 JR NZ,$BDAA    ;
 $BDA6 LD A,($9C43)   ;
 $BDA9 LD (HL),A      ;
*$BDAA LD IY,$9D1E    ;
*$BDAE LD HL,$9C33    ; {flip and mask border colour bits at $9C33/$9C34,
 $BDB1 LD A,(HL)      ; output to port $FE
 $BDB2 XOR $18        ;
 $BDB4 LD (HL),A      ; }
 $BDB5 INC HL         ;
 $BDB6 AND (HL)       ;
 $BDB7 OUT ($FE),A    ;
 $BDB9 LD L,(IY+$00)  ; {load player object pointer into IY, save previous IY
 $BDBC LD H,(IY+$01)  ;
 $BDBF LD ($B7E4),IY  ; }
 $BDC3 PUSH HL        ;
 $BDC4 POP IY         ;
 $BDC6 BIT 2,(IY+$04) ; branch on object state flag bit 2
 $BDCA JR Z,$BDD7     ;
*$BDCC LD A,(IY+$05)  ; {self-loop: advance frame counter, run per-frame update
 $BDCF LD HL,$A052    ; at $A052
 $BDD2 CALL $B7F6     ; }
 $BDD5 JR $BDAE       ;
*$BDD7 BIT 7,(IY+$0F) ; branch on respawn/blink flag bit 7
 $BDDB JR Z,$BDF6     ;
 $BDDD DEC (IY+$0F)   ; {count down respawn blink timer
 $BDE0 LD A,(IY+$0F)  ;
 $BDE3 CP $80         ;
 $BDE5 JR Z,$BDFB     ; }

 $BDEA ADD A,$20      ;
 $BDEC LD (IY+$0D),A  ;
 $BDEF JR NC,$BDF4    ; }
 $BDF1 INC (IY+$0E)   ;
*$BDF4 JR $BDAE       ;
*$BDF6 DEC (IY+$0F)   ; count down remaining blink cycles
 $BDF9 JR NZ,$BDAE    ;
*$BDFB SET 2,(IY+$04) ; {clear blink state, resume normal update
 $BDFF JR $BDCC       ; }

; Player: skip movement if immobilised, else read input and move

; .

; .

 $BE2E LD A,($9CDE)  ; {decode horizontal direction bits from input (Kempston
 $BE31 LD C,A        ; layout: bit 0=Right, bit 1=Left)
 $BE32 AND $03       ;
 $BE34 LD B,$01      ; }

                     ; step
 $BE38 LD L,(IY+$0B) ; {load X position, DE=step distance $0060
 $BE3B LD H,(IY+$0C) ;
 $BE3E LD DE,$0060   ; }
 $BE41 RRA           ; {shift Right bit into carry; assume bank-right target
 $BE42 LD B,$02      ; (B=2)}

; Clamp player position to screen bounds, update bank animation
;
; .
;
; B bank-frame target (2=right, 0=left, 1=level)
; IY player object struct base
;
; Clamps the player's position to the screen bounds, then converts left/right
; input into a banking-tilt sprite frame - stepping the bank angle one frame at
; a time rather than snapping directly to it.
@label=clamp_player_pos
c$BE4A JR $BE4D        ; entry: X delta already applied, skip add
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$BE03.
*$BE4C ADD HL,DE       ; entry: add X delta (HL+=DE)
*$BE4D LD A,H          ; {check X within left bound
 $BE4E SUB $07         ;
 $BE50 JP P,$BE58      ; }
 $BE53 LD HL,$0700     ; {clamp X to left edge ($0700)
 $BE56 JR $BE5F        ; }
*$BE58 CP $12          ; {check X within right bound
 $BE5A JR C,$BE5F      ; }
 $BE5C LD HL,$18E0     ; clamp X to right edge ($18E0)
*$BE5F LD (IY+$0B),L   ; {store clamped X position
 $BE62 LD (IY+$0C),H   ; }
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$BE03.
*$BE65 LD (IY+$17),B   ; {save frame-select param; decode vertical direction
 $BE68 LD A,C          ; bits
 $BE69 AND $0C         ;
 $BE6B RRA             ;
 $BE6C RRA             ; }
 $BE6D JR Z,$BE98      ; skip vertical move if no direction bit set
 $BE6F LD L,(IY+$0D)   ; {load Y position, DE=step size
 $BE72 LD H,(IY+$0E)   ;
 $BE75 LD DE,$0060     ; }
 $BE78 RRA             ; {check vertical direction bit
 $BE79 JR C,$BE7F      ; }
 $BE7B SBC HL,DE       ; {move up
 $BE7D JR $BE80        ; }
*$BE7F ADD HL,DE       ; move down
*$BE80 LD A,H          ; {check Y within top bound
 $BE81 SUB $03         ;
 $BE83 JP P,$BE8B      ; }
 $BE86 LD HL,$0300     ; {clamp Y to top edge ($0300)
 $BE89 JR $BE92        ; }
*$BE8B CP $16          ; {check Y within bottom bound
 $BE8D JR C,$BE92      ; }
 $BE8F LD HL,$18E0     ; clamp Y to bottom edge ($18E0)
*$BE92 LD (IY+$0D),L   ; {store clamped Y position
 $BE95 LD (IY+$0E),H   ; }
*$BE98 LD A,(IY+$16)   ; {read current bank frame; check banking-in-progress
 $BE9B BIT 4,(IY+$04)  ; flag}
 $BE9F JR NZ,$BEAE     ; skip if already banking
 $BEA1 CP (IY+$17)     ; {no bank change needed if already at target
 $BEA4 JR Z,$BEC7      ; }
 $BEA6 SET 4,(IY+$04)  ; {start banking, set delay timer=5
 $BEAA LD (IY+$15),$05 ; }
*$BEAE DEC (IY+$15)    ; {count down bank-delay timer
 $BEB1 JR NZ,$BEC7     ; }
 $BEB3 RES 4,(IY+$04)  ; {clear banking flag; compare target vs current bank
 $BEB7 LD A,(IY+$17)   ;
 $BEBA LD C,(IY+$16)   ; }
 $BEBD CP C            ;
 $BEBE JR Z,$BEC7      ;
 $BEC0 SBC A,A         ; {step current bank frame toward target by 1
 $BEC1 OR $01          ;
 $BEC3 ADD A,C         ;
 $BEC4 LD (IY+$16),A   ; }
*$BEC7 LD H,$9B        ; {index sprite-frame table by bank value
 $BEC9 ADD A,$4C       ;
 $BECB LD L,A          ;
 $BECC LD A,(HL)       ; }
 $BECD LD (IY+$06),A   ; store new sprite frame
 $BED0 CALL $BF42      ; Use bomb
 $BED3 RET             ;
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$BE03.
*$BED4 LD HL,$9C3B     ;
 $BED7 AND A           ;
 $BED8 JP P,$BF1A      ;
 $BEDB LD A,(IY+$0E)   ;
 $BEDE CP $11          ;
 $BEE0 JR NZ,$BEF2     ;
 $BEE2 LD A,(IY+$0C)   ;
 $BEE5 CP $0E          ;
 $BEE7 JR NZ,$BEF2     ;
 $BEE9 LD (IY+$06),$06 ;
 $BEED LD A,$38        ;
 $BEEF ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $BEF0 LD (HL),A       ;
 $BEF1 RET             ;
*$BEF2 DEC (HL)        ;
 $BEF3 LD IX,$9CB5     ;
 $BEF7 CALL $B845      ; Compute angle from object IX to target IY
 $BEFA LD B,$03        ;
 $BEFC CALL $B8A2      ; Compute velocity vector (dx,dy) from angle and speed
 $BEFF CALL $BA0A      ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $BF02 LD A,(IY+$0C)   ;
 $BF05 CP $0E          ;
 $BF07 LD (IY+$06),$06 ;
 $BF0B RET Z           ;

 $BF10 LD (IY+$06),$04 ;
 $BF14 RET Z           ;
 $BF15 LD (IY+$06),$00 ;
 $BF19 RET             ;
*$BF1A DEC (HL)        ;
 $BF1B RET NZ          ;
 $BF1C LD A,$03        ;
 $BF1E CALL $A599      ; Ratchet player state forward
 $BF21 RET             ;

; Handle player hit: switch to hit/explosion animation, arm recovery timer
;
; Used by the routine at #R$BE03.
;
; IY player object base (inherited from $BDAE's caller)
;
; Switches the player into its hit/explosion animation and arms the
; death/respawn recovery timer.
@label=player_hit
c$BF22 LD IX,($9C77)   ; IX = object that hit the player
 $BF26 LD A,($9BA4)    ; {tag it with current wave/formation id
 $BF29 LD (IX+$07),A   ; }
 $BF2C LD (IY+$18),$0E ; {arm hit-reaction timer; set player's IX+$02/$03
 $BF30 LD (IY+$02),$86 ; (record ptr, not code) to $6B86...}
 $BF34 LD (IY+$03),$6B ; {...(hit/explosion animation); set visual state
 $BF38 LD (IY+$06),$06 ; }
 $BF3C LD A,$26        ; {arm 38-frame recovery/death timer at $9C3C
 $BF3E LD ($9C3C),A    ; }
 $BF41 RET             ; return

; Launch and move projectile; explode on hit
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for index $36 of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
; .
; Launches a projectile on its first call, then moves it every frame; explodes
; it on a confirmed hit, or retires it and signals formation completion once
; its lifetime flag clears.
c$C015 LD A,(IY+$10)   ; {First call only (IY+$10 != $FF)
 $C018 CP $FF          ;
 $C01A JP Z,$C02A      ; }
 $C01D LD B,(IY+$11)   ; B = launch speed (IY+$11)
 $C020 CALL $B8A2      ; Compute velocity vector (dx,dy) from angle and speed
 $C023 CALL $BA0A      ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $C026 LD (IY+$10),$FF ; Mark launched, so this only fires once
*$C02A CALL $BA0A      ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $C02D BIT 5,(IY+$04)  ; {Skip hit/retire handling unless flag bit 5 (IY+$04)
 $C031 JR Z,$C049      ; is set}
 $C033 LD A,(IY+$14)   ; {Skip if IY+$14 bit 6 is set (not a hit)
 $C036 BIT 6,A         ;
 $C038 JR NZ,$C049     ; }
 $C03A AND $80         ; {Bail out unless IY+$14 bit 7 (hit) is set
 $C03C RET Z           ; }
 $C03D LD HL,$9C6B     ; {Set the global hit flag ($9C6B)
 $C040 SET 7,(HL)      ; }
 $C042 LD DE,$9D1A     ;
 $C045 CALL $C5AF      ; Start object explosion sequence
 $C048 RET             ;
*$C049 LD HL,$9D1A     ; {Otherwise: mark this formation group's slot count
 $C04C INC (HL)        ; }
 $C04D CALL $B79F      ; Mark formation slot done, trigger completion effect
                       ; when group empties
 $C050 RET             ;

 $C061 INC A         ;
 $C062 CP $10        ; }
 $C064 JR Z,$C06A    ; branch when frame wraps
 $C066 LD (IY+$06),A ; {store frame, return
 $C069 RET           ; }
*$C06A LD L,(IY+$15) ; {load the group-counter address stored at IY+$15/$16 by
 $C06D LD H,(IY+$16) ; #R$C5AF}
 $C070 INC (HL)      ; {animation finished: bump that group counter, notify
 $C071 CALL $B7A3    ; #R$B7A3}
 $C074 RET           ; return

; Multi-hit enemy: take damage, retire after hit counter (IY+12) expires
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Handler for indices $2E, $2F of the #R$A000 jump table (see #R$B7F6).
; .
; A multi-hit enemy: every hit is ORed into the global hit-flag $9C6B and
; knocks one off its hit counter (IY+$12), and it only reacts once that counter
; runs out. At that point a state-$05 enemy may transform rather than die -
; taking a fresh movement script and a random facing - while other types always
; explode. Otherwise it just picks a sprite frame from its heading and runs its
; fire-decision timer.
c$C075 CALL $B8F9      ; Movement-pattern script interpreter
 $C078 BIT 1,(IY+$04)  ; {Retiring (IY+$04 bit 1)? explode if also
 $C07C JR Z,$C08C      ; mid-transition, otherwise retire
 $C07E BIT 4,(IY+$04)  ;
 $C082 JR NZ,$C0D4     ; }
*$C084 LD HL,$9D18     ; {Count the object out of its group ($9D18)
 $C087 INC (HL)        ; }
 $C088 CALL $B79F      ; Mark formation slot done, trigger completion effect
                       ; when group empties
 $C08B RET             ;
*$C08C BIT 4,(IY+$04)  ; {Already mid-transition (bit 4): just step the
 $C090 JR NZ,$C10A     ; animation}
 $C092 LD A,(IY+$14)   ; {Not hit this frame: skip to the movement tail
 $C095 LD C,A          ;
 $C096 AND A           ;
 $C097 JR Z,$C0E0      ; }
 $C099 LD HL,$9C6B     ; {OR the hit bits into the global hit-flag ($9C6B)
 $C09C LD A,C          ;
 $C09D OR (HL)         ;
 $C09E LD (HL),A       ; }
 $C09F DEC (IY+$12)    ; {Decrement the hit counter; nothing more to do while
 $C0A2 JR NZ,$C0E0     ; it survives}
 $C0A4 LD A,(IY+$05)   ; {Only a state-$05 enemy can transform; other types
 $C0A7 CP $05          ; explode
 $C0A9 JR NZ,$C0D4     ; }
 $C0AB CALL $B7FE      ; Pseudo-random number generator
 $C0AE BIT 7,(IY+$14)  ; {IY+$14 bit 7 set always transforms, otherwise only a
 $C0B2 JR NZ,$C0B8     ; 1-in-4 chance
 $C0B4 CP $40          ;
 $C0B6 JR NC,$C0D4     ; }
*$C0B8 RES 7,(IY+$04)  ; {Pick the new facing from the random number's low bit
 $C0BC RRA             ;
 $C0BD JR C,$C0C3      ;
 $C0BF SET 7,(IY+$04)  ; }
*$C0C3 LD (IY+$15),$F1 ; {Point its movement script at $5CF1, run it next
 $C0C7 LD (IY+$16),$5C ; frame, mark it transitioning
 $C0CB LD (IY+$18),$01 ;
 $C0CF SET 4,(IY+$04)  ; }
 $C0D3 RET             ;
*$C0D4 LD A,$04        ; Award the destruction score
 $C0D6 CALL $66B5      ; Add BCD score value to current player's score
 $C0D9 LD DE,$9D18     ; Group counter for the explosion to bump when it ends
 $C0DC CALL $C5AF      ; Start object explosion sequence
 $C0DF RET             ;
*$C0E0 LD A,(IY+$0E)   ; {Retire once past a Y bound ($1E)
 $C0E3 CP $1E          ;
 $C0E5 JR NC,$C084     ; }
 $C0E7 LD A,(IY+$10)   ; {Sprite frame from the heading, quantised to 8
 $C0EA ADD A,$03       ; directions
 $C0EC AND $38         ;
 $C0EE RRCA            ;
 $C0EF RRCA            ;
 $C0F0 RRCA            ;
 $C0F1 LD (IY+$06),A   ; }
 $C0F4 LD A,(IY+$05)   ; {A state-$0C enemy ramps a counter before it may fire
 $C0F7 CP $0C          ;
 $C0F9 JR NZ,$C106     ; }
 $C0FB LD A,(IY+$0F)   ; {Hold fire until that counter reaches $58
 $C0FE CP $58          ;
 $C100 JR NC,$C106     ;
 $C102 INC (IY+$0F)    ; }
 $C105 RET             ;
*$C106 CALL $C43C      ; Enemy fire-decision timer and heading steering
 $C109 RET             ;
*$C10A LD A,(IY+$06)   ; {step sprite frame (IY+6), 8-direction wrap, mirrored
 $C10D DEC A           ; via IY+4 bit 7
 $C10E BIT 7,(IY+$04)  ;
 $C112 JR Z,$C116      ;
 $C114 ADD A,$02       ; }
*$C116 AND $07         ;
 $C118 LD (IY+$06),A   ;
 $C11B RET             ;

 $C17F LD (IY+$06),A  ;

 $C3E5 ADD A,(IY+$15) ;
 $C3E8 AND $3F        ;
 $C3EA LD (IY+$10),A  ; }
 $C3ED LD B,(IY+$11)  ; B = speed (IY+$11)

 $C3F3 CALL $BA0A     ; Apply object velocity (dx,dy) to position
 $C3F6 BIT 7,(IY+$14) ; Skip scoring unless the action flag (IY+$14 bit 7) is
                      ; set
 $C3FA JR Z,$C41D     ;

 $C3FF INC (HL)       ; }
 $C400 LD A,$05       ; Award a fixed score bonus
 $C402 CALL $66B5     ; Add BCD score value to current player's score
 $C405 LD HL,$9C71    ; {Advance the explosion-data pointer once its group
 $C408 LD C,(HL)      ; counter allows
 $C409 LD HL,$9C72    ;
 $C40C LD A,(HL)      ;
 $C40D CP C           ;
 $C40E JR NC,$C41B    ; }
 $C410 INC (HL)       ;
 $C411 LD HL,($9C73)  ;
 $C414 LD DE,$000D    ;
 $C417 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $C418 LD ($9C73),HL  ;
*$C41B JR $C434       ;
*$C41D LD A,(IY+$0D)  ; {Otherwise: move straight down at fixed speed
 $C420 ADD A,$20      ; ($0020/frame)
 $C422 LD (IY+$0D),A  ;
 $C425 LD A,(IY+$0E)  ; }
 $C428 JR NC,$C42E    ;
 $C42A INC A          ;
 $C42B LD (IY+$0E),A  ;
*$C42E CP $1C         ; {Retire once outside a Y band ($1C-$22)
 $C430 RET C          ;
 $C431 CP $22         ;
 $C433 RET NC         ; }

 $C437 INC (HL)       ;
 $C438 CALL $B79F     ; Mark formation slot done, trigger completion effect
                      ; when group empties

; Enemy fire-decision timer and heading steering
;
; Used by the routines at #R$C075, #R$C11C, #R$C199, #R$C217 and #R$C298.
;
; IY enemy object struct base (status IY+$04, target ref IY+$1A, heading
; .  IY+$1C)
;
; Runs an enemy's shared fire-decision timer, and once it expires, steers the
; enemy's heading toward its target one rate-limited step at a time rather than
; snapping to it. The enemy only actually fires once its heading lines up
; closely enough with the target and a free bullet slot is available.
@label=enemy_fire_steer
c$C43C LD HL,$9C42     ;
 $C43F DEC (HL)        ; {Fire timer countdown; exit until it expires
 $C440 RET NZ          ; }

 $C444 LD (HL),A       ; }

 $C449 RET NZ          ; }

 $C44E RET Z           ; }

 $C452 CP $FF          ;
 $C454 RET Z           ; }
 $C455 LD IX,($9C6D)   ;
 $C459 CALL $B845      ; Compute angle from object IX to target IY
 $C45C LD C,A          ;
 $C45D EX AF,AF'       ;
 $C45E LD A,(IY+$1A)   ;
 $C461 AND A           ;
 $C462 JP M,$C499      ;
 $C465 LD A,(IY+$1C)   ;
 $C468 LD B,A          ;
 $C469 SUB C           ; {Angle difference (target minus current heading)
 $C46A AND $3F         ; }
 $C46C CP $20          ;
 $C46E LD E,$FC        ;
 $C470 JR C,$C478      ;
 $C472 LD E,$04        ;
 $C474 NEG             ;
 $C476 AND $3F         ;
*$C478 CP $04          ;
 $C47A JR NC,$C47F     ;
 $C47C LD A,C          ;
 $C47D JR $C483        ;
*$C47F LD A,B          ;
 $C480 ADD A,E         ; {Step heading toward target by +-4
 $C481 AND $3F         ; }
*$C483 LD (IY+$1C),A   ; Store new heading (IY+$1C)
 $C486 LD E,A          ;
 $C487 ADD A,$03       ;
 $C489 AND $38         ;
 $C48B RRCA            ;
 $C48C RRCA            ;
 $C48D RRCA            ;
 $C48E LD (IY+$1A),A   ; Store target sector (IY+$1A)
 $C491 LD A,E          ;
 $C492 CP C            ;
 $C493 JR Z,$C497      ;
 $C495 AND A           ;
 $C496 RET             ;
*$C497 LD A,$01        ;
*$C499 LD B,A          ;
 $C49A EX AF,AF'       ;
 $C49B CCF             ;
 $C49C RET NC          ;
 $C49D LD A,($9D1A)    ;
 $C4A0 LD HL,$9D1B     ; {Fire only if free-object slots remain ($9D1A - $9D1B)
 $C4A3 SUB (HL)        ;
 $C4A4 RET Z           ; }
 $C4A5 LD E,A          ;
 $C4A6 CALL $B7FE      ; Pseudo-random number generator
 $C4A9 CP (IY+$1B)     ; {Fire only below probability threshold (IY+$1B)
 $C4AC RET NC          ; }
 $C4AD LD A,B          ;
 $C4AE AND $03         ;
 $C4B0 RET Z           ;
 $C4B1 LD HL,$9D1A     ;
 $C4B4 CP E            ;
 $C4B5 JR C,$C4B8      ;
 $C4B7 LD A,E          ;
*$C4B8 LD B,A          ;
 $C4B9 NEG             ;
 $C4BB ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $C4BC LD (HL),A       ;
 $C4BD LD A,B          ;
 $C4BE DEC A           ;
 $C4BF ADD A,A         ;
 $C4C0 NEG             ;
 $C4C2 ADD A,C         ;
 $C4C3 AND $3F         ;
 $C4C5 LD C,A          ;
 $C4C6 LD E,(IY+$0D)   ;
 $C4C9 LD D,(IY+$0E)   ;
 $C4CC LD L,(IY+$0B)   ;
 $C4CF LD H,(IY+$0C)   ;
 $C4D2 LD A,($9C40)    ;
 $C4D5 LD ($C54E),A    ;
 $C4D8 LD A,(IY+$05)   ;
 $C4DB CP $0E          ;
 $C4DD JR NZ,$C4F6     ;
 $C4DF LD A,E          ;
 $C4E0 ADD A,$80       ;
 $C4E2 LD E,A          ;
 $C4E3 LD A,D          ;
 $C4E4 ADC A,$01       ;
 $C4E6 LD D,A          ;
 $C4E7 LD A,L          ;
 $C4E8 ADD A,$80       ;
 $C4EA LD L,A          ;
 $C4EB LD A,H          ;
 $C4EC ADC A,$01       ;
 $C4EE LD H,A          ;
 $C4EF LD A,($9C40)    ;
 $C4F2 INC A           ;
 $C4F3 LD ($C54E),A    ;
*$C4F6 EXX             ;
 $C4F7 LD BC,$6BB9     ;
 $C4FA EXX             ;
*$C4FB EXX             ;
 $C4FC LD ($C515),SP   ;
 $C500 LD IX,($9D1C)   ; {Pop a bullet object from the free list ($9D1C)
 $C504 LD SP,IX        ;

 $C50A POP HL          ;
 $C50B PUSH BC         ; }

 $C558 RET             ; }

; Allocate and initialize the player's plane object
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B730.
;
; .
;
; Allocates the player's plane from the free-list pool at wave start (called
; only from #R$B730) and places it at the bottom centre of the screen. Its
; state index IY+$05=$02 selects the player handler #R$BE03, and its address is
; published to $9C6D, which every homing enemy reads as its aim target.
@label=alloc_object
c$C559 LD ($C570),SP   ; Save caller's SP (restored at $C56F)
 $C55D LD IX,($9D1C)   ; {Pop free-list head ($9D1C) into IX
 $C561 LD SP,IX        ;
 $C563 POP HL          ; }
 $C564 LD ($9D1C),HL   ;
 $C567 LD HL,($9D30)   ; {Push old head onto secondary stack ($9D30)
 $C56A PUSH HL         ;
 $C56B LD ($9D30),SP   ; }
 $C56F LD SP,$0000     ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $C559
 $C572 LD (IX+$04),$00 ; {Clear status, set "active" bit 2
 $C576 SET 2,(IX+$04)  ; }
 $C57A LD (IX+$02),$42 ; Per-frame handler pointer -> $6B42
 $C57E LD (IX+$03),$6B ;
 $C582 LD (IX+$05),$02 ;
 $C586 LD (IX+$16),$01 ;
 $C58A LD (IX+$17),$01 ;
 $C58E LD (IX+$06),$06 ;
 $C592 LD (IX+$13),$FF ;
 $C596 LD (IX+$18),$FF ;
 $C59A LD (IX+$0B),$00 ;
 $C59E LD (IX+$0C),$10 ; Default column (IX+$0C=$10)
 $C5A2 LD (IX+$0D),$00 ;
 $C5A6 LD (IX+$0E),$16 ; Default row (IX+$0E=$16)
 $C5AA LD ($9C6D),IX   ; Publish object as current aim target ($9C6D)
 $C5AE RET             ;

; Start object explosion sequence
;
; Used by the routines at #R$BE03, #R$BFEB, #R$C015, #R$C075, #R$C11C, #R$C199,
; #R$C217 and #R$C298.
;
; IY object struct base
; DE address of the group counter to bump when the explosion finishes
; .  ($9D18/$9D19/$9D1A)
;
; The shared "object destroyed" entry point: switches an object into its
; explosion animation and resets two global explosion-growth timers.
@label=start_explosion
c$C5AF LD (IY+$02),$CA ; {set object's IX+$02/$03 (record ptr into #R$6B42's
 $C5B3 LD (IY+$03),$6B ; table, not code) to $6BCA (record 8)}
 $C5B7 LD (IY+$05),$04 ; {init state fields IY+5=4, IY+6=8
 $C5BB LD (IY+$06),$08 ; }
 $C5BF LD (IY+$15),E   ; {store the group-counter address (DE) into IY+$15/$16;
 $C5C2 LD (IY+$16),D   ; #R$C051 bumps it when the animation ends}
 $C5C5 LD HL,$FD50     ; {reset global timer/counter $9C35
 $C5C8 LD ($9C35),HL   ; }
 $C5CB LD HL,$EEA0     ; {reset global timer/counter $9C39
 $C5CE LD ($9C39),HL   ; }
 $C5D1 RET             ; return

; Convert object to explosion (set state-record pointer to $6BF3)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B79F.
;
; IY object struct base
;
; Converts an object into an explosion, the sibling of #R$C5AF. The alternate
; #R$C5EE entry additionally awards score and sets up a follow-up object based
; on how many bonus objects remain, either upgrading it to a bigger explosion
; or spawning the next object in the sequence.
@label=object_to_explosion
c$C5D2 LD HL,$9C3F     ; {Bump the shared explosion-conversion counter ($9C3F)
 $C5D5 INC (HL)        ; }
 $C5D6 CALL $B8DB      ; Set object position from $9C01, clamp column (IY+$0C)
                       ; to 8-24
 $C5D9 RES 4,(IY+$04)  ; Clear the banking-in-progress flag
 $C5DD LD (IY+$02),$F3 ; {Point at the explosion state-record entry ($6BF3)
 $C5E1 LD (IY+$03),$6B ; }
 $C5E5 LD (IY+$05),$08 ; {Init state fields (IY+$05/$06)
 $C5E9 LD (IY+$06),$00 ; }
 $C5ED RET             ;
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$C648.
*$C5EE CALL $B8DB      ; Set object position from $9C01, clamp column (IY+$0C)
                       ; to 8-24
 $C5F1 LD A,$08        ; Award a fixed score bonus
 $C5F3 CALL $66B5      ; Add BCD score value to current player's score
 $C5F6 RES 4,(IY+$04)  ; Clear the banking-in-progress flag
 $C5FA LD (IY+$06),$00 ; Reset frame
 $C5FE LD A,($9C01)    ; {Snap Y to the top ($9C01)
 $C601 LD (IY+$0D),A   ; }
 $C604 LD (IY+$0B),$00 ; Reset X to the left edge
 $C608 LD IX,($9C77)   ; IX = the object that hit the player
 $C60C LD A,(IX+$0B)   ; {Check whether it has bonus follow-up objects
 $C60F AND A           ; remaining (IX+$0B)
 $C610 JR Z,$C620      ; }
 $C612 LD A,($9C6A)    ; {Skip the upgrade check once the group-clear rate cap
 $C615 CP $03          ; is reached
 $C617 JR Z,$C631      ; }
 $C619 CALL $B7FE      ; Pseudo-random number generator
 $C61C CP $0F          ; {Otherwise randomly decide whether to upgrade
 $C61E JR C,$C631      ; }
*$C620 LD (IY+$02),$ED ; {Upgrade to a bigger explosion (record $ED)
 $C624 LD (IY+$03),$6B ; }
 $C628 LD (IY+$05),$0F ; {Init state fields (IY+$05, growth rate IY+$15)
 $C62C LD (IY+$15),$33 ; }
 $C630 RET             ;
*$C631 XOR A           ; {Otherwise: reset the group-clear rate counter
 $C632 LD ($9C6A),A    ; }
 $C635 CALL $B8DB      ; Set object position from $9C01, clamp column (IY+$0C)
                       ; to 8-24
 $C638 DEC (IX+$0B)    ; Consume one bonus follow-up object (IX+$0B)
 $C63B LD (IY+$02),$E7 ; {Spawn the next object in the sequence (record $E7)
 $C63F LD (IY+$03),$6B ; }
 $C643 LD (IY+$05),$10 ; Init state field (IY+$05)
 $C647 RET             ;

; Decrement wave-group counter; trigger group-clear bonus when it hits zero
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B79F.
;
; .
;
; Decrements the wave-group counter; once the whole group is cleared, sets up a
; bonus-award animation, otherwise falls through to per-kill scoring.
c$C648 LD HL,$9C68     ; {Decrement the wave-group counter ($9C68)
 $C64B DEC (HL)        ; }
 $C64C JR NZ,$C5EE     ;
 $C64E LD A,($9C72)    ; get Wave type / group id
 $C651 LD (HL),A       ;
 $C652 LD (IY+$02),$97 ; {Point at the bonus-animation record ($6B97)
 $C656 LD (IY+$03),$6B ; }
 $C65A LD (IY+$05),$07 ; {Init state fields (IY+$05/$06)
 $C65E LD (IY+$06),$06 ; }
 $C662 LD A,(IY+$0C)   ; {Pick the animation's direction based on column
 $C665 CP $12          ; (IY+$0C vs $12)}
 $C667 JR C,$C673      ;
 $C669 LD (IY+$15),$01 ; {Rightward outcome: set growth rate and angle
 $C66D LD (IY+$10),$20 ; }
 $C671 JR $C67B        ;
*$C673 LD (IY+$15),$FF ; {Otherwise: leftward outcome, no angle
 $C677 LD (IY+$10),$00 ; }
*$C67B LD (IY+$11),$03 ; Set the animation's duration (IY+$11)
 $C67F RET             ;

; Scroll background (periodic LDDR shift, gated by counter $9C2A)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Shifts the background graphics one byte, but only every 3rd frame.
@label=scroll_background
c$C680 LD HL,$9C2A   ;
 $C683 DEC (HL)      ; {Act only every 3rd frame ($9C2A countdown)
 $C684 RET NZ        ; }
 $C685 LD (HL),$03   ; Reload the frame counter (3)
 $C687 LD HL,$850E   ; First 16-byte ring ($8500-$850F): rotate its bytes up
                     ; one place
 $C68A LD DE,$850F   ;
 $C68D LD BC,$000F   ;
 $C690 LD A,(DE)     ;
 $C691 LDDR          ; Shift 15 bytes down (LDDR)
 $C693 LD ($8500),A  ; Wrap the scrolled-off byte to $8500
 $C696 LD HL,$851E   ; Second 16-byte ring ($8510-$851F): rotate its bytes up
                     ; one place
 $C699 LD DE,$851F   ;
 $C69C LD BC,$000F   ;
 $C69F LD A,(DE)     ;
 $C6A0 LDDR          ; Shift 15 bytes down (LDDR)
 $C6A2 LD ($8510),A  ; Wrap the scrolled-off byte to $8510
 $C6A5 RET           ;

; Screen wipe transition effect (colour set in $9C59)
;
; Used by the routines at #R$6498, #R$6A88, #R$A6BB, #R$A6E5, #R$A783 and
; #R$A802.
;
; .
;
; Wipes the screen to a solid colour (from $9C59, set by the caller beforehand)
; with a diamond/cross pattern growing outward from the centre.
@label=screen_wipe
c$C6A6 LD B,$12      ; wait ~18 frames before starting wipe
*$C6A8 HALT          ; {loop: wait 18 frames
 $C6A9 DJNZ $C6A8    ; }
 $C6AB LD A,$0B      ; {wait one more frame; init centre offset
 $C6AD HALT          ; }
 $C6AE CALL $C6EB    ; Fill screen attribute row with colour from $9C59
 $C6B1 LD B,A        ; B = wipe step count
*$C6B2 PUSH BC       ; save loop counter
 $C6B3 LD A,$04      ; {compute column right of centre, wait a frame
 $C6B5 ADD A,B       ;
 $C6B6 HALT          ; }
 $C6B7 CALL $C6D3    ; Fill screen attribute column with colour from $9C59
 $C6BA NEG           ; {mirror to column left of centre
 $C6BC ADD A,$1F     ; }
 $C6BE CALL $C6D3    ; Fill screen attribute column with colour from $9C59
 $C6C1 POP BC        ; {restore counter, compute row below centre
 $C6C2 PUSH BC       ;
 $C6C3 LD A,B        ;
 $C6C4 DEC A         ; }
 $C6C5 CALL $C6EB    ; Fill screen attribute row with colour from $9C59
 $C6C8 NEG           ; {mirror to row above centre
 $C6CA ADD A,$16     ; }
 $C6CC CALL $C6EB    ; Fill screen attribute row with colour from $9C59
 $C6CF POP BC        ; {repeat, shrinking step outward
 $C6D0 DJNZ $C6B2    ; }
 $C6D2 RET           ; return

; Fill screen attribute column with colour from $9C59

 $C6E6 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $C6E7 DJNZ $C6E5    ;
 $C6E9 POP AF        ;
 $C6EA RET           ;

; Fill screen attribute row with colour from $9C59
;
; Used by the routine at #R$C6A6.
;
; A row/column offset (encodes screen position)
;
; Fills one full-width screen row with the wipe colour.
@label=fill_attr_row

 $C6EC RRCA          ; {Rotate position code into attribute-row high bits
 $C6ED RRCA          ;
 $C6EE RRCA          ; }

 $C6F0 AND $E0       ;

 $C6F5 AND $E0       ;
 $C6F7 XOR H         ;

 $C6FA LD H,A        ; }
 $C6FB LD E,L        ;
 $C6FC LD D,H        ;

 $C6FE LD BC,$0011   ; }

 $C704 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $C705 LDIR          ; Propagate colour across the row (18 cells)
 $C707 POP AF        ;
 $C708 RET           ;

; Fill entire attribute screen with colour A (fast SP-push fill)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$C72A.
;
; A attribute colour
;
; Fills the whole screen attribute area with a single colour, using a fast
; PUSH-unroll fill.
@label=fill_attr_screen
c$C709 LD ($C727),SP ; Save caller's SP (restored at $C726)
 $C70D LD C,A        ;
 $C70E LD B,A        ;
 $C70F LD A,$17      ; A = 23 row groups to fill
 $C711 LD HL,$5819   ; HL = attribute area start ($5819)
 $C714 LD DE,$0020   ;
*$C717 LD SP,HL      ; Point SP at this row for the PUSH fill
 $C718 PUSH BC       ; {Fast fill: 9x PUSH BC (18 attribute bytes)
 $C719 PUSH BC       ;
 $C71A PUSH BC       ;
 $C71B PUSH BC       ;
 $C71C PUSH BC       ;
 $C71D PUSH BC       ;
 $C71E PUSH BC       ;
 $C71F PUSH BC       ;
 $C720 PUSH BC       ; }
 $C721 ADD HL,DE     ; {Advance HL to next row ($20 stride)
 $C722 DEC A         ; }
 $C723 JP NZ,$C717   ; Loop 23 rows
 $C726 LD SP,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Restore SP (patched by $C709)
 $C729 RET           ;

; Animate active player's indicator box colour
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Cycles the active player's corner-box indicator through a repeating colour
; sequence, one step per interrupt. Also drives the full-screen flash effect if
; one is pending.
@label=animate_player_box
c$C72A LD HL,($9C45) ; {Read next byte of the colour sequence ($9C45)
 $C72D LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $C72E CP $FF        ;
 $C730 JR NZ,$C740   ;
 $C732 LD HL,$9C44   ; {Sequence exhausted: check repeat count, reload if any
 $C735 LD A,(HL)     ; remain
 $C736 AND A         ;
 $C737 LD C,$07      ; }
 $C739 JR Z,$C745    ;
 $C73B DEC (HL)      ; {Reload the sequence pointer from its start ($9C47)
 $C73C LD HL,$9C47   ;
 $C73F LD A,(HL)     ; }
*$C740 INC HL        ; {Advance the sequence pointer, C = colour to apply
 $C741 LD ($9C45),HL ;
 $C744 LD C,A        ; }
*$C745 LD A,($9C76)  ; get Active player
 $C748 LD HL,$58C4   ; {Point at the active player's corner box ($58C4 or
 $C74B DEC A         ; $58DA)
 $C74C JR Z,$C750    ; }
 $C74E LD L,$DA      ;
*$C750 LD (HL),C     ; {Paint the box's 4 corner cells
 $C751 INC L         ;
 $C752 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C753 LD A,L        ;
 $C754 ADD A,$1F     ;
 $C756 LD L,A        ;
 $C757 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C758 INC L         ;
 $C759 LD (HL),C     ; }
 $C75A LD HL,($9C5B) ; read next full-screen flash colour byte (sequence $9C5B,
                     ; set by #R$6A88)
 $C75D LD A,(HL)     ;
 $C75E CP $FF        ;
 $C760 RET Z         ;
 $C761 INC HL        ;
 $C762 LD ($9C5B),HL ;

; Fast column mover: copy the built scroll row to the attribute screen
;
; Used by the routines at #R$6498, #R$6A88 and #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Called every frame from the main loop. Uses an unrolled
; POP/self-modified-store SP-trick to move the scroll-window row prepared by
; #R$C84C into the on-screen attribute area, with #R$C825 selecting the
; per-frame store-opcode variant and $C804 advancing between row groups.
@label=fast_attr_mover
c$C772 CALL $C825    ; Configure $C772 mover
 $C775 LD ($C81F),SP ; Save caller's SP
 $C779 LD SP,$F6D1   ; SP=#R$F6D1: fast POP-based read pointer into source data
 $C77C LD HL,$0007   ;
 $C77F LD DE,$4007   ;
 $C782 LD A,E        ; {Stash E in shadow A', A=D (destination page high byte)
 $C783 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $C784 LD A,D        ; }
 $C785 LD ($C7A0),A  ; {Patch destination high byte into 3 self-modified store
 $C788 LD ($C7BC),A  ; targets ($C7A0/$C7BC/$C7D8)
 $C78B LD ($C7D8),A  ; }
 $C78E LD A,H        ; {EXX: switch to shadow registers for the unroll loop
 $C78F EXX           ; }
 $C790 LD E,$18      ; E=$18: outer pass counter
*$C792 LD B,$06      ; Inner unroll count B=$06 (6x3 stores per pass)
*$C794 POP HL        ;
 $C795 POP IX        ;
 $C797 POP IY        ;
 $C799 LD ($C7F2),SP ; Save source read pointer (SP) before switching back
 $C79D LD SP,HL      ; SP=HL: point stack at destination write area
 $C79E EXX           ; EXX: back to normal registers for the unrolled store
                     ; sequence
 $C79F LD D,$00      ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $C785
 $C7A1 POP BC        ; {Store 4 pairs from HL-fed source (source 1/3)
 $C7A2 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7A3 INC H         ;
 $C7A4 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7A5 INC H         ;
 $C7A6 POP BC        ;
 $C7A7 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7A8 INC H         ;
 $C7A9 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7AA INC H         ;
 $C7AB POP BC        ;
 $C7AC LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7AD INC H         ;
 $C7AE LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7AF INC H         ;
 $C7B0 POP BC        ;
 $C7B1 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7B2 INC H         ;
 $C7B3 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7B4 INC H         ; }
 $C7B5 EX DE,HL      ; {Switch page, advance to next source (SP=IX)
 $C7B6 LD H,A        ;
 $C7B7 INC L         ;
 $C7B8 INC E         ;
 $C7B9 LD SP,IX      ; }
 $C7BB LD D,$00      ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $C788
 $C7BD POP BC        ; {Store 4 pairs from IX-fed source (source 2/3)
 $C7BE LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7BF INC H         ;
 $C7C0 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7C1 INC H         ;
 $C7C2 POP BC        ;
 $C7C3 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7C4 INC H         ;
 $C7C5 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7C6 INC H         ;
 $C7C7 POP BC        ;
 $C7C8 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7C9 INC H         ;
 $C7CA LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7CB INC H         ;
 $C7CC POP BC        ;
 $C7CD LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7CE INC H         ;
 $C7CF LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7D0 INC H         ; }
 $C7D1 EX DE,HL      ; {Switch page, advance to next source (SP=IY)
 $C7D2 LD H,A        ;
 $C7D3 INC L         ;
 $C7D4 INC E         ;
 $C7D5 LD SP,IY      ; }
 $C7D7 LD D,$00      ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $C78B
 $C7D9 POP BC        ; {Store 4 pairs from IY-fed source (source 3/3)
 $C7DA LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7DB INC H         ;
 $C7DC LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7DD INC H         ;
 $C7DE POP BC        ;
 $C7DF LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7E0 INC H         ;
 $C7E1 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7E2 INC H         ;
 $C7E3 POP BC        ;
 $C7E4 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7E5 INC H         ;
 $C7E6 LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7E7 INC H         ;
 $C7E8 POP BC        ;
 $C7E9 LD (HL),C     ;
 $C7EA INC H         ;
 $C7EB LD (HL),B     ;
 $C7EC INC H         ; }
 $C7ED EX DE,HL      ; {Switch page, reset source pointer for next pass
 $C7EE LD H,A        ;
 $C7EF INC L         ;
 $C7F0 INC E         ; }
 $C7F1 LD SP,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! patched by $C799
 $C7F4 EXX           ;
 $C7F5 DJNZ $C794    ; Loop $C792's inner unroll count
 $C7F7 EXX           ;
 $C7F8 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $C7F9 LD L,A        ;
 $C7FA LD H,D        ;
 $C7FB ADD A,$20     ;
 $C7FD LD E,A        ;
 $C7FE JR C,$C809    ;
 $C800 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $C801 LD A,H        ;
 $C802 EXX           ;
 $C803 DEC E         ;
 $C804 JP NZ,$C792   ;
 $C807 JR $C81E      ;
*$C809 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $C80A LD A,($C7A0)  ; {Advance the 3 self-modified destination operands by 8
 $C80D ADD A,$08     ;
 $C80F LD ($C7A0),A  ;
 $C812 LD ($C7BC),A  ;
 $C815 LD ($C7D8),A  ; }
 $C818 LD A,H        ;
 $C819 EXX           ;
 $C81A DEC E         ; Next row-group
 $C81B JP NZ,$C792   ; Loop back into the unrolled mover body
*$C81E LD SP,$0000   ; !!MUT-ARG!! Done: restore SP (patched by $C775)
 $C821 CALL $C839    ; Reset $C772 mover body opcodes to INC H
 $C824 RET           ;

; Configure $C772 mover: set fill displacement, patch 3 body opcodes to EX

; Used by the routine at #R$C772.

; .

c$C825 LD A,($9C00)  ;

; Build wrapped scroll-window row into $F6D1 buffer
;
; Used by the routines at #R$6A88 and #R$A0C4.
;
; .
;
; Copies the next window of the circular scroll buffer into #R$F6D1, wrapping
; around to the buffer's start if the window runs past its end. The resulting
; row is what #R$C772 draws to the screen.
@label=build_scroll_row
c$C84C LD HL,($9BF9) ; {HL = scroll-window source pointer, DE = dest #R$F6D1
 $C84F LD DE,$0024   ;
 $C852 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $C853 LD DE,$F6D1   ; }
 $C856 LD A,($9BF8)  ;
 $C859 LD C,A        ; {C = scroll offset, B = bytes remaining before wrap
 $C85A NEG           ; ($18-offset)
 $C85C ADD A,$18     ;
 $C85E LD B,A        ;
 $C85F LD A,C        ;
 $C860 JR Z,$C8AE    ; }
*$C862 LD C,$FF      ; C=$FF: BC = byte count for the LDI runs below
 $C864 LDI           ; {Copy up to 36 bytes into #R$F6D1, one LDI per byte
 $C866 LDI           ;
 $C868 LDI           ;
 $C86A LDI           ;
 $C86C LDI           ;
 $C86E LDI           ;
 $C870 LDI           ;
 $C872 LDI           ;
 $C874 LDI           ;
 $C876 LDI           ;
 $C878 LDI           ;
 $C87A LDI           ;
 $C87C LDI           ;
 $C87E LDI           ;
 $C880 LDI           ;
 $C882 LDI           ;
 $C884 LDI           ;
 $C886 LDI           ;
 $C888 LDI           ;
 $C88A LDI           ;
 $C88C LDI           ;
 $C88E LDI           ;
 $C890 LDI           ;
 $C892 LDI           ;
 $C894 LDI           ;
 $C896 LDI           ;
 $C898 LDI           ;
 $C89A LDI           ;
 $C89C LDI           ;
 $C89E LDI           ;
 $C8A0 LDI           ;
 $C8A2 LDI           ;
 $C8A4 LDI           ;
 $C8A6 LDI           ;
 $C8A8 LDI           ;
 $C8AA LDI           ; }

*$C8AE LD HL,$FA79   ; {Wrap: continue remaining bytes from buffer start $FA79
 $C8B1 LD B,A        ;
 $C8B2 AND A         ;
 $C8B3 LD A,$00      ;
 $C8B5 JR NZ,$C862   ; }
 $C8B7 RET           ;

; Advance background scroll: every 8th frame swap column buffer and render row
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A0C4 and #R$A4E7.
;
; .
;

; column of scenery tiles and converts it into attribute codes for the
; on-screen scroll buffer.

 $C8C8 RET NZ        ; }

 $C8F3 LD DE,($9BF9) ; cells
 $C8F7 LD B,$12      ; }

 $C8FE JR $C907      ; buffer}
*$C900 LD C,(HL)     ;
 $C901 INC HL        ;
 $C902 LD A,(IY+$00) ;
 $C905 INC IY        ;
*$C907 CP $0C        ; {Clamp tile-set index ranges to a valid attribute code
 $C909 JR C,$C916    ;

 $C90D JR NC,$C916   ;
 $C90F LD A,C        ;
 $C910 CP $60        ;
 $C912 JR C,$C917    ;
 $C914 LD C,$62      ; }

 $C918 RLCA          ;

 $C931 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $C932 DEC A         ; }

; Decode next column's tile data into ping-pong buffer
;
; Used by the routine at #R$C8B8.
;
; .
;
; Decodes the next 9 map cells into the ping-pong tile buffer, expanding each
; cell into its 2x2 tile block, and advances the level-progress counter. First
; spawns any enemies queued in the previous column.
@label=decode_column
c$C941 LD HL,$9BA2   ;
 $C944 BIT 5,(HL)    ; Check "column ready" flag before advancing
 $C946 CALL Z,$C981  ; Scan incoming column for spawn markers and allocate
                     ; enemy objects
 $C949 LD HL,($9BA9) ; {HL = column-source pointer; IX = ping-pong buffer; C =
 $C94C LD IX,$9BB0   ; table page
 $C950 LD C,$79      ;
 $C952 LD B,$09      ; }
*$C954 LD E,(HL)     ; Start of 9-entry decode loop
 $C955 LD D,C        ; {Read the cell's 4 tile-block bytes, store as a 2x2 char
 $C956 LD A,(DE)     ; block
 $C957 INC D         ;
 $C958 LD (IX+$00),A ;
 $C95B LD A,(DE)     ;
 $C95C INC D         ;
 $C95D LD (IX+$01),A ;
 $C960 LD A,(DE)     ;
 $C961 INC D         ;
 $C962 LD (IX+$12),A ;
 $C965 LD A,(DE)     ;
 $C966 LD (IX+$13),A ; }
 $C969 INC IX        ; {Advance to next buffer entry (IX+=2)
 $C96B INC IX        ; }
 $C96D INC L         ; {Advance source cell (L), bump table row (shadow A')
 $C96E EX AF,AF'     ;
 $C96F ADD A,$10     ;
 $C971 EX AF,AF'     ; }
 $C972 DJNZ $C954    ; Loop 9 times
 $C974 LD ($9BA9),HL ; {Store the advanced source pointer ($9BA9)
 $C977 LD HL,$9BAD   ;
 $C97A LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $C97B CP $1C        ; Clamp progress counter at $1C
 $C97D RET NC        ; Stop if counter already at max
 $C97E INC A         ;
 $C97F LD (HL),A     ;
 $C980 RET           ;

; Scan incoming column for spawn markers and allocate enemy objects
;
; Used by the routine at #R$C941.
;
; .
;
; Scans the newly-decoded column for enemy spawn markers and allocates an
; object for each one found, marking cells that couldn't be spawned due to a
; full object pool.
@label=scan_spawn_markers
c$C981 LD HL,$9BA2   ;
 $C984 BIT 5,(HL)    ; Skip if column-ready flag already set
 $C986 RET NZ        ;
 $C987 LD HL,($9BA9) ; {HL = column-source pointer; B = 9 entries; C = table
 $C98A LD B,$09      ; page
 $C98C LD C,$10      ; }
*$C98E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $C98F CP $05        ; Check for spawn marker $05
 $C991 JR Z,$C997    ;
 $C993 CP $55        ; {Check for spawn marker $55; skip entry if neither
 $C995 JR NZ,$C9A7   ; }
*$C997 PUSH HL       ; {D = entry offset (enemy row/type); A = 9 (formation
 $C998 PUSH BC       ; size)
 $C999 LD D,C        ;
 $C99A LD C,$00      ;
 $C99C LD A,$09      ; }
 $C99E CALL $BA5F    ; Spawn a group of formation objects from the free-list
                     ; pool
 $C9A1 POP BC        ;
 $C9A2 POP HL        ;
 $C9A3 JR C,$C9A7    ; Skip the $33 write if the spawn succeeded (carry set)
 $C9A5 LD (HL),$33   ; Pool full (carry clear): mark cell $33
                     ; (consumed/blocked)
*$C9A7 INC L         ;
 $C9A8 LD A,C        ;
 $C9A9 ADD A,$10     ;
 $C9AB LD C,A        ;
 $C9AC DJNZ $C98E    ; Loop 9 entries
 $C9AE RET           ;

; Advance enemy timeline: fire due entries and dispatch their commands
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A0C4.
;

;

; sets) or, for anything else, spawning an enemy formation. Runs once every 16

                     ; pool

; Player-plane masked sprite (24x16, interleaved pixel/mask, mask bit-reversed)
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Each frame is 24px wide x 16px tall = 3 vertical 8px strips of 32 bytes (16
; rows of a [pixel, mask] pair). The mask byte is stored bit-reversed and must
; be flipped through the #R$9A00 table to align with the pixel byte. Successive
; frames are pre-shifted horizontal copies (each +1px) built by #R$7E4A for
; smooth sub-pixel movement; #R$7DF3 interleaves the pixel/mask pairs and
; #R$7D98 generates mirrored halves via #R$9A00.

 $CA11 DEFB $00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF ;
 $CA19 DEFB $00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF ;
 $CA21 DEFB $00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF ; }

; IM2 interrupt trampoline and vector table
;
; .
;
; .
;
; The IM2 vector register I=$FE, so every interrupt reads the word at
; #R$FDFD/$FDFE. #R$FDFD holds a JP opcode ($C3, planted by #R$7D00), so the
; CPU executes JP #R$A0B0 (the ISR). #R$FE00 onward is the vector table itself,
; filled with $FD by #R$7D00 so every table entry points back here to #R$FDFD;
; it continues past this block's end ($FE7B) up to $FFFF.
@label=im2_trampoline
c$FDFD JP $A0B0      ; !!MUT-CMD!! Built at run time, never assembled: #R$7D00
                     ; plants the $C3 (JP) opcode here, and
                     ; $7D1A/$A595/$A5BB/$A897/$A8F2 each write the handler
                     ; address into $FDFE

; IM 2 vector table (257 bytes of $FD, so every vector reaches the trampoline
; at #R$FDFD)
b$FE00 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ; {Interrupt vector table: all vectors
 $FE08 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ; resolve to $FDFD
 $FE10 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE18 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE20 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE28 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE30 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE38 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE40 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE48 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE50 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE58 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE60 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE68 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE70 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE78 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE80 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE88 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE90 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FE98 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEA0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEA8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEB0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEB8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEC0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEC8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FED0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FED8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEE0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEE8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEF0 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ;
 $FEF8 DEFW $FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD,$FDFD ; }

; Game entry
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Cold-start, reached from the resident loader.
; .
; The loader JP's here once the tape image is fully in RAM.
; .
; In:  nothing meaningful (IFF1=0, IM 1, SP still loader's).
; .
; Out: never returns -- falls through into the init chain and then the main
; game loop.
; .
; Side effects: installs private stack, blacks the border, runs three init
; subroutines, seeds game-state RAM.
@label=game_entry
c$8000 JP $8006      ; alignment trampoline -- skip 3 pad bytes (8003-8005)
 $8003 NOP           ;
@label=freeze_ctr
 $8004 NOP           ;
@label=pad_var_8005
 $8005 NOP           ;
@label=entry_setup
*$8006 LD SP,$5FFE   ; install game's private stack just under screen RAM
 $8009 XOR A         ; A = 0
 $800A OUT ($FE),A   ; ULA port FE: border=black(0), MIC/beeper off
 $800C CALL $83AD    ; Setup IM2
 $800F CALL $A772    ; init #2 = clear screen + game RAM (jp_clear_screen
                     ; trampoline)
 $8012 CALL $A71E    ; init #3 = paint playfield attributes (jp_setup_attrs
                     ; trampoline)
 $8015 LD A,$01      ; A = 1
 $8017 LD ($603F),A  ; first persistent-state write: running_flag = 1

; New game
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Set up a fresh game/level and run it.
; .
; Falls in from game_entry's init chain.
; .
; Seeds state vars, builds the level, draws the screen, then enters main_loop.
; .
; On death/level-end it loops back to level_retry or game-over handling.
@label=new_game
c$801A LD A,$80      ; A=$80 -> $6056 (start flag/counter)
 $801C LD ($6056),A  ;
 $801F XOR A         ;
 $8020 LD ($60D7),A  ; set Control-key toggle flag
 $8023 LD ($8005),A  ;
 $8026 LD A,$04      ; 4 attempts/lives -> #R$6017
 $8028 LD ($6017),A  ; set Game mode

; Level entry
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8115.
@label=level_retry
c$802B XOR A         ;
 $802C LD ($60D8),A  ; set Demo/pause mode flag
 $802F CALL $9B8A    ; Title menu
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$8115.
*$8032 CALL $8305    ; Init col state
 $8035 CALL $A721    ; proc_table slot: build tower / level layout
 $8038 LD A,$01      ;
 $803A LD ($6040),A  ; set Lives
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$8064.
*$803D CALL $8311    ; Restore col state
 $8040 PUSH AF       ;
 $8041 CALL $A72A    ;
 $8044 POP AF        ;
 $8045 JR NC,$802B   ; carry clear -> rebuild (retry)
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$8064.
*$8047 CALL $A733    ;
 $804A CALL $A739    ;
 $804D CALL $A724    ;
 $8050 CALL $9963    ; Show level intro
 $8053 XOR A         ;
 $8054 LD ($60C3),A  ; set Player died this frame
 $8057 DEC A         ;
 $8058 LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler
 $805B CALL $A778    ;
 $805E CALL $81D7    ; Setup level
 $8061 CALL $A36D    ; Stop sound

; Main loop
;
; .
;
; .
;
; The in-play frame loop.
; .
; Each pass runs main_tick (one frame) then checks end conditions: death_flag
; (#R$60C3) set      -> life-loss handler ($8084) game_state (#R$60D9) == 2
; -> level-complete ($80B2) play_timer (#R$6053) == 0     -> time-up ($8081)
; Otherwise CALL #R$8115 (status update) and loop.
@label=main_loop
c$8064 CALL $8240    ; run one frame of the game
 $8067 LD A,($60C3)  ; player died this frame?
 $806A OR A          ;
 $806B JR NZ,$8084   ; yes -> life-loss handler
 $806D LD A,($60D9)  ; level-complete state?
 $8070 CP $02        ;
 $8072 JR Z,$80B2    ; yes -> level-complete handler
 $8074 LD HL,($6053) ; play_timer reached 0?
 $8077 LD A,H        ;
 $8078 OR L          ;
 $8079 JR Z,$8081    ; yes -> time-up
 $807B CALL $8115    ; Poll controls
 $807E JP $8064      ; loop
*$8081 CALL $99CE    ; Draw timeup screen
@label=on_death
*$8084 LD A,$FF      ;
 $8086 LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler
 $8089 LD A,($60D7)  ; get Control-key toggle flag
 $808C OR A          ;
 $808D JR NZ,$80A3   ;
 $808F LD HL,$6041   ;
 $8092 LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $8095 OR A          ;
 $8096 JR Z,$8099    ;
 $8098 INC HL        ;
*$8099 DEC (HL)      ;
 $809A PUSH HL       ;
 $809B CALL $A724    ;
 $809E POP HL        ;
 $809F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $80A0 OR A          ;
 $80A1 JR Z,$80A9    ;
*$80A3 CALL $8360    ; Pack col state
 $80A6 JP $803D      ;
*$80A9 CALL $8382    ; Clear col mask
 $80AC CALL $99A1    ; Draw info screen a
 $80AF JP $803D      ;
@label=on_level_done
*$80B2 LD A,$FF      ;
 $80B4 LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler
 $80B7 LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $80BA PUSH AF       ;
 $80BB LD HL,($60BA) ;
 $80BE PUSH HL       ;
 $80BF LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $80C2 PUSH HL       ;
 $80C3 CALL $9A23    ; Screen time bonus
 $80C6 CALL $A778    ;
 $80C9 LD A,$03      ;
 $80CB LD ($60D9),A  ; set Game state
 $80CE CALL $81D7    ; Setup level
 $80D1 POP HL        ;
 $80D2 LD ($6030),HL ; set Vertical scroll position
 $80D5 POP HL        ;
 $80D6 LD ($60BA),HL ;
 $80D9 POP AF        ;
 $80DA LD ($60B9),A  ; set Tower rotation position
 $80DD LD A,$04      ;
 $80DF LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state
 $80E2 LD A,$1D      ;
 $80E4 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $80E7 XOR A         ;
 $80E8 LD ($60C2),A  ;
*$80EB CALL $8240    ; Main tick
 $80EE CALL $8115    ; Poll controls
 $80F1 LD A,($60D9)  ; get Game state
 $80F4 CP $04        ;
 $80F6 JR NZ,$80EB   ;
 $80F8 XOR A         ;
 $80F9 LD ($60D9),A  ; set Game state
 $80FC CALL $8390    ; Advance col counter
 $80FF CP $08        ;
 $8101 JR NZ,$810C   ;
 $8103 CALL $8382    ; Clear col mask
 $8106 CALL $99F0    ; Draw info screen b
 $8109 JP $803D      ;
*$810C CALL $8360    ; Pack col state
 $810F CALL $A72A    ;
 $8112 JP $8047      ;

; Poll controls
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; Per-frame keyboard handling (called from main_loop, skipped while frozen):
; restart key rebuilds the level, several keys toggle ctrl_flag
; (#R$60D7)/pad_var_8005, key $21 enters demo_pause (any joystick X exits), and
; a column of 8 menu-select keys picks an option (0-7) into pad_var_8005 before
; restarting setup.
; .
; In: none. Out: none (side effects on globals only).
@label=poll_controls
c$8115 LD A,($8004)  ; A = freeze_ctr
 $8118 OR A          ;
 $8119 RET NZ        ; frozen -> do nothing this frame
 $811A CALL $A70F    ;
 $811D JP NC,$802B   ; restart condition -> rebuild level
 $8120 LD A,$27      ;
 $8122 CALL $A706    ;
 $8125 JR Z,$813A    ;
 $8127 LD A,$08      ;
 $8129 CALL $A706    ;
 $812C JR Z,$813A    ;
 $812E LD A,$15      ;
 $8130 CALL $A706    ;
 $8133 JR Z,$813A    ;
 $8135 LD A,$01      ;
 $8137 LD ($60D7),A  ; set ctrl_flag (#R$60D7) = 1
*$813A LD A,$20      ;
 $813C CALL $A706    ;
 $813F JR Z,$8148    ;
 $8141 XOR A         ;
 $8142 LD ($60D7),A  ; set Control-key toggle flag
 $8145 LD ($8005),A  ;
*$8148 LD A,($60D8)  ; A = demo_pause
 $814B OR A          ;
 $814C JR NZ,$8165   ;
 $814E LD A,($6055)  ; get Level timer prescaler
 $8151 OR A          ;
 $8152 JR NZ,$817E   ;
 $8154 LD A,$21      ;
 $8156 CALL $A706    ;
 $8159 JR Z,$817E    ;
 $815B LD A,$FF      ; enter demo/pause mode (demo_pause = $FF)
 $815D LD ($60D8),A  ; set Demo/pause mode flag
 $8160 LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler
 $8163 JR $817E      ;
*$8165 CALL $A700    ; Proc table
 $8168 LD A,($601C)  ; get Signed input
 $816B OR A          ;
 $816C JR Z,$817E    ; no X movement -> stay in demo
 $816E XOR A         ;
 $816F LD ($60D8),A  ; movement -> exit demo
 $8172 LD A,($60D7)  ; get Control-key toggle flag
 $8175 OR A          ;
 $8176 JP M,$817B    ;
 $8179 LD A,$01      ;
*$817B LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler
*$817E LD A,($60D7)  ; get Control-key toggle flag
 $8181 OR A          ;
 $8182 RET Z         ;
 $8183 LD A,$27      ;
 $8185 CALL $A706    ;
 $8188 RET Z         ;
 $8189 LD B,$00      ; --- menu key-column scan: B = option index ---
 $818B LD A,$24      ;
 $818D CALL $A706    ;
 $8190 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $8192 INC B         ;
 $8193 LD A,$1C      ;
 $8195 CALL $A706    ; test each option key
 $8198 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $819A INC B         ;
 $819B LD A,$14      ;
 $819D CALL $A706    ;
 $81A0 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81A2 INC B         ;
 $81A3 LD A,$0C      ;
 $81A5 CALL $A706    ;
 $81A8 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81AA INC B         ;
 $81AB LD A,$04      ;
 $81AD CALL $A706    ;
 $81B0 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81B2 INC B         ;
 $81B3 LD A,$03      ;
 $81B5 CALL $A706    ;
 $81B8 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81BA INC B         ;
 $81BB LD A,$0B      ;
 $81BD CALL $A706    ;
 $81C0 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81C2 INC B         ;
 $81C3 LD A,$13      ;
 $81C5 CALL $A706    ;
 $81C8 JR NZ,$81CB   ;
 $81CA RET           ; none pressed -> return
*$81CB LD A,B        ; a key matched: B = selected option
 $81CC LD ($8005),A  ; store selection -> pad_var_8005
 $81CF POP HL        ;
 $81D0 XOR A         ;
 $81D1 LD ($60D8),A  ; set Demo/pause mode flag
 $81D4 JP $8032      ; restart game setup with the new selection

; Setup level
;
; Used by the routines at #R$802B and #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; (Re)build the current level's working state.
; .
; Zeroes the work_buffers block (#R$F000.., $0FFF bytes via LDIR), loads the
; level's column data (load_level_col), resets the tower position
; (init_tower_pos), re-inits flags (init_b5cf) and the renderers (#R$8FB7,
; #R$96D4).
; .
; Clobbers: most.
@label=setup_level
c$81D7 LD HL,$F000   ; Clear work_buffers (#R$F000) for tower map
 $81DA LD DE,$F001   ;
 $81DD LD BC,$0FFF   ;
 $81E0 LD (HL),$00   ;
 $81E2 LDIR          ;
 $81E4 CALL $A763    ; Load level column data into #R$F000
 $81E7 CALL $83D0    ; Init tower pos
 $81EA CALL $A77E    ;
 $81ED CALL $8FB7    ; Clear actor states
 $81F0 CALL $96D4    ;
 $81F3 LD B,$04      ; Initialise 4 object slots to empty
 $81F5 LD HL,$60A9   ;
*$81F8 LD (HL),$FF   ; Fill slots with $FF (empty)
 $81FA INC HL        ;
 $81FB DJNZ $81F8    ;
 $81FD LD A,($60D9)  ; Check if game_state == 3 (level transition)
 $8200 CP $03        ;
 $8202 JR Z,$8235    ; Skip attribute painting if transitioning
 $8204 CALL $A799    ; Paint tower colour attributes
 $8207 LD A,$01      ;
 $8209 LD ($60C9),A  ; Set $60C9 = 1 (enable column visibility update)
 $820C LD A,$24      ; Compute disp_height = 36 - tower_height
 $820E LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $8211 SUB (HL)      ;
 $8212 AND $7F       ;
 $8214 LD ($6032),A  ; set Display height
 $8217 CALL $A751    ; Mark visible tower columns for rendering
 $821A CALL $9F11    ; Init attract actors
 $821D LD HL,$60C9   ;
 $8220 DEC (HL)      ;
 $8221 XOR A         ;
 $8222 LD ($60D9),A  ; Set game_state = 0 (normal play)
 $8225 LD A,$7D      ;
 $8227 LD ($60A3),A  ;
 $822A LD A,$01      ; Set player starting column = 1
 $822C LD ($60A4),A  ; set Player's current column
 $822F LD A,($60D7)  ; get Control-key toggle flag
 $8232 JP $8237      ;
*$8235 LD A,$FF      ; Set #R$6055 = $FF during level transition
*$8237 LD ($6055),A  ; Store $FF or $00 into timer prescaler #R$6055
 $823A LD A,$02      ; Freeze input for 2 frames
 $823C LD ($8004),A  ;
 $823F RET           ;

; Main tick
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; One frame of the game.
; .
; Called from main_loop.
; .
; Order: read input (unless frozen) -> run game-state machine (player move,
; tower rotation, enemies) -> redraw widgets -> HALT to sync to the 50Hz frame
; interrupt.
; .
; State: game_state (#R$60D9): 3=level transition, 4=finished,
; .
; else = normal play.
; .
; demo_pause (#R$60D8) skips logic.
; .
; freeze_ctr ($8004) freezes input for N frames.
; .
; Clobbers: most regs.
; .
; Returns once per frame.
@label=main_tick
c$8240 LD HL,$8004   ; HL -> freeze_ctr (in code padding at $8004)
 $8243 LD A,(HL)     ; A = freeze counter
 $8244 OR A          ;
 $8245 JR Z,$8254    ; 0 = not frozen -> read input normally
 $8247 DEC (HL)      ; frozen: count down one frame
 $8248 XOR A         ;
 $8249 LD ($601D),A  ; zero the three input vars while frozen
 $824C LD ($601E),A  ; set Signed input
 $824F LD ($601C),A  ; set Signed input
 $8252 JR $8257      ;
*$8254 CALL $A700    ; Proc table
*$8257 LD A,($60D8)  ; A = demo_pause flag
 $825A OR A          ;
 $825B JR NZ,$8291   ; set -> skip all game logic (attract/demo), just redraw
 $825D LD A,($60D9)  ; A = game_state
 $8260 CP $03        ; state 3 = level transition?
 $8262 JR NZ,$8270   ;
 $8264 CALL $8482    ; Player tick
 $8267 LD A,($60D9)  ; get Game state
 $826A CP $04        ;
 $826C RET Z         ; state 4 = finished -> done this frame
 $826D JP $8291      ;
*$8270 CALL $A769    ; --- normal play: update one frame ---
 $8273 CALL $96E9    ; Update actor pos
 $8276 CALL $8482    ; Player tick
 $8279 LD A,($60A4)  ; A = player column before move
 $827C PUSH AF       ;
 $827D CALL $A76F    ; move player (proc_table slot)
 $8280 POP AF        ;
 $8281 LD B,A        ;
 $8282 LD A,($60A4)  ; compare new vs old player column
 $8285 CP B          ;
 $8286 LD A,$00      ;
 $8288 CALL NZ,$A3DE ; Play sound
 $828B CALL $90DA    ; Update enemies
 $828E CALL $89C5    ; Check collision
*$8291 LD A,$24      ; --- redraw HUD: A = $24 (36 rows) ---
 $8293 LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $8296 SUB (HL)      ; subtract tower_height (#R$60B9)
 $8297 AND $7F       ;
 $8299 LD ($6032),A  ; store display height (#R$6032)
 $829C CALL $A751    ; draw widgets (proc_table slots)
 $829F CALL $A75A    ;
 $82A2 CALL $A75D    ;
 $82A5 CALL $A757    ;
 $82A8 PUSH AF       ;
 $82A9 CALL $8FC7    ; Draw player
 $82AC HALT          ; HALT: wait for the 50Hz frame IRQ (Z80
 $82AD CALL $A41C    ; Sound tick
 $82B0 CALL $A760    ;
 $82B3 CALL $A790    ;
 $82B6 CALL $8FFA    ; Draw actors sorted
 $82B9 CALL $A787    ;
 $82BC CALL $A796    ;
 $82BF POP AF        ;
 $82C0 CALL $A793    ;
 $82C3 CALL $A754    ;
 $82C6 CALL $A79C    ;
 $82C9 LD A,($60D9)  ; get Game state
 $82CC CP $03        ;
 $82CE JR Z,$82D9    ;
 $82D0 CALL $82DA    ; Tally score to
 $82D3 CALL $A724    ;
 $82D6 CALL $A736    ;
*$82D9 RET           ;

; Tally score to
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Count $60BC up toward #R$60BA, awarding $10 (BCD) points per step via
; add_bcd_score, until the two 16-bit values meet. Used to animate an
; end-of-section bonus tally.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=tally_score_to
c$82DA LD HL,($60BC) ; {already >= target? -> RET (nothing to tally)
 $82DD LD DE,($60BA) ;
 $82E1 OR A          ;
 $82E2 SBC HL,DE     ; }
 $82E4 RET NC        ;
*$82E5 LD HL,($60BC) ; {reload both; equal? -> RET (done)
 $82E8 LD DE,($60BA) ;
 $82EC LD A,L        ;
 $82ED CP E          ;
 $82EE JR NZ,$82F3   ;
 $82F0 LD A,H        ;
 $82F1 CP D          ; }
 $82F2 RET Z         ;
*$82F3 PUSH HL       ; {award $10 points (add_bcd_score)
 $82F4 LD HL,$0010   ;
 $82F7 CALL $A727    ; }
 $82FA POP HL        ; {counter += 1, loop
 $82FB INC HL        ;
 $82FC LD ($60BC),HL ;
 $82FF JR $82E5      ; }

; Unused
@label=col_state_words
s$8301 DEFS $04

; Init col state
;
; Used by the routine at #R$802B.
;
; .
;
; Seed both players' saved column-mask words for a fresh level build: reads
; pad_var_8005's low byte (selected option, 0 at level start) and writes
; $FF00|sel (all 8 columns present) into both the P1 (#R$8301) and P2 ($8303)
; slots.
; .
; In: pad_var_8005 (memory). Out: (#R$8301),($8303). Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=init_col_state
c$8305 LD HL,($8005) ;
 $8308 LD H,$FF      ;
 $830A LD ($8301),HL ;
 $830D LD ($8303),HL ;
 $8310 RET           ;

; Restore col state
;
; Used by the routine at #R$802B.
;
; O:CY success (a word was found and col_flags[] populated) NC failure
;
; Expand a player's saved column bitmask into the 8-byte col_flags[] array
; (#R$60CB) and mirror its counter into #R$6039. lives_p1 (#R$6040, doubling
; here as an ACTIVE-PLAYER INDEX rather than a life count) selects the P1/P2
; saved-word slot (#R$8301/$8303), toggling it first if running_flag doesn't
; already match; a zero saved word falls through to the alternate re-init path
; instead of unpacking.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,C,H.
@label=restore_col_state
c$8311 LD A,($603F)  ; A = running_flag
 $8314 CP $01        ; {running_flag==1? select player index accordingly
 $8316 LD A,$00      ;
 $8318 LD HL,$6040   ;
 $831B JR Z,$831F    ;
 $831D INC A         ;
 $831E SUB (HL)      ; }
*$831F LD (HL),A     ; store selected player index (lives_p1)
 $8320 LD HL,$8302   ; {HL -> P1/P2 saved-word high byte (#R$8301/$8303)
 $8323 OR A          ;
 $8324 JR Z,$8328    ;
 $8326 INC HL        ;
 $8327 INC HL        ; }
*$8328 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = saved word high byte
 $8329 OR A          ; }
 $832A JR NZ,$8346   ; nonzero -> unpack it ($8346)
 $832C LD A,($603F)  ; get Running flag
 $832F CP $01        ;
 $8331 JR Z,$835E    ;
 $8333 LD A,$01      ; {else: flip player index, retry with the other slot
 $8335 LD HL,$6040   ;
 $8338 SUB (HL)      ;
 $8339 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $833A LD HL,$8302   ;
 $833D OR A          ;
 $833E JR Z,$8342    ;
 $8340 INC HL        ;
 $8341 INC HL        ;
*$8342 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = other slot's high byte; zero -> give up (NC)
 $8343 OR A          ;
 $8344 JR Z,$835E    ; }
*$8346 DEC HL        ; HL -> saved word low byte (column counter)
 $8347 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8348 LD ($6039),A  ; set Level number 0
 $834B INC HL        ; {C = saved word high byte (column-present bitmask)
 $834C LD C,(HL)     ; }
 $834D LD HL,$60CB   ; {HL -> col_flags[0], B = 8
 $8350 LD B,$08      ; }
*$8352 XOR A         ; {unpack one bit: RR C -> col_flags[i] = 0/1
 $8353 RR C          ;
 $8355 JR NC,$8358   ;
 $8357 INC A         ; }
*$8358 LD (HL),A     ;
 $8359 INC HL        ;
 $835A DJNZ $8352    ; {loop 8 bits; success -> SCF, RET
 $835C SCF           ;
 $835D RET           ; }
*$835E OR A          ; {no saved word -> NC, RET
 $835F RET           ; }

; Pack col state
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; Inverse of restore_col_state: writes the live counter (#R$6039) into the
; selected player's saved-word low byte (lives_p1 picks P1/P2 slot
; #R$8301/$8303), then packs the 8 col_flags[] LSBs (#R$60CB..$60D2) back into
; the high mask byte.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,C,HL.
@label=pack_col_state
c$8360 LD HL,$8301   ; HL -> P1 saved word (#R$8301)
 $8363 LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $8366 OR A          ; {lives_p1!=0? select P2 slot instead
 $8367 JR Z,$836B    ; }
 $8369 INC HL        ; {HL -> saved word high byte
 $836A INC HL        ; }
*$836B LD A,($6039)  ; get Level number 0
 $836E LD (HL),A     ; {store counter into saved word low byte, HL -> high byte
 $836F INC HL        ; }
 $8370 PUSH HL       ; {save HL; B = 8 (bits), A = 0 (mask accumulator)
 $8371 LD B,$08      ;
 $8373 XOR A         ; }
 $8374 LD HL,$60CB   ; HL -> col_flags[0]
*$8377 LD C,(HL)     ; C = col_flags[i]
 $8378 RR C          ; shift C's bit into carry
 $837A RR A          ; shift carry into mask byte A
 $837C INC HL        ; {next flag, loop 8 bits
 $837D DJNZ $8377    ; }
 $837F POP HL        ; {restore HL; store packed mask byte
 $8380 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $8381 RET           ;

; Clear col mask
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; Zero the selected player's column mask byte (high byte of #R$8301/$8303).
; .
; lives_p1 selects the slot.
@label=clear_col_mask
c$8382 LD HL,$8302   ;
 $8385 LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $8388 OR A          ;
 $8389 JR Z,$838D    ;
 $838B INC HL        ;
 $838C INC HL        ;
*$838D LD (HL),$00   ;
 $838F RET           ;

; Advance col counter
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8064.
;
; .
;
; Mark current column done: clear col_flags[#R$6039], then bump the selected
; player's saved counter (low byte) and mirror it back to #R$6039.
@label=advance_col_counter
c$8390 LD A,($6039)  ;
 $8393 LD E,A        ;
 $8394 LD D,$00      ;
 $8396 LD HL,$60CB   ;
 $8399 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $839A LD (HL),$00   ;
 $839C LD HL,$8301   ;
 $839F LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $83A2 OR A          ;
 $83A3 JR Z,$83A7    ;
 $83A5 INC HL        ;
 $83A6 INC HL        ;
*$83A7 INC (HL)      ;
 $83A8 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $83A9 LD ($6039),A  ; set Level number 0
 $83AC RET           ;

; Setup IM2
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8000.
;
; .
;
; Install the Z80 mode-2 interrupt vector.
; .
; Builds a 257-byte page of identical bytes at $BB00..#R$BC00 so that, whatever
; the data-bus byte is at IRQ time, the Z80 reads the 16-bit vector #R$BABA
; from table[$FF]/table[$100].
; .
; At #R$BABA it plants 'JP #R$83CA' -- the actual interrupt service routine.
; .
; In:  nothing.
; .
; Out: IM 2 active, IFF1=1 (interrupts enabled).
; .
; Clobbers: A, B, HL, I.
; .
; The porter must emulate this
@label=setup_im2
c$83AD DI            ; no IRQs while we build the vector table
 $83AE LD HL,$BB00   ; HL -> vector-table page base $BB00
 $83B1 LD A,H        ; A = $BB = high byte of the table page
 $83B2 LD I,A        ; I = $BB: IM2 reads vectors from page I (Z80-only)
 $83B4 DEC A         ; A = $BA = the byte we flood the table with
 $83B5 LD B,$00      ; B = 0 -> DJNZ loops 256 times (Z80 DJNZ: dec B, jump nz)
*$83B7 LD (HL),A     ; table[i] = $BA
 $83B8 INC HL        ; next table slot
 $83B9 DJNZ $83B7    ; fill all 256 bytes of $BB00..$BBFF
 $83BB LD (HL),A     ; +1 byte at #R$BC00 = $BA: covers the table[$100]
                     ; off-by-one
 $83BC LD H,A        ; H = $BA
 $83BD LD L,A        ; L = $BA  -> HL = #R$BABA (the vector the IRQ will fetch)
 $83BE LD (HL),$C3   ; plant C3 = JP opcode at #R$BABA
 $83C0 INC L         ;
 $83C1 LD (HL),$CA   ; low byte of JP target -> $CA
 $83C3 INC L         ;
 $83C4 LD (HL),$83   ; high byte -> $83, so vector = 'JP #R$83CA' = irq_handler
 $83C6 IM 2          ; switch CPU to interrupt mode 2 (Z80-only)
 $83C8 EI            ; interrupts on

; IM2 noop return
;
; Used by the routine at #R$83CA.
@label=im2_noop_ret
c$83C9 RET           ; return to game_entry

; IRQ handler
;
; Used by the routine at #R$BABA.
;
; .
;
; IM 2 interrupt service routine (50 Hz vblank).
; .
; Reached via the planted vector at #R$BABA -> JP here.
; .
; It is a deliberate NEAR-NO-OP: 'CALL #R$83C9' targets the bare RET at the end
; of setup_im2, so the call does nothing.
; .
; The point is to REPLACE the 48K ROM's own interrupt routine (which scans the
; keyboard and bumps the FRAMES sysvar) with a handler that has no side
; effects, while still letting interrupts fire.
; .
; Verified: no code anywhere
@label=irq_handler
c$83CA CALL $83C9    ; CALL #R$83C9 = the RET in setup_im2: a no-op
                     ; (neutralized ISR)
 $83CD EI            ; re-enable interrupts
 $83CE RETI          ; RETI: return from maskable interrupt (Z80-only

; Init tower pos
;
; Used by the routine at #R$81D7.
;
; .
;
; Reset the tower/scroll position for a new level: tower_height=$04,
; #R$60BA/$60BC (current & target column)=8,
; .
; scroll_pos = 8-$28, and clear the high bytes $60BB/$60BD.
; .
; Clobbers: A.
@label=init_tower_pos
c$83D0 LD A,$04      ;
 $83D2 LD ($60B9),A  ; set Tower rotation position
 $83D5 LD A,$08      ;
 $83D7 LD ($60BA),A  ;
 $83DA LD ($60BC),A  ;
 $83DD SUB $28       ;
 $83DF LD ($6030),A  ; set Vertical scroll position
 $83E2 LD A,$00      ;
 $83E4 LD ($60BB),A  ;
 $83E7 LD ($60BD),A  ;
 $83EA SBC A,$00     ;
 $83EC AND $03       ;
 $83EE LD ($6031),A  ;
 $83F1 XOR A         ;
 $83F2 LD ($6037),A  ; set Unknown byte
 $83F5 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $83F8 LD ($60C3),A  ; set Player died this frame
 $83FB LD ($6020),A  ; set Debounce latch
 $83FE LD ($60C5),A  ;
 $8401 LD A,$00      ;
 $8403 LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state
 $8406 LD A,$80      ;
 $8408 LD ($60BE),A  ;
 $840B LD A,$01      ;
 $840D LD ($60C2),A  ;
 $8410 RET           ;

; Rotate tower
;
; Used by the routines at #R$8460, #R$84B9, #R$85DB, #R$868D and #R$8736.
;
; .
;
; Rotate the tower by signed B: tower_height = (tower_height + B) AND $7F
; (128-column wrap), saving the old value in #R$6033.
; .
; Tests the new position for a wall/collision (#R$9330) on collision (NC) it
; reverts tower_height.
; .
; In: B=delta.
; .
; Out: CY=moved.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL.
@label=rotate_tower
c$8411 LD B,A        ;
 $8412 LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $8415 LD ($6033),A  ; set Previous tower_height
 $8418 ADD A,B       ;
 $8419 AND $7F       ;
 $841B LD ($60B9),A  ; set Tower rotation position
 $841E LD HL,($60BA) ;
 $8421 CALL $9330    ; Check rotate collision
 $8424 JR NC,$842E   ;
 $8426 LD A,($6033)  ; get Previous tower_height
 $8429 LD ($60B9),A  ; set Tower rotation position
 $842C SCF           ;
 $842D RET           ;
*$842E OR A          ;
 $842F RET           ;

; Step scroll
;
; Used by the routines at #R$85DB, #R$868D and #R$879B.
;
; .
;
; Advance the column/scroll position #R$60BA by signed A (sign-extended via B),
; folding H into the 4-quadrant range (AND $03) saves the previous position in
; #R$6034.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL.
@label=step_scroll
c$8430 LD HL,($60BA) ;
 $8433 LD ($6034),HL ; set Previous scroll_pos
 $8436 LD B,$00      ;
 $8438 OR A          ;
 $8439 JP P,$843D    ;
 $843C DEC B         ;
*$843D ADD A,L       ;
 $843E LD L,A        ;
 $843F LD A,B        ;
 $8440 ADC A,H       ;
 $8441 JP M,$845C    ;
 $8444 AND $03       ;
 $8446 LD H,A        ;
 $8447 LD ($60BA),HL ;
 $844A LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $844D CALL $9330    ; Check rotate collision
 $8450 JR NC,$845A   ;
 $8452 LD HL,($6034) ; get Previous scroll_pos
 $8455 LD ($60BA),HL ;
 $8458 SCF           ;
 $8459 RET           ;
*$845A OR A          ;
 $845B RET           ;
*$845C POP HL        ;
 $845D JP $8AD7      ;

; Rotate if idle
;
; Used by the routines at #R$84B9 and #R$8854.
;
; .
;
; If #R$957A returns a pending step (CY) and there is no vertical input
; (input_y==0), rotate the tower by it (tail-calls rotate_tower).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B.
@label=rotate_if_idle
c$8460 CALL $957A    ; Check step cell
 $8463 RET NC        ;
 $8464 LD B,A        ;
 $8465 LD A,($601D)  ; get Signed input
 $8468 OR A          ;
 $8469 RET NZ        ;
 $846A LD A,B        ;
 $846B JP $8411      ; => Rotate tower

; Data block at 846E
@label=player_state_table
b$846E DEFB $B9,$84,$8D,$86,$DB,$85,$63,$85
 $8476 DEFB $36,$87,$54,$88,$BD,$88,$71,$8A
 $847E DEFB $0E,$8B,$1D,$A1

; Player tick
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Per-frame player state machine, run every frame from main_tick (both in
; normal play AND on the game_state==3 level-transition path TASK.md called
; this 'the level-transition path' -- it is really the general player update,
; the transition is just one caller).
; .
; Preamble debounces directional input: input_latch (#R$6020) records whether
; input_x is active so a press fires once a held input is consumed (input_x
; cleared).
; .
; Tail reads player_state and dispatches through a 2-byte JP-address table at
; #R$846E (index = state*2) to the pstate_N handler below.
@label=player_tick
c$8482 LD HL,$6020   ;
 $8485 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8486 OR A          ;
 $8487 JR NZ,$8492   ;
 $8489 LD A,($601C)  ; get Signed input
 $848C OR A          ;
 $848D JR Z,$849F    ;
 $848F LD (HL),A     ;
 $8490 JR $849F      ;
*$8492 LD A,($601C)  ; get Signed input
 $8495 OR A          ;
 $8496 JR NZ,$849B   ;
 $8498 LD (HL),A     ;
 $8499 JR $849F      ;
*$849B XOR A         ;
 $849C LD ($601C),A  ; set Signed input (debounce: force input_x=0 this frame)
*$849F LD A,($60C0)  ; get Player state-machine state
 $84A2 ADD A,A       ; {index player_state*2 into jump table #R$846E and
 $84A3 LD E,A        ; dispatch (JP (HL))
 $84A4 LD D,$00      ;
 $84A6 LD HL,$846E   ; }
 $84A9 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $84AA LD E,(HL)     ;
 $84AB INC HL        ;
 $84AC LD D,(HL)     ;
 $84AD EX DE,HL      ;
 $84AE JP (HL)       ;

; Pstate reset
;
; Used by the routines at #R$8563, #R$85DB, #R$868D, #R$879B, #R$8831, #R$8854
; and #R$88BD.
;
; .
;
; Common "return to normal/play" exit: player_state=0, pstate_phase=0.
; .
; Reached by tail-jump from most other pstate_N handlers when their
; animation/action completes.
@label=pstate_reset
c$84AF LD A,$00      ;
 $84B1 LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state
 $84B4 XOR A         ;
 $84B5 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $84B8 RET           ;

; Pstate play
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 0 (standing/walking, the default state): reads the cell under the
; player and dispatches on its type (0=normal falls through, 1->#R$8590,
; 2->#R$85A1, else->#R$85B0). On a normal cell: vertical input enters pstate_3
; (climb) horizontal input (or a blocked ROTATE_TOWER) enters pstate_1 (climb a
; column) via #R$8656/#R$8673 no input advances the idle-walk animation, or
; with fire held over a conveyor/special cell, enters pstate_4 (jump/fall) via
; #R$8724. Dispatched from player_tick's jump table state entries take no

; Pstate 1
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 1: climbing a tower column (entered via code_8656/#R$8673).
; .

; the direction stashed in tbl_863f, then looks up a scroll delta (table $8643,
; mirrored $864F when climbing the other way) and applies it via STEP_SCROLL.
; .

; pstate_reset). Otherwise advances phase; once phase reaches the $8642 limit
; it does a final STEP_SCROLL($FF) -- no-carry falls into the pstate_5 setup
; path (#R$8596), carry sets phase=1 and player_state=2 (pstate_2, slide-in).

*$86CA INC A         ;

 $86CD LD A,$02      ;

*$86D5 LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $86D8 INC (HL)      ;
 $86D9 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $86DA LD HL,$8642   ;
 $86DD CP (HL)       ;
 $86DE RET C         ;

; Pstate 4
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 4: jump/fall arc (entered from #R$8724 or from pstate_play's
; ROTATE_TOWER-blocked path).
; .
; Early phase (0..6): plays a landing sound at gated points, picks a sprite
; frame from tables $8700/$8704 (mirrored by facing), nudges tower rotation
; toward the center column (#R$60B9&7 vs 4) via ROTATE_TOWER, advances phase.
; .
; Phase 7..$0C: picks frame from table $8709, advances phase. Falls through to
; #R$879B for the rest of the arc.
@label=pstate_4
c$8736 LD A,($60BF)  ; A = pstate_phase (landing-sound gate)
 $8739 CP $07        ; {phase in [7,$22]? sound-gate window test
 $873B JR C,$874A    ;
 $873D CP $23        ;
 $873F JR NC,$874A   ; }
 $8741 SUB $07       ;
 $8743 AND $03       ;
 $8745 LD A,$02      ;
 $8747 CALL Z,$A3DE  ; Play sound
*$874A LD A,($60BF)  ; get Player state-machine phase/height window
 $874D CP $04        ; {phase>=4? skip walk-frame select
 $874F JR NC,$877D   ; }
 $8751 LD E,A        ; {select sprite frame table $8700/$8704 (mirrored by
 $8752 LD D,$00      ; facing)
 $8754 LD HL,$8704   ;
 $8757 LD A,($60BE)  ;
 $875A OR A          ;
 $875B JP P,$8761    ;
 $875E LD HL,$8700   ; }
*$8761 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $8762 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8763 LD ($60C1),A  ;
 $8766 LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $8769 AND $07       ; {rotate tower toward center column (compare &7 vs 4)
 $876B CP $04        ;
 $876D JR Z,$8778    ;
 $876F LD A,$01      ;
 $8771 JR C,$8775    ;
 $8773 LD A,$FF      ; }
*$8775 CALL $8411    ; Rotate tower
*$8778 LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $877B INC (HL)      ;
 $877C RET           ;
*$877D CP $07        ; {phase<7: force phase=7 (skip window)
 $877F JR NC,$8786   ;
 $8781 LD A,$07      ; }
 $8783 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
*$8786 CP $0D        ; phase>=$0D? end of this section
 $8788 JR NC,$879B   ;
 $878A LD E,A        ; {phase 7..$0C: frame from table $8709, phase++
 $878B LD D,$00      ;
 $878D LD HL,$8709   ;
 $8790 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $8791 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8792 LD ($60C1),A  ; }
 $8795 LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $8798 INC (HL)      ;
 $8799 RET           ;

; Unused

; Pstate 4 land
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8736.
;
; .
;
; Continuation of pstate_4 for phase>=$0D (descent/landing).
; .
; At phase==$1D: clears $60C2, and if game_state!=0 sets game_state=2 (signals
; landing to main_tick). Also rotates tower position by +-2 per facing,
; toggling a self-mod alternator so this only fires every other call.
; .
; Phase $1D..$22: frame from table $86F9. Phase>=$23: if game_state==3, JP
; #R$A113 (external -- special level-transition landing, not covered here).
; Else STEP_SCROLL($FC) and, at phase<$24, latches a landing facing direction
; into $60BE from vertical input.
; .
; Phase $24..$27: frame from table $86E4/$86E8 (mirrored). Phase>=$28: jump
; sequence complete, JP pstate_reset.
c$879B CP $1D        ; phase < $1D? skip landing-signal block
 $879D JR NC,$87CF   ;
 $879F XOR A         ; {clear $60C2
 $87A0 LD ($60C2),A  ; }
 $87A3 LD A,($60D9)  ; get Game state
 $87A6 OR A          ;
 $87A7 JR Z,$87AF    ;
 $87A9 LD A,$02      ;
 $87AB LD ($60D9),A  ; set Game state
 $87AE RET           ;
*$87AF LD A,($60BE)  ; {rotate +-2 per facing (self-mod alternator gated)
 $87B2 OR A          ;
 $87B3 LD A,$02      ;
 $87B5 JP M,$87BA    ;
 $87B8 LD A,$FE      ; }
*$87BA LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $87BD ADD A,(HL)    ;
 $87BE AND $7F       ;

 $87C3 LD HL,$879A   ; {alternator toggled -> fire every other call
 $87C6 INC (HL)      ;
 $87C7 BIT 0,(HL)    ;
 $87C9 RET NZ        ; }
 $87CA LD HL,$60BF   ; {not yet: phase++, done
 $87CD INC (HL)      ;
 $87CE RET           ; }
*$87CF CP $23        ; phase < $23? use table $86F9 frame
 $87D1 JR NC,$87E8   ;
 $87D3 LD E,A        ; {frame from $86F9[phase], phase++
 $87D4 LD D,$00      ;
 $87D6 LD HL,$86F9   ;
 $87D9 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $87DA LD A,(HL)     ;
 $87DB LD ($60C1),A  ;
 $87DE LD A,$01      ;
 $87E0 LD ($60C2),A  ; }
 $87E3 LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $87E6 INC (HL)      ;
 $87E7 RET           ;
*$87E8 LD B,A        ; phase >= $23: check game_state==3
 $87E9 LD A,($60D9)  ; get Game state
 $87EC CP $03        ;
 $87EE JP Z,$A113    ; => Level shift entry
 $87F1 LD A,B        ;
 $87F2 CP $24        ;
 $87F4 JR NC,$8812   ;
 $87F6 LD A,$FC      ;
 $87F8 CALL $8430    ; Step scroll
 $87FB RET NC        ;
 $87FC LD B,$00      ;
 $87FE LD A,($601D)  ; get Signed input
 $8801 OR A          ;
 $8802 JR Z,$880D    ;
 $8804 JP M,$8809    ;
 $8807 LD B,$80      ;
*$8809 LD A,B        ;
 $880A LD ($60BE),A  ;
*$880D LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $8810 INC (HL)      ;
 $8811 RET           ;
*$8812 CP $28        ; phase < $28? frame table $86E4/E8
 $8814 JP NC,$84AF   ; => Pstate reset
 $8817 LD E,A        ;
 $8818 LD D,$00      ;
 $881A LD HL,$86E4   ;
 $881D LD A,($60BE)  ;
 $8820 OR A          ;
 $8821 JP M,$8827    ;

*$8827 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $8828 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8829 LD ($60C1),A  ;
 $882C LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $882F INC (HL)      ;

; Pstate 5
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 5: ledge-grab / climb-onto (entered from pstate_1 at #R$8596 when a
; column climb ends without reaching the top-of-climb case). Calls
; ROTATE_IF_IDLE each frame; at phase==3 the grab completes (JP pstate_reset),

@label=pstate_5

 $8857 LD A,($60BF)  ; get Player state-machine phase/height window
 $885A CP $03        ;

 $8860 LD D,$00      ;

; Update player obj
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8854.
;
; .
;
; Copy the live tower position (#R$60BA) into the player object (actor_obj)
; column fields (+6/+12), biased by tower_height and facing ($60BE bit7).
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL,IX.
@label=update_player_obj
