 $887F LD HL,($60BA)   ; obj+6/+12
 $8882 LD (IX+$06),L   ;
 $8885 LD (IX+$0C),H   ; }
 $8888 LD A,($60B9)    ; get Tower rotation position
 $888B DEC A           ; {A = rotation-1, +2 if facing bit7 set; wrap &7F;
 $888C LD HL,$60BE     ; obj+0 = A
 $888F BIT 7,(HL)      ;
 $8891 JR Z,$8895      ;
 $8893 ADD A,$02       ;
*$8895 AND $7F         ;
 $8897 LD (IX+$00),A   ; }
 $889A LD (IX+$2A),$00 ; {obj+$2A = 0 (reset sub-step); obj+$36 =
 $889E LD A,$01        ; facing-dependent $01/$FF
 $88A0 BIT 7,(HL)      ;
 $88A2 JR NZ,$88A6     ;
 $88A4 LD A,$FF        ;
*$88A6 LD (IX+$36),A   ;
 $88A9 RET             ; }

; Unused
s$88AA DEFS $01

; Exit pstate 5 (ledge grab)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$84B9.
;
; .
;
; Exit path from pstate_5's ledge-grab completion: checks CHECK_CONVEYOR under
; the player and either hands off into pstate_6 (state=6, on a conveyor) or
; resets phase/state back to normal play.
@label=pstate5_exit
c$88AB LD ($88AA),A  ;
 $88AE XOR A         ;
 $88AF LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $88B2 LD A,$06      ;
 $88B4 LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state
 $88B7 CALL $9540    ; Check conveyor
 $88BA JP $A76C      ;

; Pstate 6
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 6: riding a conveyor / column-transition (entered from #R$88AB).
; .
; Phase==0: nudges tower rotation (#R$60B9) toward the center column (compare
; &7 vs 4), same trick as pstate_4.
; .
; Phase==1: sets flag #R$6038=$FE, calls CHECK_CONVEYOR and combines its result
; with a self-mod "descending" byte at #R$88AA to build a movement mask, then
; applies a signed 16-bit step to the actor's column position (#R$60BA). Every
; 4th sub-step plays sound $0A and re-checks the conveyor.
; .
; Examines the cell flags to either block movement (early RET) or complete it:
; on completion ORs $81 into the cell flags, calls $A766 (object/effect hook,
; not analysed here), sets #R$6038=$FF, returns to pstate_reset.
@label=pstate_6
c$88BD LD A,($60BF)   ; {phase!=0? skip center-rotate step
 $88C0 OR A           ;
 $88C1 JR NZ,$88F6    ; }
 $88C3 LD A,($60B9)   ; get Tower rotation position
 $88C6 AND $07        ;
 $88C8 CP $04         ;
 $88CA JR Z,$88DA     ;
 $88CC LD A,$01       ;
 $88CE JR C,$88D2     ;
 $88D0 LD A,$FF       ;
*$88D2 LD HL,$60B9    ;
 $88D5 ADD A,(HL)     ;
 $88D6 AND $7F        ;
 $88D8 LD (HL),A      ;
 $88D9 RET            ;
*$88DA LD HL,$60BF    ; {phase==0 tail: phase++, flag_6038=$FE
 $88DD INC (HL)       ;
 $88DE LD A,$FE       ; }
 $88E0 LD ($6038),A   ; set Flag?? $00 $FE $FF
 $88E3 CALL $9540     ; Check conveyor
 $88E6 LD A,(HL)      ; {combine conveyor result with self-mod #R$88AA
 $88E7 AND $0C        ; descending flag
 $88E9 LD IX,$88AA    ;
 $88ED BIT 7,(IX+$00) ; }
 $88F1 JR NZ,$88F5    ;
 $88F3 OR $80         ;
*$88F5 LD (HL),A      ;
*$88F6 LD A,($88AA)   ; {A = descending flag; B = sign extend
 $88F9 LD B,$00       ;
 $88FB OR A           ;
 $88FC JP P,$8900     ; }
 $88FF DEC B          ;
*$8900 LD HL,($60BA)  ; {apply signed step to actor column (16-bit)
 $8903 ADD A,L        ;
 $8904 LD L,A         ;
 $8905 LD A,B         ;
 $8906 ADC A,H        ;
 $8907 AND $03        ;
 $8909 LD H,A         ;
 $890A LD ($60BA),HL  ;
 $890D LD A,L         ;
 $890E AND $03        ;
 $8910 RET NZ         ; }
 $8911 LD A,$0A       ;
 $8913 CALL $A3DE     ; Play sound
 $8916 CALL $9540     ; Check conveyor
 $8919 LD A,($88AA)   ; {re-check conveyor result sign
 $891C OR A           ; }
 $891D JP P,$8936     ;
 $8920 LD A,(HL)      ; {facing-negative branch: test cell flags, block or pass
 $8921 AND $0C        ;
 $8923 CP $04         ;
 $8925 JR Z,$894D     ;
 $8927 CP $0C         ;
 $8929 JR NZ,$8934    ;
 $892B LD B,A         ; }
 $892C LD A,($601E)   ; get Signed input
 $892F OR A           ;
 $8930 LD A,B         ;
 $8931 JP P,$894D     ;
*$8934 LD (HL),A      ;
 $8935 RET            ;
*$8936 LD A,(HL)      ; {facing-positive branch: mirrored test
 $8937 AND $0C        ;
 $8939 CP $08         ;
 $893B JR Z,$894D     ;
 $893D CP $0C         ;
 $893F JR NZ,$8949    ;
 $8941 LD B,A         ; }
 $8942 LD A,($601E)   ; get Signed input
 $8945 DEC A          ;
 $8946 LD A,B         ;
 $8947 JR NZ,$894D    ;
*$8949 OR $80         ;
 $894B LD (HL),A      ;
 $894C RET            ;
*$894D OR $81         ; {complete: mark cell done, notify, reset flag, return
 $894F LD (HL),A      ;
 $8950 CALL $A766     ;
 $8953 LD A,$FF       ; }
 $8955 LD ($6038),A   ; set Flag?? $00 $FE $FF
 $8958 JP $84AF       ; => Pstate reset

; Collision test
;
; Used by the routine at #R$89C5.
;
; .
;
; Player-vs-world collision probe, called from check_collision.
; .
; Builds a synthetic object record for the player at $6060 (angular
; pos=tower_height, column=#R$60BA+1/$60BB carry AND 3) so the shared
; actor-vs-actor code in check_collisions can be reused, then calls it.
; .
; If check_collisions reports a hit (CY), converts its returned IY pointer into
; IX and returns CY=1 (hit an enemy/moving actor).
; .
; If no actor hit, falls back to a static "wall marker" scan: walks the 4
; object_table entries, considering only those with state (+48)==7 (used here
; as a static-obstacle marker, distinct from player_state's own state 7), and
; tests whether the player's row (16-bit, from #R$60BA/$60BB) falls within
; roughly [entry_row-9, entry_row+16] of the entry's position (IX+6/IX+12).
; First match sets CY=1 with IX pointing at that entry else NC.
; .
; Out: CY=hit, IX=colliding object (actor or wall-marker entry).
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL,IX.
@label=collision_test
c$895B LD IX,$6060   ; IX -> synthetic player record ($6060)
 $895F LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $8962 LD (IX+$00),A ; {store angular pos + column (16-bit) into it
 $8965 LD A,($60BA)  ;
 $8968 ADD A,$01     ;
 $896A LD (IX+$06),A ;
 $896D LD A,($60BB)  ;
 $8970 ADC A,$00     ;
 $8972 AND $03       ;
 $8974 LD (IX+$0C),A ; }
 $8977 CALL $95BD    ; Check collisions
 $897A JR C,$89C0    ; actor hit -> convert IY to IX (below)
 $897C LD B,$04      ; {fallback: B=4, walk object_table for wall markers
 $897E LD IX,$605B   ; }
*$8982 LD A,(IX+$30) ; {only consider state==7 (wall marker) entries
 $8985 CP $07        ;
 $8987 JR Z,$898F    ;
 $8989 INC IX        ; }
 $898B DJNZ $8982    ;
*$898D OR A          ;
 $898E RET           ;
*$898F LD A,(IX+$00) ; {row window test vs entry's position: too far?
 $8992 CP $35        ;
 $8994 JR C,$898D    ;
 $8996 CP $44        ; }
 $8998 JR NC,$898D   ;
 $899A LD A,(IX+$06) ; {row+7 <= entry's position? (upper bound)
 $899D ADD A,$07     ;
 $899F LD L,A        ;
 $89A0 LD A,(IX+$0C) ;
 $89A3 ADC A,$00     ;
 $89A5 LD H,A        ; }
 $89A6 LD DE,($60BA) ;
 $89AA OR A          ;
 $89AB SBC HL,DE     ;
 $89AD JR C,$898D    ;
 $89AF LD HL,$0009   ; {entry's position+9 >= row? (lower bound)
 $89B2 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $89B3 LD E,(IX+$06) ;
 $89B6 LD D,(IX+$0C) ;
 $89B9 OR A          ;
 $89BA SBC HL,DE     ;
 $89BC JR C,$898D    ; }
 $89BE SCF           ;
 $89BF RET           ;
*$89C0 PUSH HL       ; {convert actor hit: HL(from check_collisions)->IX, set
 $89C1 POP IX        ; CY
 $89C3 SCF           ;
 $89C4 RET           ; }

; Check collision
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Test the player against the tower/hazards and apply the result.
; .
; Dispatches on player_state (#R$60C0):
; .
; 7 = invulnerable/idle -> no test (RET)
; .
; 4 = check a height window (#R$60BF in $0A..$1E)
; .
; 8 = RET else test flag $60C5.
; .
; Calls #R$895B (carry = hit).
; .
; On a hit it patches the value at #R$8A49 (SELF-MODIFYING: $14/$0F/$20 select
; the bump/death response used downstream) and branches into the hit handler.
@label=check_collision
c$89C5 LD A,($60C0)  ; A = player_state (#R$60C0)
 $89C8 CP $07        ;
 $89CA RET Z         ; state 7: no collision this frame
 $89CB CP $04        ;
 $89CD JR NZ,$89DB   ;
 $89CF LD A,($60BF)  ; A = #R$60BF (height-in-column)
 $89D2 CP $0A        ;
 $89D4 JR C,$89E4    ;
 $89D6 CP $1F        ;
 $89D8 JR NC,$89E4   ;
 $89DA RET           ;
*$89DB CP $08        ;
 $89DD RET Z         ;
 $89DE LD A,($60C5)  ;
 $89E1 OR A          ;
 $89E2 JR NZ,$8A26   ;
*$89E4 CALL $895B    ; Collision test
 $89E7 JR C,$8A01    ; hit -> hit handler
 $89E9 LD A,($60C0)  ; get Player state-machine state
 $89EC CP $06        ;
 $89EE RET NZ        ;
 $89EF LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $89F2 LD HL,($60BA) ;
 $89F5 CALL $9330    ; Check rotate collision
 $89F8 RET NC        ;
 $89F9 LD A,$14      ;
 $89FB LD ($8A49),A  ; patch response code at #R$8A49 = $14 (SELF-MOD)
 $89FE JP $8A17      ;
*$8A01 LD A,(IX+$30) ; A = colliding object state (+48)
 $8A04 LD B,$0F      ;
 $8A06 CP $07        ;
 $8A08 JR Z,$8A0C    ;
 $8A0A LD B,$14      ;
*$8A0C LD A,B        ;
 $8A0D LD ($8A49),A  ; patch response code ($0F enemy / $14 wall)
 $8A10 LD A,($60C0)  ; get Player state-machine state
 $8A13 CP $06        ;
 $8A15 JR NZ,$8A23   ;
*$8A17 LD A,($60BA)  ;
 $8A1A AND $03       ;
 $8A1C JR Z,$8A33    ;
 $8A1E LD HL,$60C5   ;
 $8A21 INC (HL)      ;
 $8A22 RET           ;
*$8A23 JP $8A4A      ; => Apply a hit
*$8A26 LD A,($60C0)  ; get Player state-machine state
 $8A29 CP $06        ;
 $8A2B JR NZ,$8A42   ;
 $8A2D LD A,($60BA)  ;
 $8A30 AND $03       ;
 $8A32 RET NZ        ;
*$8A33 CALL $9540    ; Check conveyor
 $8A36 CALL $A766    ;
 $8A39 JR NC,$8A3D   ;
 $8A3B LD (HL),$8D   ;
*$8A3D LD A,$FF      ;
 $8A3F LD ($6038),A  ; set Flag?? $00 $FE $FF
*$8A42 XOR A         ;
 $8A43 LD ($60C5),A  ;
 $8A46 JP $8A4A      ; => Apply a hit

; Unused
;
; .
;
; .
;
; SELF-MODIFIED scratch byte, not code: check_collision writes a response code
; here ($14 wall / $0F enemy) on a hit, and code_a871 reads it at $8A74 to pick
; the bump-vs-death branch.
@label=hit_response
s$8A49 DEFS $01

; Apply a hit (player invulnerable, sound)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$89C5.
;
; .
;
; Common "player got hit" handler, reached from check_collision's hit path.
; .
; Sets player_state=7 (invulnerable/frozen, matches check_collision's "state 7
; = no test" case), phase=0, game_state=0, calls $A72D with A=2 (life/damage
; counter update), plays sound 5 (hit sound).
@label=coll_apply
c$8A4A LD A,$07      ;
 $8A4C LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state
 $8A4F XOR A         ;
 $8A50 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $8A53 LD ($60D9),A  ; set Game state
 $8A56 LD A,$02      ;
 $8A58 CALL $A72D    ;
 $8A5B LD A,$05      ;
 $8A5D CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $8A60 RET           ;

; Data block at 8A61
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 16-byte signed-offset table used by code_8a71 to size the knockback step,
; indexed by (response_code>>1)&3.
@label=tbl_8a61
b$8A61 DEFB $03,$02,$01,$01,$01,$00,$00,$FF
 $8A69 DEFB $FE,$FE,$FD,$FD,$FD,$FD,$FD,$FC

; Bump/knockback handler
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Bump/knockback handler, dispatched from check_collision's hit path via the
; response code at hit_response (#R$8A49).
; .
; If the current animation phase equals the stored response code: "wall bump"
; branch ($8AB5) -- sets a sprite frame, subtracts 4 from the actor's column
; position (#R$60BA), and if that didn't go negative, re-checks via
; CHECK_ROTATE_COLLISION; no collision bounces back into pstate_play_cell1
; (#R$8590), otherwise (or on negative position) falls into the death handler
; at $8AD7.
; .
; If phase differs from the response code: "step" branch -- picks a sprite
; frame from table $871F (mirrored by facing), clamps the response code to $0F,
; looks up a signed delta from tbl_8a61 and applies it to the actor's column
; position; going negative also falls into $8AD7 (death), otherwise the
; position is masked/stored and phase increments.
@label=code_8a71
c$8A71 LD A,($60BF)    ; {A=phase; compare vs stored response code
 $8A74 LD HL,$8A49     ; (hit_response)
 $8A77 CP (HL)         ; }
 $8A78 JR Z,$8AB5      ;
 $8A7A LD C,A          ; {step branch: index sprite frame table $871F by
 $8A7B SRL A           ; (code>>1)&3
 $8A7D AND $03         ;
 $8A7F LD E,A          ;
 $8A80 LD D,$00        ;
 $8A82 LD HL,$871F     ;
 $8A85 ADD HL,DE       ;
 $8A86 LD A,($60BE)    ; }
 $8A89 OR (HL)         ;
 $8A8A LD ($60C1),A    ;
 $8A8D LD D,$00        ; {clamp response code to $0F for delta lookup
 $8A8F LD A,C          ;
 $8A90 CP $0F          ;
 $8A92 JR C,$8A96      ;
 $8A94 LD C,$0F        ; }
*$8A96 LD B,$00        ; {B=0; lookup signed delta from tbl_8a61
 $8A98 LD HL,$8A61     ;
 $8A9B ADD HL,BC       ;
 $8A9C LD A,(HL)       ;
 $8A9D OR A            ; }
 $8A9E JP P,$8AA2      ;
 $8AA1 DEC B           ;
*$8AA2 LD HL,$60BA     ; {apply delta to actor column (16-bit)
 $8AA5 ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $8AA6 LD (HL),A       ;
 $8AA7 LD A,B          ;
 $8AA8 INC HL          ;
 $8AA9 ADC A,(HL)      ; }
 $8AAA JP M,$8AD7      ; went negative -> death_handler
 $8AAD AND $03         ;
 $8AAF LD (HL),A       ;
 $8AB0 LD HL,$60BF     ;
 $8AB3 INC (HL)        ;
 $8AB4 RET             ;
*$8AB5 LD A,($60BE)    ; {bump branch: sprite frame from facing
 $8AB8 OR $00          ;
 $8ABA LD ($60C1),A    ; }
 $8ABD LD HL,($60BA)   ; {subtract 4 from actor column (wall bump)
 $8AC0 LD DE,$0004     ;
 $8AC3 OR A            ;
 $8AC4 SBC HL,DE       ;
 $8AC6 LD ($60BA),HL   ; }
 $8AC9 BIT 7,H         ; {negative -> death_handler
 $8ACB JR NZ,$8AD7     ; }
 $8ACD LD A,($60B9)    ; get Tower rotation position
 $8AD0 CALL $9330      ; Check rotate collision
 $8AD3 RET C           ;
 $8AD4 JP $8590        ; => Pstate play cell1
; Death processing: sets player_state=8 (pstate_8), phase=0, clears actor
; position (#R$60BA/$60BB), resets each of the 4 object_table actors' state
; field (+48: 7->0, else->4) and clears their +42 field, plays sound 6, falls
; straight into pstate_8.
@label=death_handler
*$8AD7 LD A,$08        ; death: state=8
 $8AD9 LD ($60C0),A    ; set Player state-machine state
 $8ADC XOR A           ;
 $8ADD LD ($60BF),A    ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $8AE0 LD ($60BA),A    ; {clear actor position (#R$60BA/$60BB)
 $8AE3 LD ($60BB),A    ; }
 $8AE6 LD IX,$605B     ; IX -> object_table, B=4
 $8AEA LD B,$04        ;
*$8AEC LD A,(IX+$30)   ; {reset each actor's state (7->0, else->4), clear phase
 $8AEF CP $00          ;
 $8AF1 JR Z,$8B05      ;
 $8AF3 CP $07          ;
 $8AF5 JR NZ,$8AFC     ;
 $8AF7 LD A,$00        ;
 $8AF9 JP $8AFE        ;
*$8AFC LD A,$04        ;
*$8AFE LD (IX+$30),A   ;
 $8B01 LD (IX+$2A),$00 ; }
*$8B05 INC IX          ; {next actor, loop
 $8B07 DJNZ $8AEC      ; }
 $8B09 LD A,$06        ;
 $8B0B CALL $A3DE      ; Play sound

; Pstate 8
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 8: death fall-off animation, entered from death_handler ($8AD7).
; .
; While phase<$18, sets sprite frame ($60C1) from phase>>2 and increments phase
; each call. Once phase>=$18, clears $60C2 and keeps counting.
; .
; At phase==$38 sets death_flag (#R$60C3)=1 -- this is the signal main_loop
; polls to trigger the life-loss handler.
@label=pstate_8

 $8B11 LD A,(HL)     ; }

 $8B14 JR NC,$8B1F   ;
 $8B16 SRL A         ;
 $8B18 SRL A         ; }

 $8B1D INC (HL)      ;
 $8B1E RET           ;
*$8B1F XOR A         ; {phase>=$18: clear $60C2, check phase==$38
 $8B20 LD ($60C2),A  ;
 $8B23 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8B24 CP $38        ;
 $8B26 JR Z,$8B2A    ; }
 $8B28 INC (HL)      ;
 $8B29 RET           ;
*$8B2A LD A,$01      ;
 $8B2C LD ($60C3),A  ; set Player died this frame
 $8B2F RET           ;

; Unused
s$8B30 DEFS $20

; Sprite setup
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8FC7.
;
; .
;
; Compute on-screen positions for the 4 actor sprites (objects 0..3) ahead of
; drawing.
; .
; Derives a buffer base from tower_height into #R$600A, fills two coordinate
; tables at #R$8B30/$8B40 (X and Y per sprite, via #R$8BEC/#R$8BFF), then per
; object copies sprite id (IX+18 -> IX+24) and stores the screen column (IX+30)
; from the angular position (IX+0).
; .
; Self-mod: #R$8B30/$8B40 are coordinate scratch buffers IN code.
@label=sprite_setup

 $8B56 AND $07         ;

 $8B5A SRL A           ;
 $8B5C RR L            ;
 $8B5E LD H,A          ;
 $8B5F LD DE,$6600     ; DE = $6600 sprite work buffer base
 $8B62 ADD HL,DE       ;
 $8B63 LD ($600A),HL   ; store buffer ptr -> #R$600A
 $8B66 LD HL,$8B30     ; fill X-coord table #R$8B30 (4 sprites, step 8)
 $8B69 LD A,$04        ;
*$8B6B PUSH AF         ;
 $8B6C CALL $8BEC      ; Col screen y
 $8B6F ADD A,$1E       ;
 $8B71 LD (HL),A       ;
 $8B72 INC HL          ;
 $8B73 POP AF          ;
 $8B74 ADD A,$08       ;
 $8B76 CP $84          ;
 $8B78 JR NZ,$8B6B     ;
 $8B7A LD HL,$8B40     ; fill Y-coord table $8B40 (4 sprites)
 $8B7D LD A,$04        ;
*$8B7F PUSH AF         ;
 $8B80 CALL $8BFF      ; Col screen x
 $8B83 LD (HL),A       ;
 $8B84 INC HL          ;
 $8B85 POP AF          ;
 $8B86 ADD A,$08       ;
 $8B88 CP $84          ;
 $8B8A JR NZ,$8B7F     ;
 $8B8C LD IX,$605B     ; IX -> object_table
 $8B90 LD B,$04        ;
*$8B92 PUSH BC         ;
 $8B93 LD A,(IX+$12)   ; back up sprite id (IX+18 -> IX+24)
 $8B96 LD (IX+$18),A   ;
 $8B99 LD A,(IX+$30)   ;
 $8B9C CP $00          ; state 0 (inactive) -> skip
 $8B9E JR Z,$8BD5      ;
 $8BA0 CP $07          ;
 $8BA2 LD A,$40        ; state 7 -> fixed screen col $40
 $8BA4 JR Z,$8BAC      ;
 $8BA6 LD A,(IX+$00)   ;
 $8BA9 CALL $8BFF      ; Col screen x
*$8BAC LD (IX+$1E),A   ; store sprite screen column (IX+30)
 $8BAF LD L,(IX+$06)   ;
 $8BB2 LD H,(IX+$0C)   ;
 $8BB5 LD DE,($6057)   ;
 $8BB9 OR A            ;
 $8BBA PUSH HL         ;
 $8BBB SBC HL,DE       ;
 $8BBD POP HL          ;
 $8BBE JR C,$8BDF      ;
 $8BC0 LD DE,($6059)   ;
 $8BC4 OR A            ;
 $8BC5 SBC HL,DE       ;
 $8BC7 JR NC,$8BD5     ;
 $8BC9 LD A,(IX+$30)   ;
 $8BCC CP $07          ;
 $8BCE JR Z,$8BD9      ;
 $8BD0 CALL $8CC2      ; Calc sprite shift
 $8BD3 JR NC,$8BD9     ;
*$8BD5 LD (IX+$18),$FF ;
*$8BD9 POP BC          ;
 $8BDA INC IX          ;
 $8BDC DJNZ $8B92      ;

*$8BDF LD A,(IX+$30)   ;
 $8BE2 CP $07          ;
 $8BE4 JR Z,$8BD5      ;
 $8BE6 LD (IX+$30),$00 ;
 $8BEA JR $8BD5        ;

; Col screen y
;
; Used by the routines at #R$8B50 and #R$8CC2.
;
; .
;
; Map an actor's angular column to its screen Y / vertical-projection value.
; .
; In: A = angular position (0..127).
; .
; Offsets by the tower rotation: rel = (A + $20 - tower_height) & $7F, then
; returns col_y_table[#R$6380 + rel].
; .
; Out: A = projected value.
; .
; Preserves HL (PUSH/POP).
@label=col_screen_y
c$8BEC PUSH HL       ;
 $8BED ADD A,$20     ; bias by +$20 (quarter turn)
 $8BEF LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $8BF2 SUB (HL)      ; subtract current tower rotation
 $8BF3 AND $7F       ; wrap to 0..127 (around the tower)
 $8BF5 LD E,A        ;
 $8BF6 LD D,$00      ;
 $8BF8 LD HL,$6380   ; HL -> col_y_table (#R$6380)
 $8BFB ADD HL,DE     ;
 $8BFC LD A,(HL)     ; A = table[rel] = projected Y/value
 $8BFD POP HL        ;
 $8BFE RET           ;

; Col screen x
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8B50.
;
; .
;
; Map an actor's angular column to a screen X column, folding the cylinder so
; only the front face shows.
; .
; In: A = angular position (0..127).
; .
; rel = (A + $20 - tower_height) & $7F, then fold: rel < $20        -> rel +
; $20      (left quadrant) $20..$5F         -> $60 - rel      (front, mirrored)
; rel >= $60       -> rel - $60      (right quadrant) Out: A = screen column.
; .
; Preserves HL.
@label=col_screen_x
c$8BFF PUSH HL       ;
 $8C00 ADD A,$20     ; bias +$20
 $8C02 LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $8C05 SUB (HL)      ; subtract tower rotation
 $8C06 AND $7F       ; wrap to 0..127
 $8C08 CP $20        ; left quadrant?
 $8C0A JR NC,$8C10   ;
 $8C0C ADD A,$20     ; -> rel + $20
 $8C0E JR $8C1C      ;
*$8C10 CP $60        ; back face?
 $8C12 JR C,$8C18    ;
 $8C14 SUB $60       ; -> rel - $60 (right quadrant)
 $8C16 JR $8C1C      ;
*$8C18 LD H,A        ;
 $8C19 LD A,$60      ;
 $8C1B SUB H         ; front: mirror $60 - rel
*$8C1C POP HL        ;
 $8C1D RET           ;

; Sprite shift masks
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 1bpp AND/shift mask data for drawing the tower-column sprites at sub-byte X
; offsets (patterns 3F/0F/03/00 FF...).
; .
; Base referenced from $8D35/$8F5E.
; .
; Interleaved with a few SELF-MODIFIED 1-byte slots
; ($8C76/$8C77/$8C78/$8C81/$8C82/$8C83/ $8C85) that calc_sprite_shift patches
; with computed shift counts.
; .
; Spans #R$8C1E..$8CC1 code resumes at calc_sprite_shift.
@label=sprite_shift_masks
b$8C1E DEFB $FF,$FF,$FC,$FF,$FF,$F0,$FF,$FF
 $8C26 DEFB $C0,$FF,$FF,$00,$FF,$FC,$00,$FF
 $8C2E DEFB $F0,$00,$FF,$C0,$00,$FF,$00,$00
 $8C36 DEFB $FC,$00,$00,$F0,$00,$00,$C0,$00
 $8C3E DEFB $00,$3F,$FF,$FF,$0F,$FF,$FF,$03
 $8C46 DEFB $FF,$FF,$00,$FF,$FF,$00,$3F,$FF
 $8C4E DEFB $00,$0F,$FF,$00,$03,$FF,$00,$00
 $8C56 DEFB $FF,$00,$00,$3F,$00,$00,$0F,$00
 $8C5E DEFB $00,$03,$C0,$03,$FF,$F0,$00,$FF
 $8C66 DEFB $FC,$00,$3F,$FF,$00,$0F,$FF,$C0
 $8C6E DEFB $03,$C0,$00,$03,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8C76 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$08,$02,$06,$04
 $8C7E DEFB $04,$06,$02,$00,$00,$00,$00,$FF
 $8C86 DEFB $FF,$FF,$03,$03,$03,$07,$07,$07
 $8C8E DEFB $07,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8C96 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8C9E DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8CA6 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8CAE DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $8CB6 DEFB $00,$00,$12,$12,$12,$0E,$0E,$0E
 $8CBE DEFB $0E,$FF,$FF,$FF

; Calc sprite shift
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8B50.
;
; .
;
; For the actor at IX, compute its screen row (via col_screen_y) and the
; horizontal sub-byte shift, and patch the shift counts into the self-mod slots
; above ($8C76/77/ 81).
; .
; Reads the column buffer (#R$600A) to skip empty/edge columns ($0F/$0E
; sentinels).
; .
; Called from sprite_setup ($8BD0).
@label=calc_sprite_shift
c$8CC2 LD A,(IX+$00)  ; A = actor angular pos (IX+0)
 $8CC5 CALL $8BEC     ; Col screen y
 $8CC8 ADD A,$1E      ; {A += $1E+$02, mask $FC (row baseline, 4-aligned)
 $8CCA ADD A,$02      ;
 $8CCC AND $FC        ; }
 $8CCE LD ($8C81),A   ; patch self-mod slot $8C81 (row)
 $8CD1 LD HL,($600A)  ; HL -> column buffer (#R$600A)
 $8CD4 ADD HL,DE      ; {HL += DE; A = column buffer entry
 $8CD5 LD A,(HL)      ; }
 $8CD6 CP $0F         ; $0F = empty column -> skip (RET)
 $8CD8 RET Z          ; {$0E = edge column (inverted match) -> RET; B = column
 $8CD9 CP $0E         ; entry
 $8CDB CCF            ;
 $8CDC RET Z          ;
 $8CDD LD B,A         ; }
 $8CDE LD A,($60B9)   ; A = tower_height (rotation)
 $8CE1 SUB $1D        ; {rotation -= $1D, mask $7F
 $8CE3 AND $7F        ; }
 $8CE5 SRL A          ; /8 -> byte-column shift
 $8CE7 SRL A          ; {continue /8 shift; C = byte-column shift
 $8CE9 SRL A          ;
 $8CEB LD C,A         ; }
 $8CEC ADD A,B        ; {shift += column entry, mask to nibble
 $8CED AND $0F        ; }
 $8CEF LD ($8C77),A   ; patch shift count slot $8C77
 $8CF2 LD B,A         ; {second /16 shift; += C, mask to nibble (other slot)
 $8CF3 SRL A          ;
 $8CF5 SRL A          ;
 $8CF7 SRL A          ;
 $8CF9 SRL A          ;
 $8CFB ADD A,C        ;
 $8CFC AND $0F        ; }
 $8CFE LD ($8C76),A   ; patch shift count slot $8C76
 $8D01 LD HL,$FFFF    ; {clear 5 pending-sprite slots ($600C-$6013); reset draw
 $8D04 LD ($600C),HL  ; counter $8C78; reload A = angular pos
 $8D07 LD ($600E),HL  ;
 $8D0A LD ($6010),HL  ;
 $8D0D LD ($6012),HL  ;
 $8D10 LD ($6013),HL  ;
 $8D13 XOR A          ;
 $8D14 LD ($8C78),A   ;
 $8D17 LD A,(IX+$00)  ; }
 $8D1A CALL $8BEC     ; Col screen y
 $8D1D BIT 6,E        ; edge-flag bit test
 $8D1F LD ($8C83),A   ;
 $8D22 JR Z,$8D5D     ; JR Z -> skip special masking (edge flag clear)
 $8D24 ADD A,$1E      ; A += $1E (masked-column table index)
 $8D26 LD E,A         ;
 $8D27 LD D,$00       ;
 $8D29 LD HL,$8C85    ;
 $8D2C ADD HL,DE      ;
 $8D2D LD A,(HL)      ; {A = column entry; CP $FF; JR Z -> skip (no masked
 $8D2E CP $FF         ; column)
 $8D30 JR Z,$8D5D     ; }
 $8D32 ADD A,A        ; {E = entry*3 (mask-triple byte index)
 $8D33 ADD A,(HL)     ;
 $8D34 LD E,A         ; }
 $8D35 LD HL,$8C1E    ; {HL = sprite_shift_masks + E
 $8D38 ADD HL,DE      ; }
 $8D39 LD A,(HL)      ; mask byte 1 -> broadcast to $600C/$600F/$6012
 $8D3A INC HL         ;
 $8D3B LD ($600C),A   ;
 $8D3E LD ($600F),A   ;
 $8D41 LD ($6012),A   ;
 $8D44 LD A,(HL)      ; mask byte 2 -> broadcast to $600D/$6010/$6013
 $8D45 INC HL         ;
 $8D46 LD ($600D),A   ;
 $8D49 LD ($6010),A   ;
 $8D4C LD ($6013),A   ;
 $8D4F LD A,(HL)      ; mask byte 3 -> broadcast to $600E/$6011/$6014
 $8D50 LD ($600E),A   ;
 $8D53 LD ($6011),A   ;
 $8D56 LD ($6014),A   ;
 $8D59 LD HL,$8C78    ; {bump draw counter $8C78
 $8D5C INC (HL)       ; }
*$8D5D LD A,(IX+$06)  ; {A = facing (IX+6) & 3 -> shift-count slot $8C82
 $8D60 AND $03        ;
 $8D62 LD ($8C82),A   ; }
 $8D65 LD L,(IX+$06)  ; {B/A = per-half sub-byte shift counts (IX fields +
 $8D68 LD A,(IX+$0C)  ; self-mod slots)
 $8D6B RRA            ;
 $8D6C RR L           ;
 $8D6E RRA            ;
 $8D6F RR L           ;
 $8D71 LD A,($8C77)   ;
 $8D74 LD B,A         ;
 $8D75 LD A,($8C76)   ; }
*$8D78 PUSH AF        ; {push loop state (AF,BC,HL)
 $8D79 PUSH BC        ;
 $8D7A PUSH HL        ; }
 $8D7B CALL $8EF1     ; Calc sprite col
 $8D7E POP HL         ; {pop loop state back
 $8D7F POP BC         ;
 $8D80 POP AF         ; }
 $8D81 INC A          ; {column += 1, mask nibble; loop until == B (4 columns)
 $8D82 AND $0F        ;
 $8D84 CP B           ;
 $8D85 JR NZ,$8D78    ; }
 $8D87 LD A,($8C78)   ; {nothing drawn ($8C78==0)? -> RET
 $8D8A OR A           ;
 $8D8B RET Z          ; }
 $8D8C PUSH IX        ; {DE = IX (actor pointer)
 $8D8E POP DE         ; }
 $8D8F LD A,($8C83)   ; {fraction = facing($8C83)+$3C &3 + (IX+$12)
 $8D92 ADD A,$3C      ;
 $8D94 AND $03        ;
 $8D96 ADD A,(IX+$12) ; }
 $8D99 PUSH AF        ; {A = fraction - $5B + $7C; store IX+$18 (sub-column)
 $8D9A LD A,E         ;
 $8D9B SUB $5B        ;
 $8D9D ADD A,$7C      ;
 $8D9F LD (IX+$18),A  ; }
 $8DA2 SUB $7C        ; {sprite id -= $7C; *24 (table offset)
 $8DA4 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DA5 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DA6 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DA7 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DA8 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DA9 LD L,A         ;
 $8DAA ADD A,A        ;
 $8DAB ADD A,L        ;
 $8DAC LD L,A         ; }
 $8DAD LD H,$00       ; {H = high byte, +1 on carry
 $8DAF JR NC,$8DB2    ;
 $8DB1 INC H          ; }
*$8DB2 LD DE,$BC80    ; {HL = $BC80 + offset (fixed runtime sprite entry)
 $8DB5 ADD HL,DE      ; }
 $8DB6 POP AF         ; {push HL; call $A784
 $8DB7 PUSH HL        ;
 $8DB8 CALL $A784     ; }
 $8DBB POP DE         ; {C == 2? else -> patch_expand_masks
 $8DBC LD A,C         ;
 $8DBD CP $02         ;
 $8DBF JP NZ,$8E48    ; }
 $8DC2 LD A,($8C82)   ; {BC = pointer-table entry for shift-count slot
 $8DC5 ADD A,A        ;
 $8DC6 ADD A,$79      ;
 $8DC8 LD C,A         ;
 $8DC9 LD A,$8C       ;
 $8DCB ADC A,$00      ;
 $8DCD LD B,A         ; }
 $8DCE LD A,(BC)      ; {fetch routine-pointer pair; self-mod into $8DF2/$8E24
 $8DCF LD ($8DF2),A   ;
 $8DD2 INC BC         ;
 $8DD3 LD A,(BC)      ;
 $8DD4 LD ($8E24),A   ; }
 $8DD7 LD A,($8C82)   ; {shift-count zero? -> skip first mask triple
 $8DDA OR A           ;
 $8DDB JR Z,$8DF6     ; }
 $8DDD LD A,($600C)   ; {copy $600C/$600D into expand_sprite_a operands (+CPL
 $8DE0 LD ($8E2D),A   ; for AND)
 $8DE3 CPL            ;
 $8DE4 LD ($8E27),A   ;
 $8DE7 LD A,($600D)   ;
 $8DEA LD ($8E39),A   ;
 $8DED CPL            ;
 $8DEE LD ($8E33),A   ; }
 $8DF1 LD B,$00       ; B = 0 (loop 2 mask bytes)
 $8DF3 CALL $8E25     ; Expand sprite a
*$8DF6 LD A,($600F)   ; {second mask triple: copy $600F/$6010 (skipped-case
 $8DF9 LD ($8E2D),A   ; entry)
 $8DFC CPL            ;
 $8DFD LD ($8E27),A   ;
 $8E00 LD A,($6010)   ;
 $8E03 LD ($8E39),A   ;
 $8E06 CPL            ;
 $8E07 LD ($8E33),A   ; }
 $8E0A LD B,$08       ; B = 8 (loop count, second strip)
 $8E0C CALL $8E25     ; Expand sprite a
 $8E0F LD A,($6012)   ;
 $8E12 LD ($8E2D),A   ;
 $8E15 CPL            ;
 $8E16 LD ($8E27),A   ;
 $8E19 LD A,($6013)   ;
 $8E1C LD ($8E39),A   ;
 $8E1F CPL            ;
 $8E20 LD ($8E33),A   ;
 $8E23 LD B,$00       ;

; Expand sprite a
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8CC2.
;
; .
;
; Unrolled copy of a sprite/mask definition from (HL) to (DE), terminated by
; $FF.
; .
; The alternating OR $00 / AND $00 immediates are SELF-MODIFIED (by
; calc_sprite_shift) to apply the per-column shift mask.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=expand_sprite_a
c$8E25 LD A,(HL)     ; A = source byte (HL)
 $8E26 OR $00        ; self-mod OR mask (set by calc_sprite_shift)
 $8E28 LD (DE),A     ; store merged byte, advance dest
 $8E29 INC HL        ;
 $8E2A INC DE        ;
 $8E2B LD A,(HL)     ; A = next source byte
 $8E2C AND $00       ; self-mod AND mask (set by calc_sprite_shift)
 $8E2E LD (DE),A     ;
 $8E2F INC HL        ;
 $8E30 INC DE        ;
 $8E31 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8E32 OR $00        ;
 $8E34 LD (DE),A     ;
 $8E35 INC HL        ;
 $8E36 INC DE        ;
 $8E37 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8E38 AND $00       ;
 $8E3A LD (DE),A     ;
 $8E3B INC HL        ;
 $8E3C INC DE        ;
 $8E3D LD A,$FF      ; A = $FF (terminator byte)
 $8E3F LD (DE),A     ; store terminator, advance dest
 $8E40 INC DE        ;
 $8E41 INC A         ; A += 1 (second terminator byte)
 $8E42 LD (DE),A     ;
 $8E43 INC DE        ;
 $8E44 DJNZ $8E25    ; loop 4 columns
 $8E46 OR A          ;
 $8E47 RET           ;
; Entry point used by calc_sprite_shift, not by expand_sprite_a's own DJNZ
; loop.
; .
; Reads the self-mod shift-count slot ($8C82) to index a 2-byte pair from table
; $8C79 (shift*2), storing it into the loop-count operands of the first/third
; strip's "LD B,nn" at $8E81/$8EC7 (operand bytes $8E82/$8EC8) -- CORRECTION:
; these are NOT routine pointers or mask operands, they are the row counts for
; the two edge strips. Confirmed by emulation: for every shift value 0-3,
; (first-strip-count + third-strip-count) == 8, and combined with the
; always-8-row middle strip, TOTAL decoded height is a shift-INVARIANT 16 rows.
; When the shift-count slot is 0, the first strip is skipped entirely (JR
; Z,$8E86) and its row count (0) is moot.
; .
; Then, per 8-pixel strip, copies 3 source mask bytes ($600C/$600D/$600E or
; $600F/$6010/$6011 or $6012/$6013/$6014, selected by the same shift-count
; test) straight into expand_sprite_b's real OR-immediate operands
; ($8ECB/$8ED7/$8EE3), and their bitwise complement (CPL) into the paired
; AND-immediate operands ($8ED1/$8EDD/$8EE9) -- so expand_sprite_b ORs in the
; new sprite bits and ANDs out the old ones at the right sub-byte shift, then
; calls expand_sprite_b.
; .
; See gfx_c1f6 (#R$C1F6) for the full sprite-bitmap decode writeup (this
; self-modifying pipeline is why the bitmap can't be rendered as a raw UDG
; array image).
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC.
@label=patch_expand_masks
*$8E48 LD A,($8C82)  ; A = shift-count slot ($8C82)
 $8E4B ADD A,A       ; {index a 2-byte routine-pointer pair
 $8E4C ADD A,$79     ;
 $8E4E LD C,A        ; }
 $8E4F LD A,$8C      ;
 $8E51 ADC A,$00     ;
 $8E53 LD B,A        ;
 $8E54 LD A,(BC)     ; fetch first pointer byte
 $8E55 LD ($8E82),A  ; self-mod store: expand_sprite_b OR operand
 $8E58 INC BC        ;
 $8E59 LD A,(BC)     ; fetch second pointer byte
 $8E5A LD ($8EC8),A  ; self-mod store: expand_sprite_b AND operand
 $8E5D LD A,($8C82)  ; re-test shift-count slot
 $8E60 OR A          ;
 $8E61 JR Z,$8E86    ; zero? -> skip first mask triple
 $8E63 LD A,($600C)  ; A = mask byte 1 ($600C)
 $8E66 LD ($8ED1),A  ; self-mod store: OR operand
 $8E69 CPL           ; complement for AND operand
 $8E6A LD ($8ECB),A  ; self-mod store: AND operand
 $8E6D LD A,($600D)  ;
 $8E70 LD ($8EDD),A  ;
 $8E73 CPL           ;
 $8E74 LD ($8ED7),A  ;
 $8E77 LD A,($600E)  ;
 $8E7A LD ($8EE9),A  ;
 $8E7D CPL           ;
 $8E7E LD ($8EE3),A  ;
 $8E81 LD B,$00      ; B = 0 (loop count for this strip)
 $8E83 CALL $8EC9    ; Expand sprite b
*$8E86 LD A,($600F)  ;
 $8E89 LD ($8ED1),A  ;
 $8E8C CPL           ;
 $8E8D LD ($8ECB),A  ;
 $8E90 LD A,($6010)  ;
 $8E93 LD ($8EDD),A  ;
 $8E96 CPL           ;
 $8E97 LD ($8ED7),A  ;
 $8E9A LD A,($6011)  ;
 $8E9D LD ($8EE9),A  ;
 $8EA0 CPL           ;
 $8EA1 LD ($8EE3),A  ;
 $8EA4 LD B,$08      ; B = $08 (loop count for this strip)
 $8EA6 CALL $8EC9    ; Expand sprite b
 $8EA9 LD A,($6012)  ;
 $8EAC LD ($8ED1),A  ;
 $8EAF CPL           ;
 $8EB0 LD ($8ECB),A  ;
 $8EB3 LD A,($6013)  ;
 $8EB6 LD ($8EDD),A  ;
 $8EB9 CPL           ;
 $8EBA LD ($8ED7),A  ;
 $8EBD LD A,($6014)  ;
 $8EC0 LD ($8EE9),A  ;
 $8EC3 CPL           ;
 $8EC4 LD ($8EE3),A  ;
 $8EC7 LD B,$00      ; B = 0 (loop count for final strip)

; Expand sprite b
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8E25.
;
; .
;
; Same unrolled-copy shape as expand_sprite_a, but its OR/AND immediate
; operands are self-modified by patch_expand_masks ($8E48) rather than
; calc_sprite_shift directly -- used for the shift-boundary case where 3 source
; mask bytes (not 2) are needed per strip.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=expand_sprite_b
c$8EC9 LD A,(HL)     ; A = source byte (HL)
 $8ECA OR $00        ; self-mod OR mask (set by patch_expand_masks)
 $8ECC LD (DE),A     ; store merged byte, advance dest
 $8ECD INC HL        ;
 $8ECE INC DE        ;
 $8ECF LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8ED0 AND $00       ;
 $8ED2 LD (DE),A     ;
 $8ED3 INC HL        ;
 $8ED4 INC DE        ;
 $8ED5 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8ED6 OR $00        ;
 $8ED8 LD (DE),A     ;
 $8ED9 INC HL        ;
 $8EDA INC DE        ;
 $8EDB LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8EDC AND $00       ;
 $8EDE LD (DE),A     ;
 $8EDF INC HL        ;
 $8EE0 INC DE        ;
 $8EE1 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8EE2 OR $00        ;
 $8EE4 LD (DE),A     ;
 $8EE5 INC HL        ;
 $8EE6 INC DE        ;
 $8EE7 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $8EE8 AND $00       ;
 $8EEA LD (DE),A     ;
 $8EEB INC HL        ;
 $8EEC INC DE        ;
 $8EED DJNZ $8EC9    ; loop 3 mask bytes
 $8EEF OR A          ; {restore flags, RET
 $8EF0 RET           ; }

; Calc sprite col
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8CC2.
;
; A actor's screen column
;
; Looks up an actor's screen-column clip value in table #R$8B30 and, if the
; column is beyond the actor's clip field (IX+$1E), draws up to 3 tower-cell
; mask columns (#R$8F31) at screen offsets $6012/$600F/$600C, with the 3rd
; gated on ($8C82) != 0.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=calc_sprite_col
c$8EF1 LD E,A        ; {E=A; H=$F0+A (table1 row); D=0
 $8EF2 ADD A,$F0     ;
 $8EF4 LD H,A        ;
 $8EF5 LD D,$00      ;
 $8EF7 PUSH HL       ;
 $8EF8 LD HL,$8B30   ;
 $8EFB ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $8EFC LD A,(HL)     ; {read table1[A] entry; advance HL to table2 (+$10)
 $8EFD LD DE,$0010   ;
 $8F00 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $8F01 LD E,A        ;
 $8F02 LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $8F03 CP (IX+$1E)   ; {clip = table2 entry; if actor's column < clip -> RET
 $8F06 JR NC,$8F0A   ; (still visible, skip masking)
 $8F08 POP HL        ;
 $8F09 RET           ; }
*$8F0A LD A,E        ; {shift E = column - shift_slot($8C81) + $0B; RET M if
 $8F0B LD HL,$8C81   ; negative
 $8F0E SUB (HL)      ;
 $8F0F ADD A,$0B     ;
 $8F11 POP HL        ;
 $8F12 RET M         ; }
 $8F13 CP $16        ; {clamp E < $16 (22); save DE
 $8F15 RET NC        ;
 $8F16 LD E,A        ;
 $8F17 PUSH DE       ; }
 $8F18 LD BC,$6012   ; BC = $6012 (cell 1)
 $8F1B CALL $8F31    ; Draw tower cell
 $8F1E INC L         ; {advance sub-position, BC = $600F (cell 2)
 $8F1F POP DE        ;
 $8F20 PUSH DE       ;
 $8F21 LD BC,$600F   ; }
 $8F24 CALL $8F31    ; Draw tower cell
 $8F27 INC L         ; {advance, BC = $600C; gate 3rd draw on ($8C82)!=0
 $8F28 POP DE        ;
 $8F29 LD A,($8C82)  ;
 $8F2C OR A          ;
 $8F2D RET Z         ;
 $8F2E LD BC,$600C   ; }

; Draw tower cell
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8EF1.
;
; .
;
; Decode one tower map cell byte at (HL) -- full bitfield format documented in
; docs/Level-Format.md (bit7=occupied, bits0-1=type, bits4-5=subtype).
; .
; Bit7 clear (unoccupied) or type==3 (invalid combo here) -> RET, nothing
; drawn. Otherwise type bit0 selects one of three offset tables (bit0==0 ->
; tbl_cell_offsets_c $8FA1 bit0==1 and bits2-3==0 -> tbl_cell_offsets_a #R$8F75
; bit0==1 and bits2-3!=0 -> tbl_cell_offsets_b $8F8B).
; .
; The chosen table is indexed by DE (caller-supplied sub-position, not part of
; the cell byte) negative entries ($FF) mean nothing to draw at that
; sub-position.
; .
; A non-negative entry is *3 and indexes sprite_shift_masks (#R$8C1E) for 3
; AND-mask bytes, ANDed into 3 destination screen bytes at (BC) to punch out
; the feature's silhouette. Bumps a self-mod counter at $8C78 on every
; successful draw.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL,...
@label=draw_tower_cell
c$8F31 PUSH HL       ;
 $8F32 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = cell byte; bit7 clear (unoccupied) -> RET
 $8F33 OR A          ;
 $8F34 JP P,$8F73    ; }
 $8F37 LD H,A        ; {H = cell byte; isolate type bits0-1
 $8F38 AND $03       ; }
 $8F3A CP $03        ; {type==3 (invalid/no-render)? -> RET
 $8F3C JR Z,$8F73    ; }
 $8F3E SRL A         ; {test type bit0
 $8F40 JR NC,$8F51   ; }
 $8F42 LD A,H        ; {reload cell byte, isolate bits2-3
 $8F43 AND $0C       ; }
 $8F45 JR Z,$8F4C    ; bits2-3==0 -> table_a
 $8F47 LD HL,$8F8B   ; {else -> table_b ($8F8B)
 $8F4A JR $8F54      ; }
*$8F4C LD HL,$8F75   ; {table_a (#R$8F75)
 $8F4F JR $8F54      ; }
*$8F51 LD HL,$8FA1   ; bit0==0 -> table_c ($8FA1)
*$8F54 ADD HL,DE     ; HL += DE (sub-position index)
 $8F55 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = table[DE]; negative -> RET (nothing here)
 $8F56 OR A          ;
 $8F57 JP M,$8F73    ; }
 $8F5A LD E,A        ; {index = A*3 into sprite_shift_masks
 $8F5B ADD A,A       ;
 $8F5C ADD A,E       ;
 $8F5D LD E,A        ; }
 $8F5E LD HL,$8C1E   ; {HL -> sprite_shift_masks[index]
 $8F61 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $8F62 LD A,(BC)     ; {AND-mask 3 destination bytes at (BC)
 $8F63 AND (HL)      ;
 $8F64 LD (BC),A     ;
 $8F65 INC BC        ;
 $8F66 INC HL        ;
 $8F67 LD A,(BC)     ;
 $8F68 AND (HL)      ;
 $8F69 LD (BC),A     ;
 $8F6A INC BC        ;
 $8F6B INC HL        ;
 $8F6C LD A,(BC)     ;
 $8F6D AND (HL)      ;
 $8F6E LD (BC),A     ; }
 $8F6F LD HL,$8C78   ; {bump feature-drawn counter ($8C78)
 $8F72 INC (HL)      ; }
*$8F73 POP HL        ;
 $8F74 RET           ;

; Data block at 8F75
;
; .
;
; .
;
; First of three sibling offset tables (#R$8F75/$8F8B/$8FA1), selected by
; draw_tower_cell on the cell descriptor's bits 2-3, then indexed by DE (low
; descriptor bits) to get an offset into sprite_shift_masks (#R$8C1E).
@label=tbl_cell_offsets_a
b$8F75 DEFB $0B,$0C,$0D,$0E,$0F,$10,$11,$12
 $8F7D DEFB $13,$14,$15,$1C,$0A,$09,$08,$07
 $8F85 DEFB $06,$05,$04,$03,$02,$01,$FF,$0B
 $8F8D DEFB $0C,$0D,$0E,$0F,$10,$11,$12,$13
 $8F95 DEFB $14,$1B,$09,$08,$07,$06,$05,$04
 $8F9D DEFB $03,$02,$01,$00,$FF,$FF,$FF,$0B
 $8FA5 DEFB $0C,$0D,$0E,$0F,$10,$16,$17,$18
 $8FAD DEFB $19,$1A,$05,$04,$03,$02,$01,$00
 $8FB5 DEFB $FF,$FF

; Clear actor states
;
; Used by the routine at #R$81D7.
;
; .
;
; Zero the state byte (+48) of all four object_table actors, deactivating every
; enemy.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,IX.
@label=clear_actor_states
c$8FB7 LD IX,$605B   ;
 $8FBB LD A,$00      ;
 $8FBD LD B,$04      ;
*$8FBF LD (IX+$30),A ;
 $8FC2 INC IX        ;
 $8FC4 DJNZ $8FBF    ;
 $8FC6 RET           ;

; Draw player
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Compute the player sprite's on-screen address from the vertical scroll
; (#R$6030) and draw it.
; .
; Handles the tower wrap: the playfield scrolls vertically mod the tower
; height, so the screen row is (#R$6030 +/- offset) kept in range.
; .
; Stores the two derived screen pointers ($6057, $6059) then calls the blit
; helpers (#R$8B50, #R$9035).
; .
; In: #R$6030 = scroll position.
; .
; Out: player drawn.
; .
; Clobbers A,HL.
@label=draw_player
c$8FC7 LD HL,($6030) ; HL = scroll position (#R$6030)
 $8FCA LD A,L        ;
 $8FCB SUB $08       ; - 8 (sprite top offset)
 $8FCD LD L,A        ;
 $8FCE LD A,H        ;
 $8FCF SBC A,$00     ;
 $8FD1 AND $03       ; keep within the 3 screen-thirds (mod via AND 3)
 $8FD3 LD H,A        ;
 $8FD4 CP $03        ; past the wrap point ($3D0)?
 $8FD6 JR NZ,$8FE0   ;
 $8FD8 LD A,L        ;
 $8FD9 CP $D0        ;
 $8FDB JR C,$8FE0    ;
 $8FDD LD HL,$0000   ; -> clamp to top (0)
*$8FE0 LD ($6057),HL ; store upper screen pointer ($6057)
 $8FE3 LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $8FE6 LD A,L        ;
 $8FE7 ADD A,$4D     ; + $4D (sprite body offset)
 $8FE9 LD L,A        ;
 $8FEA LD A,H        ;
 $8FEB ADC A,$00     ;
 $8FED AND $03       ;
 $8FEF LD H,A        ;
 $8FF0 LD ($6059),HL ; store lower screen pointer ($6059)
 $8FF3 CALL $8B50    ; Sprite setup
 $8FF6 CALL $9035    ; Sprite depth sort
 $8FF9 RET           ;

; Draw actors sorted
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Draw the 4 actors back-to-front: for depth key C=3..0, find the object whose
; field (+36) matches and draw it via draw_actor.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,IX.
@label=draw_actors_sorted
c$8FFA LD C,$03      ; C = 3 (starting depth key, back-most)
*$8FFC LD IX,$605B   ; {IX -> object_table, B = 4 slots
 $9000 LD B,$04      ;
 $9002 LD A,C        ; }
*$9003 CP (IX+$24)   ; {match this slot's draw-order field (+36)? draw it
 $9006 JR Z,$9012    ;
 $9008 INC IX        ; }
 $900A DJNZ $9003    ;
*$900C DEC C         ; {next depth key; done all 4? -> player tail
 $900D JP P,$8FFC    ;
 $9010 JR $9019      ; }
*$9012 PUSH BC       ;
 $9013 CALL $A78A    ;
 $9016 POP BC        ;
 $9017 JR $900C      ;
*$9019 LD IX,$605F   ; {player actor: skip if inactive (phase==$FF)
 $901D LD A,(IX+$2A) ;
 $9020 CP $FF        ; }
 $9022 RET Z         ;
 $9023 LD A,(IX+$12) ;
 $9026 ADD A,$4A     ;
 $9028 LD (IX+$18),A ;
 $902B CALL $A78A    ;
 $902E LD A,($60A6)  ;
 $9031 LD ($60A5),A  ;
 $9034 RET           ;

; Sprite depth sort
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8FC7.
;
; .
;
; Decide the back-to-front draw order of the 4 actor sprites so nearer ones
; overdraw farther ones around the tower.
; .
; Does all 6 pairwise comparisons of the sprites' screen columns
; (IX+30..IX+33), packing the results into 6 bits of B, XORs $3F, and uses that
; as an index into data_908e -- a precomputed table mapping each comparison
; outcome to a draw permutation.
; .
; The 4 order indices are unpacked (2 bits each) into IX+36..IX+39.
; .
; TRI
@label=sprite_depth_sort
c$9035 LD IX,$605B   ; IX -> object_table
 $9039 LD B,$00      ;
 $903B LD A,(IX+$1E) ; compare sprite0 col vs sprite1..3
 $903E CP (IX+$1F)   ;
 $9041 RL B          ; shift compare result into key (RL B)
 $9043 CP (IX+$20)   ;
 $9046 RL B          ;
 $9048 CP (IX+$21)   ;
 $904B RL B          ;
 $904D LD A,(IX+$1F) ;
 $9050 CP (IX+$20)   ;
 $9053 RL B          ;
 $9055 CP (IX+$21)   ;
 $9058 RL B          ;
 $905A LD A,(IX+$20) ;
 $905D CP (IX+$21)   ;
 $9060 RL B          ;
 $9062 LD A,B        ; A = packed 6-bit comparison key
 $9063 XOR $3F       ; invert (XOR $3F) to index orientation
 $9065 LD C,A        ;
 $9066 LD B,$00      ;
 $9068 LD HL,$908E   ; HL -> data_908e[key]
 $906B ADD HL,BC     ;
 $906C LD B,(HL)     ; B = packed draw order (4 x 2-bit indices)
 $906D LD A,B        ;
 $906E AND $03       ;
 $9070 LD (IX+$27),A ; unpack order[0] -> IX+39
 $9073 LD A,B        ;
 $9074 RRA           ;
 $9075 RRA           ;
 $9076 LD B,A        ;
 $9077 AND $03       ;
 $9079 LD (IX+$26),A ; unpack order[1] -> IX+38
 $907C LD A,B        ;
 $907D RRA           ;
 $907E RRA           ;
 $907F LD B,A        ;
 $9080 AND $03       ;
 $9082 LD (IX+$25),A ; unpack order[2] -> IX+37
 $9085 LD A,B        ;
 $9086 RRA           ;
 $9087 RRA           ;
 $9088 AND $03       ;
 $908A LD (IX+$24),A ; unpack order[3] -> IX+36
 $908D RET           ; return: draw order in IX+36..+39

; DATA_908E
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 64-entry packed draw-order permutation table for sprite_depth_sort.
; .
; Index = 6-bit pairwise-comparison key of the 4 sprites' columns (XOR $3F).
; .
; Each byte packs 4 two-bit object
; .
; indices = the back-to-front draw order.
; .
; Bounded by update_enemies.
@label=data_908e
b$908E DEFB $E4,$E1,$00,$D2,$D8,$00,$C9,$C6
 $9096 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$93,$00,$00,$00,$87
 $909E DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$9C,$00,$8D,$00
 $90A6 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$4E,$4B
 $90AE DEFB $B4,$B1,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $90B6 DEFB $00,$72,$00,$63,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $90BE DEFB $78,$00,$00,$00,$6C,$00,$00,$00
 $90C6 DEFB $39,$36,$00,$27,$2D,$00,$1E,$1B
 $90CE DEFB $02,$02,$01,$01,$00,$00,$FF,$FF
 $90D6 DEFB $FE,$FE,$FC,$00

; Update enemies
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Step the 4 enemy actors (objects 0..3 of object_table).
; .
; For each: dispatch on its state (+48):
; .
; 0 = inactive (skip), 7 = patrol/home toward player_col,
; .
; 4/6 = -> #R$9158 (full movement state machine), 5 = phase countdown (+42) --
; expires (bit7 of +42 set) into state 2.
; .
; else (any other state, e.g. 3/8/9) falls straight into #R$9158 too, since
; only 0/7/5 are filtered out here.
; .
; State 7 homing: moves angular pos (+0) by speed (+54), then compares against
; player_col and the tower quadrant marks $3C/$78 to pick a chase direction (+2
; / -2), or deactivates.
; .
; In: nothing.
; .
; Loops B=4 objects.
; .
; Clobbers most regs + IX.
@label=update_enemies
c$90DA LD IX,$605B     ; IX -> object_table (enemy 0)
 $90DE LD B,$04        ; B = 4 enemies
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$931F.
*$90E0 PUSH BC         ;
 $90E1 LD A,(IX+$30)   ; A = this enemy's state (+48)
 $90E4 CP $00          ;
 $90E6 JP Z,$931F      ; 0 = inactive -> next enemy
 $90E9 CP $07          ;
 $90EB JR NZ,$912C     ; state 7 = active/homing?
 $90ED LD (IX+$12),$4E ; set sprite id (+18) = $4E
 $90F1 LD A,(IX+$00)   ;
 $90F4 ADD A,(IX+$36)  ; angular pos (+0) += speed (+54)
 $90F7 LD (IX+$00),A   ;
 $90FA LD HL,$60A4     ; HL -> player_col
 $90FD BIT 7,(HL)      ; bit7 = which side of the tower the player is on
 $90FF JR NZ,$9111     ;
 $9101 CP $3C          ; at quadrant mark $3C?
 $9103 JR Z,$910B      ;
 $9105 CP $78          ;
 $9107 JR NZ,$9129     ;
 $9109 JR $9120        ;
*$910B LD (IX+$36),$02 ; chase: speed = +2 (toward player)
 $910F JR $9129        ;
*$9111 CP $3C          ;
 $9113 JR Z,$911A      ;
 $9115 OR A            ;
 $9116 JR NZ,$9129     ;
 $9118 JR $9120        ;
*$911A LD (IX+$36),$FE ; chase: speed = -2 ($FE)
 $911E JR $9129        ;
*$9120 LD (IX+$30),$00 ; off-screen/limit -> deactivate (state 0)
 $9124 LD A,$7D        ; flag $60A3 = $7D (respawn/notify)
 $9126 LD ($60A3),A    ;
*$9129 JP $931F        ; => Next enemy
*$912C CP $04          ; state 4?
 $912E JP Z,$9158      ; => Enemy state dispatch
 $9131 CP $06          ;
 $9133 JP Z,$9158      ; => Enemy state dispatch
 $9136 CP $05          ; state 5 = phase countdown
 $9138 JP NZ,$914B     ;
 $913B DEC (IX+$2A)    ; decrement phase (+42)
 $913E BIT 7,(IX+$2A)  ; phase underflowed (bit7 set) -> state=2
 $9142 JR Z,$9148      ;
 $9144 LD (IX+$30),$02 ;
*$9148 JP $931F        ; => Next enemy
*$914B CALL $934C      ; Check actor collision
 $914E JR NC,$9158     ;
 $9150 LD (IX+$30),$04 ; blocked -> force state=4, phase=0
 $9154 LD (IX+$2A),$00 ;

; Enemy state dispatch
;
; Used by the routine at #R$90DA.
;
; .
;
; Entry into the enemy's full movement/behaviour state machine, reached from
; update_enemies for states 4, 6, and the default case.
; .
; state==4 -> #R$9183 (idle/animate-in-place check). state==6 -> tests phase
; (+42): phase==6 means a pending transform is queued, jumps to enemy_transform
; (#R$9170) else falls into the shared idle-animation tail (enemy_idle_anim,
; #R$9191) with a mirrored phase.
; .
; Any other state falls through to #R$91A4 (enemy_move_dispatch2).
@label=enemy_move_dispatch
c$9158 LD A,(IX+$30) ; A = state (+48)
 $915B CP $04        ;
 $915D JR Z,$9183    ; state 4 -> #R$9183
 $915F CP $06        ; state 6?
 $9161 JR NZ,$91A4   ;
 $9163 LD A,(IX+$2A) ; A = phase (+42)
 $9166 CP $06        ; phase==6 -> pending transform
 $9168 JR Z,$9170    ;
 $916A NEG           ;
 $916C ADD A,$05     ;
 $916E JR $9191      ;

; Enemy transforms into queued next state
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9158.
;
; .
;
; Applies a queued state transform: copies the enemy's own +42/+3C fields into
; its live state (+48) and phase (+42), sets sprite id=$52.
; .
; This is how an enemy morphs into a different behaviour after a countdown
; (fields +42/+3C are pre-loaded elsewhere as the "next state/phase" to
; become).
@label=enemy_transform
c$9170 LD A,(IX+$42)   ;
 $9173 LD (IX+$30),A   ;
 $9176 LD A,(IX+$3C)   ;
 $9179 LD (IX+$2A),A   ;
 $917C LD (IX+$12),$52 ;
 $9180 JP $931F        ; => Next enemy

; Enemy idle: deactivate after full cycle
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9158.
;
; .
;
; state==4 path: if phase (+42) has reached 6, deactivates the enemy (state=0)
; else falls into enemy_idle_anim to keep cycling its idle sprite.
@label=enemy_idle_check
c$9183 LD A,(IX+$2A)   ;
 $9186 CP $06          ;
 $9188 JR NZ,$9191     ;
 $918A LD (IX+$30),$00 ;
 $918E JP $931F        ; => Next enemy

; Enemy idle animation cycle
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9158 and #R$9183.
;
; .
;
; Shared idle-animation tail for state 4 and the non-transform branch of state
; 6: clamps phase to 0..2 (wraps at 3), computes sprite id = phase*4+$5A,
; increments phase (+42), done.
@label=enemy_idle_anim
c$9191 CP $03        ; clamp phase to 0..2
 $9193 JR C,$9197    ;
 $9195 SUB $03       ;
*$9197 ADD A,A       ; {sprite id = phase*4 + $5A
 $9198 ADD A,A       ;
 $9199 ADD A,$5A     ;
 $919B LD (IX+$12),A ; }
 $919E INC (IX+$2A)  ; phase++
 $91A1 JP $931F      ; => Next enemy

; Enemy movement: pick vertical/horizontal/attack path
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9158.
;
; .
;
; Second dispatch tier, reached for any state other than 0/4/5/6/7.
; .
; state==3 -> #R$921D (enemy_post_move, shared attack/death dispatch). state==8
; -> #R$91AD (enemy_move_vertical). else -> #R$91F8 (enemy_move_horizontal, the
; default case covering states like 1/2/9 during normal movement).
@label=enemy_move_dispatch2
c$91A4 CP $03        ; state==3?
 $91A6 JP Z,$921D    ; -> enemy_post_move
 $91A9 CP $08        ; state==8?
 $91AB JR NZ,$91F8   ;

; Enemy moves vertically
;
; .
;
; .
;
; state 8: moves the enemy's 16-bit vertical position (+6/+12) by its signed
; speed (+54), backing up the old position in #R$6034 first.
; .
; Tests the new position via CHECK_ACTOR_COLLISION_A (#R$934C) and, if clear,
; CHECK_COLLISIONS against the player/other actors on-screen wraps checked via
; bit7 of the high byte (JP NZ,#R$9311 = out-of-bounds reset).
; .
; On a block, restores the previous position and reverses the speed sign
; (bounce).
; .
; Always ends by setting sprite id from the level number (#R$6039&3)*4+$66
; (level-tinted variant), then next enemy -- does not fall into
; enemy_post_move.
@label=enemy_move_vertical
c$91AD LD L,(IX+$06) ; {backup old position, add speed (16-bit)
 $91B0 LD H,(IX+$0C) ; }
 $91B3 LD ($6034),HL ;
 $91B6 LD E,(IX+$36) ;
 $91B9 BIT 7,E       ;
 $91BB LD D,$00      ;
 $91BD JR Z,$91C0    ;
 $91BF DEC D         ;
*$91C0 ADD HL,DE     ; {wrap-check: out of range -> #R$9311 (bounds reset)
 $91C1 BIT 7,H       ;
 $91C3 JP NZ,$9311   ; }
 $91C6 LD (IX+$06),L ;
 $91C9 LD A,H        ;
 $91CA AND $03       ;
 $91CC LD (IX+$0C),A ;
 $91CF CALL $934C    ; Check actor collision
 $91D2 JR C,$91D9    ;
 $91D4 CALL $95BD    ; Check collisions
 $91D7 JR NC,$91E9   ;
*$91D9 LD HL,($6034) ; {blocked: restore old position
 $91DC LD (IX+$06),L ;
 $91DF LD (IX+$0C),H ; }
 $91E2 XOR A         ; {reverse speed sign
 $91E3 SUB (IX+$36)  ;
 $91E6 LD (IX+$36),A ; }
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$921D.
*$91E9 LD A,($6039)  ;
 $91EC AND $03       ;
 $91EE ADD A,A       ;
 $91EF ADD A,A       ;
 $91F0 ADD A,$66     ;
 $91F2 LD (IX+$12),A ;
 $91F5 JP $931F      ; => Next enemy

; Enemy moves horizontally (around tower)
;
; Used by the routine at #R$91A4.
;
; .
;
; Default movement case (any state not 3/4/5/6/7/8): moves the enemy's angular
; position (+0) by its signed speed (+54), mod 128, backing up the old value in
; #R$6033 first.
; .
; Same collision test/bounce pattern as enemy_move_vertical
; (CHECK_ACTOR_COLLISION_A then CHECK_COLLISIONS on clear on a block, restores
; old position and reverses speed).
; .
; Falls through into enemy_post_move (#R$921D), unlike enemy_move_vertical.
@label=enemy_move_horizontal
c$91F8 LD A,(IX+$00)  ; {backup old angular pos
 $91FB LD ($6033),A   ; }
 $91FE ADD A,(IX+$36) ; {add speed, wrap mod 128
 $9201 AND $7F        ;
 $9203 LD (IX+$00),A  ; }
 $9206 CALL $934C     ; Check actor collision
 $9209 JR C,$9210     ;
 $920B CALL $95BD     ; Check collisions
 $920E JR NC,$921D    ;
*$9210 LD A,($6033)   ; {blocked: restore old position, reverse speed
 $9213 LD (IX+$00),A  ;
 $9216 XOR A          ;
 $9217 SUB (IX+$36)   ; }
 $921A LD (IX+$36),A  ;

; Enemy post-move: hazard/attack dispatch
;
; Used by the routines at #R$91A4 and #R$91F8.
;
; .
;
; Shared post-movement dispatch: state==2 -> #R$92EC (enemy_hazard_react).
; state==9 -> $91E9 (just refresh the level-tinted sprite, no movement -- an
; inert/spawned variant).
; .
; Otherwise this is the attack-pattern driver: indexes a per-enemy step table
; at $90CE by phase (+42). A zero entry means no attack step due yet ->
; enemy_attack_cooldown (#R$92DC, phase++ up to $0A). A nonzero entry is a
; signed step consumed by enemy_attack_step (#R$9238) to chain a dash/charge
; move.
@label=enemy_post_move
c$921D LD A,(IX+$30) ; A = state (+48)
 $9220 CP $02        ; {state==2 -> enemy_hazard_react
 $9222 JP Z,$92EC    ; }
 $9225 CP $09        ; {state==9 -> refresh level-tinted sprite only
 $9227 JP Z,$91E9    ; }
 $922A LD E,(IX+$2A) ; {phase -> index into attack-step table $90CE
 $922D LD D,$00      ;
 $922F LD HL,$90CE   ;
 $9232 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $9233 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $9234 OR A          ;
 $9235 JP Z,$92DC    ; entry==0 -> no attack step due, cooldown

; Enemy attack dash step
;
; .
;
; .
;
; One step of an attack dash/charge sequence, driven by the $90CE table entry
; for the current phase.
; .
; Applies the (sign-extended) step as a 16-bit delta to the enemy's vertical
; position (+6/+12), backing up the old value in #R$6034. Wrap past the tower
; bounds (bit7 of H) resets the enemy via #R$9311.
; .
; Tests the new position (CHECK_ACTOR_COLLISION_A then CHECK_COLLISIONS); on a
; block, restores the old position and falls to enemy_hazard_react (#R$92DC)
; instead of continuing the dash.
; .
; On success, re-examines the just-consumed table entry: $FF or $01 (a mid-dash
; unit step) loops back to consume the next table entry (re-enters at #R$9238)
; any other value (the dash's terminating marker) branches to either finish the
; attack (state==3 -> set state=2, phase=0) or fall to #R$928D to decide
; whether to trigger a fresh attack.
@label=enemy_attack_step
c$9238 LD ($90D9),A    ;
 $923B LD E,A          ;
 $923C ADD A,A         ;
 $923D SBC A,A         ;
 $923E LD D,A          ;
 $923F LD L,(IX+$06)   ;
 $9242 LD H,(IX+$0C)   ;
 $9245 LD ($6034),HL   ; backup old position (16-bit)
 $9248 ADD HL,DE       ;
 $9249 BIT 7,H         ;
 $924B JP NZ,$9311     ; wrap -> #R$9311 (bounds reset)
 $924E LD (IX+$06),L   ;
 $9251 LD A,H          ;
 $9252 AND $03         ;
 $9254 LD (IX+$0C),A   ;
 $9257 CALL $934C      ; Check actor collision
 $925A JR C,$9262      ;
 $925C CALL $95BD      ; Check collisions
 $925F JP NC,$92DC     ; => Enemy attack cooldown countdown
*$9262 LD HL,($6034)   ; {blocked: restore old position
 $9265 LD (IX+$06),L   ; }
 $9268 LD (IX+$0C),H   ;
 $926B LD A,($90D9)    ;
 $926E OR A            ;
 $926F JP M,$9278      ;
 $9272 DEC A           ;
 $9273 JR NZ,$9238     ;
 $9275 JP $92DC        ; => Enemy attack cooldown countdown
*$9278 INC A           ; {terminating step: A==1?
 $9279 JR NZ,$9238     ; }
 $927B LD A,(IX+$30)   ;
 $927E CP $03          ; {state==3 -> finish attack (state=2, phase=0)
 $9280 JR NZ,$928D     ;
 $9282 LD (IX+$30),$02 ; }
 $9286 LD (IX+$2A),$00 ;
 $928A JP $931F        ; => Next enemy

; Enemy checks whether to launch an attack
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9238.
;
; .
;
; End of a completed (or not-yet-started) attack cycle: only fires when the
; enemy is currently stationary (speed +54 == 0).
; .
; Requires $60C2 nonzero, player_state==0 (normal play), and the player's tower
; position to exactly match this enemy's (+6/+12) -- i.e. same column.
; .
; If so, computes the angular direction D (+1/-1) from tower_height to the
; enemy and, if the angular distance is under $20 (close enough), stores D into
; speed (+54) -- launching the attack dash that enemy_attack_step will then
; drive frame by frame.
; .
; Always resets phase (+42)=0 and plays sound 1 (attack cue) before falling to
; the next enemy.
@label=enemy_attack_trigger
c$928D LD A,(IX+$36) ; A = speed (+54)
 $9290 OR A          ;
 $9291 JR NZ,$92D0   ;
 $9293 LD A,($60C2)  ; {require $60C2 and player_state==0
 $9296 OR A          ;
 $9297 JR Z,$92D0    ; }
 $9299 LD A,($60C0)  ;
 $929C CP $00        ;
 $929E JR NZ,$92D0   ;
 $92A0 LD A,($60BA)  ; {require player column matches (first axis)
 $92A3 CP (IX+$06)   ;
 $92A6 JR NZ,$92D0   ; }
 $92A8 LD A,($60BB)  ; {require player column matches (second axis)
 $92AB CP (IX+$0C)   ;
 $92AE JR NZ,$92D0   ; }
 $92B0 LD D,$FF      ;
 $92B2 LD A,(IX+$00) ; {compute chase direction from tower_height delta
 $92B5 LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $92B8 SUB (HL)      ;
 $92B9 AND $7F       ;
 $92BB CP $40        ;
 $92BD JR C,$92C1    ; }
 $92BF OR $80        ;
*$92C1 CP $80        ;
 $92C3 JR C,$92C9    ;
 $92C5 NEG           ;
 $92C7 LD D,$01      ;
*$92C9 CP $20        ; {too far (>=$20) -> skip trigger
 $92CB JR NC,$92D0   ; }
 $92CD LD (IX+$36),D ;

; Enemy attack: reset phase, play cue

; Used by the routine at #R$928D.

; next enemy.
@label=enemy_attack_reset

 $92D4 LD A,$01        ;
 $92D6 CALL $A3DE      ; Play sound
 $92D9 JP $931F        ; => Next enemy

; Enemy attack cooldown countdown
;

 $92E0 CP $0A        ;
 $92E2 JR C,$92E6    ;

*$92E6 LD (IX+$2A),A ;
 $92E9 JP $931F      ; => Next enemy

; Enemy reacts to hazard cell
;
; Used by the routine at #R$921D.
;
; .
;
; state 2 (also reached when enemy_attack_step is blocked): sets sprite id=$56,
; reads the tower-map cell under the enemy via read_actor_cell.
; .
; Cell type 0 -> nothing, next enemy. Type 1 -> enters state 3 with phase=$0A
; (a timed sub-state, presumably "stuck/retreating"). Any other type ->
; reverses speed (+54) sign and continues.
@label=enemy_hazard_react

 $92EE LD (IX+$12),A   ; }

 $92F4 OR A            ;

 $92F8 CP $01          ; cell type == 1?
 $92FA JR Z,$9306      ; -> type-1 handler ($9306)
 $92FC XOR A           ; {else: reverse speed sign
 $92FD SUB (IX+$36)    ;
 $9300 LD (IX+$36),A   ; }
 $9303 JP $931F        ; => Next enemy
*$9306 LD (IX+$30),$03 ; {type 1: state=3, phase=$0A
 $930A LD (IX+$2A),$0A ; }
 $930E JP $931F        ; => Next enemy

 $931B LD (IX+$30),$04 ;

; RUN_CELL_PROBE
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9330 and #R$934C.
;
; .
;
; Shared cell-scan engine for check_rotate_collision/check_actor_collision_a/b:
; walks a vertical span of tower-map cells (from the self-mod params at
; $9329-$932C) looking for a blocking cell, auto-consuming a collectable along
; the way (score+timer bonus, sound 9) when the right conditions match.
; .
; Out: CY=blocked, NC=clear.
@label=run_cell_probe
c$9395 LD A,($9329)   ; {A = probe column + direction offset, wrap to row 0-15
 $9398 PUSH IX        ;
 $939A LD IX,$932A    ;
 $939E ADD A,(IX+$00) ;
 $93A1 SRL A          ;
 $93A3 SRL A          ;
 $93A5 SRL A          ;
 $93A7 AND $0F        ; }
 $93A9 LD ($9327),A   ; {store row; recompute the same for the span's other end
 $93AC LD A,($9329)   ;
 $93AF ADD A,(IX+$01) ;
 $93B2 POP IX         ;
 $93B4 SRL A          ;
 $93B6 SRL A          ;
 $93B8 SRL A          ;
 $93BA INC A          ;
 $93BB AND $0F        ; }
 $93BD LD ($9328),A   ; {stash the second row; HL = start position
 $93C0 LD A,L         ; }
 $93C1 SRL H          ; {fold position to a coarse row delta
 $93C3 RR L           ;
 $93C5 SRL H          ;
 $93C7 RR L           ; }
 $93C9 LD B,A         ; {B = delta; C = span length; delta==0 special-case
 $93CA LD A,($932C)   ;
 $93CD OR A           ;
 $93CE LD C,A         ;
 $93CF LD A,B         ;
 $93D0 JR Z,$93D7     ; }
 $93D2 DEC C          ; {single-row span? branch
 $93D3 JR NZ,$93E9    ;
 $93D5 JR $93ED       ; }
*$93D7 AND $03        ; {compute row-direction step (+2/-1/+1 pattern by
 $93D9 CP $03         ; quadrant)
 $93DB CCF            ;
 $93DC LD A,$02       ;
 $93DE ADC A,$00      ; }
 $93E0 LD ($6036),A   ;
 $93E3 LD A,($9327)   ;
 $93E6 JP $93FB       ;
*$93E9 LD B,$00       ; {delta nonzero -> direction = 0
 $93EB JR $93EF       ; }
*$93ED LD B,$01       ; single-row (delta=0) -> direction = 1
*$93EF AND $03        ; {fold direction into 0-3
 $93F1 JR Z,$93F4     ;
 $93F3 INC B          ;
*$93F4 LD A,B         ; }
 $93F5 LD ($6036),A   ;
 $93F8 LD A,($9327)   ;
*$93FB ADD A,$F0      ; {H = row page ($F0+row)
 $93FD LD H,A         ; }
 $93FE LD A,($6036)   ;
 $9401 LD E,A         ; {DE = column (loop counter E)
 $9402 LD D,$00       ; }
*$9404 LD ($932E),HL  ; {HL -> tower-map cell; fetch it
 $9407 ADD HL,DE      ;
 $9408 LD A,(HL)      ; }
 $9409 OR A           ;
 $940A JP P,$9471     ; unoccupied -> next cell ($9471)
 $940D AND $0F        ; {classify cell type/subtype
 $940F CP $04         ;
 $9411 JR C,$941D     ;
 $9413 AND $03        ;
 $9415 CP $01         ;
 $9417 JR NZ,$941D    ; }
 $9419 XOR A          ;
 $941A JP $9428       ;
*$941D AND $03        ; {type==3 (special)? skip type==2? invert and test
 $941F CP $03         ; blocking
 $9421 JR Z,$9471     ;
 $9423 SRL A          ;
 $9425 JP C,$9491     ; }
*$9428 LD ($932D),A   ; {stash blocking flag; compute self-mod probe-limit
 $942B LD A,($9327)   ; bytes
 $942E ADD A,A        ;
 $942F ADD A,A        ;
 $9430 ADD A,A        ;
 $9431 ADC A,$00      ;
 $9433 LD ($943F),A   ;
 $9436 ADC A,$00      ;
 $9438 LD ($9443),A   ; }
 $943B LD A,($9329)   ; {probe column outside 0-$FF range? -> treat as clear
 $943E CP $00         ;
 $9440 JR C,$9471     ;
 $9442 CP $00         ;
 $9444 JR NC,$9471    ; }
 $9446 LD A,($932D)   ; {blocking flag set? else clear/skip
 $9449 OR A           ;
 $944A JR Z,$9491     ; }
 $944C LD A,($932C)   ; {span type must be 2 (actor probe) for auto-consume
 $944F CP $02         ;
 $9451 JR NZ,$9491    ; }
 $9453 LD A,($603E)   ; {bump the pickup counter ($603E)
 $9456 INC A          ;
 $9457 LD ($603E),A   ; }
 $945A LD (HL),$00    ; {clear the cell (consumed)
 $945C PUSH HL        ; }
 $945D LD HL,$0050    ; {award score ($50) and timer bonus (+2)
 $9460 CALL $A727     ;
 $9463 LD A,$02       ; }
 $9465 CALL $A730     ;
 $9468 LD A,$09       ; {Play sound
 $946A CALL $A3DE     ; }

 $946E JP $9491       ; }
*$9471 LD HL,($932E)  ; {next cell in the span; more to go? loop
 $9474 DEC E          ;
 $9475 JP P,$9404     ; }
 $9478 LD A,($9327)   ; {advance row 0-15, compare against the span's other end
 $947B INC A          ;
 $947C AND $0F        ;
 $947E LD ($9327),A   ; }
 $9481 PUSH IX        ; {reached it? -> clear (NC), else loop the whole span
 $9483 LD IX,$9328    ;
 $9487 CP (IX+$00)    ;
 $948A POP IX         ;
 $948C JP NZ,$93FB    ; }
 $948F OR A           ;
 $9490 RET            ;
*$9491 SCF            ; {blocked -> SCF, RET
 $9492 RET            ; }

; Position to column
;
; Used by the routines at #R$949D and #R$9516.
;
; .
;
; Convert a 16-bit fixed-point position (e.g. #R$60BA, the actor's column
; position -- 4 sub-units per tower column) into a coarse column index: A = HL
; >> 2, computed as a proper 16-bit shift (H's low bits feed into A) so the
; result isn't just the high byte.
; .
; In: HL = fixed-point position.
; .
; Out: A = column index (HL >> 2), HL preserved.
; .
; Clobbers: A.
@label=pos_to_col
c$9493 PUSH HL       ; save HL (preserve caller's position)
 $9494 LD A,L        ; A = L (low byte of position)
 $9495 SRL H         ; H >>= 1, carry = H's old bit0
 $9497 RRA           ; A = (A>>1) with carry in from H -- 16-bit shift, pass 1
 $9498 SRL H         ; H >>= 1 again, carry = bit0
 $949A RRA           ; A = (A>>1) with carry in -- 16-bit shift, pass 2 (A =
                     ; HL>>2)
 $949B POP HL        ; restore HL
 $949C RET           ;

; Read player cell
;
; Used by the routine at #R$84B9.
;
; .
;
; Compute and read the tower-map cell at the player's position (from #R$60BA
; via pos_to_col and tower_height), returning the cell contents for the
; pstate_play logic.
; .
; Clobbers: A,C,HL.
@label=read_player_cell
c$949D LD HL,($60BA) ; HL = player position
 $94A0 CALL $9493    ; Position to column
 $94A3 DEC A         ; {L = column - 1 (left neighbour)
 $94A4 LD L,A        ; }
 $94A5 LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $94A8 ADD A,$7A     ; {page = ((rotation+$7A)>>3)&$0F + $F0; C = 0 (blocked
 $94AA SRL A         ; flag)
 $94AC SRL A         ;
 $94AE SRL A         ;
 $94B0 AND $0F       ;
 $94B2 PUSH AF       ;
 $94B3 ADD A,$F0     ;
 $94B5 LD H,A        ;
 $94B6 LD C,$00      ; }
 $94B8 LD A,(HL)     ; {left cell occupied & not type3 -> C = $02 (blocked
 $94B9 OR A          ; flag)
 $94BA JP P,$94C5    ;
 $94BD AND $03       ;
 $94BF CP $03        ;
 $94C1 JR Z,$94C5    ;
 $94C3 LD C,$02      ; }
*$94C5 POP AF        ; {next page = (col+1)&$0F + $F0
 $94C6 INC A         ;
 $94C7 AND $0F       ;
 $94C9 ADD A,$F0     ;
 $94CB LD H,A        ; }
 $94CC LD A,(HL)     ; {same test on right neighbour cell -> C += 1 (blocked
 $94CD OR A          ; flag)
 $94CE JP P,$94D8    ;
 $94D1 AND $03       ;
 $94D3 CP $03        ;
 $94D5 JR Z,$94D8    ;
 $94D7 INC C         ; }
*$94D8 LD A,($60B9)  ; get Tower rotation position
 $94DB AND $07       ; {index = (rotation&7)*4 | C; DE = index
 $94DD ADD A,A       ;
 $94DE ADD A,A       ;
 $94DF OR C          ;
 $94E0 LD E,A        ;
 $94E1 LD D,$00      ; }
 $94E3 LD HL,$94F6   ; {HL = table+index; A = facing flag; A = table[index]
 $94E6 ADD HL,DE     ; (cell descriptor)
 $94E7 LD A,($60BE)  ;
 $94EA OR A          ;
 $94EB LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $94EC JP P,$94F3    ; {facing set -> mirror nibble (rotate down 4); mask to
 $94EF RRA           ; nibble; return
 $94F0 RRA           ;
 $94F1 RRA           ;
 $94F2 RRA           ;
*$94F3 AND $0F       ;
 $94F5 RET           ; }

b$94F6 DEFB $11,$20,$02,$00,$11,$00,$32,$00
 $94FE DEFB $11,$00,$32,$00,$11,$00,$11,$00
 $9506 DEFB $11,$00,$11,$00,$11,$00,$11,$00
 $950E DEFB $11,$23,$00,$00,$11,$23,$00,$00

; Check collisions
;
; Used by the routines at #R$895B, #R$91AD, #R$91F8, #R$9238 and #R$96E9.
;
; .
;
; Test actor IX against the four object_table entries (IY walks #R$605B..) for
; an overlap, runs with interrupts off.
; .
; Per entry, skips to the next one ($9648: INC IY, next loop pass) when: IY==IX
; (self), or state (+48) is 0/4/6/7 (inactive/certain non-collidable states).
; .
; Otherwise does a 2-stage proximity test: angular distance |IX+0 - IY+0| (mod
; 128) must be small (<4, or >$7C i.e. wrapped small-negative) -- else skip;
; then vertical distance from the 16-bit position (IX+6/+12 vs IY+6/+12) must
; be within a small window (same page and delta<8, or one-page-back wrap with
; delta>=$F9) -- else skip.
; .
; On proximity, resolves a per-shape collision bitmask: if the target is object
; index 5 (the synthetic player record, see collision_test) it's an
; unconditional hit (SCF); if index 4, tests a bit in table $95AE; otherwise
; table #R$959F -- indexed by the angular delta, bit tested via RRA loop.
; .
; On a hit, exits via $9650 with CY=1 and HL=IY (colliding object's base
; pointer, since PUSH IY/POP HL runs before the final POP IY restores the
; caller's IY). No hit after all 4 entries: CY=0.
; .
; Skips comparing the actor with itself.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL,IY (IX preserved).
@label=check_collisions
c$95BD DI             ; {DI; IY -> object_table[0]; B=4 outer loop
 $95BE PUSH IY        ;
 $95C0 LD A,$04       ; }
 $95C2 LD IY,$605B    ;
*$95C6 EX AF,AF'      ; {skip if IY==IX (self)
 $95C7 PUSH IX        ;
 $95C9 PUSH IY        ;
 $95CB POP DE         ;
 $95CC POP HL         ;
 $95CD LD A,H         ;
 $95CE CP D           ;
 $95CF JR NZ,$95D6    ;
 $95D1 LD A,L         ;
 $95D2 CP E           ;
 $95D3 JP Z,$9648     ; }
*$95D6 LD A,(IY+$30)  ; A = target's state (+48)
 $95D9 CP $07         ; {skip if state is 0/4/6/7 (non-collidable)
 $95DB JP Z,$9648     ;
 $95DE CP $00         ;
 $95E0 JP Z,$9648     ;
 $95E3 CP $04         ;
 $95E5 JP Z,$9648     ;
 $95E8 CP $06         ;
 $95EA JP Z,$9648     ; }
 $95ED LD A,(IX+$00)  ; {angular distance |IX+0 - IY+0| within window?
 $95F0 SUB (IY+$00)   ;
 $95F3 AND $7F        ;
 $95F5 CP $04         ; }
 $95F7 JR C,$95FE     ;
 $95F9 CP $7C         ;
 $95FB JP C,$9648     ;
*$95FE ADD A,$03      ;
 $9600 AND $07        ;
 $9602 LD B,A         ;
 $9603 LD A,(IX+$06)  ; {vertical delta low byte (+6)
 $9606 SUB (IY+$06)   ;
 $9609 LD L,A         ; }
 $960A LD A,(IX+$0C)  ; {vertical delta high byte (+12) &3
 $960D SBC A,(IY+$0C) ;
 $9610 AND $03        ; }
 $9612 JR NZ,$961B    ; {same page: within 8 rows?
 $9614 LD A,L         ;
 $9615 CP $08         ;
 $9617 JR C,$9624     ; }
 $9619 JR $9648       ;
*$961B CP $03         ; {one-page-back wrap: within -7 rows?
 $961D JR NZ,$9648    ;
 $961F LD A,L         ;
 $9620 CP $F9         ;
 $9622 JR C,$9648     ; }
*$9624 ADD A,$07      ; {build delta+3 &7 -> table index E
 $9626 LD E,A         ;
 $9627 LD D,$00       ; }
 $9629 PUSH IX        ; {object index = IX low - $5B
 $962B POP HL         ;
 $962C LD A,L         ; }
 $962D SUB $5B        ; {index==5 (synthetic player)? unconditional hit
 $962F CP $05         ; }
 $9631 JR Z,$9645     ;
 $9633 LD HL,$959F    ; {else pick shape table #R$959F/$95AE by index==4
 $9636 CP $04         ;
 $9638 JR NZ,$963D    ; }
 $963A LD HL,$95AE    ;
*$963D ADD HL,DE      ; {test bit E in shape table byte
 $963E LD A,(HL)      ;
 $963F INC B          ;
*$9640 RRA            ;
 $9641 DJNZ $9640     ; }
 $9643 JR NC,$9648    ;
*$9645 SCF            ;
 $9646 JR $9650       ;
*$9648 INC IY         ; {next object: INC IY, loop B
 $964A EX AF,AF'      ;
 $964B DEC A          ;
 $964C JP NZ,$95C6    ; }
 $964F OR A           ;
*$9650 PUSH IY        ; {exit: HL=IY (colliding object), EI, RET
 $9652 POP HL         ;
 $9653 POP IY         ;
 $9655 EI             ; }
 $9656 RET            ;

; Read actor cell
;
; Used by the routine at #R$92EC.
;
; .
;
; Compute the tower-map cell address for actor IX (column IX+0>>3, position
; IX+6/IX+12) and read the cell there the actor counterpart of
; player_cell_addr.
; .
; Beyond the address/read, also classifies the result: tests the cell's type
; bits, then re-reads the cell one row above or below (direction chosen by the
; facing/movement bit at IX+54) to detect an edge. Returns A=0
; (blocked/special), 1 (open) or 2 (edge in the movement direction) -- consumed
; by enemy_hazard_react's 0/1/else dispatch.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=read_actor_cell
c$9657 LD A,(IX+$00)  ; A = actor's angular column (IX+0)
 $965A RRA            ;
 $965B RRA            ;
 $965C RRA            ;
 $965D AND $0F        ; isolate row nibble
 $965F ADD A,$F0      ; bias to $F0.. row page
 $9661 LD H,A         ;
 $9662 LD L,(IX+$06)  ; L = actor's vertical pos low (IX+6)
 $9665 LD A,(IX+$0C)  ;
 $9668 RRA            ;
 $9669 RR L           ;
 $966B RRA            ;
 $966C RR L           ;
 $966E DEC L          ; L -= 1 (row above)
 $966F LD A,(HL)      ; A = cell at (HL)
 $9670 OR A           ;
 $9671 JP P,$9685     ; sign bit set? -> skip to $9685
 $9674 AND $03        ; mask cell type bits
 $9676 CP $01         ; type == 1?
 $9678 JR NZ,$9681    ;
 $967A LD A,(HL)      ;
 $967B AND $0C        ; test sub-bits $0C
 $967D JR Z,$96D2     ;
 $967F JR $96CF       ;
*$9681 CP $03         ;
 $9683 JR NZ,$96D2    ;
*$9685 LD A,(IX+$00)  ; A = actor's angular column again
 $9688 AND $07        ; mask to row-in-column (0..7)
 $968A CP $02         ; row < 2? -> $9694 (near top)
 $968C JR C,$9694     ;
 $968E CP $07         ; row < 7? -> $96CC (open, no edge)
 $9690 JR C,$96CC     ;
 $9692 JR $96B0       ;
*$9694 LD A,H         ; A = row-page byte (H)
 $9695 SUB $F0        ;
 $9697 DEC A          ; row -= 1 (check row above)
 $9698 AND $0F        ;
 $969A ADD A,$F0      ;
 $969C LD H,A         ;
 $969D LD A,(HL)      ; A = cell above
 $969E OR A           ;
 $969F JP P,$96CC     ;
 $96A2 AND $03        ;
 $96A4 CP $03         ;
 $96A6 JR Z,$96CC     ;
 $96A8 BIT 7,(IX+$36) ; test facing/direction bit (IX+54)
 $96AC JR Z,$96CF     ;
 $96AE JR $96D2       ;
*$96B0 LD A,H         ; A = row-page byte (H)
 $96B1 SUB $F0        ;
 $96B3 INC A          ; row += 1 (check row below)
 $96B4 AND $0F        ;
 $96B6 ADD A,$F0      ;
 $96B8 LD H,A         ;
 $96B9 LD A,(HL)      ; A = cell below
 $96BA OR A           ;
 $96BB JP P,$96CC     ;
 $96BE AND $03        ;
 $96C0 CP $03         ;
 $96C2 JR Z,$96CC     ;
 $96C4 BIT 7,(IX+$36) ; test facing/direction bit (IX+54)
 $96C8 JR NZ,$96CF    ;
 $96CA JR $96D2       ;
*$96CC LD A,$01       ; return 1 (open/no obstruction)
 $96CE RET            ;
*$96CF LD A,$02       ; return 2 (edge in movement direction)
 $96D1 RET            ;
*$96D2 XOR A          ; return 0 (blocked/special)
 $96D3 RET            ;

; Routine at 96D4
;
; Used by the routine at #R$81D7.
@label=reset_actor_phase

 $96D8 LD (IX+$2A),$FF ;
 $96DC RET             ;

; Data block at 96DD
@label=move_curve
b$96DD DEFB $00,$01,$00,$01,$00,$01,$00,$00
 $96E5 DEFB $01,$00,$00,$00

; Update actor pos
;
; Used by the routine at #R$8240.
;
; .
;
; Advance one actor's position around/along the tower for this frame.
; .
; IX = actor_obj (#R$605F).
; .
; Fields used: (IX+0)  angular column around the tower (accumulated mod 128)
; (IX+6)  vertical position, low  (sub-pixel) (IX+12) vertical position, high
; (0..3) (IX+18) per-frame scratch, cleared on entry (IX+42) animation/move
; phase 0..$0C ($FF = inactive/done) (IX+48) actor state (2,4,5,8,9 -- see
; transitions below) (IX+54)
@label=update_actor_pos
c$96E9 LD IX,$605F     ; IX -> actor struct base (#R$605F)
 $96ED LD (IX+$12),$00 ; clear per-frame scratch field (+18)
 $96F1 LD A,(IX+$2A)   ; A = phase (+42)
 $96F4 CP $FF          ; $FF = inactive -> nothing to do
 $96F6 RET Z           ;
 $96F7 CP $0C          ; phase $0C = end of move -> mark done ($FF)
 $96F9 JR NZ,$9700     ;
*$96FB LD (IX+$2A),$FF ;
 $96FF RET             ;
*$9700 LD E,A          ; E = phase (table index)
 $9701 INC (IX+$2A)    ; advance phase
 $9704 LD A,(IX+$36)   ; A = speed(+54) * 2
 $9707 ADD A,A         ;
 $9708 ADD A,(IX+$00)  ; + angular pos (+0)
 $970B AND $7F         ; wrap to 0..127 (around the tower)
 $970D LD (IX+$00),A   ; store new angular column (+0)
 $9710 LD D,$00        ;
 $9712 LD HL,$96DD     ; HL -> move_curve[phase]
 $9715 ADD HL,DE       ;
 $9716 LD A,(IX+$06)   ; add curve delta to vertical-low (+6)
 $9719 ADD A,(HL)      ;
 $971A LD (IX+$06),A   ;
 $971D LD A,(IX+$0C)   ; carry into vertical-high (+12), keep 0..3
 $9720 ADC A,$00       ;
 $9722 AND $03         ;
 $9724 LD (IX+$0C),A   ;
 $9727 CALL $9372      ; Check actor collision b
 $972A JR C,$96FB      ; blocked -> mark move done
 $972C CALL $95BD      ; Check collisions
 $972F RET NC          ;
 $9730 PUSH IX         ;
 $9732 PUSH HL         ;
 $9733 POP IX          ;
 $9735 LD A,(IX+$30)   ; branch on actor state (+48)
 $9738 CP $05          ;
 $973A JR Z,$976A      ;
 $973C CP $08          ;
 $973E JR Z,$976A      ;
 $9740 CP $09          ;
 $9742 JR Z,$976A      ;
 $9744 CP $02          ;
 $9746 JR NZ,$9752     ;
 $9748 LD (IX+$2A),$4B ; state 2: arm phase=$4B, state=5
 $974C LD (IX+$30),$05 ;
 $9750 JR $976A        ;
*$9752 LD (IX+$30),$04 ; default: state=4, phase=0
 $9756 LD (IX+$2A),$00 ;
 $975A LD HL,$0100     ;
 $975D CALL $A727      ;
 $9760 LD A,$05        ;
 $9762 CALL $A730      ;
 $9765 LD A,$09        ;
 $9767 CALL $A3DE      ; Play sound
*$976A POP IX          ;
 $976C JP $96FB        ;

; Update timer digits
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9A23.
;
; .
;
; Patches ASCII digits straight into the status-line text strings ($986C-$986E
; level/timer, $987E-$9880 and $9890-$9892 the two players' bonus blocks at
; $604B), converting each BCD nibble by adding $30. Then prints the 5 status
; lines at rows $08/$0A/$0E/$10/$12 via print_string_at.
@label=update_timer_digits

 $9ADA LD A,($6054)  ; {A = ($6054) high nibble as ASCII
 $9ADD SRL A         ;
 $9ADF SRL A         ;
 $9AE1 SRL A         ;
 $9AE3 SRL A         ;
 $9AE5 ADD A,$30     ; }

 $9AEA LD A,($6054)  ; {low nibble as ASCII
 $9AED AND $0F       ;
 $9AEF ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9AF1 LD ($986D),A  ; patch digit into string $986D
 $9AF4 LD A,($6053)  ; get Level countdown timer
 $9AF7 SRL A         ; {high nibble as ASCII
 $9AF9 SRL A         ;
 $9AFB SRL A         ;
 $9AFD SRL A         ;
 $9AFF ADD A,$30     ; }

 $9B04 LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $9B07 LD IX,$604B   ; {IX = bonus block ($604B), +2 if player 2 active
 $9B0B OR A          ;
 $9B0C JR Z,$9B12    ;
 $9B0E INC IX        ;
 $9B10 INC IX        ; }
*$9B12 LD A,(IX+$01) ; {(IX+1) as ASCII
 $9B15 ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9B17 LD ($987E),A  ; patch digit into string $987E
 $9B1A LD A,(IX+$00) ; {(IX+0) low nibble as ASCII
 $9B1D AND $0F       ;
 $9B1F ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9B21 LD ($9880),A  ; patch digit into string $9880
 $9B24 LD A,(IX+$00) ; {(IX+0) high nibble as ASCII
 $9B27 SRL A         ;
 $9B29 SRL A         ;
 $9B2B SRL A         ;
 $9B2D SRL A         ;
 $9B2F ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9B31 LD ($987F),A  ; patch digit into string $987F
 $9B34 INC IX        ; {IX += 4 (player 2's bonus block)
 $9B36 INC IX        ;
 $9B38 INC IX        ;
 $9B3A INC IX        ; }
 $9B3C LD A,(IX+$01) ; {(IX+1) as ASCII
 $9B3F ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9B41 LD ($9890),A  ; patch digit into string $9890
 $9B44 LD A,(IX+$00) ; {(IX+0) low nibble as ASCII
 $9B47 AND $0F       ;
 $9B49 ADD A,$30     ; }

 $9B4E LD A,(IX+$00) ; {(IX+0) high nibble as ASCII
 $9B51 SRL A         ;
 $9B53 SRL A         ;
 $9B55 SRL A         ;
 $9B57 SRL A         ;
 $9B59 ADD A,$30     ; }
 $9B5B LD ($9891),A  ; patch digit into string $9891
 $9B5E LD A,$08      ; {row $08, string $983E
 $9B60 LD HL,$983E   ; }

; Title menu
;
; Used by the routine at #R$802B.
;
; .
;
; Title screen, option menu and attract/demo loop.
; .
; (TASK.md guessed 'init level data' here -- WRONG verified to be the
; front-end.) Blits the 24-row NEBULUS logo bitmap from rt_be00 ($BE00) into
; the screen, paints attribute rows, and prints the option lines (1/2 PLAYER
; etc.) via draw_menu_text.
; .
; Runs proc_table as an attract demo until input, then polls the keyboard ($FE)
; and Kempston ($1F) for select/start.
; .
; Entry: ticks the background animation once, starts music 0, resets the
; page/timeout/active flags (#R$9B87=0 main menu page, $9B88=$C0 attract
; timeout, $9B89=0 not-yet-active), falls into #R$9BA5.
; .

@label=title_menu
c$9B8A CALL $9CEB    ; tick background animation once
 $9B8D LD A,$00      ; A = tune 0
 $9B8F CALL $A197    ; Start music
 $9B92 XOR A         ; {clear menu_page (#R$9B87=0, main menu)
 $9B93 LD ($9B87),A  ; }
 $9B96 LD A,$C0      ; {attract_timer = $C0
 $9B98 LD ($9B88),A  ; }
 $9B9B XOR A         ; {menu_active = 0
 $9B9C LD ($9B89),A  ; }
 $9B9F JP $9BA5      ; => Title menu draw
