; Fill attr row
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9BA5.
;
; .
;
; Flood-fill 16 bytes starting at HL with the byte already stored at (HL)
; (DE=HL+1, LDIR propagates it forward) -- paints one attribute row a single
; flat colour.
; .
; In: HL=start address (byte already set), fills 16 bytes total.
@label=fill_attr_row
c$9CBE LD E,L        ; {DE = HL+1
 $9CBF LD D,H        ;
 $9CC0 INC DE        ; }
 $9CC1 LD BC,$000F   ; BC = 15 (remaining bytes)
 $9CC4 LDIR          ; LDIR: propagate the seed byte forward
 $9CC6 RET           ;

; Draw menu text
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9BA5.
;
; .
;
; Prints the two state-dependent menu lines: CONTROLS (row $15, text depends on
; running_flag==1 vs other -- 1P vs 2P control scheme) and SOUND (row $17, text
; depends on $6056 bit7 -- on/off).
@label=draw_menu_text
c$9CC7 LD A,($603F)  ; A = running_flag
 $9CCA CP $01        ; ==1 (single player)?
 $9CCC LD A,$15      ;
 $9CCE LD HL,$98F0   ;
 $9CD1 JR Z,$9CD6    ;
 $9CD3 LD HL,$98FA   ;
*$9CD6 CALL $9D21    ; Print string at
 $9CD9 LD A,($6056)  ; A = sound-enable flag ($6056)
 $9CDC OR A          ;
 $9CDD LD A,$17      ;
 $9CDF LD HL,$990E   ; HL -> "on" text
 $9CE2 JR Z,$9CE7    ;
 $9CE4 LD HL,$9904   ; HL -> "off" text (if flag clear)
*$9CE7 CALL $9D21    ; Print string at
 $9CEA RET           ;

; Enter HiScore name
;
; Used by the routines at #R$99A1 and #R$99F0.
;
; .
;
; "Type your initials" screen, entered from the time-up/bonus screens
; (#R$99A1/#R$99F0) after a level. Checks check_hiscore first RET NC
; immediately if the active player's score didn't qualify.
; .
; On a qualifying score: seeds the new table row's 3-char name with "A  "
; (IX+4/5/6), stashes the row pointer at $9D7E and the letter-position counter
; (4/5/6, one per char) at #R$9D7D=4, then redraws the hiscore screen with
; prompt text and enters an input loop.
; .
; Per letter: waits for horizontal input release, then a fire/movement poll.
; Vertical/horizontal movement (input_x, added to the current letter) cycles
; the letter A-Z (wrapping $40/$5B boundaries) fire or continued input confirms
; the letter and advances the position counter, defaulting the next letter to
; the same value as the one just confirmed. After all 3 letters (counter
; reaches 7), pauses ~25 frames and returns.
; .
; Clobbers: most.
@label=enter_hiscore_name
c$9D80 CALL $9E6D      ; check_hiscore
 $9D83 RET NC          ; not a qualifying score -> RET
 $9D84 LD (IX+$04),$41 ; default letter 1 = 'A'
 $9D88 LD (IX+$05),$20 ; default letter 2 = ' '
 $9D8C LD (IX+$06),$20 ; default letter 3 = ' '
 $9D90 LD ($9D7E),IX   ; stash row pointer ($9D7E)
 $9D94 LD A,$04        ; A = 4 (first letter-position value)
 $9D96 LD ($9D7D),A    ; stash letter-position counter (#R$9D7D)
 $9D99 CALL $9CEB      ; Title anim tick
*$9D9C CALL $9D4C      ; Draw hiscore screen
 $9D9F LD A,$15        ; A = row $15 (prompt line 1)
 $9DA1 LD HL,$9935     ; HL -> prompt string
 $9DA4 CALL $9D21      ; Print string at
 $9DA7 LD A,$17        ; A = row $17 (prompt line 2)
 $9DA9 LD HL,$9943     ; HL -> prompt string
 $9DAC CALL $9D21      ; Print string at
 $9DAF HALT            ; HALT (sync)
*$9DB0 CALL $A700      ; Proc table
 $9DB3 LD A,($601C)    ; get Signed input
 $9DB6 OR A            ;
 $9DB7 JR NZ,$9DB0     ; horizontal input still held -> wait for release
*$9DB9 LD B,$06        ; B = 6 (debounce frames)
*$9DBB HALT            ;
 $9DBC DJNZ $9DBB      ; loop 6 HALTs
 $9DBE CALL $A700      ; Proc table
 $9DC1 LD A,($601E)    ; get Signed input
 $9DC4 LD HL,$601C     ;
 $9DC7 OR (HL)         ; {fire or horizontal input? else keep waiting
 $9DC8 JR Z,$9DB9      ; }
 $9DCA LD A,($601E)    ; get Signed input
 $9DCD OR A            ;
 $9DCE JR Z,$9DEB      ; no vertical input -> confirm letter ($9DEB)
 $9DD0 LD IX,($9D7E)   ; IX -> current letter slot
 $9DD4 ADD A,(IX+$04)  ; A = input_y + current letter
 $9DD7 CP $40          ; wrapped below 'A'? -> wrap to 'Z'
 $9DD9 JR NZ,$9DDF     ;
 $9DDB LD A,$5A        ; A = 'Z'
 $9DDD JR $9DE5        ;
*$9DDF CP $5B          ; wrapped past 'Z'? -> wrap to 'A'
 $9DE1 JR NZ,$9DE5     ;
 $9DE3 LD A,$41        ; A = 'A'
*$9DE5 LD (IX+$04),A   ; store adjusted letter
 $9DE8 JP $9D9C        ; loop (redraw with new letter)
*$9DEB LD IX,($9D7E)   ; IX -> current letter slot
 $9DEF INC IX          ; IX += 1 (advance to next letter)
 $9DF1 LD ($9D7E),IX   ; store advanced pointer
 $9DF5 LD A,($9D7D)    ; A = letter-position counter
 $9DF8 INC A           ;
 $9DF9 LD ($9D7D),A    ; store advanced counter
 $9DFC CP $07          ; all 3 letters entered (counter==7)?
 $9DFE JR Z,$9E09      ;
 $9E00 LD A,(IX+$03)   ; else: A = previous letter's final value
 $9E03 LD (IX+$04),A   ; seed next letter with the same value
 $9E06 JP $9D9C        ; loop (redraw for next letter)
*$9E09 LD B,$19        ; B = $19 (pause frames)
*$9E0B HALT            ; HALT
 $9E0C DJNZ $9E0B      ; loop pause frames
 $9E0E RET             ;

@label=print_score_entry

 $9E2D CALL $9E58    ;

 $9E48 CALL $A73F    ;

; Check hiscore
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9D80.
;
; .
;
; Compare the active player's 4-byte BCD score ($6043 / $6047 by lives_p1)
; against the high-score table and insert it in rank order if it qualifies.
; .
; Runs with IRQs off.
; .
; Clobbers: A,IX,IY,...
@label=check_hiscore
c$9E6D DI             ; DI
 $9E6E PUSH IY        ;
 $9E70 LD A,($6040)   ; get Lives
 $9E73 LD IX,$6043    ;
 $9E77 OR A           ; player index==0? select score buffer
 $9E78 JR Z,$9E7E     ;
 $9E7A LD IX,$6047    ; else IX -> P2 score ($6047)
*$9E7E LD IY,$9D2F    ; IY -> hiscore table (#R$9D2F)
 $9E82 LD B,$04       ; B = 4 (BCD score bytes)
*$9E84 LD A,(IY+$00)  ; A = table entry byte
 $9E87 SUB (IX+$00)   ; subtract score byte (with carry chain)
 $9E8A LD A,(IY+$01)  ;
 $9E8D SBC A,(IX+$01) ;
 $9E90 LD A,(IY+$02)  ;
 $9E93 SBC A,(IX+$02) ;
 $9E96 LD A,(IY+$03)  ;
 $9E99 SBC A,(IX+$03) ;
 $9E9C JR C,$9EAA     ; table entry >= score? -> next entry
 $9E9E LD DE,$0007    ;
 $9EA1 ADD IY,DE      ; IY += 7 (next table row)
 $9EA3 DJNZ $9E84     ; loop 4 bytes; no qualifying row -> fall through
 $9EA5 POP IY         ; restore IY
 $9EA7 EI             ; EI
 $9EA8 OR A           ;
 $9EA9 RET            ; RET (no new high score)
*$9EAA PUSH IY        ; save insertion point (IY) into DE
 $9EAC POP DE         ;
 $9EAD LD IY,$9D44    ; IY -> end of hiscore table (#R$9D44)
*$9EB1 PUSH IY        ;
 $9EB3 POP HL         ;
 $9EB4 LD A,L         ; A = low byte of IY
 $9EB5 CP E           ;
 $9EB6 JR NZ,$9EBC    ; not yet at insertion point? keep shifting
 $9EB8 LD A,H         ;
 $9EB9 CP D           ;
 $9EBA JR Z,$9ECF     ; reached insertion point -> store new score

 $9EC8 DEC IY         ;

 $9ECC JP $9EB1       ;
*$9ECF LD A,(IX+$00)  ; A = new score byte (IX)
 $9ED2 LD (IY+$00),A  ; store into table row (IY)
 $9ED5 LD A,(IX+$01)  ;
 $9ED8 LD (IY+$01),A  ;
 $9EDB LD A,(IX+$02)  ;
 $9EDE LD (IY+$02),A  ;
 $9EE1 LD A,(IX+$03)  ;
 $9EE4 LD (IY+$03),A  ;
 $9EE7 PUSH IY        ; IY -> IX (restore active player's score ptr)
 $9EE9 POP IX         ;
 $9EEB POP IY         ; restore IY
 $9EED EI             ; EI
 $9EEE SCF            ; SCF (new high score inserted)
 $9EEF RET            ;

; Init attract actors

;
; .

; Set up the attract/demo actor records at #R$9EF0 (copy 5-byte template

; Attract step
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9F11 and #R$A170.
;
; .
;
; Advance the attract/demo one frame: silence SFX, render_play_frame, then fire
; scripted sounds keyed off the demo phase #R$9F0E.
; .
; Phase 0: sweeps a tone counter down by 2/frame until $68, then advances to
; phase 1 (also plays sound 3). Phase 1: cycles the 4 actor Y-offsets down by
; 2/frame at $9EFB, resetting a sub-counter every 9th frame, plays sound 3
; every wrap, advances to phase 2 at the end. Phase 2/4: replay scripted
; actor-position frames from tables #R$9F04/$9F09 indexed by a frame counter
; ($9F0F). Phase 3: sweeps $9EFA up/down by 2/frame between bounds, plays sound
; 3 at each end, toggling direction via $9F10. Phase else (5+): sweeps the same
; tone counter back up by 2/frame until $90, then RET (attract sequence done).
; .
; Clobbers: most.
@label=attract_step
c$9F33 LD ($9F10),A  ; stash tune id / phase-0 marker ($9F10)
 $9F36 CALL $A36D    ; Stop sound
*$9F39 CALL $A02A    ; Render play frame
 $9F3C LD A,($9F0E)  ; A = demo phase (#R$9F0E)
 $9F3F CP $01        ; {phase == 1? -> $9F6A
 $9F41 JR NZ,$9F6A   ; }
 $9F43 LD A,$0B      ; A = sound id 11 (phase-0 tone)
 $9F45 CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $9F48 LD HL,$9EFB   ; HL -> actor Y-offsets ($9EFB)
 $9F4B LD B,$04      ; B = 4 (offset count)
*$9F4D LD A,(HL)     ; {subtract 2 from this offset, next
 $9F4E SUB $02       ;
 $9F50 LD (HL),A     ;
 $9F51 INC HL        ; }
 $9F52 DJNZ $9F4D    ; loop 4 offsets
 $9F54 CP $68        ; reached lower bound ($68)?
 $9F56 JP NZ,$9F39   ;
 $9F59 LD HL,$9F0E   ; HL -> demo phase
 $9F5C INC (HL)      ; advance to phase 1
 $9F5D LD A,$00      ;
 $9F5F LD ($9F0F),A  ; reset frame sub-counter ($9F0F)=0
 $9F62 LD A,$03      ;
 $9F64 CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $9F67 JP $9F39      ;
*$9F6A CP $02        ; {phase == 2? -> $9F97
 $9F6C JR NZ,$9F97   ; }
 $9F6E LD A,($9F0F)  ; A = frame sub-counter
 $9F71 SRL A         ; /2 -> table index
 $9F73 LD E,A        ;
 $9F74 LD D,$00      ;
 $9F76 LD HL,$9F04   ; HL -> position table #R$9F04
 $9F79 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $9F7A LD A,(HL)     ; {fetch scripted X, store ($9EF6)
 $9F7B LD ($9EF6),A  ; }
 $9F7E LD HL,$9F09   ; HL -> position table $9F09
 $9F81 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $9F82 LD A,(HL)     ; {fetch scripted Y, store (#R$9EF1)
 $9F83 LD ($9EF1),A  ; }
 $9F86 LD HL,$9F0F   ; HL -> frame sub-counter
 $9F89 INC (HL)      ; {advance sub-counter
 $9F8A LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $9F8B CP $09        ; {reached frame $09? -> advance to phase 2
 $9F8D JP NZ,$9F39   ; }
 $9F90 LD HL,$9F0E   ;
 $9F93 INC (HL)      ;
 $9F94 JP $9F39      ;
*$9F97 CP $03        ; {phase == 3? -> $9FE7
 $9F99 JR NZ,$9FE7   ; }
 $9F9B LD A,($9F10)  ; A = sweep direction flag ($9F10)
 $9F9E OR A          ; {nonzero? -> sweep up branch $9FC4
 $9F9F JR NZ,$9FC4   ; }
 $9FA1 LD A,$00      ; {zero flag: clear demo-actor marker (#R$9EF0)
 $9FA3 LD ($9EF0),A  ; }
 $9FA6 LD A,($9EFA)  ; A = sweep value ($9EFA)
 $9FA9 SUB $02       ; {subtract 2 (sweep down)
 $9FAB LD ($9EFA),A  ; }
 $9FAE CP $54        ; reached lower bound ($54)?
 $9FB0 JP NZ,$9F39   ;
 $9FB3 LD HL,$9F0E   ;
 $9FB6 INC (HL)      ;
 $9FB7 LD A,$08      ; {A = 8, seed frame sub-counter
 $9FB9 LD ($9F0F),A  ; }
 $9FBC LD A,$03      ;
 $9FBE CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $9FC1 JP $9F39      ;
*$9FC4 LD A,($9EFA)  ; A = sweep value ($9EFA)
 $9FC7 ADD A,$02     ; {add 2 (sweep up)
 $9FC9 LD ($9EFA),A  ; }
 $9FCC CP $68        ; reached upper bound ($68)?
 $9FCE JP NZ,$9F39   ;
 $9FD1 LD HL,$9F0E   ;
 $9FD4 INC (HL)      ;
 $9FD5 LD A,$FF      ; {A = $FF, mark demo-actor active
 $9FD7 LD ($9EF0),A  ; }
 $9FDA LD A,$08      ;
 $9FDC LD ($9F0F),A  ;
 $9FDF LD A,$03      ;
 $9FE1 CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $9FE4 JP $9F39      ;
*$9FE7 CP $04        ; {phase == 4? -> $A013
 $9FE9 JR NZ,$A013   ; }
 $9FEB LD A,($9F0F)  ; A = frame sub-counter
 $9FEE SRL A         ;
 $9FF0 LD E,A        ;
 $9FF1 LD D,$00      ;
 $9FF3 LD HL,$9F04   ;
 $9FF6 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $9FF7 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $9FF8 LD ($9EF6),A  ;
 $9FFB LD HL,$9F09   ;
 $9FFE ADD HL,DE     ;
 $9FFF LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A000 LD ($9EF1),A  ;
 $A003 LD HL,$9F0F   ; HL -> frame sub-counter
 $A006 DEC (HL)      ; decrement sub-counter
 $A007 BIT 7,(HL)    ; underflowed (bit7 set)?
 $A009 JP Z,$9F39    ;
 $A00C LD HL,$9F0E   ; HL -> demo phase
 $A00F INC (HL)      ; advance to next phase
 $A010 JP $9F39      ;
*$A013 LD A,$0B      ; A = sound id 11 (final sweep tone)
 $A015 CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $A018 LD HL,$9EFB   ; HL -> actor Y-offsets ($9EFB)
 $A01B LD B,$04      ; B = 4 (offset count)
*$A01D LD A,(HL)     ; {add 2 to this offset, next
 $A01E ADD A,$02     ;
 $A020 LD (HL),A     ;
 $A021 INC HL        ; }
 $A022 DJNZ $A01D    ; loop 4 offsets
 $A024 CP $90        ; reached upper bound ($90)? done
 $A026 JP NZ,$9F39   ;
 $A029 RET           ;

; Render play frame
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9F11 and #R$9F33.
;
; .
;
; One frame of the in-play tower screen: setup_tower_scroll, code_ad00, wait
; vsync (HALT), tick the sound engine (sound_tick), draw the tower body +
; column strip, refresh the strip params and the scroll-wrap edge, then process
; the 5 actor records at #R$9EF0.
; .
; Clobbers: most.
@label=render_play_frame
c$A02A CALL $A75D    ; {setup_tower_scroll / code_ad00 trampolines
 $A02D CALL $A757    ; }
 $A030 PUSH AF       ;
 $A031 HALT          ;
 $A032 CALL $A41C    ; Sound tick
 $A035 CALL $A760    ; draw tower body (jp_draw_tower)
 $A038 CALL $A796    ; draw column strip (jp_draw_strip)
 $A03B POP AF        ;

 $A03F CALL $A754    ; scroll-wrap edge (jp_blit_scroll_wrap)
 $A042 LD IX,$9EF0   ; {IX -> demo actor records (#R$9EF0), B=5
 $A046 LD B,$05      ; }
*$A048 PUSH IX       ; {save IX/BC for this actor
 $A04A PUSH BC       ; }
 $A04B LD A,(IX+$00) ; {marker==$FF? inactive, skip
 $A04E CP $FF        ; }
 $A050 JP Z,$A109    ;
 $A053 LD A,(IX+$05) ; {compute screen row from actor Y and row table
 $A056 SRL A         ;
 $A058 SRL A         ;
 $A05A SRL A         ;
 $A05C LD L,A        ;
 $A05D LD H,(IX+$0A) ; }
 $A060 CALL $A781    ;
 $A063 PUSH HL       ;
 $A064 LD A,(IX+$00) ; {compute screen column
 $A067 CALL $A784    ; }
 $A06A POP DE        ;
 $A06B LD A,(IX+$0A) ; {off-screen (Y>=$7C)? skip
 $A06E CP $7C        ;
 $A070 JP NC,$A109   ; }

 $A075 CP $6A        ;
 $A077 JR C,$A07E    ;
 $A079 LD B,A        ;
 $A07A LD A,$7C      ;
 $A07C SUB B         ;
 $A07D LD B,A        ; }
*$A07E DI            ; DI

 $A084 EX DE,HL      ;
 $A085 LD A,C        ; {C selects row-width variant: 1/2/3-cell

 $A08B CP $03        ;
 $A08D JP Z,$A0B2    ; }

 $A093 OR D          ;

 $A096 POP DE        ;

 $A09E AND $07       ;

 $A0A3 LD A,L        ;
 $A0A4 ADD A,$20     ;
 $A0A6 LD L,A        ;
 $A0A7 JR C,$A0AD    ;
 $A0A9 LD A,H        ;
 $A0AA SUB $08       ;
 $A0AC LD H,A        ; }

 $A0AF JP $A104      ; }
*$A0B2 POP DE        ; {--- 2-cell-wide: copy+merge 3 mask/data pairs ---
 $A0B3 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A0B4 AND E         ;
 $A0B5 OR D          ;
 $A0B6 LD (HL),A     ;
 $A0B7 INC L         ;
 $A0B8 POP DE        ;
 $A0B9 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A0BA AND E         ;
 $A0BB OR D          ;
 $A0BC LD (HL),A     ;
 $A0BD INC L         ;

 $A10F JP NZ,$A048   ;

; Level shift entry
;
; Used by the routine at #R$879B.
;
; .
;
; Entry into pstate_9, taken from pstate_4's landing code ($87E9) when
; game_state==3 (level transition).
; .
; Sets pstate_phase=$FF (negative, selects pstate_9's shift-in-progress branch)
; and player_state=9, falls into pstate_9.
@label=level_shift_entry
c$A113 LD A,$FF      ;
 $A115 LD ($60BF),A  ; set Player state-machine phase/height window
 $A118 LD A,$09      ;
 $A11A LD ($60C0),A  ; set Player state-machine state

; Pstate 9
;
; .
;
; .
;
; State 9: level-transition tower-column shift (slides the next section of the
; tower map into place after landing).
; .
; While pstate_phase is negative: if the level-column property byte ($603A) has
; counted down to 6, jumps to $A15B to wait for scroll_pos to reach the wrap
; point (#R$6030==$03E0), then INCs pstate_phase (0, still non-negative) to end
; the shift on the next call.
; .
; Otherwise: steps actor_obj column position back by 4, shifts 6 columns of the
; #R$F000 tower map left by one row (byte-copy loop), decrements $603A, stops
; the current sound and plays sound $0C -- repeats every call until the column
; property hits 6.
; .
; Once pstate_phase is non-negative, falls through (next call) to #R$A170 to
; finish the transition.
@label=pstate_9
c$A11D LD A,($60BF)  ; get Player state-machine phase/height window
 $A120 OR A          ;
 $A121 JP P,$A170    ; => Level shift done
 $A124 LD A,($603A)  ;
 $A127 CP $06        ;
 $A129 JR Z,$A15B    ;
 $A12B LD HL,($60BA) ;
 $A12E LD DE,$FFFC   ;
 $A131 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A132 LD ($60BA),HL ;
 $A135 LD A,($603A)  ;
 $A138 SUB $05       ;
 $A13A LD L,A        ;
 $A13B LD H,$F0      ;
 $A13D LD C,$06      ;
*$A13F PUSH HL       ;
 $A140 LD B,$10      ;
*$A142 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A143 DEC L         ;
 $A144 LD (HL),A     ;
 $A145 INC L         ;
 $A146 INC H         ;
 $A147 DJNZ $A142    ;
 $A149 POP HL        ;
 $A14A INC L         ;
 $A14B DEC C         ;
 $A14C JR NZ,$A13F   ;
 $A14E LD HL,$603A   ;
 $A151 DEC (HL)      ;
 $A152 CALL $A36D    ; Stop sound
 $A155 LD A,$0C      ;
 $A157 CALL $A3DE    ; Play sound
 $A15A RET           ;
*$A15B LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $A15E LD A,H        ;
 $A15F CP $03        ;
 $A161 RET NZ        ;
 $A162 LD A,L        ;
 $A163 CP $E0        ;
 $A165 RET NZ        ;
 $A166 LD HL,$60BF   ;
 $A169 INC (HL)      ;
 $A16A RET           ;

b$A16B DEFB $54,$7C,$90,$90,$90

; Level shift done
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A11D.
;
; .
;
; Finishes the level-transition shift (reached once pstate_9's pstate_phase
; goes non-negative).
; .
; Resets the attract/demo actor state at #R$9EF0 (copies the #R$A16B template,
; clears the marker, sets phase 1), calls ATTRACT_STEP once, then sets
; game_state=4 (finished) -- the signal main_tick polls to end the transition

@label=level_shift_done

 $A173 LD DE,$9EFA   ;

 $A18A LD A,$04      ;
 $A18C LD ($60D9),A  ; set Game state

; Data block at A190
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Music sequencer's live state, not fixed data: stream pointer (#R$A190/91),
; current-note pointer ($A192/93), note-groups-remaining counter ($A194), note
; timer ($A195), active tune id ($A196). The DEFB values shown are just the
; reset state baked into the snapshot.
b$A190 DEFB $59,$A2,$72,$A2,$09,$00,$00

; Start music
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9963, #R$99A1, #R$99CE and #R$9B8A.
;
; .
;
; Begin music/jingle A: stash the id ($A196) then fall into init_music_seq to
; choose the data stream and arm the sequencer.
; .
; In: A=tune id.
@label=start_music
c$A197 LD ($A196),A  ;

; Init music sequence
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A1BD.
;
; .
;
; Picks one of 3 preset note-stream start addresses by tune id: 0 -> $A257 (9
; note-groups), 1 -> $A269 (1 group), else -> $A26B (fallback/short stinger).
; Arms the stream pointer, group counter and note timer (=1, fires
; immediately).
@label=init_music_seq
c$A19A LD A,($A196)  ;
 $A19D LD HL,$A257   ; {id==0 -> stream $A257, 9 groups
 $A1A0 LD B,$09      ; }
 $A1A2 OR A          ;
 $A1A3 JR Z,$A1B0    ;
 $A1A5 LD HL,$A269   ; {id==1 -> stream $A269, 1 group
 $A1A8 LD B,$01      ; }
 $A1AA DEC A         ;
 $A1AB JR Z,$A1B0    ;
 $A1AD LD HL,$A26B   ; else -> stream $A26B (same group count)
*$A1B0 LD ($A190),HL ; {arm stream pointer, group counter, note timer
 $A1B3 LD A,B        ;
 $A1B4 LD ($A194),A  ;
 $A1B7 LD A,$01      ; }
 $A1B9 LD ($A195),A  ;
 $A1BC RET           ;

; Music tick
;
; Used by the routines at #R$9963, #R$99A1, #R$99CE and #R$9BA5.
;
; .
;
; Per-frame music sequencer step (DI around it).
; .
; When the note timer ($A195) elapses, fetch the next event from the stream
; (#R$A190), update the current note ($A192), and play it.
; .
; A $FF note byte ends the current group: decrements the group counter ($A194)
; and loops to the next group if any remain, otherwise either holds the last
; note (tune id==0) or restarts via init_music_seq (id!=0, one-shot jingles
; loop back to their own start).
; .
; Otherwise the note byte indexes two parallel tables at #R$A238 (or $A23A,
; selected by the Specialist-beeper flag $6056) for a period value and #R$A249
; (an 11-char string used as a duration/shape lookup) for a tone-loop shape,
; then bit-bangs OUT ($FE) via an inlined tone loop (same shape as sfx_tone).
; .
; The Specialist has a 1-bit beeper too -- retarget the port and retune the
; delay loops.
@label=music_tick
c$A1BD DI            ;
 $A1BE LD A,($A195)  ;
 $A1C1 OR A          ;
 $A1C2 JR Z,$A1D6    ;
*$A1C4 XOR A         ;
 $A1C5 LD ($A195),A  ;
 $A1C8 LD HL,($A190) ; HL -> stream pointer, fetch next 16-bit event
 $A1CB LD E,(HL)     ;
 $A1CC INC HL        ;
 $A1CD LD D,(HL)     ;
 $A1CE INC HL        ;
 $A1CF LD ($A190),HL ;
 $A1D2 LD ($A192),DE ;
*$A1D6 LD HL,($A192) ; {A = current note byte
 $A1D9 LD A,(HL)     ; }
 $A1DA CP $FF        ; $FF = end of note-group
 $A1DC JR NZ,$A1F0   ;
 $A1DE LD HL,$A194   ;
 $A1E1 DEC (HL)      ; {decrement group counter
 $A1E2 JR NZ,$A1C4   ; }
 $A1E4 LD A,($A196)  ; {last group done: id==0 -> hold, else -> restart tune
 $A1E7 OR A          ;
 $A1E8 SCF           ;
 $A1E9 JR NZ,$A236   ; }
 $A1EB CALL $A19A    ; Init music sequence
 $A1EE JR $A1C4      ;
*$A1F0 INC HL        ;
 $A1F1 LD ($A192),HL ;
 $A1F4 LD HL,$A237   ; {index period table $A237+note, select beeper variant
 $A1F7 LD E,A        ; via $6056
 $A1F8 LD D,$00      ;
 $A1FA ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A1FB LD BC,$A238   ; }
 $A1FE LD A,($6056)  ;
 $A201 OR A          ;
 $A202 JR NZ,$A207   ;
 $A204 LD BC,$A23A   ;
*$A207 LD A,(BC)     ;
 $A208 LD ($A22B),A  ;
 $A20B INC BC        ;
 $A20C LD A,(BC)     ;
 $A20D LD ($A22C),A  ;
 $A210 LD B,(HL)     ;
 $A211 LD A,$01      ;
 $A213 ADD A,B       ;
 $A214 LD C,A        ;
 $A215 LD E,$00      ;
 $A217 LD D,$16      ;
 $A219 LD H,B        ;
 $A21A XOR A         ;
*$A21B DEC H         ; {inlined tone-loop bit-bang (OUT $FE), shaped by
 $A21C JR NZ,$A221   ; duration string byte
 $A21E OR $10        ;
 $A220 LD H,B        ;
*$A221 DEC L         ;
 $A222 JR NZ,$A227   ;
 $A224 OR $10        ;
 $A226 LD L,C        ;
*$A227 ADD A,$08     ;
 $A229 AND $10       ;
 $A22B OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A22D SRL A         ;
 $A22F DEC E         ;
 $A230 JR NZ,$A21B   ;
 $A232 DEC D         ;
 $A233 JR NZ,$A21B   ;
 $A235 OR A          ;
*$A236 EI            ;
 $A237 RET           ; }

; Data block at A238
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Two parallel 8-entry period/duration tables (ZX at #R$A238, alternate
; "Specialist" beeper variant at $A240), indexed by note code and selected via
; $6056.
b$A238 DEFB $D3,$FE,$23,$2B,$00,$F2,$E7,$D8
 $A240 DEFB $CD,$C2,$B7,$AC,$A1,$99,$90,$88
 $A248 DEFB $80
; 11-char duration/shape string, one char per note code: each character's ASCII
; value supplies the H/L sub-loop counts for music_tick's inlined tone loop.
 $A249 DEFM "yslfa[VPLHD"

; Data block at A254
;
; .
;
; .
;
; A second, shorter period/shape table pair (1 byte + 3 chars) -- sparse
; coverage, likely only used by a short jingle's reduced note set.
b$A254 DEFB $40
 $A255 DEFM "96m"

; Data block at A258
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Real note-stream data starts one byte earlier, at $A257 (see init_music_seq):
; $A257 (9-group stream), $A269 (1-group stream) and $A26B (fallback stream)
; are literal entry addresses into this block, not a lookup table.
; .
; Byte values are note codes (indices into the #R$A238/#R$A249 tables) $FF
; marks the end of a note-group. Runs through $A367 the final 5 bytes
; ($A368-$A36C) are SFX-engine state (active effect id/pointer/priority), not
; music data.
b$A258 DEFB $A2,$6D,$A2,$8E,$A2,$8E,$A2,$AF
 $A260 DEFB $A2,$F0,$A2,$F0,$A2,$31,$A3,$31
 $A268 DEFB $A3,$52,$A3,$5B,$A3,$18,$16,$18
 $A270 DEFB $16,$18,$18,$16,$18,$18,$16,$18
 $A278 DEFB $16,$1B,$1A,$1B,$1B,$18,$16,$18
 $A280 DEFB $16,$18,$18,$13,$16,$16,$15,$16
 $A288 DEFB $16,$16,$16,$16,$16,$FF,$1A,$18
 $A290 DEFB $1A,$18,$1A,$1A,$18,$1A,$1A,$18
 $A298 DEFB $1A,$18,$1D,$1C,$1D,$1D,$1A,$18
 $A2A0 DEFB $1A,$18,$1A,$1A,$15,$18,$18,$17
 $A2A8 DEFB $18,$18,$18,$18,$18,$18,$FF,$16
 $A2B0 DEFB $15,$11,$0E,$15,$13,$10,$0C,$11
 $A2B8 DEFB $10,$0E,$10,$10,$11,$11,$11,$16
 $A2C0 DEFB $15,$11,$0E,$15,$13,$10,$0C,$18
 $A2C8 DEFB $18,$16,$15,$15,$11,$11,$11,$16
 $A2D0 DEFB $15,$11,$0E,$15,$13,$10,$0C,$11
 $A2D8 DEFB $10,$0E,$10,$10,$11,$11,$11,$16
 $A2E0 DEFB $15,$13,$15,$15,$16,$16,$16,$19
 $A2E8 DEFB $18,$16,$18,$18,$19,$19,$1C,$FF
 $A2F0 DEFB $11,$0A,$15,$0A,$11,$0A,$15,$11
 $A2F8 DEFB $0A,$15,$0A,$11,$16,$15,$11,$0E
 $A300 DEFB $10,$09,$13,$09,$10,$09,$13,$10
 $A308 DEFB $09,$13,$09,$10,$11,$10,$0C,$09
 $A310 DEFB $0E,$07,$11,$07,$0E,$07,$11,$0E
 $A318 DEFB $07,$11,$07,$0E,$10,$0E,$11,$0E
 $A320 DEFB $10,$09,$13,$09,$10,$09,$13,$10
 $A328 DEFB $09,$13,$09,$10,$11,$10,$0E,$10
 $A330 DEFB $FF,$18,$18,$16,$15,$15,$11,$0E
 $A338 DEFB $11,$13,$11,$13,$15,$18,$15,$18

 $A348 DEFB $13,$15,$13,$15,$18,$1A,$18,$15

 $A360 DEFB $0B,$08,$08,$07,$07,$07,$07,$FF
 $A368 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00

; Stop sound
;
; Used by the routines at #R$802B, #R$9F33 and #R$A11D.
;
; .
;
; Silences the current SFX effect by marking $A368=$FF (sound_tick's "active
; marker" gate).
@label=stop_sound
c$A36D LD A,$FF      ;
 $A36F LD ($A368),A  ;
 $A372 RET           ;

; Data block at A373
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 13 pointer words (ids 0..$0C, matching play_sound's "id<$0D" range), one per
; sound effect, resolved by lookup_sound.
@label=snd_ptr_table
b$A373 DEFB $8D,$A3,$97,$A3,$9A,$A3,$9D,$A3
 $A37B DEFB $A2,$A3,$AA,$A3,$AF,$A3,$C9,$A3
 $A383 DEFB $C9,$A3,$CD,$A3,$D5,$A3,$D8,$A3
 $A38B DEFB $DB,$A3

; Data block at A38D
;
; .
;
; .
;
; The 13 effects' byte streams, back-to-back, addressed via snd_ptr_table. Each
; stream starts with 2 header bytes (priority, then a repeat/duration count
; copied into $A36C) followed by command/data bytes consumed by sound_tick:
; values <$80 are raw tone/length data for sfx_tone values $80/$81/$C8/$C9/$CA
; are specific ops (noise burst, random tone, etc., handled at
; #R$A48A/#R$A470/#R$A4BF/#R$A52E/#R$A4F2) values $82..$C7 go through the
; generic handler at #R$A493 anything else ends the effect.
@label=snd_effect_data
b$A38D DEFB $14,$08,$20,$1C,$18,$14,$20,$18
 $A395 DEFB $20,$18,$05,$01,$81,$0A,$01,$C9
 $A39D DEFB $0A,$03,$01,$20,$01,$0A,$06,$04
 $A3A5 DEFB $08,$0C,$10,$14,$18,$1E,$03,$01
 $A3AD DEFB $80,$81,$1E,$18,$01,$80,$82,$01
 $A3B5 DEFB $80,$82,$80,$82,$20,$81,$1C,$81
 $A3BD DEFB $18,$81,$14,$81,$10,$82,$0C,$82
 $A3C5 DEFB $08,$82,$04,$82,$1E,$02,$81,$82
 $A3CD DEFB $1E,$06,$82,$83,$84,$85,$86,$87
 $A3D5 DEFB $0A,$01,$80,$28,$01,$C8,$28,$01
 $A3DD DEFB $CA

; Play sound
;
; Used by the routines at #R$8240, #R$84B9, #R$85DB, #R$8656, #R$868D, #R$8724,
; #R$8736, #R$8831, #R$88BD, #R$8A4A, #R$8A71, #R$92D0, #R$9395, #R$955B,
; #R$96E9, #R$9F33 and #R$A11D.
;
; A effect id (<$0D)
;
; Trigger sound effect A (id < $0D, else ignored): looks up the effect via
; lookup_sound and, unless a higher-priority effect is already playing
; ($A368/$A369), latches its data pointer/duration/priority for sound_tick to
; play out. Most-called audio API preserves all registers.
; .
; Clobbers: nothing (all regs saved/restored).
@label=play_sound
c$A3DE PUSH AF       ; {save all regs
 $A3DF PUSH BC       ;
 $A3E0 PUSH DE       ;
 $A3E1 PUSH HL       ; }
 $A3E2 CP $0D        ; {id out of range? -> ignore
 $A3E4 JR NC,$A406   ; }
 $A3E6 CALL $A40B    ; lookup_sound: HL=data, B=priority, C=duration
 $A3E9 LD D,A        ;
 $A3EA LD A,($A368)  ; {an effect already active?
 $A3ED CP $FF        ;
 $A3EF JR Z,$A3F7    ; }
 $A3F1 LD A,($A369)  ; {new priority lower? -> ignore
 $A3F4 CP B          ;
 $A3F5 JR C,$A406    ; }
*$A3F7 LD ($A36A),HL ; latch data pointer ($A36A)
 $A3FA LD A,C        ; {latch duration ($A36C)
 $A3FB LD ($A36C),A  ; }
 $A3FE LD A,D        ; {mark active, latch priority ($A368/$A369)
 $A3FF LD ($A368),A  ;
 $A402 LD A,B        ;
 $A403 LD ($A369),A  ; }
*$A406 POP HL        ;
 $A407 POP DE        ;
 $A408 POP BC        ;
 $A409 POP AF        ;
 $A40A RET           ;

; Lookup sound
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A3DE.
;
;   A effect id
; O:HL data pointer O:B priority O:C duration
;
; Looks up effect A in the pointer table at $A373 to get its data pointer, then
; reads the pointed-at priority/duration header bytes.
@label=lookup_sound
c$A40B LD L,A        ; {HL = ($A373 + A*2) table entry address
 $A40C LD H,$00      ;
 $A40E LD DE,$A373   ;
 $A411 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $A412 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $A413 LD E,(HL)     ; {HL = table entry (16-bit data pointer)
 $A414 INC HL        ;
 $A415 LD D,(HL)     ;
 $A416 EX DE,HL      ; }
 $A417 LD B,(HL)     ; {B = priority, C = duration (header bytes at HL)
 $A418 INC HL        ;
 $A419 LD C,(HL)     ;
 $A41A INC HL        ;
 $A41B RET           ; }

; Sound tick
;
; Used by the routines at #R$8240 and #R$A02A.
;
; .
;
; Per-frame SFX engine step.
; .
; Gated by the sound-enable flag ($6056) and the active marker ($A368).
; .
; Reads the next byte of the current effect (pointer $A36A), interpreting
; commands (>=$80) vs tone/length data, and emits to the speaker.
; .
; The Specialist has a 1-bit beeper too -- retarget the port and retune the
; delay loops.
@label=sound_tick
c$A41C LD A,($6056)  ; sound-enable flag; off -> RET
 $A41F OR A          ;
 $A420 JP Z,$A50E    ;
 $A423 LD A,($A368)  ; {no active effect -> RET
 $A426 CP $FF        ; }
 $A428 JP Z,$A50E    ;
 $A42B LD HL,($A36A) ; {fetch next command/data byte from the effect stream
 $A42E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A42F INC HL        ;
 $A430 LD ($A36A),HL ; }
 $A433 CP $80        ; raw data (<$80)? -> SFX tone
 $A435 JR C,$A462    ;
 $A437 CALL Z,$A48A  ; SFX Command $80
 $A43A JR Z,$A465    ;
 $A43C CP $81        ;
 $A43E CALL Z,$A470  ; SFX Sweep
 $A441 JR Z,$A465    ;
 $A443 CP $C8        ;
 $A445 CALL Z,$A4BF  ; SFX_ROM_NOISE
 $A448 JR Z,$A465    ;
 $A44A CP $C9        ;
 $A44C CALL Z,$A52E  ;
 $A44F JR Z,$A465    ;
 $A451 CP $CA        ;
 $A453 CALL Z,$A4F2  ; SFX Column Tone
 $A456 JR Z,$A465    ;
 $A458 CP $82        ; {else dispatch on command byte ($82-$C7 -> generic
 $A45A CALL NC,$A493 ; handler)}
 $A45D JR NC,$A465   ;
 $A45F JP $A46A      ;
*$A462 CALL $A539    ; SFX tone
*$A465 LD HL,$A36C   ;
 $A468 DEC (HL)      ;
 $A469 RET NZ        ;
*$A46A LD A,$FF      ;
 $A46C LD ($A368),A  ;
 $A46F RET           ;

; SFX Sweep
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
;
; .
;
; Sound_tick command $81 handler: a pitch sweep -- toggles the speaker bit 18
; times ($12 outer steps), each with a shrinking delay loop (D -= 3 per step),
; so the tone rises over the burst.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE.
@label=sfx_sweep
c$A470 PUSH AF       ; {E = $10 (speaker toggle); C = 18 steps; D = $80 (delay)
 $A471 LD E,$10      ;
 $A473 LD C,$12      ;
 $A475 LD D,$80      ; }
*$A477 LD A,E        ; {toggle speaker bit
 $A478 OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A47A XOR $10       ;
 $A47C LD E,A        ; }
 $A47D LD B,D        ; {delay loop (B=D); shrink D by 3, loop 18 steps
*$A47E DJNZ $A47E    ;
 $A480 LD A,D        ;
 $A481 SUB $03       ;
 $A483 LD D,A        ;
 $A484 DEC C         ;
 $A485 JP NZ,$A477   ; }
 $A488 POP AF        ;
 $A489 RET           ;

; SFX Command $80
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
;
; .
;
; Sound_tick command $80 handler: a fixed-duration ($0143) white-noise burst
; via sfx_noise.
@label=sfx_command_80
c$A48A PUSH AF       ; {DE = $0143 (duration)
 $A48B LD DE,$0143   ; }
 $A48E CALL $A4AD    ; SFX noise
 $A491 POP AF        ;
 $A492 RET           ;

; SFX Playback
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
;
; A command byte ($82-$C7)
;
; Generic sound_tick command handler (commands $82-$C7): plays back a fixed
; bit-pattern table selected by the command byte (page $A3xx+cmd, offset $6D),
; masking bit 4 out to the speaker each iteration, for $0143 iterations.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=sfx_playback
c$A493 PUSH AF       ; {B = $10 (speaker mask); HL = table page for this
 $A494 LD B,$10      ; command
 $A496 ADD A,$A3     ;
 $A498 LD H,A        ;
 $A499 LD L,$6D      ; }
 $A49B LD DE,$0143   ; DE = $0143 (iteration count)
*$A49E LD A,(HL)     ; {speaker bit = table byte & $10; advance, loop
 $A49F AND B         ;
 $A4A0 OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A4A2 INC HL        ;
 $A4A3 DEC DE        ;
 $A4A4 LD A,D        ;
 $A4A5 OR E          ;
 $A4A6 NOP           ;
 $A4A7 NOP           ;
 $A4A8 JP NZ,$A49E   ; }
 $A4AB POP AF        ;
 $A4AC RET           ;

; SFX noise
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A48A.
;
; .
;
; White-noise burst: XORs the refresh register R into the speaker bit and
; toggles OUT ($FE) for DE iterations.
; .
; The Specialist has a 1-bit beeper too -- retarget the port and retune the
; delay loops.
@label=sfx_noise
c$A4AD LD B,$10      ;
*$A4AF LD A,R        ;
 $A4B1 XOR D         ;
 $A4B2 ADD A,E       ;
 $A4B3 AND B         ;
 $A4B4 OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A4B6 DEC DE        ;
 $A4B7 LD A,D        ;
 $A4B8 OR E          ;
 $A4B9 NOP           ;
 $A4BA NOP           ;
 $A4BB JP NZ,$A4AF   ;
 $A4BE RET           ;

; SFX ROM Noise
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
;
; .
;
; Noise burst sourced from ROM bytes at $8000+ (game code, used as
; pseudo-random data) rather than the R register: steps through with a random
; increment each read, OUTs bit 4 of each byte to the speaker, for BC=$7A
; iterations.
@label=sfx_rom_noise
c$A4BF PUSH AF       ; {save AF; A = random step (jp_random)
 $A4C0 CALL $A715    ; }
 $A4C3 LD E,A        ;
 $A4C4 LD HL,$8000   ; {HL -> $8000, BC = $7A (iteration count)
 $A4C7 LD BC,$007A   ; }
*$A4CA LD A,(HL)     ; {speaker bit = byte's bit 4
 $A4CB AND $10       ;
 $A4CD OUT ($FE),A   ; }
 $A4CF LD A,L        ; {HL += random step
 $A4D0 ADD A,E       ;
 $A4D1 LD L,A        ; }
 $A4D2 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A4D3 AND $10       ;
 $A4D5 OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A4D7 LD A,L        ;
 $A4D8 ADD A,E       ;
 $A4D9 LD L,A        ;
 $A4DA LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A4DB AND $10       ;
 $A4DD OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A4DF LD A,L        ;
 $A4E0 ADD A,E       ;
 $A4E1 LD L,A        ;
 $A4E2 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A4E3 AND $10       ;
 $A4E5 OUT ($FE),A   ;
 $A4E7 LD A,L        ;
 $A4E8 ADD A,E       ;
 $A4E9 LD L,A        ;
 $A4EA DEC BC        ; {loop BC iterations
 $A4EB LD A,B        ;
 $A4EC OR C          ;
 $A4ED JP NZ,$A4CA   ; }
 $A4F0 POP AF        ;
 $A4F1 RET           ;

; SFX Column Tone
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
;
; .
;
; Derives a tone pitch from the current level column's property byte (#R$603A,
; halved twice and clamped to $22), XORs in 2 random low bits from #R$A715,
; then plays it via sfx_tone.
@label=sfx_column_tone
c$A4F2 PUSH AF       ; {A = ($603A) >> 2, clamped to max $22
 $A4F3 LD A,($603A)  ;
 $A4F6 SRL A         ;
 $A4F8 SRL A         ;
 $A4FA CP $23        ;
 $A4FC JR C,$A500    ;
 $A4FE LD A,$22      ; }
*$A500 PUSH AF       ; {A ^= random & $03 (pitch jitter)
 $A501 CALL $A715    ;
 $A504 AND $03       ;
 $A506 LD B,A        ;
 $A507 POP AF        ;
 $A508 XOR B         ; }
 $A509 CALL $A539    ; {SFX tone
 $A50C POP AF        ;
 $A50D RET           ; }

; Routine at A50E
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
c$A50E LD HL,$036B   ;
*$A511 DEC HL        ;
 $A512 LD A,H        ;
 $A513 OR L          ;
 $A514 JP NZ,$A511   ;
 $A517 RET           ;

; Unused
s$A518 DEFS $01

; Routine at A519
;
; Used by the routine at #R$9AD7.
@label=sfx_random_tone
c$A519 PUSH AF       ;
 $A51A CALL $A715    ;
 $A51D AND $07       ;
 $A51F LD B,A        ;
 $A520 LD A,($A518)  ;
 $A523 SUB B         ;
 $A524 AND $1F       ;
 $A526 LD ($A518),A  ;
 $A529 CALL $A539    ; SFX tone
 $A52C POP AF        ;
 $A52D RET           ;

; Routine at A52E
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A41C.
c$A52E PUSH AF       ;
 $A52F CALL $A715    ;
 $A532 AND $03       ;
 $A534 CALL $A539    ; SFX tone
 $A537 POP AF        ;
 $A538 RET           ;

; SFX tone
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A41C, #R$A4F2, #R$A519 and #R$A52E.
;
; A pitch index
;
; Emit a square-wave tone: pitch index A selects a half-period from table
; #R$A560, then toggles the speaker every half-period for a fixed
; $0148-iteration duration (shadow AF' holds the toggle mask, B/L reload the
; half-period countdown). The Specialist has a 1-bit beeper too -- retarget the
; port and retune the delay loops.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL,AF'.
@label=sfx_tone
c$A539 LD L,A          ; {HL = $A560[pitch] (half-period byte)
 $A53A LD H,$00        ;
 $A53C LD DE,$A560     ;
 $A53F ADD HL,DE       ; }
 $A540 LD DE,$0148     ;
 $A543 LD C,(HL)       ; C = half-period
 $A544 LD A,$10        ; {shadow A = $10 (speaker toggle mask)
 $A546 EX AF,AF'       ; }
 $A547 LD B,$10        ; {B = $10 (half-period reload), L = C
 $A549 LD L,C          ; }
*$A54A DEC L           ; {count down one half-period
 $A54B JR NZ,$A559     ; }
 $A54D EX AF,AF'       ; {toggle speaker (XOR mask via shadow AF)
 $A54E XOR B           ;
 $A54F OUT ($FE),A     ;
 $A551 EX AF,AF'       ; }
 $A552 LD L,C          ; L = C (reload half-period)
*$A553 DEC DE          ; {outer duration -= 1; done? RET
 $A554 LD A,D          ;
 $A555 OR E            ;
 $A556 JR NZ,$A54A     ;
 $A558 RET             ; }
*$A559 OR $00          ; {T-state padding (balance the two branch paths)
 $A55B BIT 0,A         ;
 $A55D JP $A553        ; }
 $A560 DEFM "fa[VQMHD" ;

b$A568 DEFB $40

 $A58D DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A595 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A59D DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A5A5 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A5AD DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A5B5 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
 $A5BD DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00

; Read input
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Proc_table[0]: sample controls into the signed input_x/input_y/input_fire
; vars.
; .
; Only active when game_mode (#R$6017) == 4 (in play) otherwise returns.
; .
; Reads the Kempston joystick and converts each axis to -1/0/+1 via bit tests +
; SBC/NEG.
; .
; The Specialist has no Kempston port -- replace read_joystick with the
; target's keyboard/joystick scan, keeping the -1/0/+1 result.
@label=read_input
c$A79F LD A,($6017)  ; A = game_mode (#R$6017)
 $A7A2 CP $04        ;
 $A7A4 JR NZ,$A7ED   ; only read controls while in play (mode 4)
 $A7A6 CALL $A7C8    ; A = raw joystick bits
 $A7A9 LD B,A        ;
 $A7AA AND $01       ;
 $A7AC SRL B         ;
 $A7AE SRL B         ;
 $A7B0 SBC A,$00     ;
 $A7B2 LD ($601D),A  ; input_y = -1/0/+1
 $A7B5 LD A,B        ;
 $A7B6 AND $01       ;
 $A7B8 SRL B         ;
 $A7BA SRL B         ;
 $A7BC SBC A,$00     ;
 $A7BE NEG           ;
 $A7C0 LD ($601E),A  ; input_fire = -1/0/+1 (negated)
 $A7C3 LD A,B        ;
 $A7C4 LD ($601C),A  ; input_x = -1/0/+1
 $A7C7 RET           ;

; Routine at A7C8
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A79F and #R$A840.
@label=read_joystick
c$A7C8 IN A,($1F)    ; read Kempston joystick port $1F (Z80 IN
 $A7CA AND $1F       ;
 $A7CC CP $1F        ; all 5 bits = nothing pressed
 $A7CE RET NZ        ;
 $A7CF XOR A         ;
 $A7D0 RET           ;

; Data block at A7D1
b$A7D1 DEFB $1D,$15,$19,$22,$0F,$12,$1A,$1E
 $A7D9 DEFB $25,$08,$24,$1C,$14,$0C,$04,$04
 $A7E1 DEFB $13,$03,$0B,$23,$D1,$A7,$D6,$A7
 $A7E9 DEFB $DB,$A7,$E0,$A7

; Scan control keys
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$A79F.
;
; .
;
; Read one 5-key control set into the flag array at $6018.
; .
; A selects the set: index a word-pointer table at $A7E5 (A*2) to a 5-byte
; key-id list, then test_key each one, storing 0/1 into $6018..#R$601C.
; .
; Used to read the redefinable keys.
; .
; In: A=set index.
; .
; Out: $6018[0..4] flags.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,DE,HL.
@label=scan_control_keys
c$A7ED ADD A,A       ;
 $A7EE LD L,A        ;
 $A7EF LD H,$00      ;
 $A7F1 LD DE,$A7E5   ;
 $A7F4 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A7F5 LD E,(HL)     ;
 $A7F6 INC HL        ;
 $A7F7 LD D,(HL)     ;
 $A7F8 LD HL,$6018   ;
 $A7FB LD B,$05      ;
*$A7FD LD A,(DE)     ;
 $A7FE CALL $A81F    ; Test key
 $A801 LD (HL),$00   ;
 $A803 JR Z,$A806    ;
 $A805 INC (HL)      ;
*$A806 INC HL        ;
 $A807 INC DE        ;
 $A808 DJNZ $A7FD    ;
 $A80A LD HL,$6018   ;
 $A80D LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A80E INC HL        ;
 $A80F SUB (HL)      ;
 $A810 INC HL        ;
 $A811 NEG           ;
 $A813 LD ($601D),A  ; set Signed input
 $A816 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A817 INC HL        ;
 $A818 SUB (HL)      ;
 $A819 NEG           ;
 $A81B LD ($601E),A  ; set Signed input
 $A81E RET           ;

; Test key
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$A7ED.
;
; .
;
; Is a specific key down?
; .
; (proc_table slot $A706.) In:  A = key id, encoded (row<<3 | column) into the
; ZX keyboard matrix.
; .
; Out: Z set (A=0) if the key is pressed.
; .
; Builds the half-row select on the address bus (A=$FE rotated <row> times so
; one of A8..A15 is low) and reads ULA port $FE rotates out <column> bits and
; tests the active-low key bit.
@label=test_key
c$A81F PUSH BC       ;
 $A820 LD C,A        ; C = key id
 $A821 AND $07       ; low 3 bits = column -> bit count
 $A823 INC A         ;
 $A824 LD B,A        ;
 $A825 SRL C         ; C >>= 3 -> row index
 $A827 SRL C         ;
 $A829 SRL C         ;
 $A82B LD A,$05      ;
 $A82D SUB C         ; 5 - row -> number of rotates for the row select
 $A82E LD C,A        ;
 $A82F LD A,$FE      ; A = $FE: one address line low selects a keyboard
                     ; half-row
*$A831 RRCA          ; rotate the low bit into the row position (DJNZ)
 $A832 DJNZ $A831    ;
 $A834 IN A,($FE)    ; read ULA keyboard port $FE (Z80 IN
*$A836 RRA           ; shift out columns
 $A837 DEC C         ;
 $A838 JR NZ,$A836   ;
 $A83A LD A,C        ;
 $A83B JR C,$A83E    ; carry set = not pressed -> A=1
 $A83D INC A         ;
*$A83E POP BC        ;
 $A83F RET           ;

; Poll any key
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Return NZ if ANY input is active: scans the five keyboard half-rows via IN
; ($FE) (CPL+AND $1F), and if none, tests the Kempston fire bit ($10).
; .
; Out: A/flags NZ = pressed.
@label=poll_any_key
c$A840 XOR A         ;
 $A841 IN A,($FE)    ;
 $A843 CPL           ;
 $A844 AND $1F       ;
 $A846 RET NZ        ;
 $A847 CALL $A7C8    ;
 $A84A AND $10       ;
 $A84C RET           ;
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$A700.
@label=wait_no_key
*$A84D CALL $A840    ; Poll any key
 $A850 JR NZ,$A84D   ;
 $A852 RET           ;

; Test break key
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Test the BREAK combination (CAPS SHIFT + SPACE) via two IN ($FE) row reads.
; .
; Returns with CARRY CLEAR only when both are held (used to abort).
; .
; Clobbers: A.
@label=test_break_key
c$A853 LD A,$7F      ;
 $A855 IN A,($FE)    ;
 $A857 RRA           ;
 $A858 RET C         ;
 $A859 LD A,$FE      ;
 $A85B IN A,($FE)    ;
 $A85D RRA           ;
 $A85E RET           ;

; Delay loop
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Busy-wait: B outer iterations of a ~$0086 inner countdown.
; .
; In: B=outer count.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL (HL preserved).
@label=delay_loop
c$A85F PUSH HL       ;
*$A860 LD HL,$0086   ;
*$A863 DEC HL        ;
 $A864 LD A,H        ;
 $A865 OR L          ;
 $A866 JR NZ,$A863   ;
 $A868 DJNZ $A860    ;
 $A86A POP HL        ;
 $A86B RET           ;

; Next random
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Pseudo-random generator.
; .
; Reads the 16-bit seed (#R$6002), applies a multiply/shift + add $0029 LCG
; step, writes the new seed back, and returns A = high byte.
; .
; Out: A=random byte, (#R$6002) advanced.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=next_random
c$A86C PUSH DE       ;
 $A86D PUSH HL       ;
 $A86E LD DE,($6002) ; get 16-bit LCG seed
 $A872 LD H,E        ;
 $A873 LD L,$00      ;
 $A875 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A876 EX DE,HL      ;
 $A877 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $A878 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $A879 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $A87A EX DE,HL      ;
 $A87B OR A          ;
 $A87C SBC HL,DE     ;
 $A87E LD DE,$0029   ;
 $A881 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $A882 LD ($6002),HL ; set 16-bit LCG seed
 $A885 LD A,H        ;
 $A886 POP HL        ;
 $A887 POP DE        ;
 $A888 RET           ;

; Save regs frame
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; HL value to keep available after the save O:HL same value
;
; Paired full CPU-context save/restore (called via proc_table). save_regs_frame
; swaps HL with the return address on entry (EX (SP),HL), pushes both main and
; shadow register sets plus IX/IY, then reads the caller's pushed HL parameter
; back out of the frame ($SP+$17) so it survives the register save.
; restore_regs_frame pops everything back in reverse and swaps the return
; address back with EX (SP),HL to resume normally.
; .
; Clobbers: none (by design -- the whole point is preserving all registers).
@label=save_regs_frame
c$A889 EX (SP),HL    ; {swap HL with the return address (stash it), save
 $A88A PUSH DE       ; DE/BC/AF
 $A88B PUSH BC       ;
 $A88C PUSH AF       ; }
 $A88D EX AF,AF'     ; {save the shadow register set (AF'/BC'/DE'/HL')
 $A88E EXX           ;
 $A88F PUSH HL       ;
 $A890 PUSH DE       ;
 $A891 PUSH BC       ;
 $A892 PUSH AF       ;
 $A893 EX AF,AF'     ;
 $A894 EXX           ; }
 $A895 PUSH IX       ; {save IX, IY, and the original HL parameter
 $A897 PUSH IY       ;
 $A899 PUSH HL       ;
 $A89A PUSH AF       ; }
 $A89B LD HL,$0017   ; {re-read the saved HL parameter from the frame
 $A89E ADD HL,SP     ;
 $A89F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $A8A0 DEC HL        ;
 $A8A1 LD L,(HL)     ;
 $A8A2 LD H,A        ;
 $A8A3 POP AF        ;
 $A8A4 RET           ; }

; Restore regs frame
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Pops all registers back in reverse order, then restores the true return
; address (EX (SP),HL) before returning.
@label=restore_regs_frame
c$A8A5 POP HL                       ; {restore HL, IY, IX
 $A8A6 POP IY                       ;
 $A8A8 POP IX                       ; }
 $A8AA EX AF,AF'                    ; {restore the shadow register set
 $A8AB EXX                          ;
 $A8AC POP AF                       ;
 $A8AD POP BC                       ;
 $A8AE POP DE                       ;
 $A8AF POP HL                       ;
 $A8B0 EX AF,AF'                    ;
 $A8B1 EXX                          ; }
 $A8B2 POP AF                       ; {restore AF, BC, DE
 $A8B3 POP BC                       ;
 $A8B4 POP DE                       ; }
 $A8B5 EX (SP),HL                   ; {swap the return address back, RET
 $A8B6 RET                          ; }

; Data block at A8D9
@label=attr_rle

; Setup attrs
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Paint the static playfield attribute layout and the two PLAYER score labels.
; .
; Run once at start (via jp_setup_attrs).
; .
; Reads attr_rle (9 run-length [count,attr] pairs) and floods the attribute
; area $5800+ with attr|$40 (BRIGHT set on every cell).
; .
; Then prints the PLAYER 1 / PLAYER 2 strings and seeds two score/counter
; widgets via helper calls.
; .
; In: nothing.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=setup_attrs
c$A8EB LD A,$FF      ; A = $FF
 $A8ED LD ($60C8),A  ; store $FF to a flag at #R$60C8
 $A8F0 LD HL,$A8D9   ; HL -> attr_rle (run-length attribute table)
 $A8F3 LD DE,$5800   ; DE -> $5800 = attribute area base
 $A8F6 LD C,$09      ; C = 9 outer groups
*$A8F8 LD B,(HL)     ; B = run length for this group
 $A8F9 INC HL        ;
 $A8FA LD A,(HL)     ; A = attribute byte for this group
 $A8FB OR $40        ; force BRIGHT bit ($40) on
 $A8FD INC HL        ;
*$A8FE LD (DE),A     ; write attr to cell
 $A8FF INC DE        ;
 $A900 DJNZ $A8FE    ;
 $A902 DEC C         ;
 $A903 JR NZ,$A8F8   ; next group until C groups done
 $A905 LD HL,$A8C7   ; HL -> 'PLAYER 1' string
 $A908 LD BC,$0000   ; BC = 0x0000 = attr/screen position arg
 $A90B CALL $AB53    ; Print string
 $A90E LD BC,$1800   ; BC = 0x1800 = position for 'PLAYER 2'
 $A911 CALL $AB53    ; Print string
 $A914 LD BC,$0900   ;
 $A917 LD A,$A8      ;
 $A919 CALL $AAC2    ;
 $A91C LD BC,$1600   ;
 $A91F LD A,$A7      ;
 $A921 CALL $AAC2    ;
 $A924 LD BC,$0002   ;
 $A927 CALL $A936    ; Draw HUD bar
 $A92A LD BC,$1802   ;
 $A92D CALL $A936    ; Draw HUD bar
 $A930 CALL $A943    ; Reset score state
 $A933 JP $A959      ; tail-jump into the next setup step

; Draw HUD bar
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8EB.
;
; .
;
; At the print position in BC, print 8 copies of glyph $81 (a solid block) --
; the score-panel divider bar.
; .
; In: BC=print pos.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B.
@label=draw_hud_bar
c$A936 CALL $AB7A    ; Set print pos
 $A939 LD A,$81      ;
 $A93B LD B,$08      ;
*$A93D CALL $AAC5    ; Print char
 $A940 DJNZ $A93D    ;
 $A942 RET           ;

; Reset score state
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$A8EB.
;
; .
;
; Init the score/lives HUD state for a new game: lives_p2 (#R$6041)=3, $6042=3,
; $60C2=0, and zero the 8-byte block $6043..$604A (the two 4-byte BCD score
; buffers).
; .
; Reached from proc_table slot $A721 (JP) and from $A930 (CALL, then falls
; through to draw_hud_counters).
@label=reset_score_state
c$A943 LD A,$03      ;
 $A945 LD ($6041),A  ; set Lives
 $A948 LD ($6042),A  ;
 $A94B XOR A         ;
 $A94C LD ($60C2),A  ;
 $A94F LD HL,$6043   ;
 $A952 LD B,$08      ;
*$A954 LD (HL),A     ;
 $A955 INC HL        ;
 $A956 DJNZ $A954    ;
 $A958 RET           ;

; Draw HUD counters

@label=draw_hud_counters

@label=print_score_field

@label=print_nibble

; Routine at A9AD
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A959.
@label=draw_gauge8
c$A9AD LD B,$08      ;
 $A9AF LD C,A        ;
*$A9B0 LD A,$00      ;

; Add BCD score
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; HL BCD delta to add
;
; Add HL (16-bit BCD delta) to the active player's 4-byte BCD score (lives_p1
; selects $6043 or $6047), with DAA carry propagation across all 4 bytes. Then
; tests the two upper BCD digits for two score milestones (nibble patterns
; $4_/$5_ and $9_) and, if crossed, awards an extra life via lives_p1/lives_p2
; (capped at 8).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,C,DE.
@label=add_bcd_score
c$A9BD LD DE,$6043   ; {DE = P1 score ($6043), or P2 ($6047) if lives_p1!=0
 $A9C0 LD A,($6040)  ;
 $A9C3 OR A          ;
 $A9C4 JR Z,$A9C9    ;
 $A9C6 LD DE,$6047   ; }
*$A9C9 LD A,(DE)     ; {byte0 += L, DAA, store advance to byte1
 $A9CA ADD A,L       ;
 $A9CB DAA           ;
 $A9CC LD (DE),A     ;
 $A9CD INC DE        ;
 $A9CE LD A,(DE)     ;
 $A9CF LD B,A        ;
 $A9D0 ADC A,H       ;
 $A9D1 DAA           ;
 $A9D2 LD (DE),A     ; }
 $A9D3 LD C,A        ; {stash byte1 in C, advance to byte2
 $A9D4 INC DE        ; }
 $A9D5 LD A,(DE)     ; {byte2 += carry, byte3 += carry (no further DAA)
 $A9D6 ADC A,$00     ;
 $A9D8 LD (DE),A     ;
 $A9D9 INC DE        ;
 $A9DA LD A,(DE)     ;
 $A9DB ADC A,$00     ;
 $A9DD LD (DE),A     ; }
 $A9DE LD A,B        ; {byte1's high nibble == $40?
 $A9DF AND $F0       ;
 $A9E1 CP $40        ;
 $A9E3 JR NZ,$A9EC   ; }
 $A9E5 LD A,C        ; {and byte2's high nibble == $50? -> award life
 $A9E6 AND $F0       ;
 $A9E8 CP $50        ;
 $A9EA JR Z,$A9F6    ; }
*$A9EC LD A,B        ; {else byte1's high nibble == $90? -> award life
 $A9ED AND $F0       ;
 $A9EF CP $90        ;
 $A9F1 RET NZ        ; }
 $A9F2 LD A,C        ; {else no milestone crossed -> RET
 $A9F3 AND $F0       ;
 $A9F5 RET NZ        ; }
*$A9F6 LD HL,$6041   ; {HL = lives_p1/lives_p2
 $A9F9 LD A,($6040)  ; }
 $A9FC OR A          ;
 $A9FD JR Z,$AA00    ;
 $A9FF INC HL        ;
*$AA00 INC (HL)      ; {increment lives, clamp to max 8
 $AA01 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA02 CP $08        ;
 $AA04 RET C         ;
 $AA05 LD (HL),$08   ;
 $AA07 RET           ; }

; Init bonus
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Seed the active player's (lives_p1 index) bonus/ accumulator block at $604B:
; bonus = BCD 0100, $604F-side cleared.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=init_bonus
c$AA08 LD HL,$604B   ; HL = $604B
 $AA0B LD A,($6040)  ; get Lives
 $AA0E OR A          ; {+2 to HL if player 2 active
 $AA0F JR Z,$AA13    ;
 $AA11 INC HL        ;
 $AA12 INC HL        ; }
*$AA13 LD (HL),$00   ; {clear byte; set next byte = $01 (BCD 0100 hi digit)
 $AA15 INC HL        ;
 $AA16 LD (HL),$01   ;
 $AA18 INC HL        ;
 $AA19 INC HL        ;
 $AA1A INC HL        ; }
 $AA1B LD (HL),$00   ; {clear remaining two bytes
 $AA1D INC HL        ;
 $AA1E LD (HL),$00   ; }
 $AA20 RET           ;

; Bonus sub
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; A BCD amount to subtract
;
; BCD-subtract A from the active player's bonus value ($604B, 2 bytes lives_p1
; selects P1/P2), clamping at 0 on underflow instead of wrapping negative.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL.
@label=bonus_sub
c$AA21 LD B,A        ; {B = amount; HL = P1 bonus, or P2 if lives_p1!=0
 $AA22 LD HL,$604B   ;
 $AA25 LD A,($6040)  ;
 $AA28 OR A          ;
 $AA29 JR Z,$AA2D    ;
 $AA2B INC HL        ;
 $AA2C INC HL        ; }
*$AA2D LD A,(HL)     ; {subtract B from the 2-byte BCD value (DAA both bytes)
 $AA2E SUB B         ;
 $AA2F DAA           ;
 $AA30 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA31 INC HL        ;
 $AA32 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA33 SBC A,$00     ;
 $AA35 DAA           ;
 $AA36 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $AA37 RET NC        ; no underflow -> RET
 $AA38 XOR A         ; {underflowed -> clamp both bytes to 0
 $AA39 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA3A DEC HL        ;
 $AA3B LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA3C RET           ; }

; Add to bonus field 604F
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; A BCD amount to add
;
; BCD-add A to the active player's 2-byte field at $604F (lives_p1 selects
; P1/P2), saturating: high byte hitting 6 resets to 05/low=00.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL.
@label=field_604f_add
c$AA3D LD B,A        ; {B = amount; HL = P1 field, or P2 if lives_p1!=0
 $AA3E LD HL,$604F   ;
 $AA41 LD A,($6040)  ;
 $AA44 OR A          ;
 $AA45 JR Z,$AA49    ;
 $AA47 INC HL        ;
 $AA48 INC HL        ; }
*$AA49 LD A,(HL)     ; {add B to the 2-byte BCD value (DAA both bytes)
 $AA4A ADD A,B       ;
 $AA4B DAA           ;
 $AA4C LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA4D INC HL        ;
 $AA4E LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA4F ADC A,$00     ;
 $AA51 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $AA52 CP $06        ; high byte hit the $06 cap?
 $AA54 RET C         ;
 $AA55 LD (HL),$05   ; {clamp to $0500
 $AA57 DEC HL        ;
 $AA58 LD (HL),$00   ; }
 $AA5A RET           ;

; Set level timer
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Load play_timer from the word table at #R$A8B7 indexed by (#R$6039)*2
; (per-level start time), then fall into #R$AA96 to show it.
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=set_level_timer
c$AA5B LD A,($6039)  ;
 $AA5E ADD A,A       ;
 $AA5F LD E,A        ;
 $AA60 LD D,$00      ;
 $AA62 LD HL,$A8B7   ;
 $AA65 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AA66 LD E,(HL)     ;
 $AA67 INC HL        ;
 $AA68 LD D,(HL)     ;
 $AA69 LD ($6053),DE ; set Level countdown timer
 $AA6D JP $AA96      ; => Draw timer

; Tick timer
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Prescaled level-timer countdown.
; .
; #R$6055 counts 0..4 only every 5th call does it BCD-decrement play_timer (2
; bytes, clamped at 0) and redraw via draw_timer.
; .
; RET M while prescaler is negative (timer disabled).
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=tick_timer
c$AA70 LD HL,$6055   ;
 $AA73 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA74 OR A          ;
 $AA75 RET M         ;
 $AA76 INC A         ;
 $AA77 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA78 CP $05        ;
 $AA7A RET C         ;
 $AA7B LD (HL),$00   ;
 $AA7D LD HL,$6053   ;
 $AA80 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA81 SUB $01       ;
 $AA83 DAA           ;
 $AA84 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA85 INC HL        ;
 $AA86 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AA87 SBC A,$00     ;
 $AA89 DAA           ;
 $AA8A LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA8B JP P,$AA96    ; => Draw timer
 $AA8E XOR A         ;
 $AA8F LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA90 DEC HL        ;
 $AA91 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AA92 DEC A         ;
 $AA93 LD ($6055),A  ; set Level timer prescaler

; Draw timer
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700, #R$AA5B and #R$AA70.
;
; .
;
; Print the 2-byte BCD play_timer ($6054) as decimal digits at print row $0E
; (white).
; .
; Uses print_2digits/print_digit.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,HL.
@label=draw_timer
c$AA96 LD A,$FF      ;
 $AA98 LD ($60C8),A  ; set Current text colour/attribute
 $AA9B LD BC,$0E00   ;
 $AA9E CALL $AB7A    ; Set print pos
 $AAA1 LD HL,$6054   ;
 $AAA4 CALL $AAA8    ;
 $AAA7 DEC HL        ;
@label=print_2digits
*$AAA8 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AAA9 RRA           ;
 $AAAA RRA           ;
 $AAAB RRA           ;
 $AAAC RRA           ;
 $AAAD CALL $AAB1    ;
 $AAB0 LD A,(HL)     ;
@label=print_digit
*$AAB1 AND $0F       ;
 $AAB3 ADD A,$30     ;
 $AAB5 JP $AAC5      ; => Print char

; Data block at AAB8
@label=punct_map
b$AAB8 DEFB $20,$00
 $AABA DEFM "<(>'"

; Data block at AABE
b$AABE DEFB $40,$26,$2A,$19,$CD,$7A,$AB

; Print char
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700, #R$A936, #R$A993, #R$AA96 and #R$AB53.
;
; .
;
; Render one character at the current text cursor.
; .
; In:  A = character code.
; .
; >=$80 : direct glyph index (graphics char), A&$7F.
; .
; 'A'..'Z' : glyph = (A-'A')+2.
; .
; '0'..'9' : glyph = (A-'0')+$1C.
; .
; <$10     : colour/attribute control code -> cur_color.
; .
; else     : looked up in punct_map.
; .
; cursor in print_cursor (#R$60C6 lo=col) cur_color (#R$60C8).
; .
; Out: glyph blitted to screen column cursor ($60C7) advanced.
@label=print_char
c$AAC5 PUSH AF       ; save all regs (caller-transparent)
 $AAC6 PUSH BC       ;
 $AAC7 PUSH DE       ;
 $AAC8 PUSH HL       ;
 $AAC9 BIT 7,A       ; bit7 set? -> direct graphics glyph index
 $AACB JR Z,$AAD1    ;
 $AACD AND $7F       ; strip bit7, use as glyph index
 $AACF JR $AB0F      ;
*$AAD1 CP $41        ; 'A'($41)..'Z'($5A)?
 $AAD3 JR C,$AADF    ;
 $AAD5 CP $5B        ;
 $AAD7 JR NC,$AADF   ;
 $AAD9 SUB $41       ; glyph = (A-'A') + 2  (letters start at glyph 2)
 $AADB ADD A,$02     ;
 $AADD JR $AB0F      ;
*$AADF CP $30        ; '0'($30)..'9'($39)?
 $AAE1 JR C,$AAED    ;
 $AAE3 CP $3A        ;
 $AAE5 JR NC,$AAED   ;
 $AAE7 SUB $30       ; glyph = (A-'0') + $1C  (digits start at glyph $1C)
 $AAE9 ADD A,$1C     ;
 $AAEB JR $AB0F      ;
*$AAED CP $10        ; code <$10? -> colour control code
 $AAEF JR NC,$AAFF   ;
 $AAF1 LD B,A        ;
 $AAF2 AND $07       ; ink = A & 7
 $AAF4 BIT 3,B       ; bit3 of code = BRIGHT -> OR $40
 $AAF6 JR Z,$AAFA    ;
 $AAF8 OR $40        ;
*$AAFA LD ($60C8),A  ; store into cur_color (#R$60C8)
 $AAFD JR $AB4E      ;
*$AAFF LD HL,$AAB8   ; HL -> punct_map (5 entries)
 $AB02 LD B,$05      ;
*$AB04 CP (HL)       ; compare code against each map char
 $AB05 JR Z,$AB0D    ;
 $AB07 INC HL        ;
 $AB08 INC HL        ;
 $AB09 DJNZ $AB04    ;
 $AB0B JR $AB4E      ;
*$AB0D INC HL        ;
 $AB0E LD A,(HL)     ; matched: A = glyph index from map
@label=glyph_addr
*$AB0F LD L,A        ; L = glyph index
 $AB10 ADD A,A       ; A = index*6 via index + index*2, then *2 (6 bytes/glyph)
 $AB11 ADD A,L       ;
 $AB12 ADD A,A       ;
 $AB13 LD L,A        ; HL = index*6
 $AB14 LD H,$00      ;
 $AB16 LD DE,$C000   ; DE = #R$C000 = font base
 $AB19 ADD HL,DE     ; HL -> glyph bitmap (6 bytes)
 $AB1A PUSH HL       ;
 $AB1B LD BC,($60C6) ; BC = print_cursor (C=column 0..31)
@label=glyph_blit
 $AB1F LD A,C        ; A = column
 $AB20 AND $18       ; H = (col & $18) | $40 : screen-addr high byte
                     ; (third+page)
 $AB22 LD H,A        ;
 $AB23 SET 6,H       ;
 $AB25 RRCA          ;
 $AB26 RRCA          ;
 $AB27 RRCA          ;
 $AB28 OR $58        ; OR $58 -> D = matching attribute-area high byte ($58xx)
 $AB2A LD D,A        ;
 $AB2B LD A,C        ;
 $AB2C AND $07       ;
 $AB2E RRCA          ;
 $AB2F RRCA          ;
 $AB30 RRCA          ;
 $AB31 ADD A,B       ;
 $AB32 LD L,A        ;
 $AB33 LD E,A        ;
 $AB34 LD A,($60C8)  ; A = cur_color
 $AB37 CP $FF        ; $FF = 'transparent' -> skip attribute write
 $AB39 JR Z,$AB3C    ;
 $AB3B LD (DE),A     ; write colour to attribute cell
*$AB3C POP DE        ;
 $AB3D LD (HL),$00   ; blank top scanline of the cell
 $AB3F INC H         ; INC H = step down one pixel row (Z80 ZX adjacency)
 $AB40 LD B,$06      ; B = 6 font rows
*$AB42 LD A,(DE)     ; copy one font row to screen
 $AB43 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AB44 INC DE        ;
 $AB45 INC H         ;
 $AB46 DJNZ $AB42    ;
 $AB48 LD (HL),$00   ; blank bottom scanline
 $AB4A LD HL,$60C7   ;
 $AB4D INC (HL)      ; advance column cursor ($60C7)
*$AB4E POP HL        ;
 $AB4F POP DE        ;
 $AB50 POP BC        ;
 $AB51 POP AF        ;
 $AB52 RET           ;

; Print string
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A8EB.
;
; .
;
; Print an ASCIIZ string at position BC.
; .
; In: HL=string (00-terminated), BC=cursor pos.
; .
; Out: HL past terminator.
@label=print_string
c$AB53 CALL $AB7A    ; set cursor = BC
; This entry point is used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$AB5F.
@label=print_string_loop
*$AB56 LD A,(HL)     ; A = next char
 $AB57 INC HL        ;
 $AB58 OR A          ; 00 terminator?
 $AB59 RET Z         ; done (ASCIIZ) -- RET on Z
 $AB5A CALL $AAC5    ; Print char
 $AB5D JR $AB56      ; next char

; Print centered
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
@label=print_centered
c$AB5F PUSH HL       ;
 $AB60 LD C,$00      ; C = visible-char count
*$AB62 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AB63 OR A          ;
 $AB64 JR Z,$AB6E    ;
 $AB66 CP $10        ; ignore codes <$10 (colour controls) in the count
 $AB68 JR C,$AB6B    ;
 $AB6A INC C         ;
*$AB6B INC HL        ;
 $AB6C JR $AB62      ;
*$AB6E LD A,$20      ; A = 32 - count
 $AB70 SUB C         ;
 $AB71 RRA           ; RRA = /2 = left margin
 $AB72 LD ($60C7),A  ; store as start column ($60C7)
 $AB75 POP HL        ;
 $AB76 CALL $AB56    ;
 $AB79 RET           ;

; Set print pos
