; Used by the routines at #R$A700, #R$A936, #R$A993, #R$AA96 and #R$AB53.
@label=set_print_pos
c$AB7A LD ($60C6),BC ;
 $AB7E RET           ;

; Clear obj table
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Zero the $6460 strip-buffer scratch area used by calc_tower_col_addr: 20
; entries, each two 3-byte fields (a $0D-byte gap apart).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,DE,HL.
@label=clear_obj_table
c$AB7F LD HL,$6460   ; {HL = $6460; DE = $0D (field gap); B = 20 entries
 $AB82 LD DE,$000D   ;
 $AB85 LD B,$14      ;
 $AB87 XOR A         ; }
*$AB88 LD (HL),A     ; {zero 3 bytes (first field)
 $AB89 INC HL        ;
 $AB8A LD (HL),A     ;
 $AB8B INC HL        ;
 $AB8C LD (HL),A     ; }
 $AB8D ADD HL,DE     ; skip the gap
 $AB8E LD (HL),A     ; {zero 3 bytes (second field)
 $AB8F INC HL        ;
 $AB90 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AB91 INC HL        ;
 $AB92 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AB93 INC HL        ; }
 $AB94 DJNZ $AB88    ; loop 20 entries
 $AB96 RET           ;

; Calc tower col addr
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Compute a byte address inside the $6400 tower/column buffer from disp_height
; (&7, *24) and scroll_pos, returning the slot pointer(s) for column rendering.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=calc_tower_col_addr
c$AB97 LD A,($6032)  ; {row offset = (disp_height&7)*24 into $6400
 $AB9A AND $07       ;
 $AB9C LD B,A        ;
 $AB9D ADD A,A       ;
 $AB9E ADD A,B       ;
 $AB9F ADD A,A       ;
 $ABA0 ADD A,A       ; }
 $ABA1 LD C,A        ;
 $ABA2 LD B,$00      ;
 $ABA4 LD HL,$6400   ;
 $ABA7 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $ABA8 EX DE,HL      ;
 $ABA9 ADD A,$30     ; {column offset, wrapped mod $60 (96)
 $ABAB CP $60        ;
 $ABAD JR C,$ABB1    ;
 $ABAF SUB $60       ; }
*$ABB1 LD C,A        ;
 $ABB2 LD HL,$6400   ; {HL -> $6400+offset (primary column pointer)
 $ABB5 ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $ABB6 LD A,($6030)  ; get Vertical scroll position
 $ABB9 AND $04       ; {scroll_pos bit2 selects HL/DE swap
 $ABBB JR NZ,$ABBE   ;
 $ABBD EX DE,HL      ; }
*$ABBE PUSH DE       ; {copy 2x12-byte snapshot from HL/DE into $6463/$6475
 $ABBF LD DE,$6463   ; scratch
 $ABC2 LDI           ;
 $ABC4 LDI           ;
 $ABC6 LDI           ;
 $ABC8 LDI           ;
 $ABCA LDI           ;
 $ABCC LDI           ;
 $ABCE LDI           ;
 $ABD0 LDI           ;
 $ABD2 LDI           ;
 $ABD4 LDI           ;
 $ABD6 LDI           ;
 $ABD8 LDI           ;
 $ABDA LD DE,$6475   ;
 $ABDD POP HL        ;
 $ABDE LDI           ;
 $ABE0 LDI           ;
 $ABE2 LDI           ;
 $ABE4 LDI           ;
 $ABE6 LDI           ;
 $ABE8 LDI           ;
 $ABEA LDI           ;
 $ABEC LDI           ;
 $ABEE LDI           ;
 $ABF0 LDI           ;
 $ABF2 LDI           ;
 $ABF4 LDI           ; }
 $ABF6 LD HL,$6463   ; {HL/DE -> $6463/$6487, A=$12 repeat count
 $ABF9 LD DE,$6487   ;
 $ABFC LD A,$12      ; }
*$ABFE LDI           ; {duplicate the 24-byte snapshot forward (stride 12) to
 $AC00 LDI           ; extend the strip buffer
 $AC02 LDI           ;
 $AC04 LDI           ;
 $AC06 LDI           ;
 $AC08 LDI           ;
 $AC0A LDI           ;
 $AC0C LDI           ;
 $AC0E LDI           ;
 $AC10 LDI           ;
 $AC12 LDI           ;
 $AC14 LDI           ;
 $AC16 LD BC,$0006   ;
 $AC19 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $AC1A EX DE,HL      ;
 $AC1B ADD HL,BC     ;
 $AC1C EX DE,HL      ;
 $AC1D DEC A         ;
 $AC1E JP NZ,$ABFE   ;
 $AC21 RET           ; }

; Col visible offset
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Compute the on-screen column offset of the object at #R$60BA relative to
; scroll_pos, folded into the 4-quadrant (mod $03) tower wrap.
; .
; Returns A=offset (RET Z if off-screen).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,DE,HL.
@label=col_visible_offset
c$AC22 LD HL,($60BA) ; {HL = object position ($60BA), biased and wrapped mod 4
 $AC25 LD A,L        ;
 $AC26 SUB $28       ;
 $AC28 LD L,A        ;
 $AC29 LD A,H        ;
 $AC2A SBC A,$00     ;
 $AC2C AND $03       ;
 $AC2E LD H,A        ; }
 $AC2F LD B,$00      ;
 $AC31 LD DE,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $AC35 LD A,L        ; {delta = position - scroll_pos
 $AC36 SUB E         ;
 $AC37 LD L,A        ;
 $AC38 LD A,H        ;
 $AC39 SBC A,D       ;
 $AC3A AND $03       ; }
 $AC3C CP $02        ;
 $AC3E LD A,L        ;
 $AC3F JR C,$AC44    ;
 $AC41 DEC B         ;
 $AC42 NEG           ;
*$AC44 OR A          ; {zero delta -> RET (off-screen)
 $AC45 RET Z         ; }
 $AC46 ADD A,$03     ; {fold delta to an on-screen column offset
 $AC48 SRL A         ; }
 $AC4A SRL A         ;
 $AC4C BIT 7,B       ;
 $AC4E JR Z,$AC52    ;
 $AC50 NEG           ;
*$AC52 LD HL,$6030   ; {apply the offset back into scroll_pos, wrapped mod 4
 $AC55 ADD A,(HL)    ;
 $AC56 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AC57 LD A,B        ;
 $AC58 INC HL        ;
 $AC59 ADC A,(HL)    ;
 $AC5A AND $03       ;
 $AC5C LD (HL),A     ; }
 $AC5D RET           ;

; Blit scroll wrap
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; When scroll_pos has wrapped past the top (H==$03 && L>=$D8), fast-fill the
; newly exposed strip using the LD SP,screen / stack-write trick (saves real SP
; to #R$6000, DI, reads mask_acb0). RET early when no wrap is pending.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=blit_scroll_wrap
c$AC5E LD HL,($6030) ; {get scroll_pos; not wrapped past the top -> RET
 $AC61 LD A,H        ;
 $AC62 CP $03        ;
 $AC64 RET NZ        ; }
 $AC65 LD A,L        ; {low byte before the wrap point ($D8)? -> RET
 $AC66 CP $D8        ;
 $AC68 RET C         ; }
 $AC69 XOR A         ; {overshoot = 2*(-L) (rows exposed by the wrap)
 $AC6A SUB L         ;
 $AC6B SUB L         ;
 $AC6C PUSH AF       ; }
 $AC6D LD B,A        ; {row = $B8 - overshoot
 $AC6E LD A,$B8      ;
 $AC70 SUB B         ;
 $AC71 LD H,A        ;
 $AC72 LD L,$1E      ; }
 $AC74 CALL $B5D9    ; Get screen addr
 $AC77 POP AF        ;
 $AC78 LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $AC7C DI            ; {DI; DE -> mask_acb0
 $AC7D LD DE,$ACB0   ; }
*$AC80 EX AF,AF'     ; {redirect SP to the screen address
 $AC81 LD SP,HL      ;
 $AC82 EX DE,HL      ; }
 $AC83 LD C,(HL)     ; {C = mask byte; B = C (fill value)
 $AC84 INC HL        ;
 $AC85 LD B,C        ; }
 $AC86 PUSH BC       ; {push BC 14x -- masked-fill one row via the stack
 $AC87 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC88 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC89 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8A PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8B PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8C PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8D PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8E PUSH BC       ;
 $AC8F PUSH BC       ;
 $AC90 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC91 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC92 PUSH BC       ;
 $AC93 PUSH BC       ; }
 $AC94 EX DE,HL      ; {restore HL, step down one pixel row
 $AC95 INC H         ; }
 $AC96 LD A,H        ; {wrap to the next screen row (char-cell boundary)
 $AC97 AND $07       ;
 $AC99 JR NZ,$ACA5   ;
 $AC9B LD A,L        ;
 $AC9C ADD A,$20     ;
 $AC9E LD L,A        ;
 $AC9F JR C,$ACA5    ;
 $ACA1 LD A,H        ;
 $ACA2 SUB $08       ;
 $ACA4 LD H,A        ; }
*$ACA5 EX AF,AF'     ; {loop remaining rows (A = row counter)
 $ACA6 DEC A         ;
 $ACA7 JP NZ,$AC80   ; }
 $ACAA LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $ACAE EI            ; {EI; RET
 $ACAF RET           ; }

; Data block at ACB0
@label=mask_acb0
b$ACB0 DEFB $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$20,$00
 $ACB8 DEFB $08,$00,$40,$00,$02,$20,$00,$01
 $ACC0 DEFB $80,$04,$20,$08,$40,$02,$10,$01
 $ACC8 DEFB $88,$22,$44,$11,$88,$22,$44,$11
 $ACD0 DEFB $92,$25,$92,$45,$8A,$51,$A2,$51
 $ACD8 DEFB $55,$AA,$55,$AA,$55,$AA,$55,$AA
 $ACE0 DEFB $6D,$DA,$6D,$BA,$75,$AE,$5D,$AE
 $ACE8 DEFB $77,$DD,$BB,$EE,$77,$DD,$BB,$EE
 $ACF0 DEFB $7F,$FB,$DF,$F7,$BF,$FD,$EF,$FE
 $ACF8 DEFB $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

; Clear object list near scroll seam
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Called every frame from render_play_frame, before setup_tower_scroll.
; .
; Reads scroll_pos and checks whether it is near the tower's top or bottom wrap
; seam (two symmetric branches on the high byte, biased by +$15/+$13 and
; compared against the $603A level-column threshold). If near an edge, computes
; an overshoot count C and zero-fills C*9 bytes at $6460+ -- clearing stale
; object/sprite-list entries that would otherwise linger once the visible
; column range shrinks near the seam. If not near an edge (C==0), returns
; immediately.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=code_ad00
c$AD00 LD C,$00      ; C = 0 (default: no overshoot)
 $AD02 LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $AD05 LD A,H        ; {near the top seam (H==3)?
 $AD06 CP $03        ;
 $AD08 JR NZ,$AD23   ; }
 $AD0A LD A,L        ; {low byte far from the wrap point ($D8)? skip
 $AD0B CP $D8        ;
 $AD0D JR C,$AD23    ; }
 $AD0F LD A,L        ; {fold scroll_pos to a coarse row (>>2)
 $AD10 SRL H         ;
 $AD12 RRA           ;
 $AD13 SRL H         ;
 $AD15 RRA           ; }
 $AD16 ADD A,$15     ; bias by $15 (top-seam offset)
 $AD18 LD HL,$603A   ;
 $AD1B CP (HL)       ; compare vs level-column threshold ($603A)
 $AD1C JR C,$AD35    ;
 $AD1E DEC A         ; {overshoot = row-1 - threshold
 $AD1F SUB (HL)      ;
 $AD20 JP $AD34      ; }
*$AD23 LD A,L        ; {bottom-seam mirror: fold, bias by $13, compare
 $AD24 SRL H         ;
 $AD26 RRA           ;
 $AD27 SRL H         ;
 $AD29 RRA           ;
 $AD2A ADD A,$13     ;
 $AD2C LD HL,$603A   ;
 $AD2F CP (HL)       ; }
 $AD30 JR C,$AD35    ;
 $AD32 INC A         ;
 $AD33 SUB (HL)      ;
*$AD34 LD C,A        ;
*$AD35 LD A,C        ; {A = overshoot count; none -> RET
 $AD36 OR A          ;
 $AD37 RET Z         ; }
 $AD38 PUSH AF       ;
 $AD39 ADD A,A       ; {count*9 -> BC (9 bytes per overshoot unit)
 $AD3A ADD A,A       ;
 $AD3B ADD A,A       ;
 $AD3C ADD A,C       ;
 $AD3D ADD A,A       ;
 $AD3E LD C,A        ; }
 $AD3F LD B,$00      ;
 $AD41 DEC BC        ;
 $AD42 LD HL,$6460   ;
 $AD45 LD DE,$6461   ;
 $AD48 LD (HL),$00   ; seed first byte = 0
 $AD4A LDIR          ; LDIR: zero-fill BC bytes at $6460 (stale slot cleanup)
 $AD4C POP AF        ;
 $AD4D RET           ;

; Anim bg phase
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Advance the background animation phase counter ($603D) on the wrap point
; reload $603C with $08 (animation restart).
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=anim_bg_phase
c$AD4E LD HL,$603D   ;
 $AD51 INC (HL)      ;
 $AD52 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AD53 ADD A,A       ;
 $AD54 AND $18       ;
 $AD56 CP $18        ;
 $AD58 JR NZ,$AD5C   ;
 $AD5A LD A,$08      ;
*$AD5C LD ($603C),A  ;
 $AD5F RET           ;

; Data block at AD60
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Self-modified scratch, not pure data: #R$AD60/$AD61 are 1-byte accumulators
; seeded by setup_tower_scroll ($ADA1/$ADAF) with a row-start bias and a fine
; row offset, then incremented every pass of setup_tower_scroll's row loop
; ($AE6E-$AE81) by table bytes stored at $AD62..$AD80 (16 rows x 2-byte deltas)
; -- i.e. a per-row coarse/fine screen-row stepping table, not just static
; data.
b$AD60 DEFB $00,$00,$FF,$F8,$FF,$F8,$FF,$F8
 $AD68 DEFB $04,$20,$01,$08,$01,$08,$01,$08
 $AD70 DEFB $F8,$C0,$FF,$F8,$FF,$F8,$FF,$F8
 $AD78 DEFB $FC,$E0,$01,$08,$01,$08,$01,$08
 $AD80 DEFB $00,$00

; Setup tower scroll
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Per-frame scroll/render setup.
; .
; Clears the object table, derives the coarse column ($ADC6) and sub-column
; fraction ($6021) from scroll_pos, and the row base ($AD61) from disp_height.
; .
; SELF-MODIFIES the render code ($ADC6/$AD61) and latches $6021 for
; draw_tower_cols.
; .
; Runs a 16-row loop ($ADB8..$AE85): for each row it reads two per-column-cell
; nibbles from map data at #R$6200+DE / $6280+DE, classifies the cell
; (bit-pattern tests at $AE21-$AE67) and jumps to one of the masked-blit
; handlers below (#R$AEBB/#R$AF2A/#R$AF86/#R$AFD0/#R$B03F) or straight to the
; row-accumulator advance at $AE6D. Each handler returns to the common
; continuation $AE18 (advance HL by -$12, DJNZ loop) before the next row.
; .
; Clobbers: A,C,HL.
@label=setup_tower_scroll
c$AD82 CALL $AB7F    ; clear object table (calc_tower_col_addr's prep)
 $AD85 LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $AD88 LD A,L        ;
 $AD89 SRL H         ; shift scroll_pos right by 3 (coarse column)
 $AD8B RRA           ;
 $AD8C SRL H         ;
 $AD8E RRA           ;
 $AD8F LD ($ADC6),A  ; self-mod store: coarse column ($ADC6)
 $AD92 LD A,L        ;
 $AD93 AND $03       ; isolate sub-column fraction bits
 $AD95 ADD A,A       ;
 $AD96 LD ($6021),A  ; latch sub-column phase ($6021)
 $AD99 LD A,($6032)  ; get Display height
 $AD9C LD C,A        ;
 $AD9D AND $07       ; isolate row-in-cell bits (disp_height&7)
 $AD9F ADD A,$58     ; bias by $58 (attribute-row base)
 $ADA1 LD ($AD61),A  ; self-mod store: row base ($AD61)
 $ADA4 SRL C         ; C = disp_height >> 3 (coarse row)
 $ADA6 SRL C         ;
 $ADA8 SRL C         ;
 $ADAA LD A,$0B      ; A = $0B - coarse row
 $ADAC SUB C         ;
 $ADAD AND $0F       ; mask to 4 bits
 $ADAF LD ($AD60),A  ; self-mod store: row accumulator (#R$AD60)
 $ADB2 EXX           ;
 $ADB3 LD B,$00      ; B = 0 (row counter)
 $ADB5 LD HL,$AD62   ; HL -> per-row delta table ($AD62)
*$ADB8 LD A,B        ; A = row counter
 $ADB9 CP $08        ; {row==8? recompute column addr mid-loop
 $ADBB JP NZ,$ADC5   ; }
 $ADBE PUSH BC       ;
 $ADBF PUSH HL       ;
 $ADC0 CALL $AB97    ; Calc tower col addr
 $ADC3 POP HL        ;
 $ADC4 POP BC        ;
*$ADC5 LD E,$00      ; E = 0 (cell index low)
 $ADC7 LD A,($AD60)  ; {D = row accumulator + $F0 (map page)
 $ADCA ADD A,$F0     ; }
 $ADCC LD D,A        ;
 $ADCD EXX           ;
 $ADCE LD A,($AD61)  ; {E = column fraction (map offset low)
 $ADD1 LD E,A        ; }
 $ADD2 LD D,$00      ;
 $ADD4 LD HL,$6200   ; {HL -> #R$6200 + column (cell type table 1)
 $ADD7 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $ADD8 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $ADD9 OR A          ; {negative? -> $AE6D (empty cell, skip)
 $ADDA JP M,$AE6D    ; }
 $ADDD SRL A         ; {shift cell nibble right 2
 $ADDF SRL A         ; }
 $ADE1 LD ($AE35),A  ; {self-mod: patch two render-handler operands
 $ADE4 LD ($AE4B),A  ; }
 $ADE7 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = cell byte again, mask low 2 bits
 $ADE8 AND $03       ; }
 $ADEA LD ($AF2D),A  ; {self-mod: patch two more render-handler operands
 $ADED LD ($AFD3),A  ; }
 $ADF0 LD HL,$6280   ; {HL -> $6280 + column (cell type table 2)
 $ADF3 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $ADF4 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $ADF5 OR A          ;
 $ADF6 JP M,$ADFD    ; negative? skip the shift
 $ADF9 SRL A         ; shift cell nibble right 2
 $ADFB SRL A         ;
*$ADFD LD ($AE40),A  ; {self-mod: patch two render-handler operands
 $AE00 LD ($AE58),A  ; }
 $AE03 LD A,(HL)     ; {A = 2nd cell byte, mask low 2 bits
 $AE04 AND $03       ; }
 $AE06 LD ($AF89),A  ; {self-mod: patch two more render-handler operands
 $AE09 LD ($B044),A  ; }
 $AE0C LD B,$14      ; B = $14 (20 sub-cells to classify)
 $AE0E LD HL,$65B6   ; HL -> classification bitmap ($65B6)
*$AE11 EXX           ; {fetch next classification bit
 $AE12 LD A,(DE)     ;
 $AE13 INC E         ;
 $AE14 EXX           ; }
 $AE15 ADD A,A       ; shift bit into carry
 $AE16 JR C,$AE21    ;
; This entry point is used by the routines at #R$AEBB, #R$AF2A, #R$AF86,
; #R$AFD0 and #R$B03F.
*$AE18 LD DE,$FFEE   ; DE = -$12 (back up dest ptr)
 $AE1B ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AE1C DJNZ $AE11    ; loop 20 sub-cells
 $AE1E JP $AE6D      ;
*$AE21 RRA           ; shift in the next bit
 $AE22 LD C,A        ; C = classification byte so far
 $AE23 AND $0C       ; test bits $0C (cell sub-type)
 $AE25 JR Z,$AE2B    ;
 $AE27 BIT 0,C       ; test bit 0 of C
 $AE29 JR NZ,$AE4A   ;
*$AE2B LD A,C        ;
 $AE2C AND $03       ; mask to bits 0-1
 $AE2E SRL A         ; shift right (test bit 0)
 $AE30 JR NZ,$AE55   ; nonzero -> $AE55 (anim-texture case)
 $AE32 JR NC,$AE3F   ; no carry -> $AE3F (cap-b case)
 $AE34 LD DE,$0000   ; self-mod operand for the handler call
 $AE37 BIT 7,E       ; test bit 7 of E
 $AE39 JP Z,$AF2A    ; dispatch -> render_col_cap_a
 $AE3C JP $AE18      ;
*$AE3F LD DE,$0000   ;
 $AE42 BIT 7,E       ;
 $AE44 JP Z,$AF86    ; => Render col cap b
 $AE47 JP $AE18      ;
*$AE4A LD DE,$0000   ;
 $AE4D BIT 7,E       ;
 $AE4F JP Z,$AFD0    ; => Render col fill
 $AE52 JP $AE18      ;
*$AE55 JR C,$AE62    ; carry set -> $AE62 (partial-column case)
 $AE57 LD DE,$0000   ;
 $AE5A BIT 7,E       ;
 $AE5C JP Z,$B03F    ; => Render anim texture
 $AE5F JP $AE18      ;
*$AE62 LD A,($AD61)  ; A = row base
 $AE65 CP $40        ; compare vs $40 (screen-half boundary)
 $AE67 JP C,$AEBB    ; dispatch -> render_col_partial
 $AE6A JP $AE18      ;
*$AE6D EXX           ; EXX back to main register set
 $AE6E LD A,($AD60)  ; A = row accumulator
 $AE71 ADD A,(HL)    ; {add per-row delta, wrap to 4 bits
 $AE72 AND $0F       ; }
 $AE74 LD ($AD60),A  ; store updated row accumulator
 $AE77 INC HL        ;
 $AE78 LD A,($AD61)  ; A = fine row offset
 $AE7B ADD A,(HL)    ; {add per-row delta, wrap to 7 bits
 $AE7C AND $7F       ; }
 $AE7E LD ($AD61),A  ; store updated fine row offset
 $AE81 INC HL        ;
 $AE82 INC B         ; B++ (row counter)
 $AE83 BIT 4,B       ; done all 16 rows?
 $AE85 JP Z,$ADB8    ;
 $AE88 RET           ;

; Data block at AE89
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 24-entry (2 bytes each) AND/OR mask-pair table: "AND clear old bits, OR in
; new bits" merge masks for column pixel bytes that don't align to a whole
; screen byte (edge-clipped column tops/bottoms). Read by the handler at
; #R$AEBB.
@label=col_blit_masks
b$AE89 DEFB $FF,$00,$FC,$02,$F3,$08,$F0,$0A
 $AE91 DEFB $CF,$20,$CC,$00,$C3,$28,$C0,$22
 $AE99 DEFB $3F,$80,$3C,$00,$33,$00,$30,$00
 $AEA1 DEFB $0F,$A0,$0C,$00,$03,$88,$00,$82
 $AEA9 DEFB $00,$80,$C0,$20,$F0,$08,$FC,$02
 $AEB1 DEFB $3F,$80,$0F,$20,$03,$08,$00,$02
 $AEB9 DEFB $00,$00

; Render col partial
;
; Used by the routine at #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; One of setup_tower_scroll's five per-cell render handlers -- the
; "partial/short column" case.
; .
; Looks up a length adjustment (table $6300) and an edge-type value (table
; $6340) indexed by the column (DE), computes and self-mod-stores a destination
; pointer ($AEB9), then masked-merges the destination byte(s) using mask pairs
; picked from col_blit_masks (#R$AE89, 16-entry branch for tall/negative case)
; or from a second 4-entry table at $AEA9 (short/positive case), plus a run of
; up to 3 plain-store bytes and a final 2-entry table ($AEB1) merge.
; .
; Ends by jumping back to setup_tower_scroll's row loop continuation ($AE18).
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=render_col_partial
c$AEBB PUSH BC       ; {DE=A; HL -> length table $6300+DE
 $AEBC PUSH HL       ;
 $AEBD LD E,A        ;
 $AEBE LD D,$00      ;
 $AEC0 LD HL,$6300   ;
 $AEC3 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $AEC4 LD A,(HL)     ; {length+3 -> destination byte offset
 $AEC5 ADD A,$03     ;
 $AEC7 LD C,A        ;
 $AEC8 LD B,$00      ;
 $AECA POP HL        ;
 $AECB PUSH HL       ;
 $AECC ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $AECD LD ($AEB9),HL ; self-mod store: destination pointer ($AEB9)
 $AED0 LD HL,$6340   ; {HL -> edge-type table $6340+DE
 $AED3 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AED4 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AED5 OR A          ; }
 $AED6 JP P,$AEEF    ; sign bit set? -> short/positive branch
 $AED9 AND $0F       ; {tall branch: index col_blit_masks (#R$AE89) by
 $AEDB ADD A,A       ; (type&$0F)*2
 $AEDC LD E,A        ;
 $AEDD LD HL,$AE89   ;
 $AEE0 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AEE1 LD DE,($AEB9) ; }
 $AEE5 LD A,(DE)     ; {AND/OR merge one byte, restore regs, return
 $AEE6 AND (HL)      ;
 $AEE7 INC HL        ;
 $AEE8 OR (HL)       ;
 $AEE9 LD (DE),A     ;
 $AEEA POP HL        ;
 $AEEB POP BC        ;
 $AEEC JP $AE18      ; }
*$AEEF LD C,A        ; {short branch: index 2nd mask table $AEA9 by (type&3)*2
 $AEF0 AND $03       ;
 $AEF2 ADD A,A       ;
 $AEF3 LD E,A        ;
 $AEF4 LD HL,$AEA9   ;
 $AEF7 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $AEF8 LD DE,($AEB9) ; }
 $AEFC LD A,(DE)     ; {AND/OR merge first byte, advance DE
 $AEFD AND (HL)      ;
 $AEFE INC HL        ;
 $AEFF OR (HL)       ;
 $AF00 LD (DE),A     ;
 $AF01 INC DE        ; }
 $AF02 LD A,C        ; {C = type; test bits $30 (extra-byte count)
 $AF03 AND $30       ; }
 $AF05 JR Z,$AF15    ;
 $AF07 CP $20        ; {write 0/1/2 plain bytes depending on $30 bits
 $AF09 LD A,$00      ;
 $AF0B JR C,$AF13    ;
 $AF0D JR Z,$AF11    ;
 $AF0F LD (DE),A     ;
 $AF10 INC DE        ;
*$AF11 LD (DE),A     ;
 $AF12 INC DE        ;
*$AF13 LD (DE),A     ;
 $AF14 INC DE        ; }
*$AF15 LD A,C        ; {C = (type>>1)&$06 -> index final 2-entry table $AEB1
 $AF16 RRA           ;
 $AF17 AND $06       ;
 $AF19 LD C,A        ;
 $AF1A LD B,$00      ;
 $AF1C LD HL,$AEB1   ; }
 $AF1F ADD HL,BC     ;
 $AF20 LD A,(DE)     ; {AND/OR merge last byte, restore regs, return
 $AF21 AND (HL)      ;
 $AF22 INC HL        ;
 $AF23 OR (HL)       ;
 $AF24 LD (DE),A     ;
 $AF25 POP HL        ;
 $AF26 POP BC        ; }
 $AF27 JP $AE18      ;

; Render col cap a
;
; Used by the routine at #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Another per-cell render handler, selected for a specific column-edge sub-case
; (DE==0 test in setup_tower_scroll's classification).
; .
; 4-way branch on a self-mod test byte ($AF2C/$AF2E, patched by
; setup_tower_scroll at $ADEA/$ADED). Each branch writes 3 destination bytes
; with mostly-fixed bit patterns (pre-rendered tower-cap/edge tile graphics)
; merged via AND/OR masks at the first/last byte to blend with the adjacent
; column.
; .
; Ends `POP HL / JP $AE18` in all 4 branches.
c$AF2A PUSH HL       ; save dest ptr
 $AF2B ADD HL,DE     ; HL += DE (apply column offset)
 $AF2C LD A,$00      ; A = self-mod test byte
 $AF2E SRL A         ; shift test byte -> Z/C flags
 $AF30 JP NZ,$AF57   ; nonzero -> branch 3/4 ($AF57)
 $AF33 JP C,$AF42    ; carry set -> branch 2 ($AF42)
 $AF36 LD (HL),$1B   ; branch 1: fixed byte 1 ($1B)
 $AF38 INC HL        ;
 $AF39 LD (HL),$FB   ; fixed byte 2 ($FB)
 $AF3B INC HL        ;
 $AF3C LD (HL),$A4   ; fixed byte 3 ($A4)
 $AF3E POP HL        ; restore dest ptr
 $AF3F JP $AE18      ; done -> setup_tower_scroll continuation
*$AF42 LD A,(HL)     ; branch 2: A = dest byte 1
 $AF43 AND $C0       ; keep high 2 bits (blend mask)
 $AF45 OR $06        ; OR in fixed low bits
 $AF47 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF48 INC HL        ;
 $AF49 LD (HL),$FE   ; fixed byte 2 ($FE)
 $AF4B INC HL        ;
 $AF4C LD (HL),$E9   ; fixed byte 3 ($E9)
 $AF4E INC HL        ;
 $AF4F LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $AF50 AND $3F       ; keep low 6 bits (blend mask)
 $AF52 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF53 POP HL        ;
 $AF54 JP $AE18      ;
*$AF57 JP C,$AF71    ; branch 3/4: carry set -> branch 4 ($AF71)
 $AF5A LD A,(HL)     ; branch 3: A = dest byte 1
 $AF5B AND $F0       ; keep high nibble (blend mask)
 $AF5D OR $01        ; OR in fixed low bit
 $AF5F LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF60 INC HL        ;
 $AF61 LD (HL),$BF   ; fixed byte 2 ($BF)
 $AF63 INC HL        ;
 $AF64 LD (HL),$BA   ; fixed byte 3 ($BA)
 $AF66 INC HL        ;
 $AF67 LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $AF68 AND $0F       ; keep low nibble (blend mask)
 $AF6A OR $40        ; OR in fixed high bits
 $AF6C LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF6D POP HL        ;
 $AF6E JP $AE18      ;
*$AF71 LD A,(HL)     ; branch 4: A = dest byte 1
 $AF72 AND $FC       ; keep high 6 bits (blend mask)
 $AF74 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF75 INC HL        ;
 $AF76 LD (HL),$6F   ; fixed byte 2 ($6F)
 $AF78 INC HL        ;
 $AF79 LD (HL),$EE   ; fixed byte 3 ($EE)
 $AF7B INC HL        ;
 $AF7C LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $AF7D AND $03       ; keep low 2 bits (blend mask)
 $AF7F OR $90        ; OR in fixed high bits
 $AF81 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF82 POP HL        ;
 $AF83 JP $AE18      ;

; Render col cap b
;
; Used by the routine at #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Structurally identical 4-way dispatch to render_col_cap_a (self-mod test byte
; at $AF89, patched by $AE06/$AE09), but writes only 2 destination bytes per
; branch instead of 3 -- a narrower cap/edge graphic for a different column
; class.
; .
; Ends `POP HL / JP $AE18` in all branches.
@label=render_col_cap_b
c$AF86 PUSH HL       ; {save dest ptr, apply column offset
 $AF87 ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $AF88 LD A,$00      ; {self-mod test byte -> Z/C flags
 $AF8A SRL A         ; }
 $AF8C JP NZ,$AFB0   ; nonzero -> branch 3/4
 $AF8F JP C,$AF9F    ; carry set -> branch 2
 $AF92 LD (HL),$2F   ; branch 1: fixed byte 1 ($2F)
 $AF94 INC HL        ;
 $AF95 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AF96 AND $0F       ;
 $AF98 OR $80        ;
 $AF9A LD (HL),A     ;
 $AF9B POP HL        ;
 $AF9C JP $AE18      ;
*$AF9F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AFA0 AND $C0       ;
 $AFA2 OR $0B        ;
 $AFA4 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFA5 INC HL        ;
 $AFA6 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AFA7 AND $03       ;
 $AFA9 OR $E0        ;
 $AFAB LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFAC POP HL        ;
 $AFAD JP $AE18      ;
*$AFB0 JP C,$AFC0    ;
 $AFB3 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AFB4 AND $F0       ;
 $AFB6 OR $02        ;
 $AFB8 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFB9 INC HL        ;
 $AFBA LD (HL),$F8   ;
 $AFBC POP HL        ;
 $AFBD JP $AE18      ;
*$AFC0 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AFC1 AND $FC       ;
 $AFC3 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFC4 INC HL        ;
 $AFC5 LD (HL),$BE   ;
 $AFC7 INC HL        ;
 $AFC8 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $AFC9 AND $3F       ;
 $AFCB LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFCC POP HL        ;
 $AFCD JP $AE18      ;

; Render col fill
;
; Used by the routine at #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Third 4-way dispatch variant (test byte self-mod at $AFD3, sharing the
; $ADEA/$ADED patch point with render_col_partial's mask selection), writing up
; to 3 bytes with mostly solid-$FF fill patterns -- a plain/bright
; tower-segment fill rather than a textured cap. One branch ($B000) has a
; nested sub-branch (JP C,$B016), making 5 cases total.
; .
; Ends `POP HL / JP $AE18` in all branches.
@label=render_col_fill
c$AFD0 PUSH HL       ; save dest ptr
 $AFD1 ADD HL,DE     ; HL += DE (apply column offset)
 $AFD2 LD A,$00      ; A = self-mod test byte
 $AFD4 SRL A         ; shift test byte -> Z/C flags
 $AFD6 JP NZ,$B000   ; nonzero -> branch 3/4 ($B000)
 $AFD9 JP C,$AFF0    ; carry set -> branch 2 ($AFF0)
 $AFDC LD A,(HL)     ; branch 1: A = dest byte 1
 $AFDD AND $C0       ; keep high 2 bits (blend mask)
 $AFDF OR $0F        ; OR in fixed low bits
 $AFE1 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFE2 INC HL        ;
 $AFE3 LD (HL),$FF   ; solid fill byte 2 ($FF)
 $AFE5 INC HL        ;
 $AFE6 LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $AFE7 AND $03       ; keep low 2 bits (blend mask)
 $AFE9 OR $F0        ;
 $AFEB LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFEC POP HL        ;
 $AFED JP $AE18      ;
*$AFF0 LD A,(HL)     ; branch 2: A = dest byte 1
 $AFF1 AND $F0       ; keep high nibble (blend mask)
 $AFF3 OR $03        ;
 $AFF5 LD (HL),A     ;
 $AFF6 INC HL        ;
 $AFF7 LD (HL),$FF   ; solid fill byte 2 ($FF)
 $AFF9 INC HL        ;
 $AFFA LD (HL),$FC   ; solid fill byte 3 ($FC)
 $AFFC POP HL        ;
 $AFFD JP $AE18      ;
*$B000 JP C,$B016    ; branch 3/4: carry set -> branch 4 ($B016)
 $B003 LD A,(HL)     ; branch 3: A = dest byte 1
 $B004 AND $FC       ; keep high 6 bits (blend mask)
 $B006 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B007 INC HL        ;
 $B008 LD (HL),$FF   ; solid fill byte 2 ($FF)
 $B00A INC HL        ;
 $B00B LD (HL),$FF   ; solid fill byte 3 ($FF)
 $B00D INC HL        ;
 $B00E LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $B00F AND $3F       ; keep low 6 bits (blend mask)
 $B011 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B012 POP HL        ;
 $B013 JP $AE18      ;
*$B016 INC HL        ; branch 4: skip byte 1 (no write)
 $B017 LD (HL),$3F   ; solid fill byte 2 ($3F)
 $B019 INC HL        ;
 $B01A LD (HL),$FF   ; solid fill byte 3 ($FF)
 $B01C INC HL        ;
 $B01D LD A,(HL)     ; A = dest byte 3
 $B01E AND $0F       ; keep low nibble (blend mask)
 $B020 OR $C0        ; OR in fixed high bits
 $B022 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B023 POP HL        ;
 $B024 JP $AE18      ;

; Data block at B027
;
; .
;
; .
;
; 3 groups of 8 bytes (mask/value pairs), indexed by the $603C animation phase
; counter (anim_bg_phase) via render_anim_texture (#R$B03F) -- an animated
; dithered/striped tower texture that cycles as $603C advances.
@label=anim_texture_masks
b$B027 DEFB $3F,$C0,$0F,$F0,$03,$FC,$FF,$00
 $B02F DEFB $2A,$80,$0A,$A0,$02,$A8,$AA,$00
 $B037 DEFB $15,$40,$05,$50,$01,$54,$55,$00

; Render anim texture
;
; Used by the routine at #R$AD82.
;
; .
;
; Final per-cell render handler, and the only one whose graphic depends on
; animation phase rather than static column geometry: reads $603C into BC as an
; index into anim_texture_masks (#R$B027), giving an animated tower
; stripe/shade effect.
; .
; Same self-mod 4-way branch-and-mask-merge shape as the other handlers (test
; byte at $B045), each branch copying/merging bytes from a different #R$B027
; offset ($B029/$B02B/$B02D).
; .
; Ends `POP BC / POP HL / JP $AE18` in all branches.
@label=render_anim_texture
c$B03F PUSH HL       ; save HL (destination byte ptr)
 $B040 ADD HL,DE     ; DE += HL (advance to next cell)
 $B041 EX DE,HL      ; swap: HL=dest ptr, DE=advance amount
 $B042 PUSH BC       ; save BC
 $B043 LD A,$00      ; A = self-mod test byte (patched by setup_tower_scroll)
 $B045 SRL A         ; shift test byte -> Z/C flags
 $B047 LD A,($603C)  ; A = anim_bg_phase ($603C)
 $B04A LD C,A        ; C = phase (BC = table index)
 $B04B LD B,$00      ;
 $B04D JP NZ,$B078   ; test byte nonzero -> $B078
 $B050 JP C,$B063    ; test byte carry set -> $B063
 $B053 LD HL,$B027   ; HL -> anim_texture_masks + phase
 $B056 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $B057 LDI           ; copy one animated byte via LDI
 $B059 LD A,(DE)     ; A = current dest byte
 $B05A AND $0F       ; mask low nibble
 $B05C OR (HL)       ; OR in the animated bits
 $B05D LD (DE),A     ;
 $B05E POP BC        ;
 $B05F POP HL        ;
 $B060 JP $AE18      ;
*$B063 LD HL,$B029   ; HL -> $B029 + phase (2nd branch base)
 $B066 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $B067 LD A,(DE)     ; A = current dest byte
 $B068 AND $C0       ; mask high 2 bits ($C0)
 $B06A OR (HL)       ;
 $B06B LD (DE),A     ;
 $B06C INC HL        ;
 $B06D INC DE        ;
 $B06E LD A,(DE)     ; A = second dest byte
 $B06F AND $03       ; mask low 2 bits ($03)
 $B071 OR (HL)       ;
 $B072 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B073 POP BC        ;
 $B074 POP HL        ;
 $B075 JP $AE18      ;
*$B078 JP C,$B08D    ; test byte carry set -> $B08D
 $B07B LD HL,$B02B   ; HL -> $B02B + phase (3rd branch base)
 $B07E ADD HL,BC     ;
 $B07F LD A,(DE)     ; A = current dest byte
 $B080 AND $F0       ; mask high nibble ($F0)
 $B082 OR (HL)       ;
 $B083 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B084 INC HL        ;
 $B085 INC DE        ;
 $B086 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B087 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B088 POP BC        ;
 $B089 POP HL        ;
 $B08A JP $AE18      ;
*$B08D LD HL,$B02D   ; HL -> $B02D + phase (4th branch base)
 $B090 ADD HL,BC     ;
 $B091 LD A,(DE)     ; A = current dest byte
 $B092 AND $FC       ; mask high 6 bits ($FC)
 $B094 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B095 INC DE        ;
 $B096 LDI           ; copy one animated byte via LDI
 $B098 LD A,(DE)     ; A = second dest byte
 $B099 AND $3F       ; mask low 6 bits ($3F)
 $B09B LD (DE),A     ;
 $B09C POP BC        ;
 $B09D POP HL        ;
 $B09E JP $AE18      ;

; Unused
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Self-mod scratch byte, not unused: draw_tower_cols patches this as the
; immediate operand of its column-count loop (see draw_tower_cols's own note)
; -- the live loop-count constant, reduced near the scroll wrap edge.
s$B0A1 DEFS $01

; Draw tower cols
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Render the visible tower column strip.
; .
; Patches the column count at #R$B0A1 ($14, reduced near the wrap edge from
; scroll_pos) and dispatches on the $6021 sub-column phase.
; .
; SELF-MOD: #R$B0A1 loop count.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL (+ render regs).
@label=draw_tower_cols
c$B0A2 LD A,$14      ; {self-mod default column count = $14
 $B0A4 LD ($B0A1),A  ; }
 $B0A7 LD HL,($6030) ; get Vertical scroll position
 $B0AA LD A,H        ; {near the scroll wrap? reduce column count
 $B0AB CP $03        ; }
 $B0AD JR NZ,$B0BE   ;
 $B0AF LD A,L        ;
 $B0B0 NEG           ;
 $B0B2 DEC A         ;
 $B0B3 RRA           ;
 $B0B4 RRA           ;
 $B0B5 AND $0F       ;
 $B0B7 LD B,A        ;
 $B0B8 LD A,$13      ;
 $B0BA SUB B         ;
 $B0BB LD ($B0A1),A  ;
*$B0BE LD A,($6021)  ; A = sub-column phase ($6021)
 $B0C1 OR A          ;
 $B0C2 JR Z,$B0D1    ; phase 0 -> straight into the strip blit below
 $B0C4 CP $02        ; {phase 2 -> variant at $B126
 $B0C6 JP Z,$B126    ; }
 $B0C9 CP $04        ; {phase 4 -> variant at $B17E
 $B0CB JP Z,$B17E    ; }
 $B0CE JP $B1D6      ; else -> variant at $B1D6
*$B0D1 DI            ; DI (fast blit: redirect SP as a data pointer)
 $B0D2 LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $B0D6 LD SP,$B22E   ; SP -> pre-baked strip-params table ($B22E)
 $B0D9 LD IX,$6460   ; IX -> column-mask source ($6460)
 $B0DD LD B,$5B      ; B = $5B (91 columns)
 $B0DF EXX           ; {EXX; C' = self-mod column count (#R$B0A1)
 $B0E0 LD A,($B0A1)  ; }
 $B0E3 LD C,A        ;
*$B0E4 LD B,$09      ; {B' = 9 (sub-rows); DE' = 2 (IX step)
 $B0E6 LD DE,$0002   ; }
 $B0E9 EXX           ;
 $B0EA POP HL        ; {HL = next pre-baked screen address (POP off $B22E
 $B0EB EXX           ; table)
*$B0EC EXX           ; }
 $B0ED LD C,(IX+$00) ; C = column-mask byte (IX+0); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B0F0 LD A,(BC)     ;
 $B0F1 LD (HL),$00   ; {stamp C/A bytes downward (INC H each) for this sub-row
 $B0F3 INC H         ;
 $B0F4 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B0F5 INC H         ;
 $B0F6 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B0F7 INC H         ;
 $B0F8 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B0F9 INC H         ;
 $B0FA LD (HL),C     ;
 $B0FB INC H         ;
 $B0FC LD (HL),A     ;
 $B0FD INC H         ;
 $B0FE LD (HL),C     ;
 $B0FF INC H         ; }
 $B100 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B101 INC L         ; L += 1 (next byte pair)
 $B102 LD C,(IX+$01) ; {C = column-mask byte (IX+1); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B105 LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B106 LD (HL),A     ; {stamp A/C bytes upward (DEC H each), mirrored half
 $B107 DEC H         ;
 $B108 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B109 DEC H         ;
 $B10A LD (HL),A     ;
 $B10B DEC H         ;
 $B10C LD (HL),C     ;
 $B10D DEC H         ;
 $B10E LD (HL),A     ;
 $B10F DEC H         ;
 $B110 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B111 DEC H         ;
 $B112 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B113 DEC H         ; }
 $B114 LD (HL),$00   ; (HL) = $00 (blank terminator byte)
 $B116 INC L         ; {L += 1; EXX; IX += DE (next mask byte pair)
 $B117 EXX           ;
 $B118 ADD IX,DE     ; }
 $B11A DJNZ $B0EC    ; loop 9 sub-rows
 $B11C DEC C         ; {loop 91 columns
 $B11D JP NZ,$B0E4   ; }
 $B120 LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $B124 EI            ;
 $B125 RET           ;
*$B126 DI            ;
 $B127 LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $B12B LD SP,$B256   ; SP = $B256 (phase-4 pre-baked strip-params table)
 $B12E LD IX,$6460   ; IX -> column-mask source ($6460)
 $B132 LD B,$5B      ; B = $5B (91 columns)
 $B134 EXX           ; {EXX; C' = self-mod column count (#R$B0A1)
 $B135 LD A,($B0A1)  ;
 $B138 LD C,A        ; }
*$B139 LD B,$09      ; {B' = 9 (sub-rows); DE' = 2 (IX step)
 $B13B LD DE,$0002   ;
 $B13E EXX           ; }
 $B13F POP HL        ; {HL,DE = two screen addresses (POP, adjacent columns)
 $B140 POP DE        ;
 $B141 EXX           ; }
*$B142 EXX           ; {EXX; C = column-mask byte (IX+0); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B143 LD C,(IX+$00) ;
 $B146 LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B147 LD (HL),$00   ; {stamp C/A bytes downward into HL half-column
 $B149 INC H         ;
 $B14A LD (HL),A     ;
 $B14B INC H         ;
 $B14C LD (HL),C     ;
 $B14D INC H         ;
 $B14E LD (HL),A     ;
 $B14F INC H         ;
 $B150 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B151 INC H         ;
 $B152 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B153 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B154 EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE (switch to second half-column)
 $B155 LD (HL),C     ; {continue stamping downward into DE-column
 $B156 INC H         ;
 $B157 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B158 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B159 LD C,(IX+$01) ; {C = column-mask byte (IX+1); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B15C LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B15D LD (HL),A     ; {stamp A/C bytes upward, first half-column
 $B15E DEC H         ;
 $B15F LD (HL),C     ;
 $B160 INC L         ; }
 $B161 EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE back
 $B162 LD (HL),A     ; {stamp upward into second half-column
 $B163 DEC H         ;
 $B164 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B165 DEC H         ;
 $B166 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B167 DEC H         ;
 $B168 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B169 DEC H         ;
 $B16A LD (HL),A     ;
 $B16B DEC H         ; }
 $B16C LD (HL),$00   ; (HL) = $00 (blank terminator byte)
 $B16E INC L         ; {L += 1; EXX; IX += DE (next mask byte pair)
 $B16F EXX           ;
 $B170 ADD IX,DE     ; }
 $B172 DJNZ $B142    ; loop 9 sub-rows
 $B174 DEC C         ; {loop 91 columns
 $B175 JP NZ,$B139   ; }
 $B178 LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $B17C EI            ;
 $B17D RET           ;
*$B17E DI            ;
 $B17F LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $B183 LD SP,$B2A6   ; SP = $B2A6 (else-phase pre-baked strip-params table)
 $B186 LD IX,$6460   ; IX -> column-mask source ($6460)
 $B18A LD B,$5B      ; B = $5B (91 columns)
 $B18C EXX           ; {EXX; C' = self-mod column count (#R$B0A1)
 $B18D LD A,($B0A1)  ;
 $B190 LD C,A        ; }
*$B191 LD B,$09      ; {B' = 9 (sub-rows); DE' = 2 (IX step)
 $B193 LD DE,$0002   ;
 $B196 EXX           ; }
 $B197 POP HL        ; {HL,DE = two screen addresses (POP, adjacent columns)
 $B198 POP DE        ;
 $B199 EXX           ; }
*$B19A EXX           ; {EXX; C = column-mask byte (IX+0); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B19B LD C,(IX+$00) ;
 $B19E LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B19F LD (HL),$00   ; {stamp C/A bytes downward into HL half-column
 $B1A1 INC H         ;
 $B1A2 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B1A3 INC H         ;
 $B1A4 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B1A5 INC H         ;
 $B1A6 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B1A7 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B1A8 EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE (switch to second half-column)
 $B1A9 LD (HL),C     ; {continue stamping downward into DE-column
 $B1AA INC H         ;
 $B1AB LD (HL),A     ;
 $B1AC INC H         ;
 $B1AD LD (HL),C     ;
 $B1AE INC H         ;
 $B1AF LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B1B0 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B1B1 LD C,(IX+$01) ; {C = column-mask byte (IX+1); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B1B4 LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B1B5 LD (HL),A     ; {stamp A/C bytes upward, first half-column
 $B1B6 DEC H         ;
 $B1B7 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B1B8 DEC H         ;
 $B1B9 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B1BA DEC H         ;
 $B1BB LD (HL),C     ; }
 $B1BC INC L         ; L += 1
 $B1BD EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE back
 $B1BE LD (HL),A     ; {stamp upward into second half-column
 $B1BF DEC H         ;
 $B1C0 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B1C1 DEC H         ;
 $B1C2 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B1C3 DEC H         ; }
 $B1C4 LD (HL),$00   ; (HL) = $00 (blank terminator byte)
 $B1C6 INC L         ; {L += 1; EXX; IX += DE (next mask byte pair)
 $B1C7 EXX           ;
 $B1C8 ADD IX,DE     ; }
 $B1CA DJNZ $B19A    ; loop 9 sub-rows
 $B1CC DEC C         ; {loop 91 columns
 $B1CD JP NZ,$B191   ; }
 $B1D0 LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $B1D4 EI            ;
 $B1D5 RET           ;
*$B1D6 DI            ;
 $B1D7 LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $B1DB LD SP,$B2F6   ; SP = $B2F6 (4th-phase pre-baked strip-params table)
 $B1DE LD IX,$6460   ; IX -> column-mask source ($6460)
 $B1E2 LD B,$5B      ; B = $5B (91 columns)
 $B1E4 EXX           ; {EXX; C' = self-mod column count (#R$B0A1)
 $B1E5 LD A,($B0A1)  ;
 $B1E8 LD C,A        ; }
*$B1E9 LD B,$09      ; {B' = 9 (sub-rows); DE' = 2 (IX step)
 $B1EB LD DE,$0002   ;
 $B1EE EXX           ; }
 $B1EF POP HL        ; {HL,DE = two screen addresses (POP, adjacent columns)
 $B1F0 POP DE        ;
 $B1F1 EXX           ; }
*$B1F2 EXX           ; {EXX; C = column-mask byte (IX+0); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B1F3 LD C,(IX+$00) ;
 $B1F6 LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B1F7 LD (HL),$00   ; {stamp C/A bytes downward into HL half-column (short: 2
 $B1F9 INC H         ; bytes)
 $B1FA LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B1FB INC L         ; L += 1
 $B1FC EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE (switch to second half-column)
 $B1FD LD (HL),C     ; {continue stamping downward into DE-column
 $B1FE INC H         ;
 $B1FF LD (HL),A     ;
 $B200 INC H         ;
 $B201 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B202 INC H         ;
 $B203 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B204 INC H         ;
 $B205 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B206 INC H         ;
 $B207 LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B208 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B209 LD C,(IX+$01) ; {C = column-mask byte (IX+1); A = palette byte (BC)
 $B20C LD A,(BC)     ; }
 $B20D LD (HL),A     ; {stamp A/C bytes upward, first half-column
 $B20E DEC H         ;
 $B20F LD (HL),C     ;
 $B210 DEC H         ;
 $B211 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B212 DEC H         ;
 $B213 LD (HL),C     ;
 $B214 DEC H         ;
 $B215 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B216 DEC H         ;
 $B217 LD (HL),C     ; }
 $B218 INC L         ; L += 1
 $B219 EX DE,HL      ; swap HL/DE back
 $B21A LD (HL),A     ; {stamp upward into second half-column (short: 1 byte)
 $B21B DEC H         ; }
 $B21C LD (HL),$00   ; (HL) = $00 (blank terminator byte)
 $B21E INC L         ; {L += 1; EXX; IX += DE (next mask byte pair)
 $B21F EXX           ;
 $B220 ADD IX,DE     ; }
 $B222 DJNZ $B1F2    ; loop 9 sub-rows
 $B224 DEC C         ; {loop 91 columns
 $B225 JP NZ,$B1E9   ; }
 $B228 LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $B22C EI            ;
 $B22D RET           ;

; Load level col
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; O:IX source pointer (level data + column offset)
;
; Fetches the column descriptor #R$6039 from the column-major table at #R$7A00
; (stride 8): low byte (+0) and high byte (+8) form a source pointer (offset by
; #R$6A00 into level data), the property byte (+16) is stashed in $603A, then
; blits the column's cells into the live map at $F000 via blit_masked_column.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL,IX.
@label=load_level_col
c$B346 LD A,($6039)  ; {A = column index (#R$6039); D = index*2+$6A (table row
 $B349 LD C,A        ; high byte)
 $B34A ADD A,A       ;
 $B34B ADD A,$6A     ;
 $B34D LD D,A        ; }
 $B34E LD E,$00      ; {IX = $7A00 + column*256 (table entry base)
 $B350 LD B,$00      ;
 $B352 LD IX,$7A00   ;
 $B356 ADD IX,BC     ; }
 $B358 LD L,(IX+$00) ; {HL = pointer = table[+0]/[+8] entries + $6A00
 $B35B LD H,(IX+$08) ;
 $B35E LD BC,$6A00   ;
 $B361 ADD HL,BC     ; }
 $B362 LD A,(IX+$10) ; {property byte -> $603A; push pointer
 $B365 LD ($603A),A  ;
 $B368 PUSH HL       ; }
 $B369 POP IX        ; {IX = source pointer; C = property byte (copy); HL =
 $B36B LD C,A        ; $F000 (dest map base)
 $B36C LD HL,$F000   ; }
*$B36F CALL $B382    ; Blit masked column
 $B372 CALL $B382    ; Blit masked column
 $B375 LD H,$F0      ; {advance dest row (H=$F0, wrap); loop until C==0
 $B377 INC L         ;
 $B378 DEC C         ;
 $B379 JR NZ,$B36F   ; }
 $B37B LD HL,$F000   ;
 $B37E LD ($6015),HL ; set Unknown word
 $B381 RET           ;

; Blit masked column
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B346.
;
;   DE mask byte pointer
;   IX source pixel-byte pointer
;   HL screen address
; O:DE mask ptr+1 O:IX advanced past consumed bytes O:HL same L, H+8 (next
; .    column)
;
; Draw an 8-pixel-tall column at HL: for each set bit of the mask byte at (DE),
; store the next source byte (IX++) and step down one pixel row (INC H) skip
; rows whose mask bit is 0.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL,IX.
@label=blit_masked_column
c$B382 LD A,(DE)     ; {A = mask byte; DE++; B = 8 (rows)
 $B383 INC DE        ;
 $B384 LD B,$08      ; }
*$B386 RRA           ; {mask bit set? -> stamp next source byte at (HL)
 $B387 JR NC,$B391   ;
 $B389 PUSH AF       ;
 $B38A LD A,(IX+$00) ;
 $B38D INC IX        ;
 $B38F LD (HL),A     ; }
 $B390 POP AF        ; {advance row (INC H); loop 8
*$B391 INC H         ;
 $B392 DJNZ $B386    ;
 $B394 RET           ; }

; Alloc object slot
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
;   HL source cell pointer
; O:CY allocated (IX=slot) NC full or blocked
;
; Find a free entry (marker $FF at +0) in the 4-slot active-object table at
; $60A9, but only if the source cell's bits2-3 aren't $04 (that value blocks
; allocation outright, no free slot needed). On success stores type $7D, the
; source pointer (HL) and a copied data byte, sets CY.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,IX.
@label=alloc_object_slot
c$B395 LD IX,$60A9     ; {IX -> object slot table, B = 4 slots
 $B399 LD B,$04        ; }
*$B39B LD A,(IX+$00)   ; {free slot ($FF marker)? else next slot
 $B39E CP $FF          ;
 $B3A0 JR NZ,$B3B9     ; }
 $B3A2 LD A,(HL)       ; {source cell's bits2-3 == $04? -> blocked, RET NC
 $B3A3 AND $0C         ;
 $B3A5 CP $04          ;
 $B3A7 JR Z,$B3BD      ; }
 $B3A9 LD A,(HL)       ; {store source ptr + data byte, mark slot type $7D
 $B3AA LD (IX+$0C),A   ;
 $B3AD LD (IX+$04),L   ;
 $B3B0 LD (IX+$08),H   ;
 $B3B3 LD (IX+$00),$7D ;
 $B3B7 SCF             ;
 $B3B8 RET             ; }
*$B3B9 INC IX          ; {next slot, loop 4
 $B3BB DJNZ $B39B      ; }
*$B3BD OR A            ; {no free slot -> RET NC
 $B3BE RET             ; }

; Update object slots
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Tick the 4-entry active-object table at $60A9 (counterpart to
; alloc_object_slot).
; .
; For each slot: $FF=free (skip), >1 = decrement its countdown, and on expiry
; write the stored byte back through its screen pointer (erase the object).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL,IX.
@label=update_object_slots
c$B3BF LD IX,$60A9     ; {IX -> active-object table ($60A9), B=4 slots
 $B3C3 LD B,$04        ; }
*$B3C5 LD A,(IX+$00)   ; {A = this slot's countdown
 $B3C8 OR A            ; }
 $B3C9 JR Z,$B3D4      ; zero -> expired, handle it
 $B3CB CP $FF          ; {$FF -> free slot, skip
 $B3CD JR Z,$B3F9      ; }
 $B3CF DEC (IX+$00)    ; {else: decrement countdown, next slot
 $B3D2 JR $B3F9        ; }
*$B3D4 LD L,(IX+$04)   ; {expired: HL -> stored screen pointer
 $B3D7 LD H,(IX+$08)   ;
 $B3DA LD A,(IX+$0C)   ; }
 $B3DD AND $0C         ;
 $B3DF LD (HL),A       ;
 $B3E0 DEC L           ;
 $B3E1 DEC (IX+$04)    ;
 $B3E4 LD A,(HL)       ;
 $B3E5 LD (IX+$0C),A   ;
 $B3E8 AND $0C         ;
 $B3EA CP $04          ;
 $B3EC JR Z,$B3F3      ;
 $B3EE LD (HL),$8D     ;
 $B3F0 JP $B3F9        ;
*$B3F3 LD (HL),$85     ;
 $B3F5 LD (IX+$00),$FF ;
*$B3F9 INC IX          ; {next slot, loop 4
 $B3FB DJNZ $B3C5      ; }
 $B3FD RET             ;

; Free object slot
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; HL pointer to match against stored slot pointers
;
; Mark the $60A9 slot whose stored pointer equals HL as free (set +0 = $FF).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,IX.
@label=free_object_slot
c$B3FE LD IX,$60A9     ; {IX = object_table; B = 4 (slot count)
 $B402 LD B,$04        ; }
*$B404 LD A,(IX+$00)   ; {skip already-free slot (+0 == $FF)
 $B407 CP $FF          ;
 $B409 JR Z,$B41C      ; }
 $B40B LD A,L          ; {stored pointer (+4/+8) == HL? -> mark free (+0 =
 $B40C CP (IX+$04)     ; $FF), RET
 $B40F JR NZ,$B41C     ;
 $B411 LD A,H          ;
 $B412 CP (IX+$08)     ;
 $B415 JR NZ,$B41C     ;
 $B417 LD (IX+$00),$FF ;
 $B41B RET             ; }
*$B41C INC IX          ; {next slot, loop 4
 $B41E DJNZ $B404      ;
 $B420 RET             ; }

; Update actors
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;

; .
; Skips when player_state is 8/9 (level-end).
; .
; Derives the camera row #R$6036 from $6059, then walks the 4 object_table
; actors, acting on each live one (state field IX+48 != 0).
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL,IX.
@label=update_actors

 $B424 CP $08          ;
 $B426 RET Z           ;
 $B427 CP $09          ;
 $B429 RET Z           ; }

 $B42D LD A,L          ;
 $B42E RR H            ;
 $B430 RRA             ;
 $B431 RR H            ;
 $B433 RRA             ; }

 $B437 LD IX,$605B     ; {find first active actor (state!=0) in object_table
 $B43B LD B,$04        ;
*$B43D LD A,(IX+$30)   ;
 $B440 CP $00          ;
 $B442 JR Z,$B449      ;
 $B444 INC IX          ;
 $B446 DJNZ $B43D      ;

 $B44F CP L            ; ($B512)}
 $B450 JP Z,$B512      ;

 $B456 CP L            ;
 $B457 JP Z,$B512      ;
 $B45A JP C,$B512      ;

 $B45E OR A            ;
 $B45F JP M,$B466      ;
 $B462 AND $70         ;
 $B464 JR NZ,$B478     ; }

 $B469 INC A           ;
 $B46A AND $0F         ;

 $B46F CP $F0          ;
 $B471 JR NZ,$B45D     ;

 $B47C PUSH AF         ;
 $B47D PUSH HL         ;
 $B47E LD A,H          ;
 $B47F SUB $F0         ;
 $B481 INC A           ;
 $B482 AND $0F         ;
 $B484 ADD A,$F0       ;
 $B486 LD H,A          ;
 $B487 CP $F0          ;
 $B489 JR NZ,$B48C     ;
 $B48B INC L           ;
*$B48C LD ($6015),HL   ; set Unknown word
 $B48F POP HL          ;

 $B491 AND $70         ; {classify flag bits ($70 mask)
 $B493 CP $10          ;
 $B495 JR Z,$B4E0      ; }
 $B497 CP $60          ; {bit pattern $60? branch
 $B499 JR NC,$B4CB     ; }
 $B49B CP $40          ; {bit pattern $40? branch
 $B49D JR NC,$B4B6     ; }

 $B4A1 JR Z,$B4A6      ;
 $B4A3 XOR A           ;
 $B4A4 JR $B4A8        ;
*$B4A6 LD A,$01        ; }
*$B4A8 LD (IX+$36),A   ; {speed/phase/pattern = 0/1/0 (idle-ish spawn)
 $B4AB LD (IX+$42),$01 ;
 $B4AF LD (IX+$3C),$00 ; }
 $B4B3 JP $B4ED        ;
*$B4B6 AND $10         ; {speed=1or2, phase=8, pattern=0 (variant B)
 $B4B8 JR Z,$B4BC      ;
 $B4BA LD A,$01        ;
*$B4BC INC A           ;
 $B4BD LD (IX+$36),A   ; }
 $B4C0 LD (IX+$42),$08 ;
 $B4C4 LD (IX+$3C),$00 ;
 $B4C8 JP $B4ED        ;
*$B4CB AND $10         ; {speed=1or2, phase=9, pattern=0 (variant C)
 $B4CD JR Z,$B4D1      ;
 $B4CF LD A,$01        ;
*$B4D1 INC A           ;
 $B4D2 LD (IX+$36),A   ; }
 $B4D5 LD (IX+$42),$09 ;
 $B4D9 LD (IX+$3C),$00 ;

 $B4E2 LD (IX+$36),A   ;
 $B4E5 LD (IX+$42),$02 ; }

 $B4F1 ADD A,A         ;
 $B4F2 ADD A,A         ;
 $B4F3 ADD A,$04       ;
 $B4F5 AND $7F         ; }

 $B4FA XOR A           ; {compute position (IX+6/+12) via rotate-left pack
 $B4FB RL L            ;
 $B4FD RL A            ;
 $B4FF RL L            ;
 $B501 RL A            ; }

 $B506 LD (IX+$0C),A   ;

*$B512 LD A,($60A3)    ; {$60A3 flag: pending single-shot spawn?
 $B515 CP $FF          ;

 $B518 DEC A           ; }

 $B51E RET NZ          ;

 $B523 LD (IX+$2A),$00 ; }

 $B52F LD (IX+$36),A   ;
 $B532 ADD A,A         ; {derive angular pos 0/$78 from sign
 $B533 LD A,$00        ;
 $B535 JR NC,$B539     ;
 $B537 LD A,$78        ; }
*$B539 LD (IX+$00),A   ; {store position (IX+0/+6/+12) from player position
 $B53C LD HL,($60BA)   ;
 $B53F LD (IX+$06),L   ;
 $B542 LD (IX+$0C),H   ;
 $B545 RET             ; }

; Clear screen
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Cold wipe before the title/play screen draws.
; .
; 1) zero game RAM #R$6000..$61FF (512 bytes, 2 pages).
; .
; 2) zero the entire display $4000..$5AFF (pixels+attrs) via LDIR.
; .
; 3) CALL #R$B567 (build a lookup table in the reclaimed printer buffer
; #R$5B00) and #R$B5EA.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=clear_screen
c$B546 LD HL,$6000   ; HL -> game RAM base #R$6000
 $B549 LD B,$02      ; B = 2 pages to clear
*$B54B LD (HL),$00   ; store 0
 $B54D INC L         ;
 $B54E JR NZ,$B54B   ; loop 256 bytes of this page
 $B550 INC H         ; next page
 $B551 DJNZ $B54B    ;
 $B553 LD HL,$4000   ; HL -> screen base $4000
 $B556 LD DE,$4001   ; DE -> $4001 (LDIR src=HL, dst=DE, overlap fill)
 $B559 LD BC,$1AFF   ; BC = $1AFF = 6911 bytes = whole display minus 1
 $B55C LD (HL),$00   ; seed first byte = 0
 $B55E LDIR          ; LDIR: propagate 0 across $4000..$5AFF
 $B560 CALL $B567    ; Build screen hi LUT
 $B563 CALL $B5EA    ; Build row addr table
 $B566 RET           ;

; Build screen hi LUT
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$B546.
;
; .
;
; Fill a 256-byte table at #R$5B00 mapping a byte value to its bit-reordered
; form used in ZX screen-address math.
; .
; Processes the index in 2-bit groups groups 00 and 11 pass through, 01/10 get
; +$40 -- the Y2<->Y0 swap that makes the ZX pixel rows non-linear.
; .
; Result accumulates in H.
; .
; The porter can DELETE this and the #R$5B00 lookups, replac
@label=build_screen_hi_lut
c$B567 LD DE,$5B00   ; DE -> #R$5B00 LUT base (reclaimed printer buffer)
*$B56A LD C,E        ; C = current index (low byte of DE)
 $B56B LD B,$04      ; B = 4 groups of 2 bits
*$B56D LD A,C        ;
 $B56E AND $C0       ; isolate the top 2-bit group
 $B570 JR Z,$B578    ; 00 -> pass through
 $B572 CP $C0        ;
 $B574 JR Z,$B578    ; 11 -> pass through
 $B576 ADD A,$40     ; 01/10 -> +$40 (the scan-order bit swap)
*$B578 LD L,A        ;
 $B579 ADD HL,HL     ; HL <<= 2 (accumulate this group)
 $B57A ADD HL,HL     ;
 $B57B SLA C         ; shift C left 2 to expose next group (Z80 SLA)
 $B57D SLA C         ;
 $B57F DJNZ $B56D    ;
 $B581 LD A,H        ;
 $B582 LD (DE),A     ; store H as LUT[index]
 $B583 INC E         ;
 $B584 JR NZ,$B56A   ; loop all 256 entries (E wraps to 0)
 $B586 RET           ;

; Routine at B587
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
@label=clear_playfield
c$B587 LD C,$20      ;
*$B589 LD A,C        ; compute screen-addr high byte from row index
 $B58A RRA           ;
 $B58B RRA           ;
 $B58C RRA           ;
 $B58D AND $18       ;
 $B58F OR $40        ;
 $B591 LD H,A        ;
 $B592 LD A,C        ;
 $B593 AND $07       ;
 $B595 ADD A,H       ;
 $B596 LD H,A        ;
 $B597 LD A,C        ;
 $B598 RLA           ;
 $B599 RLA           ;
 $B59A AND $E0       ;
 $B59C LD L,A        ;
 $B59D LD B,$20      ;
*$B59F LD (HL),$00   ; zero 32 pixel bytes of this row
 $B5A1 INC HL        ;
 $B5A2 DJNZ $B59F    ;
 $B5A4 INC C         ;
 $B5A5 LD A,C        ;
 $B5A6 CP $B8        ; stop at row $B8
 $B5A8 JR NZ,$B589   ;
 $B5AA LD HL,$5860   ;
 $B5AD LD DE,$5861   ;
 $B5B0 LD BC,$0020   ;
 $B5B3 LD (HL),$00   ;
 $B5B5 LDIR          ; LDIR: clear an attribute strip
 $B5B7 LD BC,$025F   ;
 $B5BA CALL $BA16    ;
 $B5BD LD (HL),A     ;
 $B5BE LDIR          ;
 $B5C0 LD BC,$0020   ;
 $B5C3 LD (HL),$00   ;
 $B5C5 LDIR          ;
 $B5C7 RET           ;

; Get screen addr
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700, #R$AC5E, #R$B636, #R$B74D, #R$B8A8, #R$B965
; and #R$B9D6.
;
; .
;
; Pixel address for (row=H, col-in-row=L).
; .
; Indexes scr_row_addr_tbl (#R$5D00, 2 bytes/row) at 2*H to fetch the row base,
; then adds L to get the final byte address in HL.
; .
; In: H=row 0..191, L=byte offset within row.
; .
; Out: HL=screen addr.
; .
; Clobbers A preserves DE.
@label=get_screen_addr
c$B5D9 PUSH DE       ;
 $B5DA LD D,L        ;
 $B5DB LD A,H        ;
 $B5DC ADD A,A       ; L = 2*H = table index
 $B5DD LD L,A        ;
 $B5DE LD A,$5D      ; H = $5D + carry -> HL -> scr_row_addr_tbl[H]
 $B5E0 ADC A,$00     ;
 $B5E2 LD H,A        ;
 $B5E3 LD A,D        ;
 $B5E4 ADD A,(HL)    ; A = row base low + col offset
 $B5E5 INC L         ;
 $B5E6 LD H,(HL)     ; H = row base high
 $B5E7 LD L,A        ;
 $B5E8 POP DE        ;
 $B5E9 RET           ;

; Build row addr table
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B546.
;
; .
;
; Precompute 192 screen-row addresses into scr_row_addr_tbl (#R$5D00,
; little-endian words).
; .
; For each row y in 0..191 it builds the ZX pixel address:
; .
; high = $40 | (y&7) | ((y>>3)&$18)
; .
; low  = (y&$38)<<2 i.e.
; .
; the famous ZX scan-order layout (Y bits split across the address).
; .
; get_screen_addr then just indexes this table.
@label=build_row_addr_table
c$B5EA LD DE,$5D00   ; DE -> #R$5D00 table base
 $B5ED LD HL,$0000   ; HL: H = row counter y, builds address in HL
*$B5F0 PUSH HL       ;
 $B5F1 PUSH DE       ;
 $B5F2 LD A,H        ; (y>>3)&$18  -> D (the y bits 3..5 region)
 $B5F3 RRCA          ;
 $B5F4 RRCA          ;
 $B5F5 RRCA          ;
 $B5F6 AND $18       ;
 $B5F8 LD D,A        ;
 $B5F9 LD A,H        ;
 $B5FA AND $07       ;
 $B5FC ADD A,D       ; + (y&7) + $40 -> high byte
 $B5FD ADD A,$40     ;
 $B5FF LD D,A        ;
 $B600 LD A,H        ;
 $B601 RLC A         ; (y<<2)&$E0 -> low byte (E)
 $B603 RLC A         ;
 $B605 AND $E0       ;
 $B607 LD E,A        ;
 $B608 LD H,$00      ;
 $B60A ADD HL,DE     ; HL = full row-0 screen address
 $B60B POP DE        ;
 $B60C LD A,L        ;
 $B60D LD (DE),A     ; store LE word into table[y]
 $B60E INC DE        ;
 $B60F LD A,H        ;
 $B610 LD (DE),A     ;
 $B611 INC DE        ;
 $B612 POP HL        ;
 $B613 INC H         ;
 $B614 LD A,H        ;
 $B615 CP $C0        ; stop after row $BF (192 rows)
 $B617 JP NZ,$B5F0   ;
 $B61A RET           ;

; Get sprite def
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700, #R$B636 and #R$B74D.
;
; .
;
; Look up sprite/graphic descriptor A in the #R$C100 table (A*2): unpack the
; frame count (top 2 bits, 0->4) into C and the bitmap pointer (low 6 bits +
; $C1xx base) into HL.
; .
; In: A=sprite id.
; .
; Out: HL=bitmap, C=frames.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL.
@label=get_sprite_def
c$B61B ADD A,A       ; Sprite ID to word index
 $B61C LD L,A        ;
 $B61D LD H,$00      ;
 $B61F LD DE,$C101   ; Point to sprite offsets table (#R$C100)
 $B622 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $B623 LD A,(HL)     ; Descriptor: top 2 bits = frame count, low 6 bits =
                     ; offset
 $B624 RLCA          ;
 $B625 RLCA          ;
 $B626 AND $03       ; Extract frame count into C (0-3)
 $B628 LD C,A        ;
 $B629 JR NZ,$B62D   ;
 $B62B LD C,$04      ; Default to 4 frames if count is zero
*$B62D LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B62E AND $3F       ; Keep low 6 bits
 $B630 ADD A,$C1     ; Compute bitmap address high byte: $C1 + offset
 $B632 DEC HL        ;
 $B633 LD L,(HL)     ; Low byte from preceding word entry
 $B634 LD H,A        ;
 $B635 RET           ;

; Select player sprite
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;

; Plot row wrapped
;
; Used by the routine at #R$B636.
;
; HL screen address (+ B,D,E for the plot_masked_row fallthrough)
;
; Advance the screen address HL down one pixel row (ZX scan-order arithmetic:
; char-cell wrap via +$20 / -$08) then fall into plot_masked_row.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL (+ plot regs).
@label=plot_row_wrapped
c$B72F LD A,H        ; {same char-row (H&7 != 0)? -> skip wrap, fall into plot
 $B730 AND $07       ;
 $B732 JR NZ,$B73E   ; }
 $B734 LD A,L        ; {next pixel row: L += $20; on carry (new char row) H -=
 $B735 ADD A,$20     ; 8
 $B737 LD L,A        ;
 $B738 JR C,$B73E    ;
 $B73A LD A,H        ;
 $B73B SUB $08       ;
 $B73D LD H,A        ; }

; Plot masked row
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B636 and #R$B72F.
;
;   HL left-cell screen address
;   B middle-cell fill byte
;   D left-edge AND mask
;   E right-edge AND mask
; O:HL same L, H+1 (next row)
;
; Plot a 3-cell sprite slice at HL: AND the left edge cell with mask D, write
; the two middle cells = B, AND the right edge with mask E restores L and bumps
; H.
; .
; Clobbers: A,C,HL.
@label=plot_masked_row
c$B73E LD C,L        ; {save L; left cell = (HL) AND D
 $B73F LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B740 AND D         ;
 $B741 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B742 INC L         ; }
 $B743 LD (HL),B     ; {middle two cells = B
 $B744 INC L         ;
 $B745 LD (HL),B     ;
 $B746 INC L         ; }
 $B747 LD A,(HL)     ; {right cell = (HL) AND E; restore L; H += 1
 $B748 AND E         ;
 $B749 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B74A LD L,C        ;
 $B74B INC H         ;
 $B74C RET           ; }

; Draw actor sprite
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Render one object_table actor (IX = entry).
; .
; Skips if the sprite id (IX+24)==$FF (inactive).
; .
; Computes screen-Y via actor_screen_y (also leaves an X-related byte in
; $60A6). State 7 (IX+48, the "static wall marker" convention used by
; collision_test) doubles $60A6 into a fresh angular-position copy rather than
; drawing normally.
; .
; Bounds-checks the screen row ($60A8) to [$18,$B0) (RET if off-screen),
; derives a sub-column fraction from $60A6, and for state-7 entries queues a
; one-shot deferred sprite via flag_b5cb/#R$B5CC/#R$B5CE (consumed later by
; draw_pending_sprite) instead of blitting immediately.
; .
; Otherwise computes the screen address (GET_SCREEN_ADDR), then picks the
; bitmap: sprite id >=$7C indexes the runtime table at $BC80 directly (fixed
; 3-cell-wide, 8-row blit) sprite id <$7C goes through GET_SPRITE_DEF (adds a
; facing offset derived from $60A6) to fetch the normal #R$C100 sprite
; definition. Falls through into blit_sprite_fast to draw.
; .
; Clobbers: A,HL,IX,...
@label=draw_actor_sprite
c$B74D LD A,(IX+$18) ;
 $B750 CP $FF        ; {sprite id == $FF -> RET (inactive)
 $B752 RET Z         ; }
 $B753 CALL $B869    ; Actor screen y
 $B756 LD A,(IX+$30) ; {state 7 (wall marker)?
 $B759 CP $07        ;
 $B75B JR NZ,$B764   ; }
 $B75D LD A,(IX+$00) ; {double angular pos -> $60A6
 $B760 ADD A,A       ;
 $B761 LD ($60A6),A  ; }
*$B764 LD A,($60A8)  ; A = screen row ($60A8)
 $B767 CP $18        ; {bounds check row to [$18,$B0), else RET
 $B769 RET C         ;
 $B76A CP $B0        ;
 $B76C RET NC        ; }
 $B76D LD H,A        ;
 $B76E LD A,($60A6)  ; {sub-column fraction: ($60A6)>>3 &$1F -> L
 $B771 RRA           ;
 $B772 RRA           ;
 $B773 RRA           ;
 $B774 AND $1F       ;
 $B776 LD L,A        ; }
 $B777 LD A,(IX+$30) ; {state 7 again -> defer draw
 $B77A CP $07        ;
 $B77C JR NZ,$B790   ; }
 $B77E LD ($B5CC),HL ; queue deferred sprite: pos -> #R$B5CC
 $B781 LD A,($60A6)  ; {facing quadrant -> #R$B5CE
 $B784 SRL A         ;
 $B786 AND $03       ;
 $B788 LD ($B5CE),A  ; }
 $B78B LD A,$01      ; {flag_b5cb = 1 (pending)
 $B78D LD ($B5CB),A  ; }
*$B790 CALL $B5D9    ; Get screen addr
 $B793 PUSH HL       ;
 $B794 LD A,(IX+$18) ; {sprite id >= $7C? (fixed runtime-table graphic)
 $B797 CP $7C        ;
 $B799 JR C,$B7B5    ; }
 $B79B SUB $7C       ; {offset*24 into $BC80 table
 $B79D ADD A,A       ;
 $B79E ADD A,A       ;
 $B79F ADD A,A       ;
 $B7A0 ADD A,A       ;
 $B7A1 ADD A,A       ;
 $B7A2 LD H,$00      ;
 $B7A4 LD L,A        ;
 $B7A5 ADD A,A       ;
 $B7A6 ADD A,L       ;
 $B7A7 LD L,A        ;
 $B7A8 JR NC,$B7AB   ;
 $B7AA INC H         ; }
*$B7AB LD DE,$BC80   ; {HL -> $BC80 + offset
 $B7AE ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $B7AF LD C,$03      ; {C=3,B=8: fixed 3-cell/8-row blit
 $B7B1 LD B,$08      ;
 $B7B3 JR $B7CB      ; }
*$B7B5 LD C,A        ; else: C = raw sprite id
 $B7B6 LD A,($60A6)  ; {facing quadrant + sprite id
 $B7B9 SRL A         ;
 $B7BB AND $03       ;
 $B7BD ADD A,C       ; }
 $B7BE PUSH AF       ; stash variant byte for blit_sprite_fast
 $B7BF CALL $B61B    ; Get sprite def

; Blit sprite fast
;
; .
;
; .
;
; Fast masked sprite blit using the LD SP,screen / PUSH stack-write trick
; (saves the real SP to #R$6000, DI, treats the screen as a "stack" so each
; POP+merge writes one masked byte pair).
; .
; Entered by fallthrough from draw_actor_sprite's GET_SPRITE_DEF/RET (POP AF
; recovers the sprite-variant byte pushed before that call): height B is 8 rows
; normally, or 4 rows when that byte is >=$4E (used for the fixed $BC80
; runtime-table sprites, which pre-set C=3/B=8 explicitly and skip this test).
; .
; C selects the row width variant: 1-cell-wide ($B7DD, 2 mask/data pairs per
; row), 2-cell-wide ($B7FD, 4 pairs), or 3-cell-wide ($B82B, 6 pairs) each
; variant does the same AND/OR merge-and-advance idiom (INC H each row,
; wrapping L by +$20/-8 on the char-cell boundary every 8 rows -- the standard
; ZX scan-order step), looping B times via DJNZ.
; .
; Data is consumed via POP off the (redirected) stack: each row pops a
; mask/value pair per cell, ANDs the mask into the destination screen byte, ORs
; in the value.
; .
; Restores the real SP from #R$6000 and EI before returning.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,DE,HL.
@label=blit_sprite_fast
c$B7C2 POP AF        ; recover sprite-variant byte pushed before GET_SPRITE_DEF
 $B7C3 LD B,$08      ; {height = 4 rows if variant >= $4E, else 8
 $B7C5 CP $4E        ;
 $B7C7 JR NC,$B7CB   ;
 $B7C9 LD B,$04      ; }
; This entry point is used by the routine at #R$B74D.
*$B7CB POP DE        ; DE = mask/value source pointer
 $B7CC LD ($6000),SP ; set Temporary place for SP
 $B7D0 DI            ;
 $B7D1 LD SP,HL      ; {SP=HL (write-via-POP trick); HL=mask/value ptr
 $B7D2 EX DE,HL      ; }
 $B7D3 DEC C         ; {C selects row-width variant: 1/2/3-cell
 $B7D4 JR Z,$B7DD    ;
 $B7D6 DEC C         ;
 $B7D7 JP Z,$B7FD    ;
 $B7DA JP $B82B      ; }
*$B7DD POP DE        ; --- 1-cell-wide variant ---
 $B7DE LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B7DF AND E         ;
 $B7E0 OR D          ;
 $B7E1 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B7E2 INC H         ;
 $B7E3 POP DE        ;
 $B7E4 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B7E5 AND E         ;
 $B7E6 OR D          ;
 $B7E7 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B7E8 INC H         ;
 $B7E9 LD A,H        ; {wrap to next screen row (char-cell boundary step)
 $B7EA AND $07       ;
 $B7EC JR NZ,$B7F8   ;
 $B7EE LD A,L        ;
 $B7EF ADD A,$20     ;
 $B7F1 LD L,A        ;
 $B7F2 JR C,$B7F8    ;
 $B7F4 LD A,H        ;
 $B7F5 SUB $08       ;
 $B7F7 LD H,A        ; }
*$B7F8 DJNZ $B7DD    ; loop B rows
 $B7FA JP $B863      ; done -> restore SP
*$B7FD POP DE        ; --- 2-cell-wide variant ---
 $B7FE LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B7FF AND E         ;
 $B800 OR D          ;
 $B801 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B802 INC L         ;
 $B803 POP DE        ;
 $B804 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B805 AND E         ;
 $B806 OR D          ;
 $B807 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B808 DEC L         ;
 $B809 INC H         ;
 $B80A POP DE        ;
 $B80B LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B80C AND E         ;
 $B80D OR D          ;
 $B80E LD (HL),A     ;
 $B80F INC L         ;
 $B810 POP DE        ;
 $B811 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B812 AND E         ;
 $B813 OR D          ;
 $B814 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B815 DEC L         ;
 $B816 INC H         ;
 $B817 LD A,H        ; {wrap to next screen row
 $B818 AND $07       ;
 $B81A JR NZ,$B826   ;
 $B81C LD A,L        ;
 $B81D ADD A,$20     ;
 $B81F LD L,A        ;
 $B820 JR C,$B826    ;
 $B822 LD A,H        ;
 $B823 SUB $08       ;
 $B825 LD H,A        ; }
*$B826 DJNZ $B7FD    ; loop B rows
 $B828 JP $B863      ;
*$B82B POP DE        ; --- 3-cell-wide variant ---
 $B82C LD C,L        ;
 $B82D LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B82E AND E         ;
 $B82F OR D          ;
 $B830 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B831 INC L         ;
 $B832 POP DE        ;
 $B833 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B834 AND E         ;
 $B835 OR D          ;
 $B836 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B837 INC L         ;
 $B838 POP DE        ;
 $B839 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B83A AND E         ;
 $B83B OR D          ;
 $B83C LD (HL),A     ;
 $B83D LD L,C        ;
 $B83E INC H         ;
 $B83F POP DE        ;
 $B840 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B841 AND E         ;
 $B842 OR D          ;
 $B843 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B844 INC L         ;
 $B845 POP DE        ;
 $B846 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B847 AND E         ;
 $B848 OR D          ;
 $B849 LD (HL),A     ;
 $B84A INC L         ;
 $B84B POP DE        ;
 $B84C LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B84D AND E         ;
 $B84E OR D          ;
 $B84F LD (HL),A     ;
 $B850 LD L,C        ;
 $B851 INC H         ;
 $B852 LD A,H        ; {wrap to next screen row
 $B853 AND $07       ;
 $B855 JR NZ,$B861   ;
 $B857 LD A,L        ;
 $B858 ADD A,$20     ;
 $B85A LD L,A        ;
 $B85B JR C,$B861    ;
 $B85D LD A,H        ;
 $B85E SUB $08       ;
 $B860 LD H,A        ; }
*$B861 DJNZ $B82B    ; loop B rows
*$B863 LD SP,($6000) ; get Temporary place for SP
 $B867 EI            ; {EI; RET
 $B868 RET           ; }

; Actor screen y
;
; Used by the routines at #R$A700 and #R$B74D.
;
; .
;
; Object-table counterpart of col_screen_y: map an actor's angular column
; (IX+0)+$20, minus tower_height rotation, wrapped (AND $7F), through
; col_y_table to a screen row also derives the object index ((IX low)-$5B).
; .
; Clobbers: A,DE,HL.
@label=actor_screen_y
c$B869 LD A,(IX+$00) ; {angular column + $20, minus tower rotation, wrapped
 $B86C ADD A,$20     ;
 $B86E LD HL,$60B9   ;
 $B871 SUB (HL)      ;
 $B872 AND $7F       ; }
 $B874 LD E,A        ;
 $B875 LD D,$00      ;
 $B877 LD HL,$6380   ; {HL -> col_y_table[rel]
 $B87A ADD HL,DE     ; }
 $B87B PUSH IX       ; {object index = (IX low) - $5B
 $B87D POP DE        ;
 $B87E LD A,E        ;
 $B87F SUB $5B       ;
 $B881 LD E,A        ; }
 $B882 CP $04        ;
 $B884 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $B885 JR NZ,$B889   ;
 $B887 ADD A,$02     ;
*$B889 ADD A,A       ; {scale/bias -> store projected value ($60A6)
 $B88A ADD A,$78     ;
 $B88C LD ($60A6),A  ; }
 $B88F LD A,(IX+$06) ;
 $B892 LD HL,$6030   ;
 $B895 SUB (HL)      ;
 $B896 ADD A,A       ;
 $B897 LD C,A        ;
 $B898 LD A,$A8      ;
 $B89A SUB C         ;
 $B89B LD C,A        ;
 $B89C LD A,E        ;
 $B89D CP $04        ;
 $B89F LD A,C        ;
 $B8A0 JR NZ,$B8A4   ;
 $B8A2 ADD A,$08     ;
*$B8A4 LD ($60A8),A  ;
 $B8A7 RET           ;

; Draw pending sprite
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; If flag_b5cb is set, consume it and draw the one-shot sprite queued at
; #R$B5CC (pos) / #R$B5CE (id), with on-screen bounds checks.
; .
; RET immediately when nothing queued.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,HL.
@label=draw_pending_sprite
c$B8A8 LD A,($B5CB)  ; {flag_b5cb set? consume it, else RET
 $B8AB OR A          ;
 $B8AC RET Z         ; }
 $B8AD XOR A         ;
 $B8AE LD ($B5CB),A  ;
 $B8B1 LD HL,($B5CC) ; {HL = queued pos, B = queued sprite id
 $B8B4 LD A,($B5CE)  ;
 $B8B7 LD B,A        ; }
 $B8B8 LD A,L        ; {bounds check: column edge cases (row 7..$17 skip)
 $B8B9 CP $07        ;
 $B8BB JR C,$B8C0    ;
 $B8BD CP $17        ;
 $B8BF RET C         ; }
*$B8C0 CP $1E        ; {bounds check: row < $1E
 $B8C2 RET NC        ; }
 $B8C3 LD C,$02      ; {C=2 (default cell count); row<5 -> $B8DE
 $B8C5 CP $05        ;
 $B8C7 JR C,$B8DE    ; }
 $B8C9 JR Z,$B8E3    ; {row==6 or edge cases -> adjust C (1 or 3 cells)
 $B8CB DEC C         ;
 $B8CC CP $06        ;
 $B8CE JR Z,$B8E3    ;
 $B8D0 CP $17        ;
 $B8D2 JR NZ,$B8D7   ;
 $B8D4 LD A,B        ;
 $B8D5 OR A          ;
 $B8D6 RET Z         ; }
*$B8D7 INC C         ; {adjust cell count near right/bottom edge
 $B8D8 CP $19        ;
 $B8DA JR NC,$B8DE   ;
 $B8DC INC L         ;
 $B8DD DEC C         ; }
*$B8DE LD A,B        ; {sprite id (B)!=0? bump C for extra cell
 $B8DF OR A          ;
 $B8E0 JR Z,$B8E3    ;
 $B8E2 INC C         ; }
*$B8E3 CALL $B5D9    ; Get screen addr
 $B8E6 LD B,$08      ; {B=8 rows, D=0 (erase byte)
 $B8E8 LD D,$00      ; }
 $B8EA DEC C         ; {C selects erase width: 1/2/3-cell
 $B8EB JR Z,$B8F3    ;
 $B8ED DEC C         ;
 $B8EE JR Z,$B909    ;
 $B8F0 JP $B923      ; }
*$B8F3 LD (HL),D     ; {--- 1-cell erase: write+wrap to next row ---
 $B8F4 INC H         ;
 $B8F5 LD (HL),D     ;
 $B8F6 INC H         ;
 $B8F7 LD A,H        ;
 $B8F8 AND $07       ;
 $B8FA JR NZ,$B906   ;
 $B8FC LD A,L        ;
 $B8FD ADD A,$20     ;
 $B8FF LD L,A        ;
 $B900 JR C,$B906    ;
 $B902 LD A,H        ;
 $B903 SUB $08       ;
 $B905 LD H,A        ;
*$B906 DJNZ $B8F3    ;
 $B908 RET           ; }
*$B909 LD (HL),D     ; {--- 2-cell erase: write+wrap to next row ---
 $B90A INC L         ;
 $B90B LD (HL),D     ;
 $B90C INC H         ;
 $B90D LD (HL),D     ;
 $B90E DEC L         ;
 $B90F LD (HL),D     ;
 $B910 INC H         ;
 $B911 LD A,H        ;
 $B912 AND $07       ;
 $B914 JR NZ,$B920   ;
 $B916 LD A,L        ;

; Setup strip draw
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Patches the tower column-strip blitter's params (row #R$B941/$B9A1, column
; base $B942, source pointer $B944) from disp_height/scroll_pos (bit2 selects
; the $24/$2C column phase).
; .
; Then walks up to 10 elements, stamping a placeholder byte ($18) onto any
; still-blank screen cell before #R$B9D6 draws the real graphics. SELF-MOD.
@label=setup_strip_draw
c$B965 LD B,A        ; B = source row index (actor)
 $B966 LD A,($6032)  ; get Display height
 $B969 LD ($B941),A  ; {patch $B941/$B9A1 = row; C = $24 (column-phase base)
 $B96C LD ($B9A1),A  ;
 $B96F LD C,$24      ; }
 $B971 LD A,($6030)  ; get Vertical scroll position
 $B974 BIT 2,A       ; {phase 2 -> C = $2C, row -= 1
 $B976 JR Z,$B97B    ;
 $B978 LD C,$2C      ;
 $B97A DEC B         ; }
*$B97B AND $03       ; {column = (scroll&3)*2 + phase base; patch $B942
 $B97D ADD A,A       ;
 $B97E ADD A,C       ;
 $B97F LD C,A        ;
 $B980 LD ($B942),A  ; }
 $B983 LD A,($6030)  ; get Vertical scroll position
 $B986 RRA           ; {E = row offset within strip (0-15, inverted)
 $B987 RRA           ;
 $B988 RRA           ;
 $B989 XOR $0F       ;
 $B98B AND $0F       ;
 $B98D LD E,A        ;
 $B98E LD D,$00      ; }
 $B990 LD HL,$B945   ; {patch source pointer $B944 = table + row offset
 $B993 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $B994 LD ($B944),HL ; }
 $B997 EX DE,HL      ; {H = column base; shadow B = row count; B = 10
 $B998 LD H,C        ; (elements)
 $B999 LD A,B        ;
 $B99A EXX           ;
 $B99B LD B,A        ;
 $B99C EXX           ;
 $B99D LD B,$0A      ; }
*$B99F LD A,(DE)     ; {read element byte; skip if >= $1C (blank)
 $B9A0 SUB $00       ;
 $B9A2 AND $3F       ;
 $B9A4 CP $1C        ;
 $B9A6 JR NC,$B9C7   ; }
 $B9A8 EXX           ; {shadow-row flag gates a narrow skip range
 $B9A9 BIT 7,B       ;
 $B9AB EXX           ;
 $B9AC JR Z,$B9B6    ;
 $B9AE CP $08        ;
 $B9B0 JR C,$B9B6    ;
 $B9B2 CP $14        ;
 $B9B4 JR C,$B9C7    ; }
*$B9B6 ADD A,$02     ; {L = element*2+2; C = H (save row)
 $B9B8 LD L,A        ;
 $B9B9 LD C,H        ; }
 $B9BA CALL $B5D9    ; Get screen addr
 $B9BD LD A,(HL)     ; {empty screen byte -> stamp placeholder $18 (both rows)
 $B9BE OR A          ;
 $B9BF JR NZ,$B9C6   ;
 $B9C1 LD (HL),$18   ;
 $B9C3 INC H         ;
 $B9C4 LD (HL),$18   ;
*$B9C6 LD H,C        ; }
*$B9C7 INC DE        ; {advance element; stop at screen bottom; loop 10 times
 $B9C8 LD A,H        ;
 $B9C9 ADD A,$10     ;
 $B9CB LD H,A        ;
 $B9CC CP $B8        ;
 $B9CE RET NC        ;
 $B9CF EXX           ;
 $B9D0 DEC B         ;
 $B9D1 DEC B         ;
 $B9D2 EXX           ;
 $B9D3 DJNZ $B99F    ;
 $B9D5 RET           ; }

; Draw tower strip
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Blit one vertical column strip of up to 10 tower elements using the params
; patched by setup_strip_draw resolves each cell's screen address via
; get_screen_addr.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,DE,HL.
@label=draw_tower_strip
c$B9D6 LD DE,($B944) ; DE = tower-cell source data
 $B9DA LD HL,($B941) ; HL = screen row/col params
 $B9DD LD B,$0A      ; B = 10 (elements per strip)
 $B9DF LD A,($B941)  ; A = starting row param
 $B9E2 LD ($B9E7),A  ; stash it as the erase-check row
*$B9E5 LD A,(DE)     ; A = next cell descriptor byte
 $B9E6 SUB $00       ; self-mod bias (patched per column)
 $B9E8 AND $3F       ; mask to cell type/shape bits
 $B9EA CP $1C        ; {out-of-range shape? -> skip draw
 $B9EC JR NC,$BA03   ; }
 $B9EE ADD A,$02     ; A += 2 (glyph offset)
 $B9F0 LD L,A        ;
 $B9F1 LD C,H        ;
 $B9F2 CALL $B5D9    ; Get screen addr
 $B9F5 LD A,$18      ; A = $18 (erase-check marker)
 $B9F7 CP (HL)       ; {top byte matches marker?
 $B9F8 JR NZ,$BA02   ; }
 $B9FA INC H         ; check the row below too
 $B9FB CP (HL)       ;
 $B9FC JR NZ,$BA02   ;
 $B9FE XOR A         ; {both match -> erase this cell (clear 2 bytes)
 $B9FF LD (HL),A     ; }
 $BA00 DEC H         ;
 $BA01 LD (HL),A     ;
*$BA02 LD H,C        ;
*$BA03 INC DE        ; advance source pointer
 $BA04 LD A,H        ; {step to the next screen row (+$10, wrap check)
 $BA05 ADD A,$10     ;
 $BA07 LD H,A        ; }
 $BA08 CP $B8        ;
 $BA0A RET NC        ; past the bottom -> RET
 $BA0B DJNZ $B9E5    ; loop 10 elements
 $BA0D RET           ;
 $BA0E LD B,A        ;
 $BA0F LD B,(HL)     ;
 $BA10 LD B,L        ;
 $BA11 LD B,H        ;
 $BA12 LD B,A        ;
 $BA13 LD B,(HL)     ;
 $BA14 LD B,L        ;
 $BA15 LD B,H        ;

; Routine at BA16
;
; Used by the routines at #R$B587, #R$BA26 and #R$BA67.
@label=lookup_col_attr
c$BA16 PUSH DE       ;
 $BA17 PUSH HL       ;
 $BA18 LD A,($6039)  ; get Level number 0
 $BA1B LD L,A        ;
 $BA1C LD H,$00      ;
 $BA1E LD DE,$BA0E   ;
 $BA21 ADD HL,DE     ;
 $BA22 LD A,(HL)     ;
 $BA23 POP HL        ;
 $BA24 POP DE        ;
 $BA25 RET           ;

; Paint tower attrs
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Repaint the tower's attribute (colour) band in the $58xx attribute file from
; $5860, using lookup_col_attr (#R$BA16) for per-column colours and fill_run
; ($BA61) to lay rows.
; .
; SELF-MOD: #R$BA66 row count.
; .
; Clobbers: A,BC,D,HL.
@label=paint_tower_attrs
c$BA26 LD A,$0E      ; {self-mod row count = $0E
 $BA28 LD ($BA66),A  ; }
 $BA2B LD HL,$5860   ; HL -> attribute band base ($5860)
 $BA2E LD B,$20      ;
 $BA30 XOR A         ; {D = 0 (edge/border colour)
 $BA31 LD D,A        ; }
 $BA32 CALL $BA61    ; fill_run: paint the left edge
 $BA35 LD C,$0B      ; C = $0B (column count)
*$BA37 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA38 INC HL        ;
 $BA39 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA3A INC HL        ;
 $BA3B LD B,$1C      ;
 $BA3D CALL $BA16    ; lookup_col_attr: colour for this column
 $BA40 CALL $BA61    ; fill_run: paint this column's rows
 $BA43 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA44 INC HL        ;
 $BA45 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA46 INC HL        ;
 $BA47 DEC C         ; {loop C columns
 $BA48 JR NZ,$BA37   ; }
 $BA4A LD C,$08      ;
*$BA4C LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA4D INC HL        ;
 $BA4E LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA4F INC HL        ;
 $BA50 LD B,$1C      ;
 $BA52 LD A,$41      ;
 $BA54 CALL $BA61    ;
 $BA57 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA58 INC HL        ;
 $BA59 LD (HL),D     ;
 $BA5A INC HL        ;
 $BA5B DEC C         ;
 $BA5C JR NZ,$BA4C   ;
 $BA5E LD B,$20      ;
 $BA60 XOR A         ;
@label=fill_run
*$BA61 LD (HL),A     ;
 $BA62 INC HL        ;
 $BA63 DJNZ $BA61    ;
 $BA65 RET           ;

; Unused
s$BA66 DEFS $01

; Scroll tower attrs
;
; Used by the routine at #R$A700.
;
; .
;
; Adjust the painted attribute band as scroll_pos advances (compares against
; the #R$BA66 latch set by paint_tower_attrs) so colours track the scrolling
; tower.
; .
; Clobbers: A,B,HL.
@label=scroll_tower_attrs
c$BA67 LD HL,($6030) ; HL = scroll_pos
 $BA6A LD A,H        ; {top-of-tower page (H==3)?
 $BA6B CP $03        ; }
 $BA6D LD A,$16      ; A = $16 (default row index)
 $BA6F JR NZ,$BA7C   ;
 $BA71 LD A,L        ; A = scroll_pos low byte
 $BA72 NEG           ; negate (count down from top)
 $BA74 RRA           ; {/4, mask to row range
 $BA75 RRA           ;
 $BA76 AND $0F       ; }
 $BA78 SUB $16       ; bias by -$16
 $BA7A NEG           ; negate back
*$BA7C LD B,A        ; B = target row index
 $BA7D LD A,($BA66)  ; A = previous row index (#R$BA66 latch)
 $BA80 SUB B         ; delta = new - previous
 $BA81 JR Z,$BA94    ; unchanged? -> just update latch, RET
 $BA83 CP $FF        ; delta == -1 (scrolled up one row)?
 $BA85 JR Z,$BA99    ;
 $BA87 CP $01        ; delta == +1 (scrolled down one row)?
 $BA89 JR NZ,$BA94   ;
 $BA8B LD A,B        ; {store new row index in latch
 $BA8C LD ($BA66),A  ; }
 $BA8F INC B         ; B++ (paint the row below)
 $BA90 LD C,$41      ; C = $41 (default attribute)
 $BA92 JR $BAA1      ;
*$BA94 LD A,B        ;
 $BA95 LD ($BA66),A  ;
 $BA98 RET           ;
*$BA99 LD A,B        ; {store new row index in latch
 $BA9A LD ($BA66),A  ; }
 $BA9D CALL $BA16    ; recompute the attribute for this column via
                     ; lookup_col_attr
 $BAA0 LD C,A        ;
*$BAA1 LD L,B        ; {HL = B * 32 (attribute row address)
 $BAA2 LD H,$00      ;
 $BAA4 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $BAA5 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $BAA6 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $BAA7 ADD HL,HL     ;
 $BAA8 ADD HL,HL     ; }
 $BAA9 LD DE,$5802   ; DE = $5802 (attribute area base + offset)
 $BAAC ADD HL,DE     ;
 $BAAD LD B,$1C      ; B = $1C (28 columns)
*$BAAF LD (HL),C     ; {fill one attribute row with C, loop
 $BAB0 INC HL        ;
 $BAB1 DJNZ $BAAF    ; }
 $BAB3 RET           ;
